chapters.title: Chapter 51: Breaking Through Shackles! Reaching the Limit
paragraphs: It’s agility!
Agility has astonishingly reached 20 points.
Moreover, there’s a hint message appearing after agility.
Ding Ling opened it with a thought, only to see what’s written:
[Agility has once again shattered its shackles! Training Low-tier Martial Arts hardly increases Agile Power anymore!]
Ding Ling studied this carefully for a while and suddenly realized.
After agility reached 20 points.
Ding Ling’s speed can be said to have completely broken through a mortal’s limit!
For ordinary mortals to run a hundred meters in nine seconds is almost impossible.
But Ding Ling can now easily run it in eight seconds!
Moreover, unlike ordinary people who tire quickly, his stamina, explosive power, and leap ability are extremely strong!
Agility not only concerns speed but also includes reaction time, jumping ability, explosive power, etc.
When agility reaches a certain level, wanting to increase it further requires obtaining a higher-tier cultivation technique!
If otherwise.
Even if he learns Low-tier Techniques, they can only serve as a foundation, acting as resources for continuous enhancement.
"For ordinary people, at this stage, they would definitely give up learning Low-tier Techniques, but I’m different. I can cheat the system."
Ding Ling thought:
"I can completely learn all Low-tier Techniques and turn them into my foundation."
He believes that as long as the foundation is rich enough.
Someday, there will be a day when grains form towers and streams form rivers!
"How’s it going?"
Tong Yuan noticed Ding Ling’s unusually long silence this time, thinking he hadn’t mastered Eight Trigrams Palm, and offered some comfort:
"This Eight Trigrams Palm stems from Fuxi’s Eight Trigrams, very hard to learn. If you haven’t grasped it in a moment, don’t worry. You should know that I spent a great deal of effort to learn it..."
"Senior."
Ding Ling looked at Tong Yuan with a slightly odd expression, coughed lightly, and said in a low voice:
"I’ve already comprehended Eight Trigrams Palm fully."
"Hmm?!"
Tong Yuan’s expression froze, unable to continue with his comforting words, and after a moment, he said softly:
"You’ve comprehended it fully, why do you still seem like this?"
"I feel like I’ve broken through a barrier, so I’ve been deep in contemplation,"
Ding Ling explained.
Tong Yuan looked at Ding Ling closely, even touching his bones directly, and after a while said:
"Indeed, the skin, meridians, and bones of your legs have strengthened considerably, even more than twenty times beyond ordinary people! No wonder you can break through the barrier."
He then asked Ding Ling to demonstrate Eight Trigrams Palm.

Ding Ling nodded, moved his figure, and his two hands seemed to weave through the air like flowers, shifting and striking back and forth, reaching an extreme where you could faintly see an Eight Trigrams pattern forming in the space.
At this moment, Tong Yuan completely believed in what Ding Ling said.
He marveled unceasingly, even beginning to feel somewhat numb.
Ding Ling’s talent is beyond expression with words now.

"Next, I’ll teach you Iron Sand Palm, Lion Palm, and Python Palm. Although I know them, I’m not proficient, mainly because I think it’s unnecessary to invest time in practicing such Low-tier Martial Arts. If you want to learn, I’ll pass them on to you. Of course, since I’m not proficient myself.
I may not explain them very intricately.
I can only narrate the original text of these three techniques one by one."
"I’ll learn!"
Ding Ling replied decisively.
"Good."
Tong Yuan immediately began teaching Lion Palm.
Ding Ling listened to the description.
Closed his eyes slightly, and various details about Lion Palm flickered in his mind.
Afterward...
A book titled "Lion Palm" appeared on the library shelf!
Almost at the same time.
[Lion Palm Full Level]
[Strength +1.1]
[Agility +0]
[Constitution +1.1]
[Defense +0.2]
Ding Ling felt his strength and constitution surge significantly.
Although Lion Palm is far inferior to the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear, it does have its unique aspects.
If Ding Ling’s agility hadn’t already broken the barrier and failed to increase Agile Power further, this Lion Palm surely could have increased quite a bit of agility.
Although agility didn’t increase, a line for defense appeared instead.
Ding Ling felt puzzled and saw that there was an explanation after the defense +, so he clicked to view it.
After a while.
He understood:
"Ultimately, a technique that is mostly skill-based can upgrade a maximum of three physical attributes. Now that agility is no longer moving, defense naturally can rise."
The meaning is simple.
To put it plainly:
The energy once allocated for agility is now shifting to defense.
However, due to considerable energy loss during the shifting process, the defense points will inevitably be lacking.
Unless practicing defensive kung fu like Golden Bell Shield and Iron Cloth Shirt, in which case there certainly won’t be any loss of defense points.
’I see.’
Ding Ling was relieved, no longer worried.
He can certainly practice most kung fu.
With Tong Yuan’s Hundred Schools of Martial Arts, if learned fully.
He estimates strength, agility, constitution, defense should consecutively break barriers.
Even if the shifting of energy to defense causes some loss.
But the quantity is more than enough to make up for all this.
Whoosh whoosh!
Ding Ling moved like a fierce lion, his palms creating a powerful gust of wind, reaching the pinnacle of overbearing aura, like a lion roaring on the grassland!
Accompanied by an imposing presence!
"Excellent!"
Tong Yuan applauded, exclaiming:
"Even I haven’t mastered the essence of Lion Palm! Unexpectedly, Ding Ling, by merely hearing it once, you’ve incorporated it into your instinct. Such talent truly is born as the Martial God!"
He viewed Ding Ling with eyes more and more like looking at a treasure.

Zhao Yun increasingly felt insignificant, as Ding Ling mastered each technique quickly, whereas he would feel accomplished if in such a short time he could understand thoroughly, not to mention mastering it.
Comparing with Ding Ling.
Zhao Yun felt like an ant, while Ding Ling seemed like a deity.
He even found himself beginning to look up to Ding Ling!
Of course.
He also remembered his master’s advice not to compare with Ding Ling. Otherwise, any confidence would collapse!
"Next I’ll teach you Python Palm! Like before, I only have the moves and text. I won’t add unnecessary explanations."
After realizing explanations were useless.
Tong Yuan proceeded with narrating the text and demonstrating the moves.
Ding Ling watched once.
Immediately after.
A book titled "Python Palm" was added to the library!
[Python Palm Full Level]
[Strength +0.9]
[Agility +0]
[Constitution +0.9]
[Defense +0.2]
Whoosh whoosh!

Ding Ling grasped everything about Python Palm, his hands at this moment seemed transformed into a massive venomous python, full of Evil Qi, striking into the air, and burrowing like a python threading through space, with mouth agape ready to devour.
Tong Yuan couldn’t help but feel his heart race:

"As expected, he succeeded again! Ding Ling actually doesn’t need explanations, he just needs to receive a martial arts secret manual, and he can quickly learn and turn it into instinct! This, this kind of talent..."
Tong Yuan was so shocked his hands and feet trembled slightly.
It was the first time he truly realized:
Ding Ling might be even more of a genius than he initially imagined, even more peerless!
To verify his guess.

chapters.title: Chapter 52: Talent Surpassing the Chosen Ones of the Era
paragraphs: The transmission of the Iron Sand Palm.
Tong Yuan recited the content of the original martial arts secret manual he had memorized, without adding any personal interpretation to it.
He wanted to see if, even under such circumstances, Ding Ling could quickly master the Iron Sand Palm.
Ding Ling was unaware of Tong Yuan’s thoughts.
He continued to imitate methodically.
In an instant.
[Iron Sand Palm Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0]
[Constitution +0.8]
[Defense +0.5]
Crack!
Snap!
At the moment the Iron Sand Palm reached full level, Ding Ling’s bones made a crisp sound again.
He knew that the shackles of his body were broken again.
This time it was strength and agility!
He glanced at his Character Panel:
[Power: [Bone Root 1 (normal humans at 1 point), Wisdom 2, Strength 17.8+1.1+0.9+0.2=(20), Agility 20, Constitution 17.2+1.1+0.9+0.8(20), Defense 2+0.2+0.2+0.5(2.9), Charisma 3]
Indeed.
Strength, constitution, and agility all reached the limit of 20 points.
Strength reached a terrifying level of two thousand jin!
A casual punch could easily kill a small cow!
If martial arts techniques were added to exert two thousand jin, Ding Ling could easily kill a full-grown bull!
Ding Ling had reached his current level of power.
It could be said that with every gesture, he possessed the great strength of a thousand jin, making him a veritable Divine General!
Furthermore, because his constitution reached 20 points,
His endurance and stamina became particularly long-lasting, allowing him to maintain peak condition for an entire day and night during battle!
This is the benefit of constitution reaching its limit!
The advantage of agility needs no further explanation, enabling Ding Ling to punch, thrust a spear, or swing a sword at the fastest speed!
If one’s strength and constitution matched Ding Ling’s but their agility was inferior, they might be defeated in just a few moves due to Ding Ling’s advantage of speed!
All three attributes reached their limits!
Ding Ling felt an immense sense of freedom and ease throughout his body, as an indescribable sense of power flowed through his limbs and bones.
Following this was an overwhelming sense of hunger that swept over him like a tidal wave!
Ding Ling knew this was a side effect of continuously enhancing himself.
He shared this with Tong Yuan.
Tong Yuan was shocked and trembled, thinking:

"Ding Ling really can master martial arts to the Transformation Realm with just a secret manual, in an instant without any explanation! Such talent, such comprehension, such innate ability... is this even human? The Son of the Era is absolutely inferior to him!"
Son of the Era, Chiyou and Yellow Emperor.
These are the two most well-known and terrifying titans passed down through history!
But even these two titans, Tong Yuan believed, could not be as powerful as Ding Ling!
At least, in terms of martial arts talent!
"Could Ding Ling’s potential surpass that of the ancient Yellow Emperor and Chiyou?!"
Tong Yuan’s heart was pounding rapidly.
He had a premonition.
He was about to witness the rise of a legend!
Tong Yuan actively took Zhao Yun and Ding Ling hunting together!
The mountains and forests were filled with wild beasts.
All three were peerless masters.
Working together.
They killed two bears and a tiger and carried them back to Penglai Mountain.
Penglai Mountain was originally nameless.
It was called Penglai Mountain because the Penglai Spear God resided there.
The players saw that Ding Ling, in just a few days, had gained such importance to Tong Yuan.
Even to the extent that Tong Yuan took the initiative to help with hunting!
This was unprecedented!
It made all the players drop their jaws in astonishment.
"This Ding Ling is indeed from a hidden clan, truly extraordinary!"

"We have been here for so long without meeting Tong Yuan. Not only did Ding Ling meet him upon arrival, but they seem to be on such good terms. I seriously suspect that Tong Yuan has taught Ding Ling his supreme skills!"
With these words,
The players on Penglai Mountain were envious and jealous to the extreme!
They were extremely envious!
The most feared comparison is with others.
Comparing with Ding Ling,
The sense of disparity was instant.
Many players couldn’t bear this ’psychological’ blow! Each one became distracted during martial arts training, needing several rebukes from their ’masters’ before they became serious again.
After returning to the mountain, Ding Ling started grilling.
The few of them worked together.
The speed was naturally fast.
After a while.
Ding Ling felt utterly satisfied after eating and drinking.
Comparing eating instant noodles and bread in the real world with eating various beast and wild animal meat in this game world.
The feeling was completely different.
"Shall we continue to practice martial arts?"
Tong Yuan stared at Ding Ling with bright eyes.
At this moment, his mindset differed entirely from before.
After realizing Ding Ling’s martial arts talent was even more frightening than the Son of the Era!
Tong Yuan was exceptionally enthusiastic and proactive with Ding Ling.
He originally harbored absolute doubt that someone in the mortal world could achieve Martial God status.
But now Ding Ling gave him a glimmer of hope!
Perhaps Ding Ling could recreate the myths of the ancient era’s Chiyou and Yellow Emperor?
"Of course."
Ding Ling nodded and said.
"Good."
Tong Yuan stood up.

"I’ve taught you all the body techniques and palm techniques I know. Next, I’ll teach you fist techniques. I know four complete versions: Mantis Fist, Wind Gate Fist, Kongmen Fist, and Cai Family Fist.
I also have many incomplete ones.
But as time has passed without practice, I’ve forgotten some heart techniques, remembering only some moves roughly.
I’ll teach you everything, how much you can remember and learn is up to you.
In any case, I haven’t mastered or learned the vast majority."
After speaking.
Tong Yuan began demonstrating the Mantis Fist.
His punches were as fast as the wind and lightning, like a mantis striking, always aiming for a lethal move! Each punch was extremely sharp, targeting vital points!
Tong Yuan did not explain anything.
He merely practiced the techniques and recited the manual systematically.
After a moment.
He stopped and looked at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling closed his eyes.
In his sea of consciousness flashed the scenes just witnessed.
A book instantly condensed on the library shelf: "Mantis Fist!"
In an instant.
[Mantis Fist Full Level]
[Strength +0]
[Agility +0]
[Constitution +0]
[Defense +0.8]
It was evident that Mantis Fist was also low-tier martial arts, not high tier.
So it couldn’t further enhance Ding Ling’s strength, agility, or constitution attribute points.
However, the energy from these three merged into the defense attribute, though slightly worn down,
It still increased defense by as much as 0.8 points.
After the defense increase.
Ding Ling felt a significant change, as if his skin and organs were imperceptibly forged by a mysterious energy!
Becoming increasingly tough, strong, and invincible!
Ding Ling was ecstatic; such strong defense and such an obvious effect!
If it continues to develop, will he be able to withstand arrows in the future without any problem?
Exhale!
Ding Ling took a deep breath and started practicing the Mantis Fist.
Bang!
With a punch, both power and speed were combined, making even the air seem to thunder!

chapters.title: Chapter 53: The Ten Methods of Weapon Attack and Defense
paragraphs: Ding Ling completed a full set of Mantis Fist techniques, which were as graceful and artistic as a work of art.
Zhao Yun was amazed, and thoroughly gave up the idea of competing with Ding Ling!
He began to learn from Zhao Xiaoyiu and Zhao Bingxuan, looking at Ding Ling with eyes as if he were a towering mountain or a divine spirit!
"He truly mastered it and turned it into instinct."
Tong Yuan was already mentally prepared and didn’t think much about it, directly teaching the next set of techniques.
One set after another.
Ding Ling was unsurprisingly quick to learn each one and reached full level!
[Wind Gate Fist Full Level]
[Strength +0]
[Agility +0]
[Constitution +0]
[Defense +0.6]
[Kongmen Fist Full Level]
[Defense +0.9]
[Cai Family Fist Full Level]
[Defense +0.6]
The strongest was the Kongmen Fist, rumored to be a Confucian Boxing created by the Confucian Saint Confucius himself, both holy and kingly inside and outside, for self-cultivation and enemy killing!
A boxing technique that is both elegant and fierce!
It is said that to turn this boxing technique into instinct and integrate it into your limbs, you must diligently study Confucius’ teachings and reach the realm of a Confucian Half-Saint!
Tong Yuan was deeply aware of the difficulty of this method.
He gave up after reaching the entry level.
However, despite this.
Ding Ling still instantly reached full level!
A set of Kongmen Fist performed impressed Tong Yuan and others with a true fusion of lethal force and the Confucian Dao passed down by the Confucius Family!
"Incredible!"
Zhao Yun was dazzled and overwhelmed.
Ding Ling learning boxing techniques, palm techniques, and body techniques, was truly one after another, without stopping.
Could Zhao Yun say that he now remembered very few of the heart method mantras and techniques?
What about Ding Ling?
Completely mastered and entered the Transformation Realm!
"No wonder Zhao Bingxuan holds him in such high regard!"
Zhao Yun looked at Ding Ling with increasing surprise and admiration.
This was the instinctual reaction to admire a strong person.
"Good!"
Tong Yuan applauded and praised.
Next, several incomplete sets of boxing techniques were practiced.
Ding Ling again instantly reached full level!
However, because these incomplete sets were not complete versions, some were even just showy moves without heart methods.
Even though Ding Ling reached full level, his progress was not significant.
[Defense +0.1]
This was the final result.
It can only be said that incomplete sets are indeed incomplete.
But even so, it was better than nothing.
Tong Yuan was becoming increasingly satisfied.
Because he discovered that even with the incomplete sets, Ding Ling could reach a stage he couldn’t achieve in a short time!
Such talent, comprehension, and understanding! Truly a blessing from heaven and earth!
"Next, I’ll teach you the Saber Technique."
Tong Yuan took a piece of deadwood as a saber:

"In all its changes, it never abandons its root. At my level, even decayed wood can transform into a weapon with extraordinary power. Watch closely. Next, I’ll demonstrate the Cloud Strike Saber Technique! This saber technique, when cultivated to the Realm of Great Success and Wishes, can materialize from thin air, attacking like a white cloud floating in the air, indefensible and unpredictable..."
Tong Yuan spoke for a while.
Then he started to practice it.
As usual, he just followed the texts without explaining the esoteric truths.
Ding Ling’s talent needed no explanation, so naturally, he did not waste time doing that.
After one round.
Various saber techniques and heart methods flashed through Ding Ling’s mind.
The library shelves were then filled with another book: "Cloud Strike Saber Technique"!
Instantly.
[Cloud Strike Saber Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.2]
It’s obviously a higher tier Martial Arts than Mantis Fist and Kongmen Fist!
This is a true high-tier Martial Arts.
Remarkably, it allowed Ding Ling’s strength, agility, and constitution to reach new heights!
Although the progress was not large.
But at Ding Ling’s level, every bit of improvement is a huge victory.
Thump!

He felt that his strength had increased a little more, wielding a long spear, using the spear as a saber, and executing the saber technique of the Cloud Strike Saber Technique, even creating illusions, finally unleashing chaotic strikes, as if condensing a strip of white cloud.
"This saber technique is so strong."
Zhao Yun was shaken.
Tong Yuan praised:

"Truly remarkable. To master such a high-difficulty saber technique so quickly without explanation means that the lower difficulty Shield Attack Technique, Halberd Technique, and others should be no problem for you."

Next, Tong Yuan sequentially taught Ding Ling: Halberd Technique, Spear Technique, Sword Technique, Hammer Technique, Whip Technique, Fork Technique, Staff Technique, Shield Attack Technique, Axe Technique.
Each was far inferior to the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear Technique.
Even less than the Cloud Strike Saber Technique!
Thus, although Ding Ling learned more than a dozen complete versions of various weapon offense and defense techniques, and dozens of incomplete offense and defense techniques.
The final result was...
[Defense +6.1]
Despite this.
Ding Ling was already very satisfied.
Because now his power had undergone a significant transformation again:
[Power: Bone 1 (Normal person is 1 point), Wisdom 2, Strength 20.2, Agility 20.2, Constitution 20.2, Defense 2.9+0.8+0.6+0.9+0.6+0.1+6.1=(12), Charisma 3]
After breaking the 10-point defense.
Ding Ling broke through another bottleneck.
The refining of skin membranes and internal organs was extraordinary.
To this day, Ding Ling, even if pierced by an arrow, might not die. Of course, the premise is not to be pierced through the vital parts, such as the heart or head.
One can imagine how much his defense power has enhanced his body.
In terms of defense power, it is already several times that of ordinary people!
"Phew."
Ding Ling exhaled deeply, and his bones and meridians made crackling sounds, a sound heard only after reaching a certain level.
Gurgle!
The stomach gurgled again.
He was hungry.
Tong Yuan and Zhao Yun immediately took Ding Ling hunting again.
This time, they hunted three wild boars, a leopard, and a giant python!
Ding Ling carried two wild boars by himself.
On the road, many players were dumbfounded and tongue-tied seeing this scene:

"Ding Ling’s strength must be over a thousand pounds, right?! Carrying such big wild boars, not only carrying them but also walking so far and for so long, this endurance and stamina are truly exceptional!"
"Did this guy really learn some Unparalleled Divine Skill? Otherwise, how could he have changed so much in just a few days?!"
"Can you use some brains? How can someone learn an Unparalleled Divine Skill in a few days? Even martial arts novels aren’t that far-fetched!"
"...Brother. What Ding Ling did in Jizhou is well known. Does spraying at me help? If you have the guts, go question Ding Ling in person, go spray at other netizens!"
The players learning martial arts on Penglai Mountain were once again stunned by Ding Ling.
Especially the next day.
When they learned that Ding Ling had mastered martial arts and was about to go down the mountain, returning, it caused a frenzy!
"Damn! Ding Ling really mastered some Unparalleled Divine Skill!!"
"In just a few days! It feels so fantastic! One wouldn’t dare to dream of such a thing. How did Ding Ling do it? It’s unbelievable!"
"Without seeing it with my own eyes, I wouldn’t believe it anyway. It feels like a ridiculous rumor!"
The players were discussing heatedly.
Some believed;
Others didn’t;
Of course, there were also those just watching the spectacle.

chapters.title: Chapter 54: Sparring with Zhao Yun
paragraphs: After Ding Ling returned from hunting, Zhao Bingxuan and Zhao Xiaoyiu immediately came to help with the barbecue.
After eating and drinking their fill.
At the request of Tong Yuan and the others, Ding Ling began to demonstrate what he had learned on the mountain.
From halberd technique, spear technique, shield attack technique, to body technique, palm technique, fist technique, and then to Spirit Crane Spear Technique, Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear Technique...
Various martial arts masterpieces, transformations at will, offensive and defensive techniques in harmony!
Mysterious to an unbelievable realm.
Tong Yuan and his group watched in amazement! Feeling ashamed of their own skills!
"In just a few days, you have learned everything I’ve mastered in my life! And you’ve mastered it better than I have!"
Tong Yuan’s gaze towards Ding Ling grew increasingly satisfied.

At this moment, he completely regarded Ding Ling as a future Martial God. After accepting this, he was no longer depressed, instead feeling that it was normal for a Martial God like Ding Ling to learn martial arts skills to such an extent.
After all, he is a divine being among martial artists!
Once Ding Ling finished demonstrating.
Tong Yuan asked Zhao Yun to spar with Ding Ling.
Ding Ling’s eyes lit up.
His path of the War God requires competing with strong opponents from different planes, and Zhao Yun definitely meets the criteria.
Zhao Yun quickly waved his hand, reluctantly saying:
"I can’t compare to Brother Ding, let’s not spar."
Baffled by Ding Ling’s speed of learning martial arts, Zhao Yun’s mental imbalance left him lacking confidence to compete with Ding Ling.
"Just give it a try."
Seeing Ding Ling’s eagerness, Tong Yuan went along with it, saying:
"Zhao Yun, you’ve been on the mountain for too long; it’s time to compete with your peers, so as not to regard yourself as invincible and underestimate the heroes of the world."
Zhao Yun was speechless.
A few days ago, he was somewhat elevated by the praise of the ’alien,’ feeling rather conceited.
Although still steady, deep down he held the confidence that his master was the world’s number one, and he was the second.
With Ding Ling’s arrival.
This confidence was shattered; he no longer had the courage to spar with Ding Ling, knowing that if they faced off, he would surely lose.
But since the master said so.
He had no choice but to gather his spirits, rise up, grip his long spear, and stand opposite Ding Ling.
"To avoid injuring each other, use wooden sticks for sparring."
Tong Yuan instructed Zhao Xiaoyiu to fetch two light wooden sticks from the house, resembling white rods.
Ding Ling and Zhao Yun each took one.
Once both were standing again.
At Tong Yuan’s command ’Begin,’ both simultaneously struck at each other with Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear Technique.
Both of their Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear techniques were extremely swift!
Clang!
Clang clang clang!

Each thrust faster than the last, piercing the void as if igniting fireworks. To the naked eyes of Zhao Xiaoyiu and Zhao Bingxuan, the spear tips were imperceptible, only seeing starlight dazzling the sky, with crackling and bursting sounds cutting through the air!
The two fought fast against fast!
In just a moment, they exchanged over ten rounds!
In the void, the pattern of Hundred Birds Paying Homage to the Phoenix could faintly be seen flashing by!
The two white rods transformed into divine spears, manifesting infinite power.
Boom!
But with each collision, Zhao Yun felt as if struck by lightning.
He found his strength far inferior to Ding Ling. Whenever struck by the white rod, it felt like being hit by a thousand-pound hammer, suffocating and suppressing the urge to vomit blood.
Bam bam bam!
Another dozen rounds of clashes! Three collisions in between.
Zhao Yun could no longer endure, shouting loudly, leaping out of the battle circle, raising his hand:
"Stop, stop, I admit defeat!"
"Don’t want to give it another try?"
Ding Ling felt somewhat unsatisfied.
Zhao Yun understood, his eye twitching twice, decisively shaking his head:

"No more sparring! I already said I couldn’t be your match. This further confirms my words; in terms of technique and strength, I cannot compare to you. If not for you holding back, I fear I would have been knocked over early on!"
Tong Yuan deeply agreed.
He also noted that Ding Ling’s Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear wasn’t fully unleashed. If it were, with strength unleashed, Zhao Yun holding off ten rounds would be questionable.
Ultimately.
Currently, Zhao Yun hasn’t fully matured; if he did, holding off the present Ding Ling for hundreds of rounds would likely be feasible.
But once Zhao Yun grows, Ding Ling would have grown to what extent?
At that time, Zhao Yun surely won’t be a match.
Zhao Yun evidently understood, showing full submission to Ding Ling.
[Path of the War God Progress:
1: Defeat more than 20 strong opponents from different planes: 4/20.]
Undoubtedly.
The defeat of Zhao Yun was counted.
"Alright."
Tong Yuan no longer forced Zhao Yun, stroking his beard with a smile:
"Zhao Yun is my most outstanding closed-door disciple. But unexpectedly, in my late years, I encountered a peerless talent like Ding Ling. Heaven is truly kind to me."
He paused, asking:
"Ding Ling, what are your plans for the future?"
"I plan to learn more martial arts and improve myself."
Ding Ling replied very naturally, assertively, decisively.
"Oh?"
Tong Yuan smiled, stroking his beard:
"You’re already so strong, yet not satisfied?"
"Learning has no limits. I am still far inferior to seniors like you. How can I say I am strong?"
Zhao Yun was a bit speechless.
Ding Ling was already advancing towards his master’s level! How high is his aspiration and confidence?
When can he have such confidence and aspiration?
"Hahaha..."
Tong Yuan wasn’t offended; instead, he was very pleased with Ding Ling’s confident yet modest attitude:
"You think this way. It’s worth passing all I’ve learned in my life to you. It’s worth believing you will become a future Martial God!"
Tong Yuan paused, saying:
"I have an old friend, currently serving as an official in Luoyang. If you wish to continue learning martial arts, why not visit him?"
He had Zhao Yun bring pen, ink, paper, and inkstone.
Spreading the paper, he wrote a letter, stamped it, folded it, and handed it to Ding Ling with a hearty laugh:
"Take my letter to see him. He will surely teach you martial arts."
Ding Ling quickly accepted, rising to pay respects as gratitude.
Tong Yuan waved his hand, saying,

"No need for formality with me. What I anticipate most now is whether you can achieve the Land Martial God Realm! Whether you can emulate the legends of Chiyou and Yellow Emperor from the ancient era!"
"Chiyou, Yellow Emperor?"
Ding Ling was momentarily surprised.
These two were ancient great gods!
That Tong Yuan placed him on par with the gods, showing how highly he valued him.
Ding Ling’s heart stirred with gratitude towards Tong Yuan, expressing thanks multiple times.
Tong Yuan insistently dismissed the need for formalities.
Only then did Ding Ling relax a bit.
"Rest a night. Tomorrow take Zilong and the others down the mountain."
Tong Yuan said with a smile:

"Zilong’s martial arts have reached the peak realm of a first-class General! To further break through, battlefield experience or frequent encounters with masters are needed, let him go with you to Luoyang for exposure."
He looked at Zhao Yun:
"Zilong, what do you think?"
"Following master’s orders!"
Zhao Yun responded respectfully.
"Good, good, good."
Tong Yuan clapped his hands in praise:
"This life is worthwhile. Witnessing the rise of such talented successors..."

chapters.title: Chapter 55: Sensation After Descending the Mountain
paragraphs: "... I look forward to the day when your names resound across the world and you become a Martial God on Penglai Mountain."
Tong Yuan’s words still echoed and resounded in their ears.
The next day.

Ding Ling led the horses down the mountain with Zhao Zilong, Zhao Xiaoyiu, and Zhao Bingxuan. As he turned back to look at Penglai Mountain hidden in the clouds, his emotions were inexplicably complex.
They hadn’t stayed here for long.
Yet it felt like many years had passed.
Tong Yuan shared his teachings wholeheartedly and without reservation, which moved and grateful to Ding Ling.
He thought that if he achieved success in the future, it would be only right to repay this kindness.
"Let’s go."
Zhao Yun was also taking one step and looking back three times.
He was leading a famous Da Wan steed named "Night-Shining Jade Lion," holding a Dragon Gall Silver Spear! His shiny silver armor made him look dignified and extraordinarily powerful!
This was the weapon, mount, and armor given to Zhao Yun by Tong Yuan.
He only had one set, and for this, he could only apologize to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling already had weapons, armor, and a healthy horse, so he didn’t need Tong Yuan’s.
Perhaps it was precisely because of Tong Yuan’s almost selfless dedication to Zhao Yun that made Zhao Yun reluctant to leave.
"When can we come back?"
Zhao Yun looked at Ding Ling, clearly considering him the backbone.
According to Zhao Yun’s original plan,
He intended to enlist in the army to serve the country!
The best way to serve the country was naturally to guard the borders, kill bandits, or resist the barbarians invading Han Family territory!
But his master asked him to follow Ding Ling to Luoyang to broaden his horizons.
Zhao Yun had no reason to refuse.
Having grown up, he had never been to Luoyang and was quite fascinated by the capital of the Han Dynasty.
"Once I become the War God, the world’s number one War General."
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow and said.
Zhao Yun was momentarily stunned, then earnestly nodded, showing he understood.
If someone else had said this, he would consider it too arrogant!
But Ding Ling was different; he had that potential.
Zhao Xiaoyiu and Zhao Bingxuan also obediently led their own horses.
Zhao Xiaoyiu originally didn’t have a horse.
But there was no lack of ordinary horses on the mountain, so naturally, she got one.
She couldn’t help but speak at this moment:
"Second brother, Brother Ding, what about Sister Bingxuan and me? Can we go to Luoyang with you?"
"Follow along if you want."
Ding Ling didn’t mind.
He wasn’t aiming to dominate the world or engage in intrigues.
This trip to Luoyang was solely to learn martial arts and become stronger.
Bringing a few people along naturally wasn’t a big issue.
Furthermore, Zhao Xiaoyiu also knew martial arts! She wasn’t weak and could easily handle a few petty thieves.
"But before we leave, it would be best to clear out the bandit problems in the surrounding area."
Zhao Yun was worried about the bandit problems in Changshan County:
"If we leave in an interval, and the bandits come again, can Zhao Family Village hold them off?"
"That indeed could be a problem."
Ding Ling pondered for a while and said:
"I’ll write a letter to General Pan Feng. With his help, these minor bandits shouldn’t be a concern."
Hearing this, Zhao Yun and his siblings were naturally grateful.
The group continued talking as they journeyed further away.
Players staying on Penglai Mountain and the players below saw such ’harmonious’ scenes and, aside from feeling jealousy, were also quite astonished:
"It seems the previous speculation was true! Ding Ling indeed learned the Unparalleled Divine Skill, hence he was allowed to leave the mountain!"
"Unbelievable! How did he do that? In just a few days! I think this is somewhat surreal, it should be impossible!"

"But look at Ding Ling, he has directly managed to coax Zhao Zilong away! So many have tried to coax Zhao Zilong but failed. Ding Ling comes, and in a few days, it’s done! Ahhh~~ I’m so jealous! My War God Zhao Zilong!"
The matter of divine skill aside.
Just coaxing Zhao Zilong away was enough to stir endless waves in the entire Three Kingdoms world.
After all, Zhao Zilong’s popularity in the real world is unparalleled!
Both boys and girls are extremely fond of Zhao Zilong.
Some players who happened to be assigned to Penglai Mountain to learn martial arts felt jubilant upon seeing Zhao Zilong, thinking their opportunity had come.
However, they tried so hard for so long and saw no results.
Ding Ling comes along!
In just a few days, he managed to entertain both them and the horses away!
Incredible!
This matter, spread by those with ulterior motives, quickly reached many players’ ears in the Player Plaza!
Many players were amazed!
Astonished at Ding Ling’s speed of progress and his ability to acquire a fierce general!
They all discussed fervently!
Some discussed Ding Ling’s family background, innate talent, and inherited traits!
Others discussed how strong Ding Ling truly was and why he concealed his strength so well in the real world!
Ding Ling’s name was spreading to the ears of many players, even those who usually didn’t care about current events due to the matter of Zhao Zilong being coaxed away.
It could be said.
Ding Ling really became an overnight sensation.
He was already quite popular before.
But many players did not follow the rankings, quietly improving themselves. Thus, they were not aware of him.
But the act of coaxing away Zhao Zilong sparked curiosity and caught the attention of many, who couldn’t help but begin to focus on this Ding Ling.
This focus,
They seemed to have discovered a new world, exclaiming in astonishment, shouting "Monster!", "Impossible"
"Unbelievable!"
"How could someone like this exist in the world?!"
For a time, there was all sorts of talk!
No doubt.
Ding Ling’s level of attention reached a new peak at this moment.
Witness Zhao Zilong’s incredible popularity!
This level of attention could not be achieved for other fierce generals!
But Zhao Zilong, after all, is the legendary figure who entered and exited dangerous encampments unscathed seven times! Handsome, dashing, and tall—those are his standard traits!
With such a paragon.
Who wouldn’t be fond of him?
Of course.
At this moment, Ding Ling was unaware of these things.
He returned to Zhao Family Village with Zhao Yun and company.
He received a warm reception from the villagers of Zhao Family Village.
Almost simultaneously.
A letter rushed to Ding Ling’s hands.
It was jointly sent by Pan Feng, Jushou, and others.
The messenger was an elite cavalryman, precisely an old player.
Players knowing Ding Ling was in Zhao Family Village didn’t surprise him.
He opened the letter and glanced inside.
Understood.
He couldn’t help but smile lightly.
"What is it?"
Zhao Yun glanced over.

"The Prefect of Changshan County, Dong Xuan, accused me of dereliction and humiliation. But Pan Feng, Jushou, Tian Feng, and others refuted it with a joint message! Subsequently, they reported on Dong Xuan as well. If nothing unexpected happens, Dong Xuan would either relinquish his position and head to Ye City or obediently hand over military power to me."
"Isn’t that good news?"
Zhao Yun congratulated him.
Ding Ling nodded:

"I was already aware of Dong Xuan’s dissatisfaction and malice towards me, so I directly went to Penglai Mountain to learn martial arts. I didn’t go to places like the military camp. On returning, I just planned to resolve this matter and then resign from the Tiger Valor General position to head straight to Luoyang."

chapters.title: Chapter 56: The Prefect’s Apology
paragraphs: "Why not take a good official position?"
Zhao Xiaoyiu was astonished.

"I used to think the same way. Having an official title would make handling affairs and managing interpersonal relationships more convenient, and easier to engage with and connect with certain people. However, after witnessing the skills of the elders, I realized that as long as one is strong enough, what difference does it make whether one holds an official position or not?"
Ding Ling, exhibiting full-level acting, displayed immense confidence:
"Once I become the world’s number one War General, there will be plenty of people inviting me to take office!"
Zhao Xiaoyiu, Zhao Yun, and the others suddenly comprehended, nodding in agreement, finding the reasoning sound!
In times of chaos.
A thousand troops are easy to find, but a capable general is hard to come by.
This is known to everyone.
And the world’s number one fierce general is extremely rare!
If Ding Ling becomes the world’s number one general, surely countless people will rush to ’offer him positions!’
Upon thinking this.
Zhao Yun and the others couldn’t help but increasingly agree with Ding Ling’s way of thinking.
Ding Ling did not offer further explanations, merely stating:
"Since Dong Xuan has to reap what he sowed, there’s no need to resign the Tiger Valor General position for now. It might still be of some use."
There was reason to resign before!
After all, Dong Xuan was dissatisfied with him, making it almost clear.
He could straightforwardly claim he was being suppressed by superior officials, not suited for the Defender General’s position, and walk away.
Now, there is no reason to resign.
Ding Ling naturally saw no point in resigning, since keeping it has no disadvantages, only advantages, then why resign?
As Ding Ling predicted.
Not a few hours later.
Dong Xuan personally led a squad to Zhao Family Village to apologize and make amends to Ding Ling.
He looked embarrassed and ashamed, not daring to meet Ding Ling’s eyes.
Due to his complaints, his relationship with Ding Ling could be said to be irreconcilable.
Even though he apologized and offered restitution, Ding Ling surely wouldn’t trust him.
Just like his own mindset.
He offered apologies, yet still harbored a grudge, feeling deeply concerned.
Dong Xuan only needed to maintain a superficial relationship, so life could at least be manageable.
But Ding Ling wouldn’t indulge him, directly taking his Commander’s Seal, gifts, etc., then told him:
"You can scram."
Dong Xuan froze, a blaze of anger flaring up instantly, he held back repeatedly, finally unable to contain it, letting out a cold snort, and stormed off.
"Haha."
Ding Ling was indifferent.
Dong Xuan was not recorded in the history of the Three Kingdoms, presumably dead. There’s no need for Ding Ling to concern himself with a dead man.
Moreover, he can’t even earn Achievement Medals from him.
"Aren’t you afraid of retaliation?"
Zhao Yun was somewhat worried.
"If he wanted to retaliate, he would’ve done so already."
Ding Ling said:
"But he doesn’t dare. Pan Feng, Jushou, and others have jointly warned him. Unless he wants to die, he wouldn’t dare touch me. On the contrary, he fervently hopes I remain steady.
Because if anything happens to me, the first people Pan Feng, Jushou, and Xun Chen would look for, would still be him!"
"I see."
Zhao Yun felt relieved.
He seemed to have more questions.
Ding Ling directly, holding the Commander’s Seal, galloped toward Zhending City’s direction:
"Alright then, follow me to the military camp. We strive to eliminate the bandit menace near Zhao Family Village within three days. This way, you can follow me to Luoyang in peace."
Zhao Yun’s spirit lifted, promptly urging the Night-Shining Jade Lion to follow.
Zhao Feng, Zhao Xiaoyiu, and Zhao Bingxuan also followed suit.
Zhao Feng was at a second-class general’s standard, more than capable of becoming a general in the military camp.
Ding Ling planned to promote him.
This way, Zhao Family Village and Zhending City, with Zhao Feng leading the troops in defense, ordinary bandits wouldn’t dare approach recklessly.
After all, nobody likes provoking tough characters!
In the blink of an eye.
Two days had passed.
During the time, Ding Ling wrote several letters, sending them to Ye City through players and NPCs to Pan Feng, Xun Chen, and others.
Using players and NPCs to deliver the letters.
Because travel was unsafe, many couriers were killed, players were relatively smarter.
But players weren’t fully reliable, it’s common for some to disappear en route.
So adding some NPCs for delivery, was merely to ensure more stability.
The letters’ content was mostly hoping Pan Feng, Xun Chen, and others could take good care of Zhao Family Village, also hoping to assign him a few deputy generals.
Zhao Yun and Zhao Feng were very suitable.
Hoping they’d persuade the Governor of Jizhou to agree.
The day after the letters were written.
Ding Ling immediately led two thousand troops to encircle and wipe out bandits around Zhao Family Village.
The sweep lasted two days.
During which countless bandits were slain, acquiring numerous arms and armor, several dozen maids, a small number of medicinal herbs.
The maids were all left homeless and orphaned.
Ding Ling settled them in Zhao Family Village.
As for the seized weapons and armor, Ding Ling directly gave them to Zhao Family Village’s residents, arming a small elite squad.
The people of Zhao Family Village were naturally brave.
Now equipped with weaponry and armor, they appeared even more formidable. It’s a force Ding Ling could requisition anytime in the future.
And medicinal herbs?
Ding Ling directly washed and ate them raw.
Crunch! Crunch!
He bit into a ginseng, feeling his limbs and whole body steadily warming.
It turns out the Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique reached Great Perfection, autonomously absorbing medicinal power.
As soon as the ginseng entered his belly, its medicinal strength began being absorbed and refined.
Medicinal power infiltrated the membranes, meridians.
Ding Ling distinctly felt his body’s physical quality improving.
However, this heat sensation lasted only several breaths before ending.
Ding Ling carefully checked his Character Panel.
No discernible change!
"Seems like the herbs were too few!"
Ding Ling pondered.
Then directly swallowing all the herbs.
With his immense strength, his digestion capability was naturally terrifying; the abundance of herbs felt like eating ’wild vegetables’, hence unaffected in digestion.
The most significant factor remains the Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique’s ability to absorb medicinal power directly, allowing Ding Ling to confidently eat hurriedly.
The Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique at Perfect Realm possesses such power.
Any lesser understanding of the technique would likely require herb concoction for a medicinal bath absorption.
Doing so?
Wouldn’t it be time-consuming and labor-intensive!
Would also waste much medicinal power.
Direct consumption ensures complete absorption of medicinal power!
But even so.
With all herbs consumed.
Ding Ling’s Character Panel showed only minor changes.
[Strength +0.1]
[Defense +0.1]
Only two aspects increased by 0.1.
Ding Ling knew it was due to the bandits’ herbs being too commonplace. The most precious ginseng were but a scant few.
Most were ordinary herbs, incapable of satisfying the Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique’s cultivation absorption.
"Better than none I suppose."
Ding Ling slightly clenched his fist, feeling his strength slightly enhanced, quite satisfied nevertheless.
"Time to prepare for Luoyang."
Ding Ling revitalized his spirit.
"Once the replies from Pan Feng and Tian Feng arrive, we set off."

chapters.title: Chapter 57: Five-Stone Bow
paragraphs: Only after Zhao Feng and Zhao Yun’s official positions are finalized.
Ding Ling can leave with peace of mind.
Otherwise.
This place would have no one from our own side to guard it.
Who knows, the bandit problem might resurface again.
If Zhao Family Village is destroyed because of this, Zhao Yun and the others will surely be extremely distraught!
Ding Ling now considers Zhao Yun a friend.
Naturally, he does not wish for Zhao Family Village to be annihilated.
Besides.
The people of Zhao Family Village now hold him in high regard and almost blindly follow his commands.
Where else would you find such naturally loyal subordinates?
Ding Ling wouldn’t allow Zhao Family Village to be destroyed either.
As Ding Ling was thinking this, he was about to get up and leave.
"Report!"
A scout hurriedly entered the tent and loudly reported military intelligence to Ding Ling:
"A bandit army has appeared a few miles away, numbering no less than three thousand. They’re aggressively heading towards our position."
"Oh?"
Ding Ling was astonished, then chuckled:
"These bandits are audacious beyond measure! Knowing that we are suppressing bandits, they still dare to come openly!
They clearly do not regard us, the official army, at all."
"Let me meet them."
Zhao Yun was eager to try:
"If we do not eliminate the bandits, how can I leave my hometown with peace of mind?"
In the recent anti-bandit operations, Zhao Yun charged forward multiple times. After the initial discomfort, he performed very bravely.
Killing bandits was as easy as killing chickens.
Truly invincible!
Often with one thrust, seven or eight bandits would be directly killed!
A single man worth a whole army!
This speaks of Zhao Yun!
And Zhao Yun is not even at his peak state yet; he continues to progress daily, steadily moving towards the level of a super-elite fierce general.
Imagine when he reaches super-elite status, there would hardly be anyone in the world who could withstand his swift spear.
Many of Tong Yuan’s spear techniques emphasize agility and speed!
The Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear is such a technique.
Plus, Zhao Yun has been practicing the Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique for over ten years, with countless medicinal baths, making his physique exceptionally formidable!
If not for this, he wouldn’t have been able to clash with Ding Ling head-on multiple times.
Even if Ding Ling held back.
A typical fierce general would likely be killed by just one direct confrontation with Ding Ling.
One can see Zhao Yun’s endurance, stamina, and physical strength!
"Good."
Ding Ling smiled and said:
"I really want to see which bandits are so bold."
Zhao Xiaoyiu and Zhao Bingxuan didn’t come.
Upon hearing Ding Ling’s words, Zhao Feng, Zhao Yun, and the other officers donned their armor, grabbed their weapons, and rushed out eagerly.
After a period of time.
Their troops and officers were assembled.
Ding Ling led the charge towards the location reported by the scouts.
Zhao Yun, Zhao Feng, and other officers followed closely behind.
Behind them were two thousand cavalry and infantry in dense formation.
They were commanded by mid-level officers, advancing quickly in an orderly manner.
Technically speaking.
Commanding a battle typically requires formations, with soldiers charging first, followed by generals facing off.
But in the process of suppressing bandits.
Ding Ling realized that setting up formations against bandits was like using a cannon to kill a mosquito!
The bandits didn’t deserve such careful treatment from him.

He only needed to lead Zhao Yun and other brave generals to duel the enemy leaders, defeat the enemy head, and the bandit troops would naturally fall into chaos, then charge with the army, causing the bandit forces to collapse without a fight.
This method has never failed.
But later, the bandit forces understood the prowess of Ding Ling’s side’s generals and refused to duel.
Even so.
Zhao Yun and Ding Ling could find the enemy leader amid thousands of troops and seize the king to catch the bandits first!
The far-off bandit leaders were directly shot by Ding Ling with his bow and arrow.
Ding Ling’s basic archery skills are at full level!

Paired with his extraordinarily strong physique, he could easily draw the Five-Stone Bow; when fully drawn, the arrow’s speed was exceedingly fast! Ordinary bandit leaders weren’t even as good as third-class generals; when Ding Ling targeted them, they basically only met the fate of being shot and killed.
Precisely because of the Five-Stone Bow’s aid.
Ding Ling felt that confronting bandit leaders didn’t necessitate grand formations or face-offs.
As long as he could take the enemy general’s head amid the army.
The defeat and annihilation of the enemy were naturally destined.
Ding Ling touched the large bow by his horse’s side, thinking:
"The one advantage of having control over the camp is probably just this Five-Stone Bow!"
There weren’t many Five-Stone Bows in the Jizhou camp.
Because being able to draw a Five-Stone Bow and having good archery skills is virtually extinct in Jizhou!
While Pan Feng is strong, his archery is mediocre, so naturally, he doesn’t need a Five-Stone Bow!
Ordinary first-class experts feel that a Three-Stone or Four-Stone Bow is sufficient.
Because drawing a Five-Stone Bow requires 600 pounds of force. First-class fierce generals can draw it, but most are skilled in long weapons and breathing techniques.
Few are skilled in archery.
Therefore, they don’t opt for such heavy bows!
Ding Ling could find this bow in the armory of Zhending City’s camp because no one could draw it, and it had been left collecting dust for quite some time.
"With this bow. Bandit leaders are nothing to worry about."
Ding Ling slightly arched his brows.
He was pondering:
"If I could learn Huang Zhong’s archery skills, paired with this bow, even in the Martial World, standard experts would likely only be fated to be shot by me!"
He was eager to move.
He started considering when to go to Jingzhou to find Huang Zhong, to see if he could learn his martial arts.
Having more skills doesn’t weigh down the body.
Not to mention that full-level skills can also enhance one’s foundation and combat power!
High-tier skills can directly increase physical attributes!
Low-tier skills now have the effect of improving defense.
Of course, Ding Ling wouldn’t miss out; to him, martial arts and skills are ever beneficial!
Dada!
Clip-clop!
Amid the clatter of the gallant horses.
Ding Ling and Zhao Yun galloped side by side.
Soon.
They saw a group of bandits riding in the distance on the main road ahead.
The bandits were like a vast, passing swarm of locusts, with their ranks clearly interspersed with numerous women and goods.
No need to think much.
It’s evident that these were plundered by the bandits.
Zhao Yun was furious and was about to charge out, but he realized this was not the hills but the military, so he looked to Ding Ling, asking for permission to fight.
Ding Ling nodded.
Zhao Yun was overjoyed, immediately spurring his horse forward to the front of the armies, loudly challenging:
"Bandits, have the guts to fight me to the death?"
"Looking all fair and clean like a woman."
A general rode out from the bandit army, wielding a long spear, tall and robust, likely over six feet tall, exuding a fierce aura all over:
"Your grandpa is called Wulu! When you reach hell, remember my name! Prepare to die!"
He charged at Zhao Yun.
His long spear twirled, boom! A surge of evil qi erupted, forming waves of wind out of nowhere, clearly indicating he was a second-class general!
The bandit side, seeing this, cheered up, shouting enthusiastically.
Zhao Yun just smiled slightly, not bothered. He steadied his horse, waved his long spear, and displayed the power of the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear, clang!
Clang, clang, clang!
While blocking Wulu’s spear, Zhao Yun’s spear instantly struck out nine star points!

chapters.title: Chapter 58: An Arrow Through the Shoulder Blade
paragraphs: With a clanging sound, thud!
Wulu didn’t even have time to block Zhao Yun’s move before he was pierced in the forehead!
He couldn’t help but widen his eyes in disbelief; his large body swayed and powerlessly fell off his horse, meeting his end with a shattered skull.
From Wulu’s charge to the clash between both sides, it was merely a single round, and life and death were decided in an instant!
The morale on the bandit side plummeted, and there was panic among them.
In contrast, Ding Ling’s side saw a surge in morale, with drums beating to boost their spirits and loud cheers.
Several days of bandit suppression.
Ding Ling and Zhao Yun had already become the revered ’Divine Generals’ in the camp!
The defending troops of Changshan County had always fought poorly, often bullied by bandits, not daring to fight back, and only defending the city passively.
This caused the bandit scourge to grow increasingly rampant.
However, the Prefect was incompetent, and the generals further enraged by the enemies, were shot dead by an arrow while in a furious struggle.
The soldiers and generals under them, without exception, were all killed.
From then on.
The remaining troops were even more frightened, terrified of going on the battlefield.
With Ding Ling’s arrival.
He made the soldiers truly understand what a War God and fierce General meant!

Especially with Ding Ling and Zhao Yun joining forces, oftentimes they didn’t even need to take action themselves to annihilate a bandit army, showcasing the deterrent power of super experts to them for the first time.
Therefore.
Now the soldiers’ morale was sky-high, each fighting valiantly and competing to be first!
To them, following such generals into battle was merely ’picking up achievements’!
Why would they lag behind?
Each was full of spirit, fighting spirit soaring!
At this moment, witnessing Zhao Yun’s victory again, they felt it was only right, and were even more blood-boiled, each gripping their weapons, ready to charge and kill at Ding Ling’s command.
"Wulu!"
The bandit leader was shocked:
"How could he not withstand even a single round? Are the arrivals Zhang Hex or Gao Lan?"
Upon closer look, it didn’t seem so, he couldn’t help but shout:
"Could the arriving one state their name?"
"Zhao Zilong of Changshan!"
Zhao Yun sat commanding on the back of the Night-Shining Jade Lion, wielding the Dragon Gall Silver Spear, exuding an aura of awe and majesty.
Upon hearing the words ’Zhao Zilong of Changshan.’
The players on the bandit leader’s side first lost their composure:
"Whoa, it’s Zhao Yun! How could we possibly win against such a strong man?!"
"Why is Zhao Yun here? This is crazy!"

"Have you been so engrossed in the Game World recently that you haven’t visited the Player Plaza? Anyone who has been to the plaza or surfed the net in the real world would know Zhao Yun was coaxed away by Ding Ling! Why so surprised!"
A tall, thin player couldn’t help but disdain the other players who were showing panic.
Upon hearing this, these players were left uncertain and apprehensive:
"You knew Zhao Yun was here, yet you dared to come to die?!"
"I came just to see my idol, and seeing him now, he is indeed extraordinary."
"Don’t look at me like that, after seeing my idol, I will find a chance to slip away!"
Relatively speaking.
The players were not many, just over a hundred.
But their fear and reluctance to fight were quite apparent, easily spreading to the other bandits.
The bandits, being naturally inclined to bully the weak and fear the strong, seeing such fierce generals on Ding Ling’s side, many who considered themselves brave didn’t dare to rush forward to die.
Seeing this, the bandit leader thought poorly of the situation, and couldn’t help but shout:
"Mere Zhao Zilong of Changshan, you are a nameless youngling! If you dare come to die, I will fulfill your wish!"
He waved his large hand and shouted loudly:
"Charge for me! Kill him, avenge leader Wulu!"

Ding Ling, seeing the bandit leader tall and mighty, with naturally large eyes, couldn’t help but take out his big bow, rode forward, and when the distance was about a hundred meters, suddenly bent the bow and nocked the arrow, drawing the bow fully.
Swoosh!
Releasing the string. Swoosh! Accompanied by a piercing sound cutting through the air past the ear, the arrow shot towards the bandit leader like a stream of light, at an extremely fast speed.
"Watch out!"
Someone saw Ding Ling bend the bow and nock an arrow, initially wanting to mock him for overestimating his abilities. From such a distance, how could he possibly hit?
Therefore, he did not remind the bandit leader.
But after witnessing the formidable power of this arrow, he couldn’t help but shout in fear.
But it was too late; the Five-Stone Strong Bow, combined with Ding Ling’s strength of over two thousand pounds, plus full-level Basic Archery skills!
It was a perfect match!
Even though the bandit leader spotted the dazzling ’starlight’ later and dodged in time to avoid a fatal hit, the arrow still pierced through his scapula.
The tremendous force even dragged the bandit leader, pulling him off the horse, crashing into a soldier behind him, and he tumbled onto the ground.
"The bandit leader is dead!"
Ding Ling seized the opportunity to shout loudly, putting down his bow and arrow, taking his Heaven-piercing Halberd, and charging:
"Follow me and kill!"
"Kill!"
"Kill!!"
The morale on Ding Ling’s side was soaring!
Their general was truly a Divine General, brave to an unbelievable extent, hitting the bandit leader with an arrow from such a distance! Amongst all under the heavens, how many could achieve this?
Following such generals, how could they not win battles?

Conversely, on the bandit leader’s side, losing their leader, they were already panicked, and seeing fierce generals like Ding Ling and Zhao Yun leading a ferocious charge towards them, they were utterly terrified.
Over a hundred players were the first to rapidly retreat!
They were also intimidated by Ding Ling’s martial power:

"I’ve heard before that Ding Ling is incredibly strong and unbelievable! I didn’t believe it, but now I’ve seen it! That arrow was too terrifying. Peak of Second-class Martial General Li Damu was almost shot. If I faced that arrow, it would surely mean death!"
"That’s because it was too far. If it were closer, Li Damu wouldn’t have been able to dodge either! This guy is so strong; he’s practically a human beast!"
Players ran while looking back.
Seeing Ding Ling charging in first, the first to crash into the bandit troop led by Li Damu, raising the Heaven-piercing Halberd, occasionally pointing out over a dozen starbursts, clang clang clang!
In an instant, more than a dozen bandits were killed!
At times sweeping with the Heaven-piercing Halberd, like sweeping clouds, within the sweep, sweeping five or six bandits flying with the force of cloud attack.

At times chopping, hacking, and slicing with the Heaven-piercing Halberd, turning smoothly, like an axe opening the heavens, in an instant, chopping out seven or eight axes, slaying or knocking down several!
By himself, Ding Ling broke through the elite formation at the forefront!
Causing chaos on the bandit leader’s side!
"This guy is too fierce!"
Players stared, tongues-tied:
"We’re all players, how is he so powerful!"
More players were envious, jealous:

"I’ve always dreamed of charging horses on the battlefield, wantonly killing the enemy. Now Ding Ling has realized this dream before me. He isn’t even an old player! Nor a beta tester! I really don’t understand how he’s so incredible!"
"So explosive. Too bad I can’t record a video. If I had a phone, I would have recorded this scene and posted it online, and it would easily surpass a hundred million views!"
"How did this guy train?! I really want to catch him and interrogate him harshly!"

chapters.title: Chapter 59: Black Mountain Army Li Damu
paragraphs: Ding Ling led the charge ahead.
Like a swift ship cutting through mighty waves, unstoppable!
Zhao Yun followed behind, clearing obstacles perfectly, serving as the ultimate support, leaving Ding Ling with no worries.
Their cooperation was flawless.
With their combined power, they killed and maimed no fewer than several hundred bandits.
The bandits were terrified, fleeing in panic.
Some bandit generals, armoured in general armor, were pierced through their vital points like shoulder blades by Ding Ling amidst the chaos, knocked to the ground, and ordered bound.
As for the bandit leader, attempting to escape, he was pursued by the swift Zhao Yun and stabbed directly to the ground.
Had Ding Ling not wanted to leave some alive.
None of these bandit generals would have survived.
"Surrender and live!"
Ding Ling shouted loudly.
The bandits, who were chased and battered by Ding Ling’s side, knelt and begged for surrender.
At Zhao Feng and the others’ demand.
They discarded their weapons and removed their armor.
One by one, dejected, completely devoid of their earlier ferocious aura.
As for the bandits who had fled and disappeared without a trace, Ding Ling didn’t even bother to order a pursuit.
He simply commanded the reorganization of this batch of bandits.
Afterward.
Ding Ling walked up to the bandit leader.
Seeing the fear in his eyes, Ding Ling smiled slightly:
"What is your name?"
"Li Damu."
The bandit leader replied anxiously.
"Li Damu?"
Ding Ling had long thought the name Wulu sounded familiar. Upon hearing Li Damu, he suddenly understood:
"Are you from the Black Mountain Army?"
"Master’s perceptive eye!"
Li Damu replied cautiously:
"Master, we have no personal grudges. I beg you to spare my life. The Black Mountain Army leader would be immensely grateful to you."
"Zhang Feiyan? Or Zhang Niujiao?"
"It’s Zhang Feiyan."
Li Damu was very restrained and nervous:
"Zhang Niujiao was unfortunately struck by a stray arrow and gravely wounded on the battlefield earlier in the campaign and passed away."
Recalling the arrow he had just taken.
Li Damu couldn’t help but shiver; a surge of sharp pain shot through his head, causing his forehead veins to bulge, and he gasped.
Naturally, he feared Ding Ling, the architect of all this.
Such archery!
Such immense strength!
Recalling how Ding Ling, wielding the Heaven-piercing Halberd, effortlessly slaughtered enemies during the charge.
Li Damu was utterly terrified.
He realized that Ding Ling’s power vastly surpassed Zhang Feiyan and other Black Mountain Army leaders!
It could be said.
Gathering all Black Mountain Army leaders together would likely stand no chance against Ding Ling!
Thinking of this.
He grew increasingly anxious, regretting and lamenting this rash attack on Ding Ling’s troops.
He initially thought Ding Ling’s troops would be the same as the soft targets from before.
Even if strong, they would be limited in power.
He believed he could likely defeat them, with little chance of loss, and escape would be feasible!
Little did he expect to crash headfirst into a solid wall this time!
Almost getting himself killed!
"Zhang Feiyan?"
Ding Ling pondered.
Based on historical trends and the storyline of Romance of the Three Kingdoms.
Zhang Feiyan is indeed a sensible, tactful, and discerning character.
His voluntary surrender to Cao Mengde indicates he lacks ambitions for world domination; perhaps he seeks simply a reliable future.
With these thoughts.
Ding Ling asked Li Damu a few questions.
Upon learning Zhang Feiyan was nearby.
He immediately summoned some bandits, wrote several letters for them to deliver to Zhang Feiyan.
For smooth progress.
Ding Ling even assigned a player to accompany them, promising high-tier Saber Technique to the player if the letters were successfully delivered.
The player rejoiced and swiftly went along.
No doubt.
Defense Army in Zhending City also had players.
Players were widespread.
Some were lucky to follow Zhang Liao and the likes, while others joined lesser-known figures, and some even turned into bandits.
Currently, Zhending City’s players were only learning Pile Skill without exposure to real Long Weapon Martial Arts.
Ding Ling’s promise was like timely rain.
Players would naturally strive to complete the task.
While they lacked loyalty, their cunning and wit often outmatched ordinary NPCs.
To motivate players, binding them with interests suffices.
Ding Ling needed no loyalty; he wasn’t playing ’world domination’!
That day.
The messenger from Ye City returned.
He brought several pieces of good news.
With Pan Feng, Jushou, and others’ efforts, Governor of Jizhou Hann Fu agreed to Zhao Yun and Zhao Feng’s appointments.

It’s fair to say Zhao Yun and Zhao Feng were vaulted to high positions, skipping Squad Leader, Decurion, Village Chief ranks, directly jumping to the Deputy General role, higher than Military Marquis.
"Position has family ties in the court."
Ding Ling couldn’t help but lament.
Handed general armor and official seals to Zhao Feng, Zhao Yun.
Both were very excited.
Grateful to Ding Ling.
They knew, without Ding Ling, they wouldn’t directly become generals.
Ding Ling’s status was now extraordinary, attracting strong support from Xun Chen, Pan Feng, and others.
Had it been before.
He wouldn’t wield such influence.
Yet with Pan Feng and others being so helpful.
Ding Ling secretly resolved to help them in return, to repay these favors.
Besides Zhao Feng’s good news.
Ding Ling’s Holy Decree arrived.
This time it was delivered by an eunuch from Luoyang.
Ding Ling only knew he was newly appointed Court Officer named Duanmu Qing.
’Duanmu Qing?’

Ding Ling couldn’t help but evaluate him, noting his pale, beardless face, quite handsome appearance, yet robust build, tall, clearly a long-time martial artist. Combined with his speech, Ding Ling realized:
"Are you a player?"
"Hehe."
Duanmu Qing’s grin instantly revealed his identity, he was sizing up Ding Ling, too:
"Finally seeing the recently famed Ding Ling. More impressive than the portraits online, taller, more handsome. Not bad, not bad!"
Ding Ling raised his brow, saying:
"Your Holy Decree is delivered, if no further business, I won’t entertain you. You’re free to go."
"Come on."
Duanmu Qing reached out to grab Ding Ling:
"Rumor has it you’re a heir of a Hidden Clan. I’m very curious, are you really?"
"Oh?"
Ding Ling had logged off a few times recently.
Due to his enormous appetite and extraordinary progress, he was out of funds. He even borrowed neighbor Uncle Zhang’s ID, bank cards, and other documents for internet cafes, doing quick-money jobs.
Among them were obscure language translation jobs, local repair jobs, etc.

Being adept as a repairman stemmed from maxing out skills in this domain. By donning a mask, hat, and disguising himself, he provided services fixing air conditioners, computers, fridges, quite effortlessly.

Though people wondered why his outfit was so serious, it was a law-abiding society, and nobody believed he’d dare cause trouble in broad daylight, especially in occupied house. If questioned, Ding Ling claimed he had the flu, which usually ended queries.
Thus, recently Ding Ling earned quite a sum.
Yet he speculated he might not stay long in the village.

chapters.title: Chapter 60: Duanmu’s Death
paragraphs: Just ready to make a run for it.
Ding Ling figured that once his strength increased again and he returned to the real world, he should get a new place to live.
He didn’t like staying in one place for too long.
A mobile rental was more suitable for him.
As for repaying Uncle Zhang’s favor?
Ding Ling planned to return the borrowed bank card to him; there was quite a bit of money in it. Consider it a token of appreciation.
Generally, people wouldn’t lend their documents to others, so Uncle Zhang’s trust in Ding Ling must be reciprocated sincerely.
At this moment.
When Ding Ling heard Duanmu Qing say he was a successor of an Hidden Clan, he couldn’t help but be slightly stunned, but quickly came to his senses.
It must have been distorted rumors causing this result.
However, the more chaotic the rumors were, the more advantageous it was for him. It made it easier for him to hide and conceal his identity!
Thinking of this.
Ding Ling activated his full-level acting skill and displayed an extremely subtle demeanor, as if eager to distance himself from the matter, shaking his head and saying:
"Rumors are terrifying. I’m not from a Hidden Clan."
"Really?"
Ding Ling’s reply was too direct.
Moreover, his expression and actions were so natural, and had a tinge of the unpleasant memory.
Duanmu Qing instead didn’t believe Ding Ling and felt Ding Ling must be related to the Hidden Clan, making him somewhat excited and curious:
"Buddy, can you tell me about the Hidden Clan? I’m really curious."
"Am I really that familiar with you?"
Ding Ling was surprised:
"Who do you think you are?!"
He withdrew his smile and said:
"I’m going to rest. Please leave."
"Come on, buddy, don’t be like that."
Duanmu Qing, seemingly unabashed and thick-skinned, didn’t care about Ding Ling’s expression, smiling and saying:
"In the real world, I’m a journalist. Rest assured, as long as you cooperate with me, I’ll definitely write about you in a magnificent way."
Ding Ling walked away directly.
Duanmu Qing hurriedly followed:
"Brother, cooperate a bit. I’m now a Court Officer for the imperial court. Give me some credit. I have direct access to Dong Zhuo. Maybe I can even secure a good position for you."
Ding Ling couldn’t be bothered with him.
Duanmu Qing was obviously a shameless journalist; truly believing his words would be brainless.
Yet someone like him could rise to such an important position as Court Officer.
This shows the corruption in Dong Zhuo’s system!
The collapse is probably not far away.

The involvement of players will definitely catalyze and speed up historical progress. Who knows if the Three Heroes will fight with Lü Bu, but the coalition against Dong Zhuo will definitely happen soon.
Ding Ling must quickly wrap up things here and rush to Luoyang to learn martial arts.
If he arrives late and Luoyang is burned down like in history, Tong Yuan’s old friend will surely be lost among the vast sea of people. Where could he find this master?
So, he must get to Luoyang to learn martial arts before the coalition against Dong Zhuo!
"Buddy, Brother, Ding Ling!"
Duanmu Qing shouted:
"You’re not cooperating, aren’t you afraid I’ll slander you? Aren’t you afraid I’ll badmouth you in front of Dong Zhuo?"
"Hmm?"
Ding Ling abruptly turned to look at Duanmu Qing.
Duanmu Qing became excited:
"Brother, cooperate a bit?"
"Zhao Yun."
Ding Ling called out loudly.
Zhao Yun stepped forward, clasped his fists:
"General."
Under everyone’s gaze, Zhao Yun showed great respect for Ding Ling.
Privately, of course, they’d talk casually without being formal.
"Throw this guy out."
Ding Ling pointed at Duanmu Qing:
"If he’s not compliant, stab him directly!"
Ding Ling was not a pushover.
Still want to threaten him?
Next time he sees him, he’ll beat him!
"Ding Ling. You’re really daring not to cooperate with me? Dare to act against me? Believe it or not, when I return, I’ll immediately incite Dong Zhuo to make a move against you?"
Duanmu Qing, seeing Zhao Yun walking towards him, panicked and screamed.
"Stab him!"
Ding Ling ordered.
Zhao Yun decisively shook his spear, swish! Nine spear flowers flashed past, piercing Duanmu Qing directly, leaving no time for him to utter his last words.
But Ding Ling knew the guy wouldn’t die.
He’ll probably resurrect soon.
But their rivalry was now set.
Ding Ling felt quite helpless. He didn’t want to interact too much with players.
But sometimes things are just like that.
He doesn’t seek trouble.
Trouble finds him.
This Duanmu Qing was courting death!
Knowing well how impatient he was, he still kept provoking him!
Probably the same way in reality, often doing such bold things, utterly shameless.
Having been affected by Duanmu Qing, Ding Ling received good news the next day.
Zhang Feiyan was willing to negotiate with Ding Ling.
"Location?"
Ding Ling looked at Zhao Zhantang.
He was the player tasked with delivering the message.
He looked very clever.
"Under an unnamed hill a few dozen miles outside Zhending City."
After Zhao Zhantang spoke, he eagerly looked at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling smiled and handed him the High-Tier Blade Technique Secret Manual he had prepared earlier:
"This is the secret manual."
"Thank you, boss, no, thank you, General!"
Zhao Zhantang was delighted, instinctively blurting out a thank you, boss, but quickly changed his tune.
Judging by his behavior.
He must work in the service industry in reality. Otherwise, such instinct wouldn’t nearly be ingrained in him.
"Alright. You’ll lead the way soon."
"No problem!"
Zhao Zhantang patted his chest to assure.
An hour and a half later.
Under the unnamed hill.
Ding Ling led his army here.
He saw a well-formed troop, numbering around a thousand.
Everyone was tall, well-built, and full of vitality, evidently capable fighters.
In addition, everyone was clad in sturdy armor and equipped with sharp weapons, definitely elite among elite troops.
Was Zhang Feiyan showing off his might?
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows and instructed Zhao Feng to lead two thousand soldiers to stand at a distance of a hundred meters.
He and Zhao Yun, riding horses, approached the center between the two armies.
Ding Ling stared directly at the opposition.
He immediately saw the person surrounded by their troops.
The person was clad in General Armor, wearing a golden helmet, holding a spear, and had a Treasure Saber hanging from his waist, looking majestic, with an imposing kingly aura!
"Zhang Feiyan?"
Ding Ling looked directly and said.
"Ding Ling?"
The person with the Treasure Saber squinted and examined Ding Ling; it was clearly Zhang Feiyan.
Seeing Ding Ling daring to come with just two people for negotiations, he admired Ding Ling’s courage but couldn’t resist a clear shout. His mount neighed, and he quickly surged forward.
A few generals behind him, each fierce in appearance, though uniquely so, followed him.
They glared at Ding Ling with weapon-ready hostility, vigilance, and tension.
"Indeed a young hero."
Zhang Feiyan approached, complimenting Ding Ling’s extraordinary aura and youth.
Ding Ling slightly raised an eyebrow.

Zhang Feiyan had a bold presence, dare to compliment even knowing he captured Li Damu and others; no wonder he later led hundreds of thousands of troops, rampant in Black Mountain, leaving Yuan Shao and others helpless!
Such spirit is not something ordinary people possess.
"Let’s not waste words."
Ding Ling steadied himself, getting straight to the point:
"I want to discuss that people from Black Mountain should restrain their troops from raiding in Changshan County."
