chapters.title: Chapter 61: A Single Halberd Strike Sends Lei Gong’s Blade Flying
paragraphs: "Especially near Zhending City."
Ding Ling specifically pointed out.
As for other places,
Ding Ling could only express his inability to help.
He was just a single fighter and at most could be considered a Defensive General of a county city.
He didn’t have the ability to handle the affairs of the entire Jizhou, let alone manage the Black Mountain bandits that roamed across Bingzhou and Jizhou territories.
The fact that he got them to come out for talks
was because Ding Ling had captured figures like Li Damu and Kushen, who could be said to be leaders within the Black Mountain Army.
If Zhang Feiyan didn’t take care of it, morale would surely fall apart, and it would be difficult for him to make unilateral decisions on Black Mountain’s big and small matters in the future.
Ding Ling saw through this point, so he dared to have Zhao Zhantang take several messengers directly to find Zhang Feiyan for negotiations.
Now that Zhang Feiyan was here, everything naturally needed to be laid out for discussion.
Zhang Feiyan saw Ding Ling’s directness and, without further ado, said:
"That’s not a problem, provided you release my men."
He paused and added:

"Also, I’m very curious at what level your side’s combat power has reached. Why don’t we have some of our top fighters spar? This way, we know each other’s strength, making cooperation easier in the future. Don’t you agree?"
"Alright."
Ding Ling agreed, raising the Heaven-piercing Halberd in his hand:
"Who among you will test the sharpness of my halberd first?"
Ding Ling knew Zhang Feiyan was extraordinary. Managing hundreds of thousands of Black Mountain bandits couldn’t possibly be done by someone straightforward.
He must have a mind full of twists and strategies.
But Ding Ling didn’t care about that.
Ever since he decided to walk the Path of the War God, he decided that everything would be bulldozed by strength!
If he couldn’t bulldoze his way, he would continue practicing martial arts until he could!
As long as he was strong enough,
all demonic creatures were just paper tigers!
As he grew stronger, Ding Ling’s understanding of this became deeper!
In the past, he thought of becoming an official to approach people like Cao Mengde.
But as his strength gradually grew, some of his thoughts were changing.

This made Ding Ling often marvel at how greatly one’s mindset could be altered by strength! Truly, each day was different from the last! Plans that were once firmly set could be revised or overturned as strength increased.
"I’ll give it a try."
A man of impressive stature and imposing demeanor spurred his horse forward, raising his saber as he charged at Ding Ling:
"My name is Lei Gong! General Ding, watch the saber!"
Ding Ling smiled slightly, squeezed the horse’s belly, and rushed toward Lei Gong.
The two quickly closed in on each other.
Lei Gong shouted, his voice thunderous and soul-shaking, as he swung his saber down, accompanied by the sound of wind and thunder, as if it could shatter heaven and earth.
Ding Ling was unafraid, the Heaven-piercing Halberd slightly trembled, and the Cloud Strike Saber Technique, like drifting clouds, clanged as it met Lei Gong’s saber, boom!

In a hard clash, Lei Gong’s wrist was wracked with pain. With a scream, he loosened his grip, and his saber flew from his hand, spinning through the air before embedding in the ground with a clanging sound.
Whoosh!
The Heaven-piercing Halberd rotated slightly and landed like lightning on Lei Gong’s neck.
Lei Gong’s expression froze, his scream halted, motionless, heart pounding like a drum, eyes wide as saucers, fear on his face magnified to the extreme at that moment.
"Thanks for letting me win."
Ding Ling withdrew the Heaven-piercing Halberd.
Lei Gong glanced at Ding Ling in fear, unwillingly turned his horse, and returned to the ranks.
The entire field was silent.
But in the next moment,
Cry of ’mighty!’ erupted from Zhao Feng’s side.
It was Ding Ling’s side’s warriors cheering for him.
The Black Mountain Army, on the other hand, was like eggplants hit by frost, completely deflated!
Each one of them was pondering:

"General Lei Gong is a genuine second-class peak martial general, with strength comparable to a first-class general. Though his martial skills may be lacking, his voice captures the opponent off-guard, capable of psychological intimidation! In the past, General Lei Gong used this to kill countless formidable opponents.
Never did they expect that he couldn’t withstand even one round against Ding Ling, and his weapon was knocked away!
If Ding Ling hadn’t held back, he would have been dead by now!"
[Achievement Medal Unlocked: You have won the reverence of the Black Mountain Army leaders and its most elite troops!]
[Note: Your strength is beyond imagination! You have successfully intimidated everyone from the Black Mountain Army, including all the leaders on the elite side.]
Ding Ling heard the notification, raised his eyebrows slightly.
This was good news.
Defeating Li Damu didn’t even earn him half of an Achievement Medal.
Defeating Lei Gong yielded none either.
Instead, he earned one from the awe of all their people!
Ding Ling was surprised and puzzled.
He suspected there were rules about Achievement Medals he hadn’t fully grasped, and instructions wouldn’t detail everything, and many matters required his exploration for confirmation.
"Who else wants to try?"
Ding Ling smiled faintly and asked aloud.
The Black Mountain Army looked at each other, all leaders remained indifferent.
Zhang Feiyan awkwardly cleared his throat, saying:
"General Ding’s prowess is unmatched! Our side pales in comparison. However, I mentioned having military experts compete, and General Ding personally getting involved seems rather unfair."
"Oh?"
Ding Ling nodded, stepped back, and signaled Zhao Yun to step up.
Since a duel was unlikely to earn more Achievement Medals,
it wasn’t necessary to push too hard.
Zhao Yun’s spirits lifted, and he spurred his horse forward, shook his spear, and in a clear voice announced:
"I am Zhao Zilong of Changshan, please do not hesitate to enlighten me."
"I, Yhiuu Du, will meet you!"
A fierce general with a sinister face, long build, and wielding a spear, charged at Zhao Yun.

Zhao Yun stood calm, waiting for Yhiuu Du to charge, then abruptly launched the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear Technique, and a vision of the Hundred Birds Paying Homage to the Phoenix flashed across the void.
The next moment,
Zhao Yun’s spear was already withdrawn.
Looking again,
Yhiuu Du’s helmet had been knocked away, and his armor had several puncture holes.
Yhiuu Du opened his mouth but said nothing before turning his horse and returning to the ranks.
His face burning with embarrassment, feeling thoroughly ashamed.
Having no courage to face Ding Ling was one thing, but not even able to win against one of Ding Ling’s deputies!
"What a swift spear!"
Zhang Feiyan was startled, seemingly recalling something:
"That’s the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear Technique of the Spear God Tong Yuan from Penglai Mountain!"
"Indeed."
Zhao Yun confirmed without hesitation, nodding.
"To think it’s the pupil of the Spear God, my apologies for any disrespect."
Zhang Feiyan solemnly stated:
"In my early years, I also wished to apprentice under the Spear God, but unfortunately, fate kept us apart, and I missed the chance many times, lacking such fortune."

sentences.text: "Especially near Zhending City."
Ding Ling specifically pointed out.
As for other places,
Ding Ling could only express his inability to help.
He was just a single fighter and at most could be considered a Defensive General of a county city.
He didn’t have the ability to handle the affairs of the entire Jizhou, let alone manage the Black Mountain bandits that roamed across Bingzhou and Jizhou territories.

was because Ding Ling had captured figures like Li Damu and Kushen, who could be said to be leaders within the Black Mountain Army.

chapters.title: Chapter 62: Fists Strike a Million Thieves—Chief Zhang Feiyan
paragraphs: Zhang Feiyan uses both spear and saber.
But the saber is merely a sidearm.
It’s clear that he excels in spear technique.
Those who use spears know that the Spear God is not strange.
At this moment, Zhang Feiyan sees Zhao Zilong casually stepping out, surprisingly a high disciple of Tong Yuan, and amidst his shock, he can’t help but curse his bad luck.
He initially wanted to play it off with Ding Ling, to test Ding Ling’s level for future convenience.
Unexpectedly, he was instead sized up by Ding Ling.
He finds himself with a thorny problem.
Either Ding Ling or Zhao Zilong could easily challenge the top performers in the army!
Especially Ding Ling, whose combat power is astonishing!
To know that Lei Gong’s strength is the greatest in the army, except for him and Zhang Baiqi!
But even so, in straightforward confrontation, his weapon was knocked flying within just one move!
Ding Ling’s strength is apparent!
Moreover, Ding Ling’s saber technique is swift as lightning, ethereal like clouds! Quite extraordinary! To defeat Ding Ling is even more difficult than defeating Zhao Zilong!
Two such masters!
Plus their troops behind them!
If Ding Ling gives the order to attack now, surrounding and killing them,
Zhang Feiyan would most likely die here.
Thinking of this.
Zhang Feiyan feels a chill!
This time he truly starts to worry.

Before, he had the confidence to come forward, thinking Ding Ling’s combat power was at most on par with his, while he had dozens of leaders, all second-class generals, and Zhang Baiqi further assisting from afar, reaching a first-class general level.
With such meticulous planning.
How could Ding Ling possibly overpower him?
But now he has no confidence at all!
So, when he sees Zhao Zilong again take the initiative to challenge the warriors, he coughs softly and sighs:
"Since you are a disciple of the Spear God, it is normal for us to not be able to match you. Let’s spare ourselves the embarrassment here."
He looks at Ding Ling:
"General Ding just needs to return Li Damu and the others immediately, and we’ll leave at once. I assure you here, I will absolutely not conduct raids around Changshan County anymore."
"Alright."
Ding Ling waves his hand.
Immediately, soldiers escort Li Damu and the others over.
Li Damu and his group hang their heads, not daring to look Zhang Feiyan in the eye.
"I hope Leader Zhang keeps his word."
Ding Ling says loudly:
"Otherwise, I wouldn’t mind ascending Black Mountain once."
Zhang Feiyan’s mouth twitches a couple of times, nods, and starts to leave.
Ding Ling suddenly speaks:
"Leader Zhang, I’ve heard your lightweight skill is outstanding, and your kung fu with fists and feet is remarkable. Why don’t we have a competition?"
"This..."
Zhang Feiyan pauses, unsure how to respond to Ding Ling’s request.
Refusing would certainly damage his prestige.
Agreeing, winning would be good, but losing would equally damage his prestige.
His head hurts.
Regarding this impetuous visit to see Ding Ling, he feels he shouldn’t have come.
But if he didn’t, it would similarly cause internal discord within the Black Mountain Army, a problem not easily handled.
He decides, in the future, he should probably stay away from someone as prickly as Ding Ling, not worth provoking!
"Does Leader Zhang not dare?"
The reason Ding Ling challenges,
is suddenly remembering the progress bar of the Path of the War God, seemingly needing challenges against more than 20 plane experts, and the more the better.

Zhang Feiyan is definitely a plane expert, or he wouldn’t have climbed to the position of a great commander in the bandits’ nest, leading a million Black Mountain Army and not afraid to stand against Yuan Shao and others!
"Alright!"

Zhang Feiyan is a hot-blooded, bold, combative general, just restrained from personally making a move after being a commander for too long, now provoked by Ding Ling, he can no longer hold back, giving orders to let others take his saber and spear.
He removes his helmet, clad in armor, leaps off his horse, and with several bounds, crosses fifty meters like a gust of wind, standing in the center, looking at Ding Ling:
"Barehanded melee—I, Zhang Feiyan, have never lost since I was a child! If General Ding dares, you can come over and try."
"Alright."
Ding Ling laughs heartily, also having his weapons and helmet taken by others.

Similarly wearing a full set of General Armor, activating the Wall-Climbing Technique and Agile Power, with one step, he floats across dozens of meters, several steps akin to lightning, swiftly flying and standing before Zhang Feiyan.
Zhang Feiyan stiffens internally, praising:
"What a graceful technique, what high agility!"
He is quite shocked:

"As far as I know, those skilled in body techniques in the world are mostly street rogues. Due to various reasons, their techniques are mostly lost to the river of history, not passed down. Where did you learn such a remarkable technique?"
"It was passed to me by a predecessor."
Ding Ling assumes the starting posture of Mantis Fist:
"Leader Zhang, please!"
"Mantis Fist."

Zhang Feiyan’s pupils contract: "Great success appearing flawed, great skill appearing clumsy, seemingly full of gaps yet intricately perfect to the extreme! This realm can be considered transformation realm mastery!"
His heart rises up, knowing he’s encountering a true master in fist and foot kung fu.
He really can’t imagine why someone as young as Ding Ling, skilled in weapon arts and horse skills, would also be so adept in ground combat, fists, and the Dao of Light Body, simply frightening.
He’s extremely vigilant, also assuming a starting posture.
Indeed, it is the Wild Bull Skill passed down from Zhang Niujiao!
The two set their stances.
And mutually charge toward each other with great understanding.
Boom, boom, boom!

Zhang Feiyan and Ding Ling, both, with Wild Bull Skill, once engaged with Technique and Body Technique, resemble charging mad bulls, fiercely and ominously to the extreme. Ordinary people hit by his fists would feel like being hit by a bull’s horns, with fracturing bones at the least!
Every punch and kick feels wild and fierce, with faint sounds of bull roaring, a manifestation of the Wild Bull Skill’s great success.

Ding Ling’s Mantis Fist flashes continuously, lively and dynamic to the extreme, each strike aimed directly at the opponent’s vital points, akin to a mantis catching cicadas, swift and sudden yet bold and courageous.
Once the two clash, they quickly exchange several moves, making the void boom with sound.
The sound is so loud.
It once echoes past the ears of both armies.
Both armies are wide-eyed, watching intently, silently cheering and urging their respective general (leader)!
"Kongmen Fist!"
Ding Ling’s fist changes, suddenly shifting to a grand and elegant yet fiercely murderous powerful fist technique!
This fist technique is more upright and intense!
Every punch can produce explosive crackling sound.
Every time Zhang Feiyan and Ding Ling’s fists collide, it makes them grimace, their hands hurt.
What Zhang Feiyan doesn’t know is, Ding Ling is actually holding back by thirty percent.
If not, delivering all-out blows, Zhang Feiyan might be knocked down by Ding Ling within three moves.
Ding Ling isn’t going all-out, wanting to increase his practical experience in fist and feet.
After all, his experience in this area is almost zero.
And lacks strong enough experts for practice!
Now, finally encountering one Zhang Feiyan, Ding Ling naturally doesn’t want to defeat him so quickly.
He needs him as a whetting stone.

chapters.title: Chapter 63: Dominating All Directions
paragraphs: When all the martial arts techniques were thoroughly understood, Ding Ling would naturally choose to end this contest swiftly.
"Cai Family Fist!"
The fist technique changed.
From grand and fierce to cunning and vicious.
Zhang Feiyan was exhausted from dealing with it, breaking into a cold sweat after dozens of rounds.
He looked at Ding Ling with eyes full of incredulity.
He really couldn’t understand how a person could thoroughly study and master several completely different fist techniques to such a natural and instinctive level!
It was simply too unbelievable.
However, what made him even more incredulous was.
The change in Ding Ling’s fist technique was just the beginning!
"Wind Gate Fist!"
The fist technique was elusive as the wind, difficult to trace.
Zhang Feiyan was being run around like a dog by Ding Ling, sweating profusely.
"Eight Trigrams Palm!"
The fist technique suddenly turned into a palm technique, each palm strike was astonishingly powerful, as if the Eight Trigrams were falling, trying to trap a person in one place.
Zhang Feiyan was caught unprepared, his eyes got swollen from being struck!
The pain bared his teeth, and instinctively he was about to admit defeat.
But Ding Ling’s palm technique changed again, with an overwhelming evil qi and a scorching heat that forced his words back down his throat.
"Iron Sand Palm!"
"Lion Palm!"
"Python Palm!"
"Chain Palm!"
Various palm and fist techniques kept changing!
Combined with the light spirit body technique of wall-climbing, Ding Ling left Zhang Feiyan utterly clueless, feeling as if he were a challenger knocked out by the Eighteen Arhats!
"Bang bang bang!"
The last few collisions.
Zhang Feiyan could no longer hold on, he flew backward with a leap and waved his hand, shouting:
"I admit defeat!"
[Achievement Medal Acquired: You have won Zhang Feiyan’s recognition!]
[Note: You defeated Zhang Feiyan head-on! And made Zhang Feiyan profoundly realize what it truly means to be a master of martial arts!
Your varied martial arts, each one reaching the transformation realm!
Left Zhang Feiyan dazzled and in awe.
Your skills completely won him over!
At the same time, they filled him with unlimited confusion and misunderstanding.
Simply because he couldn’t comprehend how someone so young could not only master such varied martial arts but also take each to such a profound level.
It was astonishing and unbelievable for him!

He will undoubtedly seek to learn martial arts from you. But in front of all the assembly and numerous soldiers, he couldn’t lose face in such a manner. Perhaps if you meet in private, he won’t be so courteous!]
A notification sound suddenly arose.
Ding Ling slightly raised his eyebrows.
He thought it impossible for Zhang Feiyan to have an achievement medal, didn’t expect there was one.
Why don’t the other bandits have one?
Or perhaps they do, but since he hasn’t engaged with them, he hasn’t acquired any?
Ding Ling was somewhat eager to try.
He wanted to see if defeating those bandits could earn him achievement medals.
But now was not the time to think about that.
He suppressed his thoughts, looked at Zhang Feiyan, and cupped his hands with a smile:
"Leader Zhang, thank you for the match."
"Hehe."
Zhang Feiyan chuckled wryly:
"General Ding is educated as a celestial being, skilled in the martial dao, truly admirable. I am no match for you, and that’s no lie."
He sighed:
"If there is a chance in the future, I hope we can sit down for a good drink."
"Definitely."
Ding Ling nodded.
He glanced at the character panel:
[1: Defeat more than 20 experts in the plane: 5/20.]
It moved forward by one grid.
It seems defeating Zhang Feiyan did count.
Just as expected.
As long as one reaches the level of a first-class general, they count as a plane expert!
Juyi, Zhang He, Gao Lan, Zhao Zilong, plus Zhang Feiyan!
A total of five experts.
Only need to defeat fifteen more, then the first War God progress could be complete. What wondrous changes might occur at that time?
Ding Ling was quite expectant.
"In that case, I’ll take my leave now."
Zhang Feiyan’s face was burning.
Amidst the gathering of all eyes.
In front of the Black Mountain Army leaders, elite legion.
His best martial arts against Ding Ling, could be described as a complete defeat!
Beaten to oblivion all the way!
Others could see that Ding Ling had held back, and Zhang Feiyan, upon reflecting, naturally noticed as well.
He was astonished, thinking:

’If Ding Ling hadn’t held back, how many rounds could I last? This guy is terrifying, even if he started training in the womb, he shouldn’t be this formidable. How on earth did he acquire such fearsome martial skills?’
Moreover, he noticed Ding Ling’s control over fist technique, body technique, and martial arts were advancing at a breakneck pace.
Nine out of ten, he was being used as a whetstone by Ding Ling.
Thinking up to this point.
His face couldn’t help but turn a bit ugly.
But Ding Ling, Zhao Yun were too ferocious, with two thousand soldiers supporting, he couldn’t possibly win, and if Ding Ling went berserk, Zhang Feiyan was likely to die here.
He saw this through clearly, thus even though he felt very humiliated, with diminished authority, he had to endure and hurriedly prepare to leave with his men.
The minimum goal was achieved, it was time to go.
He regretted and felt truly stupid for impulsively agreeing to the match with Ding Ling, which left him in such a passive position now!
He initially thought that in martial arts he was sure to win, but reality slapped hard on his face! He no longer has the qualification to claim any mastery in martial arts!
"Leader Zhang, wait a moment."
Ding Ling called out.
"What is it?"
Zhang Feiyan tensed up and said:
"General Ding, don’t tell me you want to go back on your word?"
"That’s not it."
Ding Ling looked firmly at Lei Gong and the other generals:
"I just want to challenge all the generals except you, can you let them all come at me. I want to test where my ultimate martial power lies."
Ultimately, it was for the achievement medal.
But Ding Ling couldn’t blatantly say it out loud, so he casually found an excuse.
Zhang Feiyan was stunned.
Lei Gong and the other generals were shocked, but quickly a smoldering anger flared up within them.
Lei Gong, with the most straightforward and fiery temper, couldn’t help but retort:
"Someone wanting to defeat us all at once! Not even Pan Feng could maybe do that. General Ding, what makes you think you can?"
If it were a battlefield skirmish, Lei Gong and his men facing Ding Ling scattered apart, they would be undoubtedly dead.
But in a joint confrontation.
They believed they would win!
Even ants can sting an elephant to death!
But they were no ants!
They were genuine second-class generals! And many were at the peak of the second-class! Just one step from breaking into the first-class!
So many, no less than dozens of leaders!
Ding Ling wants to take them on solo?!
"We won’t know unless we fight."
Ding Ling activated full-level acting, looked down from all directions, with overbearing aura, laughed loudly:
"Surely the leaders wouldn’t be afraid?"
"Hehe."
The Great Han with a wolf fang club beside Lei Gong, sneered and leapt out first:
"I, Zuo Zizhangba, want to see General Ding’s level!"
"I, Yhiuu Digen, also want to meet General Ding."

chapters.title: Chapter 64: Heroic Boldness
paragraphs: An eight-foot-tall man with a simple appearance but eyes sharp as swords held a long knife and rode out.
"Ping Han also comes to meet General Ding."
A handsome man with overwhelming ambition laughed joyfully, whipping his horse forward, shaking the spear in his hand to create flowers of spear blossoms:
"With such boldness and spirit from General Ding, if I don’t respond, won’t it lead the whole world to think our Black Mountain Army is afraid of you!"
"Indeed."
A seven-foot-tall man with a cavalier demeanor rode out, his eyes glaring at Ding Ling:
"I, Fuyun, absolutely will not allow such a thing to happen!"
"Our Black Mountain Army is not afraid of you. I, Bai Que, will also try General Ding’s Halberd!"
A nimble and graceful man with a quilled helm, Bai Que laughed and rode out.
"I, Si Li!"
"I, Yang Feng!"
"Yhiuu Du!"
"Luo City!"
"Bai Bo!"
"Zuo Xiao!"
"Yellow Dragon!"
"Liu Shi!"
Dozens of leaders rode out, all renowned figures with their names recorded in history books.
Anyone whose name is preserved in the vast history of the Three Kingdoms naturally is no simple character!
At this moment, they all roared together, creating an earth-shattering scene.
Many players hidden among the army secretly thought:
"Ding Ling is sure to lose this time!"
Their perspective was not as acute as Zhang Feiyan’s, naturally missing Ding Ling’s retention during martial arts.
They assumed Ding Ling was only a bit stronger than Zhang Feiyan.
As such, one after another, confidently pondered:
"Just wondering if, after he loses, he’ll get captured by Yhiuu Du and others? Yhiuu Du is quite cunning and insidious. If Ding Ling suffers a major defeat, he’s bound to have a miserable time!"
These players largely envied Ding Ling.
Not just because of Ding Ling’s identity as a ’Hidden Clan Heir.’
But because Ding Ling’s journey has been smooth, even Zhao Zilong eagerly follows him across the land.
This made their eyes red with jealousy, now seeing Ding Ling’s arrogance, secretly they despised him as too arrogant and foolish:
"He’s merely a Hidden Clan Heir. If he were an ordinary person, so oblivious and unaware of his own weight, he’d have been devoured by others long ago!"
The players were quite certain.
Yhiuu Du, Yang Feng, and others were also confident of their victory!
Zhang Feiyan, however, appeared uncertain. He couldn’t guarantee victory or defeat and merely acted as a referee. As everyone’s expectant gaze fell upon him, he shouted the start of the duel.
Boom!
Dozens of leaders rode out.
Zuo Zizhangba’s horse was the tallest but ran the slowest due to his heavy frame and the immensely heavy Wolf Fang Club he wielded.
In the army, his strength was comparable to Lei Gong, known as a Herculean warrior!
"Roar!"
Yang Feng spun his single knife, letting out a fierce roar with Yellow Dragon, Liu Shi, Ping Han, and several others surrounding Ding Ling, immediately beginning the siege.
Each of them was very strong.
Some wielded fierce knives, unleashing vigorous qi that rippled through the air;
Some exhibiting lethal spear techniques, conjuring flowers capable of piercing four or five holes in a human body;
Some possessed great strength, a single strike with the Wolf Fang Club could shatter rocks and skulls;
Nearly seven or eight individuals unleashed their strongest strike against Ding Ling in perfect synchrony!
They had agreed beforehand to attack Ding Ling in rotation.
After each executed their strongest strike, they would rest briefly, allowing others to attack and then return to the fray.
Such prolonged tactics were inevitable to wear Ding Ling down!
Their plan was solid.
But reality proved extremely harsh.
This time, Ding Ling was fully committed.
He feared holding back might kill him.
He had no doubts about the Black Mountain Army leaders’ ruthlessness and insidious nature.
Just from their actions, it was evident!
Thus, as Ding Ling waved his wrist with a clear shout, the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear Technique unfolded with a clang!
Cheng Cheng Cheng!
In an instant, thirteen blossoms of spear flowers bloomed!
Each flower harbored a fierce and terrifying intent to kill!
Spear blossoms bloomed in the void, forming a Hundred Birds Paying Homage to the Phoenix pattern!
The pattern spun through the void like a Tai Chi diagram, resembling a meteor across the sky accompanied by the sound of cheng cheng cheng past everyone’s ears.
What followed was a series of screams and the sound of weapons falling.
It was just one strike.

Ding Ling utilized over two thousand pounds of strength, combined with the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear, the Wall-Climbing Technique, twisting his body on horseback, relying on the thirteen spear flowers to clash head-on with Yang Feng, Yellow Dragon, and others’ weapons, forcing seven or eight of their weapons into an unstable grip!
Four or five of them instantly lost hold of their weapons, which flew out from their grasp on the spot!
Yang Feng and Zuo Zizhangba managed to hold their weapons, but their wrists were in excruciating pain, their bodies trembling incessantly.
Each looked at Ding Ling as if gazing at a Ghost God!
"Such power?!"
"Such spear techniques?!"
"A single attack, yet so many banded together couldn’t block it?!"
They were astonished, their hearts stirred with waves of emotion, unable to remain calm.
Ding Ling, however, paid no attention to their thoughts, letting out a clear shout, swinging the Heaven-piercing Halberd towards Bai Que and others outside the circle.
Bai Que and others were bewildered!
They had already prepared for the second, third, and fourth rounds to surround Ding Ling to unleash their ultimate techniques.
Unexpectedly, Yang Feng and Zuo Zizhangba couldn’t even take one strike from him!
Bang Bang Bang!
Ding Ling’s attack showed no mercy.
The Heaven-piercing Halberd swept across with the sound of bang bang bang, Yang Feng, Zuo Zizhangba, and the others were all swept off their horses.
They had been injured from the previous clash, facing Ding Ling’s sweeping halberd, instinctively blocking with their weapons, then instantly being ’pushed’ off horseback by a tremendous force.
"Hu!"
Bai Que and others were stunned.
At this juncture, fleeing was not an option, they could only shout intensely to muster courage, attacking Ding Ling with their strongest move.
"Hahaha..."
Ding Ling’s heart was stirred with heroism, laughing, he said:
"Bring it on!"

With a spin of the Heaven-piercing Halberd, the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques unleashed fierce and cunning attacks, targeting positions unimaginable by opponents, even upon initial engagement.
But with the sound of clang clang! Bang bang bang resonating nonstop.
Within a very short time, Bai Que and dozens more were swept off their horses by Ding Ling alone!
One man confronting Black Mountain Army, except for Zhang Baiqi, Zhang Feiyan, and a few others, defeated all the leaders outright!
Complete victory!
The scene fell into deathly silence.
Zhang Feiyan’s eyes widened like copper bells, gasping, muttering:
"This guy, this guy, this guy... is he really that strong?!"
His voice trembled.
The shock was boundless.
Knowing Zuo Zizhangba and others each have their strengths! If banding together, often seven or eight could easily rival a First-class Fierce General!
Dozens could easily face several First-class Fierce Generals!

chapters.title: Chapter 65: War God’s Name Progress Bar
paragraphs: But even so.
Zuo Zizhangba, Yang Feng, and others were still defeated!
And they were defeated miserably and tragically!
What does this mean?!
"Super-Elite Expert?!"
Zhang Feiyan was shocked, and his expression changed repeatedly as he looked at Ding Ling:

"Moreover, it’s a Super-Elite Expert who possesses both strength and skill! Such experts are very rare, but without exception, they are terrifyingly powerful, capable of standing against an army alone! I actually encountered one here!"
Zhang Feiyan had a toothache.
Jizhou has an Unrivaled Divine General like Pan Feng, which is bad enough.
And now another Ding Ling has emerged.
This is too difficult to deal with!
It seems that in the future, I must be careful and make sure not to provoke Ding Ling.
The schemes in Zhang Feiyan’s heart were immediately and thoroughly restrained.
Ding Ling is too terrifying, it’s best not to provoke him, but to be peaceful and friendly, to be friends, for the good of both him and myself!
"Won?!"
The players were collectively stunned and shocked:
"How is this possible?!"

"Several dozen fierce generals of the Black Mountain Army! Each with remarkable martial arts, each with supreme skills! Yet they were all defeated so easily! Is this some kind of international joke?!"

"This guy Ding Ling! How on earth did he practice?! And did you see that Hundred Birds Paying Homage to the Phoenix move just now? It was just like Zhao Zilong’s! Could it be that he really learned Tong Yuan’s trademark skill in just a few days?!"
The players were few in number, hidden within the army.
At this moment, each of them looked at Ding Ling as if they were seeing a genius or deity!
The incredulity in their eyes was almost overflowing.
If they were like this.
The elite of the Black Mountain Army were even more terrified, looking at Ding Ling with eyes full of fear and dread!
As for the soldiers on Ding Ling’s side, their morale skyrocketed, each one raising their arms and shouting loudly like a wailing ghost:
"General’s divine might!"
"Mighty! Mighty!!"
"So strong!"
This was the first time Zhao Feng saw Ding Ling make a full effort, his blood could not help but boil, full of admiration.
Zhao Yun, however, appeared as if it was a matter of course.
Among everyone present, perhaps only he knew the most about Ding Ling’s combat power, thus he was not surprised.
"Unbelievable!"
Zuo Zizhangba, Yang Feng, Yhiuu Du, and others were all dejected, like they had lost their parents!
Lei Gong, defeated for the second time, was trembling all over.
His face was as hot as if it were on fire.
He felt ashamed of his previous statements and questions!
The louder his voice was before.
The redder his face is now! The more ashamed his heart is!
Ping Han, Bai Que, and others were no exceptions, all wishing they could find a crack in the ground to crawl into.
So many people joined forces.
Yet, they were defeated by Ding Ling in such a short time without him suffering a single scratch!
Had Ding Ling not held back.
They might all have perished here today.
Thinking of this.
Bai Que, Zuo Zizhangba, and others were shocked into motion!
Each of them looked at Ding Ling with eyes full of shock, shame, dread, fear, envy, jealousy, awe...
It was a mix of feelings, so complex to the extreme!
[Achievement Medal obtained: You have gained the deep admiration of Bai Que.]
[Achievement Medal obtained: You have received the deep recognition of Zuo Zizhangba!]
[Note: You single-handedly swept through the heroes of the Black Mountain Army! You have intimidated them all! This time their awe and fear of you is ingrained in their bones!
It is foreseeable.
In the future, whenever they encounter you on the battlefield, they will surely avoid you! Or they will rally thousands of soldiers to surround and kill you! To rely on numbers to crush you!
Their fascination and fear of your martial power and skill are palpable.

They want to approach you and study you. But they are also afraid of you. Your prestige and valor, because of this battle, will undoubtedly spread throughout the Black Mountain region and become renowned in one place!]
A prompt sounded in his ear.
Ding Ling froze slightly, glanced at the character panel.
Thinking:
"Defeating dozens of Black Mountain Army leaders, yet only earning two Achievement Medals! This doesn’t make sense?"
Bai Que and Zuo Zizhangba had Achievement Medals.
Which means Yang Feng, Yhiuu Du, and others likely have them too.
But Ding Ling did not obtain them.
Either they are not completely convinced.
Or there are other reasons.
Clearly, from the commentary, everyone was genuinely convinced.
It must be for other reasons then.
"Seems I need to carefully study the pattern."
Ding Ling mused.
"Huh?"
Ding Ling noticed a change on the character panel:
[3: You must make your War God name resonate throughout the entire Plane World. 2%/100%.]
The progress before was almost invisible.
But there was a faint indication nonetheless.
It was estimated to be less than 1%, but some recognized his War God name, so there was some progress, just not much.
And now?
Defeating the Black Mountain Army’s Zhang Feiyan, especially single-handedly taking on dozens of Black Mountain Army leaders!
It completely established his War General reputation!
’I see.’
Ding Ling suddenly understood.
To become a War God.
One must perform extraordinary feats! Do things that ordinary First-class Generals simply cannot achieve!
’I originally thought I had to rely on a particular warlord to successfully spread the War God name. Now it seems maybe not?’
Ding Ling pondered.
He planned to see how things unfold.
If becoming the War God truly doesn’t require relying on a warlord to complete, traversing the Path of Glory in the Three Kingdoms Plane.
Then that would be the best possible outcome.
"General Ding!"
Zhang Feiyan rode over on a horse and called out to Ding Ling twice.
Ding Ling snapped out of his thoughts and looked at Zhang Feiyan.
Zhang Feiyan’s heart leapt into his throat as Ding Ling looked at him.
It was as if he was being watched by an unparalleled beast.
This made it hard for Zhang Feiyan not to be nervous!
Previously, he thought Ding Ling was merely a regular First-class General, at best equal to himself!
He only regarded Ding Ling as an eagle, a leopard!
But now?
Ding Ling was like an ancient true dragon, a flaming phoenix, giving him an overwhelming psychological pressure!
Zhang Feiyan knew this was the aftermath of facing Ding Ling in several battles.
It was purely psychological!

Yet despite this, he couldn’t help being nervous. Not knowing was one thing, but knowing Ding Ling’s terrifying power made it almost impossible to remain calm, because Ding Ling could kill him at any moment!
Facing someone who can kill you, which strong warrior could stay calm?
Zhang Feiyan swallowed with difficulty, feigned calmness, and forced a smile:
"The contest is over. We admit defeat. May we leave?"
He spoke very tactfully.
His attitude was worlds apart from their first meeting!
This is the intimidation of the strong over the weak!
Ding Ling understood this well but couldn’t help but ask:
"I wonder if Leader Zhang has any Great Medicine?"
"Great Medicine?"
Zhang Feiyan was startled, but quickly responded:
"Does General Ding’s Breathing Technique require a medicinal bath?"
"Something like that."
Ding Ling didn’t mention that his Breathing Technique had already achieved Great Success into Innate Ability, and he only needed to chew it raw to absorb and utilize the medicinal power.

And they were defeated miserably and tragically!
What does this mean?!
"Super-Elite Expert?!"
Zhang Feiyan was shocked, and his expression changed repeatedly as he looked at Ding Ling:
"Moreover, it’s a Super-Elite Expert who possesses both strength and skill!
Such experts are very rare, but without exception, they are terrifyingly powerful, capable of standing against an army alone!
I actually encountered one here!"
Zhang Feiyan had a toothache.
Jizhou has an Unrivaled Divine General like Pan Feng, which is bad enough.
And now another Ding Ling has emerged.

He felt ashamed of his previous statements and questions!
The louder his voice was before.
The redder his face is now!
The more ashamed his heart is!
Ping Han, Bai Que, and others were no exceptions, all wishing they could find a crack in the ground to crawl into.
So many people joined forces.

chapters.title: Chapter 66: Zhang Baiqi of the White Horse and Silver Spear
paragraphs: Zhang Feiyan’s lips twitched twice.
Thought:
"Ding Ling has already become explosively powerful. And yet he’s still not satisfied, wanting to enhance himself through the great medicine baths?"
He sighed inwardly but said aloud:
"No."
"Oh?"
Ding Ling cast a deep glance at Zhang Feiyan.
Only when Zhang Feiyan felt a tingling on his scalp did Ding Ling say:
"That’s truly unfortunate."
Zhang Feiyan laughed dryly, feeling uncomfortable all over, increasingly regretting his rashness in leading troops to discuss this matter!
Being manipulated by Ding Ling!
This made him extremely uneasy!
However, he did not lie.
He really didn’t have the great medicine.

Many in the Black Mountain Army understood the breathing technique, and although these techniques varied in strength, the sheer number of practitioners meant the demand for medicinal ingredients was astonishing.
Supply falling short of demand was common.
Where would there be extra to give to Ding Ling?
Even if there was, it wouldn’t be given!
That’s what Zhang Feiyan thought. He didn’t want to watch Ding Ling grow increasingly terrifying while he himself stagnated.
If he had the great medicine, wouldn’t he use it himself?!
After being subdued by Ding Ling.
The sense of urgency within Zhang Feiyan enlarged to an extreme; he realized it was necessary to train martial arts and practice the breathing technique well!
He no longer wanted to experience such a situation of being manipulated!
Moreover, he made a decision in his heart:
’Unless there’s absolute certainty, never provoke Ding Ling!’
"In that case."
Ding Ling waved his hand:
"Go your separate ways now."
Zhang Feiyan took a long breath, relaxing completely.
He felt a sticky sensation on his back.
Only then.
Did he realize that during this short conversation, he had actually broken out in a cold sweat!
Zhang Feiyan, along with Zuo Zizhangba, Lei Gong, Yang Feng, and others, walked away somewhat awkwardly.

Li Damu, who had been detained earlier and had now joined the ranks of the Black Mountain Army, was tongue-tied and shocked, feeling fortunate to have survived under the hands of such a formidable general like Ding Ling!
Da da!
A group of people hastily rode away.
Soon after.
They encountered the team led by Zhang Baiqi.
"Commander-in-Chief."
Zhang Baiqi, clad in white general armor, with a white helmet, riding a white horse, looked handsome with fair skin; his weapon was a bright silver spear!
An entire ensemble of white!
Majestic and extraordinary!
Standing among the soldiers, he was like a crane among chickens!
Seeing Zhang Feiyan and his crew, all without exception, wore faces of fright and appeared quite embarrassed, he couldn’t help but step forward curiously and ask:
"What happened here?"
"Ugh."
Zhang Feiyan was extremely frustrated:
"We’ll talk once we’re back at the mountain."
Zhang Baiqi grew increasingly curious.
They merely went to talk with a Defensive General!
Arrangements were thorough on their side.
Plus, he himself led troops to provide support.
How could it turn out like this?
He was baffled.
Back at the mountain.
Through the mouths of Zuo Zizhangba, Lei Gong, and Yang Feng, Zhang Baiqi finally learned the truth.
He was stunned:
"Is there truly such a mighty general in the world?!"
’Absolutely true!’
Lei Gong was visibly scared:
"I thought Pan Feng was already unbeatable. But now it seems Pan Feng might not win against this Ding Ling!"
"Indeed. This person is terrifying!"
Others quickly chimed in.
Describing Ding Ling as absolutely unrivaled, a rare peerless general!
Without such descriptors.
They couldn’t accept the fact that dozens of their leaders had joined forces and still met defeat!
To lose to the world’s number one!
This put their minds at ease!
"The world’s number one?"
Zhang Baiqi was eager and curious:
"I’d like to try sparring with him."
"No."
Zhang Feiyan objected:
"Even at full strength, I was toyed with and mocked by him. You’re on par with me; how can you stand a chance against him?"
Zhang Baiqi raised his brow:
"I’m merely curious."

"Curiosity killed the cat, this matter ends here. Without my orders, do not go near Zhending City in Changshan County. Otherwise, if you’re killed or captured, I definitely won’t rescue you, nor will I lead a rescue to avenge you!"
Zhang Feiyan decisively settled the planning regulations.
Some leaders wanted to refute.
But thinking of Ding Ling’s terrifying might, they sighed inwardly and reluctantly shut their mouths.
Soon after.
Ding Ling’s reputation as the world’s number one military general spread throughout Black Mountain!
Even three-year-olds knew!
At this moment, Ding Ling’s fame truly began to resonate!
Ding Ling returned to Zhending City with his troops.
This time, the soldiers’ admiration for Ding Ling reached an extreme!
Each one was eager to promise to lay down their lives for Ding Ling!
From their fervent eyes, Ding Ling understood this.
He smiled slightly, feeling satisfied.
He didn’t know about Zhang Baiqi’s matter; otherwise, he would surely want to spar with Zhang Baiqi.
But since he dealt with the Black Mountain Army and understood they wouldn’t easily disrupt Zhending City’s order.
Ding Ling confidently handed the military over to Zhao Feng to manage.
He himself prepared to go to Luoyang with Zhao Yun.
Zhao Bingxuan and Zhao Xiaoyiu wanted to accompany him.
But since this was no leisure trip, naturally, there was no reason to take them.
Ding Ling told them to train well and stay at his new home in Zhending City.
The new home was a gift from the Prefect as compensation.
Though called a gift.
It’s actually the residence of the Defensive General, something Ding Ling was entitled to.
The Prefect was merely offering up what was deserved as compensation.

Ding Ling despised such a petty individual; he never interacted with him, even instructed Zhao Feng that if he encountered any unsolvable major issues, he should send a letter to seek help from Pan Feng or Tian Feng.
He had spoken about this with Pan Feng and Tian Feng; upon receiving the letter, they would surely assist Zhao Feng!
Aside from that.
Ding Ling also dealt with some trivial matters.
Later.
He took a small packet of gold and set out with Zhao Yun.
The gold was obtained earlier during the raid on Bai Bo bandits, and hadn’t been used.
Going to Luoyang now, money and resources would surely be indispensable. Naturally, he took the gold.
On the way to Luoyang.
The strife was constant.
Bandits were rampant.
Looting and murder occurred frequently.
The atmosphere of chaos grew more apparent.
Especially after some lawless players joined in, further magnifying this chaotic scene to the extreme.
Zhao Yun was filled with worry, lamenting the Han Dynasty fate.
"Do you think the Han Dynasty is truly on the verge of complete collapse?"
Zhao Yun asked as he walked quickly alongside Ding Ling.
"Indeed."
Ding Ling didn’t hide the truth and said:

"Since Dong Zhuo entered the capital, the Han Dynasty has been nothing but crumbling bones! As various State Governors and Prefects independently recruit soldiers, the dynasty is destined to become a relic of the past!"
"Then how can the land return to peace?"
Zhao Yun’s face was filled with distress:
"The civilians are suffering terribly!"
Indeed.
Along the way, Ding Ling had even witnessed the horror of villages where children were eaten!
The truly brutal chaotic era hadn’t even arrived yet.
And already such inhuman events were occurring.
Though only on a small scale.
But even so, it was enough to move and shock people!

chapters.title: Chapter 67: Hu Zhen’s Troops
paragraphs: It’s just like this now.
The future is unimaginable!
This is why Zhao Yun sighed.
He is kind-hearted and compassionate towards the people, which is perfectly normal.
For his kindness, Ding Ling didn’t have much to say.
Zhao Yun’s kindness, integrity, sense of structure, ambition, courage, and bravery are inherent in him. Without these, he wouldn’t be Zhao Yun!
Naturally, he wouldn’t be the revered Zhao Zilong of Changshan!
Ding Ling knew this long ago, hence he chose to understand.
Besides.
Though Ding Ling has killed many since coming to this chaotic world, he has principles and doesn’t kill indiscriminately!
In fact, Zhao Yun has a strong urge to kill too, showing no mercy to enemies!
But his rare kindness, integrity, and bravery deserve admiration and praise from many.
Like Cao Mengde.
When he has no boundaries, he really has none, having committed massacres not once but multiple times.
Only because of his perspective, courage, and such top-tier qualities that Ding Ling had considered joining him before; otherwise, it would have been better to work alone.
"I chose the Path of the War God; the path of conquest doesn’t suit me!"
Ding Ling also doesn’t regret his choice.
Conquest clearly consumes more time, effort, and energy!
He’s long had a measure in his heart regarding his choices.
Traveling westward.
The closer they got to Luoyang.
The worse the people’s lives became.
Hebei region was slightly better, and tragedies of cannibalism weren’t common.
In Gong County, not far from Luoyang, tragedies were more prevalent.
Ding Ling even saw some soldiers raiding civilians, whipping passersby, laughing loudly, acting very blatant and inhumane!
"Whose soldiers are they?!"
Zhao Yun was furious!
Gripping the Dragon Gall Silver Spear, he was ready to rush out and fight.
Ding Ling stopped him:
"If you save these people now, you’re essentially forcing them into a dead end."
"Why?"
Zhao Yun looked sideways.

"They might not die now. But you saved them, killed these soldiers, and it became known to their commanding general. These people might all be implicated and killed! You should be able to see that these are inhumane soldiers, and their commander is surely capable of such inhumane acts!"
Zhao Yun gritted his teeth, ultimately holding back from taking action, but remained resentful throughout the journey.
Leaving Gong County far behind.
On the way.
A few disheveled soldiers saw Zhao Yun and Ding Ling’s tall and fast horses and wanted to rob them, but Ding Ling acted before Zhao Yun could, flipping the Heaven-piercing Halberd, clang!
With one strike, he directly pierced a soldier’s shoulder blade.
"Ah!"
The soldier fell screaming.
The other soldiers were furious, ready to retaliate, clang clang clang!

Zhao Yun couldn’t hold back his killing intent, and with a long spear pointed, starlight flickered in the void, and in the sound of bang bang bang, five soldiers all got their wrists pierced, leaving a coin-sized hole.
Suffering such heavy arm injuries, the five screamed, dropped their weapons, and fled.
Ding Ling did not chase, only furrowed his brows slightly.
He initially intended to stay out of it, learn skills first.
Unexpectedly.
This place encountered outrageous robbery?
"Are they blind? Didn’t they see I’m wearing Tiger Valor General’s armor?!"
Ding Ling was stunned, caught off guard by these soldiers.
Precisely because of this armor.
Wars along the way did not affect them.
Some bandits avoided them from afar, and there were some brazen ones who attempted to rob Ding Ling and Zhao Yun but were killed by both of them.
Killing many of them, a natural Evil Qi surrounded them, looking like trouble not to be mess with.
Though occasionally there were still bandits and thieves who, seeing Ding Ling was few, attempted to rob, kill, and steal horses.
These people were all killed without exception.
Entering Hebei, such incidents decreased significantly.
Near Gong County.
Many soldiers were sensible, not causing trouble.
But the soldiers just now, whether from arrogance or blindness, directly tried to rob?
"No other choice."
Ding Ling thought for a moment, directly spearing the still-screaming soldier, mounted his horse, and chased the few soldiers not far away.
"Is it time to act?"
Zhao Yun inexplicably felt excited.
"Haha."
Ding Ling chuckled bitterly:
"Since we’ve acted, let’s eliminate all threats."
"Okay."
Zhao Yun’s spirits lifted, his entire being energizing, his eyes glowing brightly, gripping the Dragon Gall Silver Spear, he said:
"The beasts of Gong County and the soldiers’ clothes and armor are identical. They must be the same group. We kill them, acting on the Celestial Path! Eliminating bandits for the people!"
Ding Ling nodded, accepting it without objection.
His horse ran fast.
Quickly catching up with the soldiers, he killed four with one strike each, leaving one to interrogate him briefly, and under his desperate pleas, splat!
Directly beheaded him.
"So it’s Hu Zhen’s troops."
Ding Ling pondered:
"How could Hu Zhen’s forces be here? Shouldn’t he be in Luoyang at this time?"
Hu Zhen, courtesy name Literary Talent, was a renowned hero of Liangzhou, subordinate to Li Jue, appointed as the Governor of Dongjun, an important general under Dong Zhuo’s command.
This is what Ding Ling knew.
As to which official position Hu Zhen holds now?
And why he leads troops here.
Ding Ling was clueless.
However, this did not affect his actions.
If acting attracts complaints from players, Ding Ling heading to Luoyang would be throwing himself into a trap?
Thinking about it.
Ding Ling decided to act at night.
Glancing at the sky.
Not far from nightfall.
Da da!
Sounds of hooves seemed to be coming, vaguely hearing shouts:
"I heard something ahead, hurry up!"
"Let’s go."
Ding Ling suddenly turned and rode away.
Zhao Yun was stunned, his burning passion cooled, instinctively following Ding Ling.
He trusts Ding Ling.
Moreover, Ding Ling excels both on and off the mountain, convincing him to willingly follow Ding Ling.
Traveled far.
Ding Ling hid behind a big tree, watching from afar.

Because of amazing progress in his abilities, his senses are extremely sharp, his eyesight extraordinary, though he couldn’t clearly see the faces hundreds of meters away, he could roughly estimate the number of people.
"Over a hundred elite troops."
Ding Ling touched the big bow, glanced at the arrow pouch on the horse’s side:
"Killing them is more than enough."
Ding Ling took off the armor, tied the horse, took a single knife from the horse’s side, tore a piece of cloth from his clothes, masked his face, and carried the bow.
Zhao Yun was shocked, puzzled.
Ding Ling explained briefly.
Zhao Yun understood, no longer questioning further. Regarding the Alien group, he had heard a lot on Penglai Mountain.
Many were no different from ordinary people, just more curious, and enthusiastic towards him.
Someone like Ding Ling, an Alien, is unique!

sentences.text: It’s just like this now.
The future is unimaginable!
This is why Zhao Yun sighed.
He is kind-hearted and compassionate towards the people, which is perfectly normal.
For his kindness, Ding Ling didn’t have much to say.
Zhao Yun’s kindness, integrity, sense of structure, ambition, courage, and bravery are inherent in him.
Without these, he wouldn’t be Zhao Yun!
Naturally, he wouldn’t be the revered Zhao Zilong of Changshan!
Ding Ling knew this long ago, hence he chose to understand.
Besides.
Though Ding Ling has killed many since coming to this chaotic world, he has principles and doesn’t kill indiscriminately!
In fact, Zhao Yun has a strong urge to kill too, showing no mercy to enemies!

Like Cao Mengde.

He’s long had a measure in his heart regarding his choices.

The worse the people’s lives became.

"Whose soldiers are they?!"

Gripping the Dragon Gall Silver Spear, he was ready to rush out and fight.
Ding Ling stopped him:
"If you save these people now, you’re essentially forcing them into a dead end."
"Why?"
Zhao Yun looked sideways.
"They might not die now.
But you saved them, killed these soldiers, and it became known to their commanding general.
These people might all be implicated and killed!
You should be able to see that these are inhumane soldiers, and their commander is surely capable of such inhumane acts!"

"Ah!"
The soldier fell screaming.
The other soldiers were furious, ready to retaliate, clang clang clang!

Zhao Yun couldn’t hold back his killing intent, and with a long spear pointed, starlight flickered in the void, and in the sound of bang bang bang, five soldiers all got their wrists pierced, leaving a coin-sized hole.
Suffering such heavy arm injuries, the five screamed, dropped their weapons, and fled.
Ding Ling did not chase, only furrowed his brows slightly.
He initially intended to stay out of it, learn skills first.
Unexpectedly.
This place encountered outrageous robbery?
"Are they blind?
Didn’t they see I’m wearing Tiger Valor General’s armor?!"
Ding Ling was stunned, caught off guard by these soldiers.
Precisely because of this armor.
Wars along the way did not affect them.
Some bandits avoided them from afar, and there were some brazen ones who attempted to rob Ding Ling and Zhao Yun but were killed by both of them.
Killing many of them, a natural Evil Qi surrounded them, looking like trouble not to be mess with.
Though occasionally there were still bandits and thieves who, seeing Ding Ling was few, attempted to rob, kill, and steal horses.
These people were all killed without exception.
Entering Hebei, such incidents decreased significantly.
Near Gong County.
Many soldiers were sensible, not causing trouble.
But the soldiers just now, whether from arrogance or blindness, directly tried to rob?
"No other choice."
Ding Ling thought for a moment, directly spearing the still-screaming soldier, mounted his horse, and chased the few soldiers not far away.
"Is it time to act?"
Zhao Yun inexplicably felt excited.
"Haha."

"Since we’ve acted, let’s eliminate all threats."

chapters.title: Chapter 68: The Two Slaughter Through the Elite Cavalry Regiment
paragraphs: And it’s almost impossible to have a second one.
If it weren’t, those aliens wouldn’t be so curious and eager to explore Ding Ling!
These days, Zhao Yun has seen all of this, and his heart is clear about it.
He just didn’t speak or ask.
At this moment, hearing Ding Ling’s explanation, he also began to choose to remove his armor, cover his face, abandon his horse, and follow Ding Ling, wielding a single saber.
The single saber was from the armory in Zhending City, Jizhou, and was of very good quality.
So Ding Ling prepared one for both himself and Zhao Yun.
This is also because their horses are good, and they have horseshoes. Otherwise, it would be impossible to carry so much and travel so far without damage.
As for why they installed horseshoes?
There are so many players. The technology of horseshoes has long been leaked and spread. Even if Ding Ling didn’t equip them, someone would suggest he does!
Ding Ling stayed behind the tree for a good quarter of an hour or so.
Watching as it got dark, the moon had already risen.
And the searching crowd was getting closer to them.
At this moment, they were less than fifty meters away from Ding Ling.
Ding Ling no longer hesitated, bending his bow and nocking an arrow, aiming at an officer on horseback in the crowd, swoosh!
An arrow shot out with a whoosh!
It hit the officer’s head directly, and due to the Five-Stone Bow and Ding Ling’s great power, the arrow pierced through the skull! Even knocking down a cavalryman behind him.
"Enemy attack!"
Over a hundred elite soldiers shouted loudly.
Ding Ling ignored them.
With his keen ears and sharp eyes,
he only needed a little light, relying on his full level of Basic Archery skills, to kill enemies in this vast land without pressure.
Swoosh!
Swoosh swoosh swoosh!
Each sharp arrow was like a scythe of death, and where they passed, elite soldiers fell one by one.
Because of the close distance,
Ding Ling not only hit everything but also managed to pierce one person’s abdomen with an arrow and then immediately hit a second person! It was also a fatal blow to the second person!
Often one arrow could kill one person and seriously injure another!
The efficiency of killing was undeniable.
Zhao Yun watched, his blood boiling, constantly handing arrows to Ding Ling.
His archery was average, and instead of shooting, he might as well supply Ding Ling with arrows to increase their efficiency in killing enemies!
Swoosh swoosh swoosh!
In just a few seconds.
Dozens were dead or injured!
The fastest to die were eight cavalrymen! Following them were the archers.
Without cavalry charging, the archers counterattacked from afar!
The remaining infantry who fought in close combat could no longer hold on, shouting and scattering.
They dared not run in Ding Ling’s direction.
Because everyone knew the archer was from that direction, running there meant a quicker death!
Human nature is selfish.
No one wants to die.
Especially not as the first one to die.
They could now only gamble that they wouldn’t be shot and that before their companions died, they could run out of the archer’s range!
Swoosh swoosh swoosh!
The arrows were like flowing light, even like lightning, and the sound of them piercing through the sky resonated across the universe, accompanied by heart-wrenching cries echoing in the wild fields.
More than ninety elite soldiers were dead.
The two who ran the farthest thought they might escape.
Unexpectedly, a flash of arrow light behind them.
Thud!
They were hit in the back, the arrowhead piercing through vital spots, staggering a few steps before crashing to the ground, still unwilling to believe:
"From such a distance? How could they hit? How could they reach?!"
"All dead."
Ding Ling gazed into the distance.
The cries had drawn more soldiers and horses towards them.
Zhao Yun was not afraid but pleased:
"Is this luring the snake out of its hole?"
"You could say that."

Ding Ling walked over and finished off the dying enemies with a knife, taking the General Armor from one of the officers and then picking up some quivers and a long spear from the bodies of these elite soldiers.
He planted the single saber into the wild ground.

Holding the long spear and carrying a quiver, he walked forward in large strides, using his Wall-Climbing Technique, his body like the wind, catching up to a spooked horse, grabbing its reins, and with a full-level riding skill, leapt elegantly onto the horse’s back.
He tightly squeezed the horse’s belly, controlling it.
Zhao Yun had also changed his attire, similarly picking up some quivers, following Ding Ling’s example, abandoning the single saber, picking up a long spear, and riding on.
The two were now outfitted like Hu Zhen’s forces.
From head to toe.
Including their weapons.
All changed!
With their faces covered, on a dark and windy night!
If they were still recognized, Ding Ling would just have to accept it!
"Kill!"
To prevent recognition, the two did not plan to use the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear Technique.
Instead, they used the Spirit Crane Spear Technique and Spiritual Snake Spear Technique.
Not many knew these techniques; even fewer could execute them.
Moreover, they looked similar to common spear techniques, unlike the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear, which had distinctive and recognizable patterns.
"Such audacity. Just the two of them dare to kill our people!"
Someone spotted Ding Ling and Zhao Yun, shouting loudly:
"Get them, slaughter them! I want to use their heads as footballs!"
Clop clop!
Hundreds of soldiers and horses charged quickly.
Each one exuding a fierce aura, filled with murderous intent!
Ding Ling and Zhao Yun were fearless, raising their brows, and charged forward.
Still perfectly synchronized in their actions.
Ding Ling charged at the forefront.
His spear sometimes like a spiritual snake, devouring people, each starburst leaving people dead;
other times like a graceful flying crane, swiftly piercing through heads!
With over two thousand pounds of force and perfect-level spear techniques,
Ding Ling on horseback was like a kingly force crushing ordinary elite soldiers and officers!
With Zhao Yun following, perfectly mopping up and eliminating any threats.

Ding Ling charged left and right without worry, driving straight for the enemy officer, scaring him into yelling repeatedly, but to no avail; Ding Ling, like a swift boat cutting through waves, burst upon the officer trying to escape, raising his spear as spear flowers gleamed in the air.
Thud!
The officer’s throat was pierced through, dead beyond dead.

The remaining soldiers, seeing this, were horrified, and after a brief fierce struggle, realizing Ding Ling and Zhao Yun’s teamwork was unrivaled and impossible to resist, fled in terror, scattering in all directions.
After Ding Ling and Zhao Yun pursued for a while,
realizing they couldn’t catch up with some soldiers,
Ding Ling would bend his bow and nock an arrow, with Zhao Yun supplying the arrows, for long-range shooting.
Some soldiers who ran far were also shot down from a distance.
The two of them, two horses, two spears, and a bow!
Had brutally killed as many as three hundred elite cavalry!
This remarkable feat.
Even Zhao Yun couldn’t help but feel excited.
It was exhilarating!
It was powerful!
"Continue."
After picking up some quivers, Ding Ling and Zhao Yun continued on their way.
They traveled several kilometers.
Through a small forest.
Finally seeing a camp.
With ears pricked up.
They could hear the pleas of women, the wails of the elderly, the screams of strong men.
Looking intently.
They saw an inhumane scene unfold.
Rows of civilians were being beheaded.

chapters.title: Chapter 69: Storming the Enemy Camp
paragraphs: As for the women, they were directly dragged into the tent.
From the sounds of pleading and screaming, it was clear what was happening inside.
Zhao Yun’s face was dark with anger, almost about to drip water.
Ding Ling frowned slightly, thought for a moment, then started to maneuver his horse behind a large tree, drawing his bow and aiming at some soldiers who were about to behead civilians.
Zhao Yun instinctively took out the quiver, starting to hand arrows to Ding Ling.
Swoosh, swoosh, swoosh!
The sharp arrows cut through the air with a whistling sound, thud! It hit right in the forehead of a soldier who was raising a large knife to chop off a young man’s head!
Because they were at a distance.
The arrow could not pierce through the skull.
But it still managed to kill the enemy with one shot!
"Enemy attack!!"
The soldiers were stunned for a moment, seemingly unable to believe that someone dared to attack them, knowing that they were under the command of General Hu Zhen of Dong Zhuo’s army!
Who would dare to touch them?
But upon seeing the fallen comrades with arrows in their foreheads, watching each of their comrades fall one by one in extremely short intervals.
They had no choice but to believe.
They involuntarily screamed from the depths of their hearts.
Some soldiers immediately rolled to one side to find cover, some drew their swords and yelled, ready to fight to the death;
Some even directly grabbed civilians to use as human shields...
Different reactions varied.
But it could be predicted that those who drew their swords and yelled for a fight were the quickest to die.
Swoosh, swoosh, swoosh!
The arrows were sharp and swift, like meteors falling from the sky, like asteroids tearing through the space, swoosh, swoosh, as soldiers were shot dead on the spot one by one.
In just a moment.
The area around the civilians became empty!
The soldiers who rushed out of the tent faced a series of swift arrows and were so frightened that they retreated back into the tent.
"Hoo!"
Watching this, Zhao Yun couldn’t help but let out a long breath, secretly admiring.
If it were him using the Five-Stone Bow, he definitely couldn’t hold on for so long!
But Ding Ling was able to do it with ease.
His endurance was so long-lasting, his breath so extended; it’s as if he had trained his kung fu to the transformation realm.
Zhao Yun felt that he needed to study diligently with Ding Ling.
"Let’s go!"
Ding Ling put down the bow, hung it on the side of his horse, held a long spear, and rode out, charging towards the enemy camp!
He first killed the executioner.
Then he shot and killed the visible archers.
Were there hidden archers?
Ding Ling didn’t know.
But relying on their reaction, defense, and resistance capabilities, dealing with ten arrows was more than enough.
Not to mention that now the two of them were working together.
They could block more arrows!
Zhao Yun, having charged through Changban Slope seven times, withstood many sneak attacks yet remained unharmed, clearly showing his prowess!
"Swoosh swoosh!"
The two had just charged within fifty meters of the enemy camp when hidden archers began shooting cold arrows at them.
Ding Ling noticed them and nonchalantly brushed the arrows aside.
His charge speed increased.
After deflecting several waves of arrows, he rushed to the front gate of the enemy camp and directly barged in.
Perhaps the enemy was too careless, or they thought no one would dare attack them.
As a result, the gate of the camp was wide open.
Ding Ling rode straight in.
Entering the camp.
Engaging in close combat.
The perfect collaboration between Ding Ling and Zhao Yun once again demonstrated an almost supernatural effect.
They cut through the enemy ranks like a hot knife through butter!
The soldiers were scattered.
Not formed into a battle array, they were of no concern.
Many soldiers were unarmored, creating chaos in the camp.
Ding Ling charged and trampled the large tent, stabbing them to death inside!
Charging all the way to the Central Army Tent!
Ding Ling saw a burly man, eight feet tall, full of a bushy beard, with disheveled armor and a slightly tipsy face, his eyes like copper bells.
Surrounded by hundreds of elite troops.
"That must be Hu Zhen!"
Ding Ling’s mind settled, holding his spear as he charged towards Hu Zhen’s direction.
"General Hu! There they are!"
A soldier pointed to Ding Ling and Zhao Yun’s location, shouting:
"It’s just those two!"
"Two men dare to storm the camp on horseback!"
General Hu was furious:
"They’re not putting me, Hu Zhen, into their eyes!"
He shouted loudly:
"Fire arrows, kill them!"
The first row of a hundred archers immediately drew their bows and aimed at Ding Ling and Zhao Yun.
Compared to other soldiers.
These hundreds of soldiers were clearly the elite of the elite, undoubtedly Hu Zhen’s Imperial Guard Corps!
Ding Ling was as clear as a mirror, fearless, gripping his long spear tightly.
As the enemy archers let loose their arrows, he twirled his spear like a wind wheel, clang, clang!
Blocking all arrows outside.
He moved side by side with Zhao Yun.
Zhao Yun was slightly behind by half a head.
The two working together, the hundred archers’ arrows couldn’t penetrate their spear technique to hit them.
Although they couldn’t use the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear.

But the Spirit Crane and Spirit Snake Spear Techniques were extraordinary, with just a casual flick, Ding Ling produced a dozen spear flowers, swift as lightning; Zhao Yun, though slightly lacking, could also produce nine spear flowers.
Together, they could block all frontal arrows!
Sneak arrows from the side were sometimes unavoidable.
But at this moment, such sneak arrows were scarce.
Because apart from the Central Army, the other soldiers were already in chaos.
At this moment, watching Ding Ling and Zhao Yun unrestrained, unharmed, charging toward them, even Hu Zhen panicked:
"How are these two men so formidable?!"
The originally tipsy mind suddenly cleared up a lot.
He mounted his horse and held his spear, looking at Ding Ling and Zhao Yun with vigilance, gritting his teeth, he yelled:
"Form up, charge!"
Ding Ling and Zhao Yun were already within twenty meters. At this proximity, archers were no longer effective.
The cavalry lined up.
In groups, they charged toward Ding Ling and Zhao Yun.
Engaging in close combat.
The cooperation between Ding Ling and Zhao Yun was perfected.

The two of them, wielding spears, seemed like a lawnmower passing through a field of flowers, easily killing or injuring hundreds of cavalry, dripping with blood, they found themselves before Hu Zhen.
"How is this possible?!"

Hu Zhen was horrified; he didn’t even flee, shouting, thrusting his spear like lightning at Ding Ling’s eyes, which Ding Ling easily parried, returning a strike that knocked Hu Zhen off his horse, followed by another strike that ended Hu Zhen.
Hu Zhen’s eyes were full of regret and remorse.
If he had run at the beginning, he might have had a chance to escape.
But later when Ding Ling and Zhao Yun approached, running would only mean exposing his back to them, a path to death, so he endured the fear and suddenly delivered his strongest strike to Ding Ling.
But his supreme skill was lightly blocked by Ding Ling.
"Where did this God of Death come from?!"
"They are too strong!"
"What did I do to provoke them? Why do they want to kill me?"
With regret, confusion, bewilderment, anger, reluctance, and a longing for life.
The light in Hu Zhen’s eyes grew dimmer, until it completely faded away.
"General Hu is dead!"
Someone shouted loudly.
Followed by turmoil in the Central Army!
Already very terrified of Ding Ling and Zhao Yun, a group of people now had no one to command them, and they immediately scattered in all directions.

sentences.text: As for the women, they were directly dragged into the tent.
From the sounds of pleading and screaming, it was clear what was happening inside.
Zhao Yun’s face was dark with anger, almost about to drip water.
Ding Ling frowned slightly, thought for a moment, then started to maneuver his horse behind a large tree, drawing his bow and aiming at some soldiers who were about to behead civilians.
Zhao Yun instinctively took out the quiver, starting to hand arrows to Ding Ling.
Swoosh, swoosh, swoosh!
The sharp arrows cut through the air with a whistling sound, thud!
It hit right in the forehead of a soldier who was raising a large knife to chop off a young man’s head!
Because they were at a distance.
The arrow could not pierce through the skull.
But it still managed to kill the enemy with one shot!
"Enemy attack!!"
The soldiers were stunned for a moment, seemingly unable to believe that someone dared to attack them, knowing that they were under the command of General Hu Zhen of Dong Zhuo’s army!
Who would dare to touch them?
But upon seeing the fallen comrades with arrows in their foreheads, watching each of their comrades fall one by one in extremely short intervals.
They had no choice but to believe.
They involuntarily screamed from the depths of their hearts.
Some soldiers immediately rolled to one side to find cover, some drew their swords and yelled, ready to fight to the death;
Some even directly grabbed civilians to use as human shields...
Different reactions varied.
But it could be predicted that those who drew their swords and yelled for a fight were the quickest to die.
Swoosh, swoosh, swoosh!
The arrows were sharp and swift, like meteors falling from the sky, like asteroids tearing through the space, swoosh, swoosh, as soldiers were shot dead on the spot one by one.
In just a moment.
The area around the civilians became empty!
The soldiers who rushed out of the tent faced a series of swift arrows and were so frightened that they retreated back into the tent.
"Hoo!"
Watching this, Zhao Yun couldn’t help but let out a long breath, secretly admiring.
If it were him using the Five-Stone Bow, he definitely couldn’t hold on for so long!
But Ding Ling was able to do it with ease.
His endurance was so long-lasting, his breath so extended; it’s as if he had trained his kung fu to the transformation realm.
Zhao Yun felt that he needed to study diligently with Ding Ling.
"Let’s go!"
Ding Ling put down the bow, hung it on the side of his horse, held a long spear, and rode out, charging towards the enemy camp!
He first killed the executioner.
Then he shot and killed the visible archers.
Were there hidden archers?
Ding Ling didn’t know.
But relying on their reaction, defense, and resistance capabilities, dealing with ten arrows was more than enough.
Not to mention that now the two of them were working together.
They could block more arrows!
Zhao Yun, having charged through Changban Slope seven times, withstood many sneak attacks yet remained unharmed, clearly showing his prowess!
"Swoosh swoosh!"
The two had just charged within fifty meters of the enemy camp when hidden archers began shooting cold arrows at them.
Ding Ling noticed them and nonchalantly brushed the arrows aside.
His charge speed increased.
After deflecting several waves of arrows, he rushed to the front gate of the enemy camp and directly barged in.
Perhaps the enemy was too careless, or they thought no one would dare attack them.
As a result, the gate of the camp was wide open.
Ding Ling rode straight in.
Entering the camp.
Engaging in close combat.
The perfect collaboration between Ding Ling and Zhao Yun once again demonstrated an almost supernatural effect.
They cut through the enemy ranks like a hot knife through butter!
The soldiers were scattered.
Not formed into a battle array, they were of no concern.
Many soldiers were unarmored, creating chaos in the camp.
Ding Ling charged and trampled the large tent, stabbing them to death inside!
Charging all the way to the Central Army Tent!
Ding Ling saw a burly man, eight feet tall, full of a bushy beard, with disheveled armor and a slightly tipsy face, his eyes like copper bells.
Surrounded by hundreds of elite troops.
"That must be Hu Zhen!"
Ding Ling’s mind settled, holding his spear as he charged towards Hu Zhen’s direction.
"General Hu!
There they are!"
A soldier pointed to Ding Ling and Zhao Yun’s location, shouting:
"It’s just those two!"
"Two men dare to storm the camp on horseback!"
General Hu was furious:
"They’re not putting me, Hu Zhen, into their eyes!"
He shouted loudly:
"Fire arrows, kill them!"
The first row of a hundred archers immediately drew their bows and aimed at Ding Ling and Zhao Yun.
Compared to other soldiers.
These hundreds of soldiers were clearly the elite of the elite, undoubtedly Hu Zhen’s Imperial Guard Corps!
Ding Ling was as clear as a mirror, fearless, gripping his long spear tightly.
As the enemy archers let loose their arrows, he twirled his spear like a wind wheel, clang, clang!
Blocking all arrows outside.
He moved side by side with Zhao Yun.
Zhao Yun was slightly behind by half a head.
The two working together, the hundred archers’ arrows couldn’t penetrate their spear technique to hit them.
Although they couldn’t use the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear.

But the Spirit Crane and Spirit Snake Spear Techniques were extraordinary, with just a casual flick, Ding Ling produced a dozen spear flowers, swift as lightning; Zhao Yun, though slightly lacking, could also produce nine spear flowers.
Together, they could block all frontal arrows!
Sneak arrows from the side were sometimes unavoidable.
But at this moment, such sneak arrows were scarce.
Because apart from the Central Army, the other soldiers were already in chaos.
At this moment, watching Ding Ling and Zhao Yun unrestrained, unharmed, charging toward them, even Hu Zhen panicked:
"How are these two men so formidable?!"
The originally tipsy mind suddenly cleared up a lot.
He mounted his horse and held his spear, looking at Ding Ling and Zhao Yun with vigilance, gritting his teeth, he yelled:
"Form up, charge!"
Ding Ling and Zhao Yun were already within twenty meters.
At this proximity, archers were no longer effective.
The cavalry lined up.
In groups, they charged toward Ding Ling and Zhao Yun.
Engaging in close combat.
The cooperation between Ding Ling and Zhao Yun was perfected.

The two of them, wielding spears, seemed like a lawnmower passing through a field of flowers, easily killing or injuring hundreds of cavalry, dripping with blood, they found themselves before Hu Zhen.

"They are too strong!"
"What did I do to provoke them?
Why do they want to kill me?"
With regret, confusion, bewilderment, anger, reluctance, and a longing for life.
The light in Hu Zhen’s eyes grew dimmer, until it completely faded away.
"General Hu is dead!"
