chapters.title: Chapter 70: Peerless Great Medicine
paragraphs: Ding Ling ignored these people.
Instead, he thrust open the central army tent with a spear and entered the tent, only to see a bed inside.
Lying haphazardly on the bed were several young maidens with torn clothes and lifeless eyes.
Apart from the bed,
there were also many jars of wine!
The pungent smell of blood mixed with the scent of alcohol assaulted Ding Ling’s nostrils.
Ding Ling wrinkled his nose.
His eyes, sharp like lightning, scanned the scene inside the tent and its contents.
Spotting a bundle, he speared it open.
To his surprise, it was filled with gold.
And an unidentifiable age-old ginseng.
Ding Ling jumped off his horse, re-wrapped the bundle, casually hung it on the side of his horse’s belly, then swiftly mounted and turned to leave the tent.
Almost simultaneously,
[Achievement Medal acquired: Horse Trample Enemy Camp!]
[Note: Two men, two horses, two spears, toppled an army camp of more than two thousand men! This is an incredibly remarkable feat!
Your actions will completely intimidate enemies from all directions!
Your achievement is unsurpassed by anyone! This is a moment highlighting your glory and honor!]
The notification sounded.
Ding Ling slightly raised an eyebrow.
Thinking:
’Hu Zhen is a major general on Dong Zhuo’s side, yet he didn’t have an achievement medal?!’
Ding Ling was puzzled.
"Could it be because someone else farmed the achievement medals from them, and when I try, there’s nothing left to farm?"
It seems likely to be the only possibility.
Since the dispute with the Bandits Bai Bo, Ding Ling had vaguely sensed this.
Leading up to the Black Mountain Army, and now with Hu Zhen.
He had this feeling even stronger.
Aside from this, it seems that no other explanation or reason is plausible.

’If that’s really the case. I need to speed up. Otherwise, if all the achievement medals of the historical figures of the Three Kingdoms are farmed out, I guess I’ll have to farm other achievement medals. Just like this ’Horse Trample Enemy Camp!’’
Receiving the ’Horse Trample Enemy Camp’ achievement medal was unexpected for Ding Ling.
But it’s better to have it than not.
He thought it through.
"Brother Ding."
Zhao Yun rode up beside Ding Ling and whispered:
"What should we do now? Shall we leave?"
Not knowing if anyone here would notice them.
Zhao Yun spoke softly, fearing exposure upon reaching Luoyang.
"Save the people and then leave."
Ding Ling activated his ’Broadcasting Skill’ to alter his voice, disguising himself as a mighty warrior whose voice was as powerful as the sea crashing against the shore:
"I’ll tell them to leave."
"Your voice..."
Zhao Yun was stunned, amazed.
"I’ll teach you the trick after we leave here."
In the real world, there are many peculiar voice actors.
Since learning the ’Broadcasting Skill,’ Ding Ling’s skills in this area were at full level, and he could be said to be at the pinnacle of the broadcasting field.
Some time later.
Ding Ling and Zhao Yun had left the enemy camp, moving towards their previous location.
Not long ago.
He rode across the land, using a voice entirely different from his own, instructing the people to run south or into the mountains, away from here.
All Ding Ling could do was this.
If he didn’t save these people,
they would have died that night.
He found a ledger in Hu Zhen’s tent.
Full of detailed records of decapitated civilians, fraudulently claiming meritorious awards.
Needless to say.
If Ding Ling had come later, none of these people would have survived!
Now that he saved them, what becomes of them in the future is beyond Ding Ling’s control; he can only do his best and leave it to fate, hoping that more of them survive.
Zhao Yun understood this and did not ask for anything more, but was increasingly dissatisfied with the current state of the Han Dynasty.
He hoped to end this chaotic situation soon!
"Dong Zhuo’s generals are truly lacking in virtue, knowledge, and wisdom, dare to do such shortsighted things. They are severing Dong Zhuo’s foundation!"

Zhao Yun and Ding Ling stripped off their bloodstained enemy armor, discarded it, and changed back into their own armor, retrieving their native sabers from the desolate ground, hanging them by their horses.
As for the two horses they seized,
Ding Ling and Zhao Yun chose to release them.
These two were Xiliang warhorses, too distinct; riding them was akin to announcing to the world that Ding Ling and Zhao Yun were the culprits of trampling the enemy camp!
Everything they looted, such as quivers, spears, etc., they discarded.
Including that bundle.
The gold inside was taken by Ding Ling, kept together with the original gold.
The medicinal ginseng, he ate it raw.
Crunch!
A bite into his stomach.
The medicine’s power surged like waves, rushing through his skin and channels.
The Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique operated automatically!
The medicine’s power turned into a ’hammer,’ pounding relentlessly on his limbs and bones, vessels, and organs!
Causing subtle changes throughout his body!
Meanwhile.
Heat waves rushed to his mind.
Ding Ling felt an internal heat.
He could distinctly sense his physical attributes improving.
The heat wave lasted for ten full breaths.
Ding Ling was not frightened but delighted.
One must know that the herbs obtained from the bandit elimination only sustained the heat for a few breaths.
Now, a single ginseng could sustain it for ten breaths.
"This is an extraordinary great medicine!"
Ding Ling felt like he struck gold.
Needless to say.
This great medicine was certainly intended by Hu Zhen for his cultivation, only he didn’t get the chance to use it, intercepted by Ding Ling.
Ding Ling glanced at his character panel:
[Strength +0.2]
[Defense +0.2]
Already quite satisfactory.
Before, after eating so much, it only increased by 0.1.
Now with one bite, 0.2!
Knowing Ding Ling’s current cultivation realm,
ordinary low-tier techniques couldn’t enhance his strength!
One bite directly increasing 0.2 in strength was extraordinary.
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
He took another bite.
Swoosh! Swoosh!
The medicine’s power even materialized into a white streak at his nose, quickly retracting into the form of a ’hammer,’ hammering relentlessly at his channels and skin!
[Strength +0.2]
[Defense +0.2]
Another 0.2!
Ding Ling was overjoyed.
He realized that taking medicine might indeed enhance cultivation speed!
Of course, provided there is medicine to take!
Crunch crunch!
A few more bites.
The entire ginseng was eaten raw.
The medicine’s power surged wildly, roaring and crashing within.
For an ordinary person eating such a timeless great medicine, they would die from excessive supplementation, bleeding from every orifice!
Over-supplementation is no joke!
But not so for Ding Ling.

His Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique had become instinct, capable of autonomously absorbing and refining medicine power anywhere and anytime, akin to a perpetual motion machine, hence Ding Ling didn’t worry about the risk of over-supplementation.
[Strength +0.8]
[Defense +0.8]
Another increase of 0.8 points.
Ding Ling’s strength leapt by a significant margin!
He felt that if he trampled the enemy camp again, it would surely be even easier!
He glanced at his character panel.
Now his power stood as follows:
[Constitution: 1 (normal human is 1 point), Intelligence: 2, Strength: 20.2+0.1+0.2+0.2+0.8=(21.5), Agility: 20.2, Physique: 20.2, Defense: 12+0.1+0.2+0.2+0.8(13.3), Charm: 3]

chapters.title: Chapter 71: Li Jue’s March
paragraphs: Strength increased to 21.5.
A massive force of over two thousand pounds! Absolute divine power!
Defense increased to 13.3.
At this point, ordinary blows are already ineffective against him!
The speed of piercing damage repair will greatly increase!
"A single dose of Great Medicine increased strength and defense by 1.2 each!"
Ding Ling was shaken, his thoughts began to diversify.
Originally, he didn’t have such a strong desire for Great Medicine!
Because the medicinal herbs consumed during bandit suppression didn’t provide much enhancement.
The effort in searching for herbs.
He might as well learn more martial arts! Those attribute points would accumulate rapidly and more effectively than consuming medicine, wouldn’t they?
But apparently, the Great Medicine’s effect is quite good too.
This naturally brought different ideas to Ding Ling’s mind.
If he encounters a treasure vault in the future, he should probably dig through it! He can’t afford to miss it casually!
Ding Ling made a decision in his heart.
Zhao Yun watched as Ding Ling crunched away at a piece of Treasure Medicine, following which his aura increased dramatically, he was astounded and envious:
"If I could eat directly like Brother Ding and freely absorb and refine the medicinal power, how wonderful would that be?"
Herbal baths not only consume time, effort, and energy.
But also waste a lot of medicinal power!
Eating directly like this.
How refreshing?
Zhao Yun, who suffered through the hardships of herbal baths, understood their intricacies, which made him exceptionally envious.
"Then train well in the Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique. If you don’t understand anything, ask me."
Ding Ling smiled.
"Now that you mention it, I forgot to ask you about the technique of voice changing."
Zhao Yun was curious:
"If I can master this voice-changing technique, doing some tasks to confuse or disrupt the enemy would become much easier and more efficient, wouldn’t it?"
"That’s true indeed. I’ll teach you."
Ding Ling explained the voice change technique in detail.
He had full level broadcasting skill.
Thus, his explanation of the essence and principles was clear and easy to understand.

Zhao Yun, with his extraordinary talent and understanding—not necessarily unmatched across the Three Kingdoms but not far off—grasped the concept, yet truly mastering it was beyond him for the moment. In frustration, he admired Ding Ling even more.
Being versatile is fundamental.
Various mastered skills came easily to him, countless and endless, never knowing what Ding Ling’s next hidden card might be!
So mysterious, so strong!
Moreover.
He was grateful for Ding Ling’s cooperation in disrupting Hu Zhen’s Legion that was harming the civilians, further elevating his esteem for Ding Ling!
He understood that if not for his request, Ding Ling might not have meddled; fundamentally, Ding Ling wasn’t someone fond of interfering!
For this, Zhao Yun saw clearly.
All the more, he resolved to follow Ding Ling firmly!
Ding Ling knew nothing of this.
Otherwise, he would surely be delighted.
After all, gaining the allegiance of a rare genius like Zhao Yun is indeed a matter of immense pride.
The two rode through the night.
Far away from the crime scene!
The next day.
In Yanshi City.
At Cloud Inn.
A window seat on the first floor.
Ding Ling and Zhao Yun were dining when suddenly they heard calls and the rapid sound of galloping hooves from the street.
Following the noise.
They saw a fierce General leading over a thousand cavalry charging through the street, ferocious and intimidating, as if ready to devour anyone in his path.
Passersby, travelers, and civilians hurriedly gave way, showing faces of fear.
Curious, Ding Ling summoned the innkeeper to inquire.

The innkeeper hesitated to speak, so Ding Ling offered some loose silver he had exchanged at the ancient city’s pawnshop that morning. All he had were large gold pieces, and everyday transactions still required silver, thus he exchanged some.
The innkeeper’s eyes lit up, taking the silver eagerly, biting it to confirm its authenticity, he then glanced around before whispering:
"Sir, you may not know. That General who just passed by is Li Jue, a favored General of the current Prime Minister!"
"Li Jue?"
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow.

Li Jue, styled Zhirang, was one of the warlords during the late Eastern Han Dynasty, a military official and powerful minister during Emperor Xian’s reign, holding the position of Grand Marshal and General of Cavalry.
After Dong Zhuo’s death, he and Guo Si joined forces, thoroughly crippling the already dying Great Han Dynasty.
It could be said.
If it wasn’t for their final devastation, the Great Han might have survived a little longer, but their involvement accelerated the dynasty’s demise several times over.
Moreover, it seems Hu Zhen is his subordinate, and judging by his indulgence of Hu Zhen, this guy is definitely a ruthless and brutal person!
And now Li Jue’s urgent rush out of the city undoubtedly signals Hu Zhen’s incident.
Indeed.
The innkeeper whispered:

"It’s said that early today, rumors were circulating that General Hu Zhen was killed by two Wuming experts. Additionally, their main camp was thoroughly overturned! The two openly attacked the Prime Minister’s elite troops right under the Emperor’s gaze! This is nothing less than a slap in the Prime Minister’s face!
The Prime Minister will be furious!
General Li Jue will surely be reprimanded.
Besides, General Li Jue is Hu Zhen’s superior, someone audaciously killed General Hu Zhen under his watch and escaped, this is absolutely intolerable for him."
The innkeeper sighed:

"The world’s too chaotic. Assuming there’s no surprise, Yanshi City will soon be sealed off, starting to inspect the travelers coming and going. I see you both are outsiders and happened to be generals; if General Li Jue encounters you, there might be trouble. I advise you to eat and drink well, and quickly leave Yanshi City secretly.
To avoid unnecessary trouble!"
The innkeeper clearly knew Li Jue’s group’s way of doing things very well.
Out of appreciation for the silver, he revealed quite a lot of useful information to Ding Ling.
Money can make the devil turn the mill.
That says it all.
Ding Ling thanked the innkeeper.
After finishing with Zhao Yun, he bought some provisions and a jug of wine before decisively setting off on horseback.
Moreover, they planned to stay clear of Li Jue’s main troops.
Not out of fear of Li Jue.
But because they were getting closer and closer to Luoyang.
If a conflict really occurs.
His grand plan of learning martial arts might be dashed!
He planned to wait until he had mastered martial arts before dealing with anything else!
Right now, he truly didn’t want to cause trouble!
Zhao Yun clearly understood Ding Ling’s thoughts and didn’t say much more, though he deeply sympathized with the civilians’ plight along the way.
He also disliked the arrogance and tyranny of Li Jue’s Great Army.
But on his own, how many could he save?
He seems to have grasped this point, contemplating how to bring peace to the world, secure the people’s livelihood.
Thump, thump!
Only after leaving Yanshi City did the two breathe a sigh of relief.
The atmosphere of war and slaughter in Yanshi City was intensely saturated, highly oppressive!
Even as strong as they were, they didn’t like staying in such a place.
And nearly half an hour after they left.
Yanshi City was sealed.
This was something Ding Ling heard travelers mention.
Ding Ling silently thought he was fortunate.
If he hadn’t bribed the innkeeper, he might have missed the best timing to leave the city, and then got tangled up with Li Jue’s army’s unnecessary trouble, a real conflict might have occurred.

sentences.text: Strength increased to 21.5.
A massive force of over two thousand pounds!
Absolute divine power!
Defense increased to 13.3.
At this point, ordinary blows are already ineffective against him!
The speed of piercing damage repair will greatly increase!
"A single dose of Great Medicine increased strength and defense by 1.2 each!"
Ding Ling was shaken, his thoughts began to diversify.
Originally, he didn’t have such a strong desire for Great Medicine!
Because the medicinal herbs consumed during bandit suppression didn’t provide much enhancement.
The effort in searching for herbs.
He might as well learn more martial arts!
Those attribute points would accumulate rapidly and more effectively than consuming medicine, wouldn’t they?
But apparently, the Great Medicine’s effect is quite good too.
This naturally brought different ideas to Ding Ling’s mind.
If he encounters a treasure vault in the future, he should probably dig through it!
He can’t afford to miss it casually!
Ding Ling made a decision in his heart.
Zhao Yun watched as Ding Ling crunched away at a piece of Treasure Medicine, following which his aura increased dramatically, he was astounded and envious:
"If I could eat directly like Brother Ding and freely absorb and refine the medicinal power, how wonderful would that be?"
Herbal baths not only consume time, effort, and energy.
But also waste a lot of medicinal power!
Eating directly like this.
How refreshing?
Zhao Yun, who suffered through the hardships of herbal baths, understood their intricacies, which made him exceptionally envious.
"Then train well in the Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique.
If you don’t understand anything, ask me."
Ding Ling smiled.
"Now that you mention it, I forgot to ask you about the technique of voice changing."
Zhao Yun was curious:
"If I can master this voice-changing technique, doing some tasks to confuse or disrupt the enemy would become much easier and more efficient, wouldn’t it?"
"That’s true indeed.
I’ll teach you."
Ding Ling explained the voice change technique in detail.
He had full level broadcasting skill.
Thus, his explanation of the essence and principles was clear and easy to understand.

Zhao Yun, with his extraordinary talent and understanding—not necessarily unmatched across the Three Kingdoms but not far off—grasped the concept, yet truly mastering it was beyond him for the moment.
In frustration, he admired Ding Ling even more.
Being versatile is fundamental.
Various mastered skills came easily to him, countless and endless, never knowing what Ding Ling’s next hidden card might be!
So mysterious, so strong!
Moreover.
He was grateful for Ding Ling’s cooperation in disrupting Hu Zhen’s Legion that was harming the civilians, further elevating his esteem for Ding Ling!
He understood that if not for his request, Ding Ling might not have meddled; fundamentally, Ding Ling wasn’t someone fond of interfering!
For this, Zhao Yun saw clearly.
All the more, he resolved to follow Ding Ling firmly!
Ding Ling knew nothing of this.
Otherwise, he would surely be delighted.
After all, gaining the allegiance of a rare genius like Zhao Yun is indeed a matter of immense pride.
The two rode through the night.
Far away from the crime scene!
The next day.
In Yanshi City.
At Cloud Inn.
A window seat on the first floor.
Ding Ling and Zhao Yun were dining when suddenly they heard calls and the rapid sound of galloping hooves from the street.
Following the noise.
They saw a fierce General leading over a thousand cavalry charging through the street, ferocious and intimidating, as if ready to devour anyone in his path.
Passersby, travelers, and civilians hurriedly gave way, showing faces of fear.
Curious, Ding Ling summoned the innkeeper to inquire.
The innkeeper hesitated to speak, so Ding Ling offered some loose silver he had exchanged at the ancient city’s pawnshop that morning.
All he had were large gold pieces, and everyday transactions still required silver, thus he exchanged some.
The innkeeper’s eyes lit up, taking the silver eagerly, biting it to confirm its authenticity, he then glanced around before whispering:
"Sir, you may not know.
That General who just passed by is Li Jue, a favored General of the current Prime Minister!"
"Li Jue?"
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow.

Li Jue, styled Zhirang, was one of the warlords during the late Eastern Han Dynasty, a military official and powerful minister during Emperor Xian’s reign, holding the position of Grand Marshal and General of Cavalry.
After Dong Zhuo’s death, he and Guo Si joined forces, thoroughly crippling the already dying Great Han Dynasty.
It could be said.
If it wasn’t for their final devastation, the Great Han might have survived a little longer, but their involvement accelerated the dynasty’s demise several times over.
Moreover, it seems Hu Zhen is his subordinate, and judging by his indulgence of Hu Zhen, this guy is definitely a ruthless and brutal person!
And now Li Jue’s urgent rush out of the city undoubtedly signals Hu Zhen’s incident.
Indeed.
The innkeeper whispered:
"It’s said that early today, rumors were circulating that General Hu Zhen was killed by two Wuming experts.
Additionally, their main camp was thoroughly overturned!
The two openly attacked the Prime Minister’s elite troops right under the Emperor’s gaze!
This is nothing less than a slap in the Prime Minister’s face!
The Prime Minister will be furious!
General Li Jue will surely be reprimanded.
Besides, General Li Jue is Hu Zhen’s superior, someone audaciously killed General Hu Zhen under his watch and escaped, this is absolutely intolerable for him."
The innkeeper sighed:
"The world’s too chaotic.
Assuming there’s no surprise, Yanshi City will soon be sealed off, starting to inspect the travelers coming and going.
I see you both are outsiders and happened to be generals; if General Li Jue encounters you, there might be trouble.
I advise you to eat and drink well, and quickly leave Yanshi City secretly.
To avoid unnecessary trouble!"
The innkeeper clearly knew Li Jue’s group’s way of doing things very well.
Out of appreciation for the silver, he revealed quite a lot of useful information to Ding Ling.
Money can make the devil turn the mill.
That says it all.
Ding Ling thanked the innkeeper.
After finishing with Zhao Yun, he bought some provisions and a jug of wine before decisively setting off on horseback.
Moreover, they planned to stay clear of Li Jue’s main troops.
Not out of fear of Li Jue.
But because they were getting closer and closer to Luoyang.
If a conflict really occurs.
His grand plan of learning martial arts might be dashed!
He planned to wait until he had mastered martial arts before dealing with anything else!
Right now, he truly didn’t want to cause trouble!
Zhao Yun clearly understood Ding Ling’s thoughts and didn’t say much more, though he deeply sympathized with the civilians’ plight along the way.
He also disliked the arrogance and tyranny of Li Jue’s Great Army.
But on his own, how many could he save?
He seems to have grasped this point, contemplating how to bring peace to the world, secure the people’s livelihood.
Thump, thump!
Only after leaving Yanshi City did the two breathe a sigh of relief.
The atmosphere of war and slaughter in Yanshi City was intensely saturated, highly oppressive!
Even as strong as they were, they didn’t like staying in such a place.
And nearly half an hour after they left.
Yanshi City was sealed.
This was something Ding Ling heard travelers mention.
Ding Ling silently thought he was fortunate.
If he hadn’t bribed the innkeeper, he might have missed the best timing to leave the city, and then got tangled up with Li Jue’s army’s unnecessary trouble, a real conflict might have occurred.

chapters.title: Chapter 72: Entering the City, Following the Map
paragraphs: This was not what Ding Ling wished to see.
Fortunately, this matter did not happen.
Ding Ling did not think further and instead discussed the ’Broadcasting Skill’ and ’Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique’ with Zhao Yun along the way.
Overall.
It was Ding Ling guiding and teaching.
Zhao Yun was learning.
More than once, he envied Ding Ling’s talent, especially when he was struggling and diligently studying while Ding Ling leisurely enjoyed the scenery.
This contrast was even more pronounced!
It dealt a blow to his confidence but also secretly instilled a surge of fighting spirit!
Even if he can’t be like Ding Ling, he must strive to be the second best in the world!!
Moreover, he must work hard not to be left too far behind by Ding Ling!
Ding Ling’s progress was too fast.
Zhao Yun was truly concerned that one day, he wouldn’t even be able to see Ding Ling’s back.
On this day.
The two finally arrived outside Luoyang Ancient City.
Ding Ling looked closely.
He saw the city walls of the ancient city almost reach the limits of height, width, and thickness of a city!
From the outside, it appeared extremely majestic and grand!
Even from such a distance, looking at the city, one could feel a heavy and ancient historical aura coming towards them!
This aura.
Ordinary ancient cities do not have.
Without a doubt.
This aura of the ancient city was ’cultivated’ by successive Human Emperors, extraordinary people, and groups of remarkable human elites!
People reading good books can cultivate their aura!
So too can ancient cities. With a group of talented individuals among them, they can naturally ’carve out’ something unique for themselves over time!
It’s incredible to say, but in this world, as it seems so far, this is indeed the case.
"This is Luoyang City!"
Zhao Yun exclaimed, moved:
"I’ve long heard of Luoyang’s extraordinary greatness, and today, it truly is so."
"Let’s go."
Ding Ling smiled.
The two traveled together, chatted, and their feelings deepened with time.
At each other’s request.
They exchanged names.
No longer using Brother Zhao or Brother Ding, which seemed too distant.
Of course, this was in private.
In public, Ding Ling, being a General, Zhao Yun would still respectfully address Ding Ling as General.
Clip-clop!
They rode their horses.
Queue to enter the city.
They found the gate officer blatantly accepting bribes.
Those who paid were let into the city.
Those who did not pay were turned away or chased off.
Ding Ling handed Zhao Yun some silver.
Though Zhao Yun felt shame over the corruption in the royal capital, being weak, he was powerless and could only go with the flow.
Upon entering the ancient city.
Ding Ling glanced at Zhao Yun, seeing he was somewhat depressed, understanding his thoughts, he did not comfort him, as many things require personal realization rather than mere comfort.
"Fortunately, my geography skills are full level."
Ding Ling, upon entering Luoyang City.
Walked around and almost became dizzy.
Just because Luoyang City is enormous, with complex geographical conditions, those unfamiliar with it can often get lost.
Ding Ling used his full-level geography skills to follow the rough map provided by Tong Yuan, heading east through the city.
The more he walked east.
The more rundown the houses became.
But this facilitated their actions.
No need to worry about inadvertently offending anyone.
In the city center, the west side occasionally appeared some Generals or officials, all extremely imposing, with entourages generally consisting of dozens of people!
Those unable to dodge being beaten to death were not uncommon.
Ding Ling himself witnessed one.
This soon?
Such a horrifying incident occurred?
Ding Ling didn’t know if he was lucky or unlucky?
Seeing such a bloody matter upon entering Luoyang Ancient City.
But he did not choose to help at this moment, and even pulled Zhao Yun away.
He saw the flag on the team attacking with a large character written:
"Guo!"
Someone with the surname Guo, so blatant in disregarding human life.
It could only be Guo Si!
Such a personage, Ding Ling currently couldn’t provoke, nor did he want to.
Zhao Yun’s expression grew more unsightly.
Until they rode their horses, took several turns, arriving at the front of a rundown mansion, Zhao Yun’s expression returned to normal.
"Prince’s Mansion."
Ding Ling looked up at the plaque with the two characters.
After carefully comparing with the map, confirming it was correct, he stepped forward to knock on the door.
Knock, knock!
Shortly after.
The sound of footsteps came from within, creak!
The door opened!
A thin figure, with a clean face, carrying a sword on his waist, was revealed.
He looked at Ding Ling and Zhao Yun, vigilantly asked:
"Who are you looking for?"
"I’m looking for Master Wang."
Ding Ling cupped his hands in greeting to show goodwill, while producing a letter, said:
"This is a letter from the Spear God of Penglai Mountain entrusted to me to deliver to Master Wang."
"Oh?"
The boy’s eyes lit up, the alert on his face slightly faded, he took the letter without looking at it, and just said to Ding Ling and Zhao Yun:
"Please wait here for a moment."
He turned back, closed the door, creak!
The door shut tight again.
Zhao Yun was speechless:
"Was this young man just now Master Wang’s disciple? Why is he so vigilant?"
"Perhaps experienced too much suffering. Endured too much hardship to be this way."
Ding Ling, however, understood this young man:
"After all, this is Luoyang!"
Recalling what he had seen not long ago.
Zhao Yun fell silent.
A period later.
With slightly hurried footsteps arriving.
Creak!
The door opened.
An elder with sideburns white, a tall and well-built figure, brows like sword edges, eyes like a bright moon appeared.
Ding Ling and Zhao Yun observed him.
He too examined Ding Ling and Zhao Yun.
He did not speak.
Ding Ling and Zhao Yun preceded to greet and say hello:
"Greetings, senior!"
"Mm."
The elder nodded, a bit curious and asked:
"Which one is Zhao Yun?"
"Senior, I am he."
Zhao Yun stood out.
"Mm."
The elder kindly nodded at Zhao Yun, then turned his eyes, eyes revealing marvelous light, staring at Ding Ling:
"Then you are the incomparable child of the era, the unparalleled super genius Ding Ling mentioned in Tong Yuan’s letter?!"
Ding Ling did not peek at the letter.
So he did not know how Tong Yuan described him.
Upon hearing such words from the elder, he could not help but feel his cheeks heat up, hurriedly replied with solemnity:
"A child of the era, unparalleled dare not assume. I am indeed Ding Ling, that’s correct."
"Mm."
The elder nodded, turned, and walked inside:
"Come in and talk."
He spoke without looking back:
"Shi A, help the guests with their horses, prepare the guest rooms. After settling them, come to the study to see me."
"Yes, Master."
The young man responded, turned to Ding Ling and Zhao Yun, actively helped them with their horses.
Ding Ling indicated it wasn’t necessary.
He insisted on leading them.
Ding Ling, seeing his stubborn nature, allowed him.
Thinking of Shi A, Master Wang.
Ding Ling’s mind sparked like lightning!
’Could it be this Master Wang is none other than the legendary Sword God Wang Yue?!’

chapters.title: Chapter 73: The Young Swordsman Shi A
paragraphs: The Sword God’s disciple, Wang Yue, had one named Shi A!
Moreover, Shi A had a sword hanging from his waist, calloused hands, and moved with a certain finesse. It was obvious he was skilled in swordsmanship.
Also, to be an old friend of Tong Yuan, he must definitely be a master.
Then linking to Luoyang, Master Wang...
Ding Ling guessed that the old man earlier was most likely the Sword God Wang Yue!
He was a bit thrilled.
This was Wang Yue!
At eighteen, he rode alone into Helan Mountain, taking the head of the Qiang Race chieftain and returning, with no one daring to meet his blade!
At thirty, he was nearly undefeated across the world, a peerless figure!
In history, as a ranger, he was listed among the heroes in the historical records of the Three Kingdoms!
Such a person, how formidable he must be, needs no more elaboration!
’I never imagined Tong Yuan would be so considerate. He actually introduced Wang Yue to me.’
Ding Ling’s heart rippled.
’If I can learn Wang Yue’s Martial Arts, I can certainly advance even further! Not to say invincible, but probably not far off!’
Thinking this.
Ding Ling’s heart pounded for a while before slowly calming down.
The world’s number one war general.
It’s the dream of so many people!
Before Ding Ling got the ’Library,’ it was something he didn’t even dare to imagine, but now he had hope of achieving it. How could he not be happy?
Although through taking Great Medicine, he would one day achieve this goal.
But not to mention that Great Medicine is hard to find, even if found, how much could he consume?
And apprenticing to learn skills.
It could undoubtedly accelerate this process infinitely.
This is much more reliable than taking Great Medicine, at least it seems so at present.
Especially learning skills from a wonder like Wang Yue, it’s even more reliable!
Shi A was taciturn and didn’t talk much.
On the road, his exchanges with Ding Ling and Zhao Yun were few and far between.
Only when arranging the bedrooms did he speak a few more words.
Once everything was settled.
Shi A took Ding Ling and Zhao Yun towards the study.
The Prince’s Mansion looked rundown from the outside.
But actually, inside there was Heaven and Earth, covering quite a large area.
You could see.
It was once glorious.
But now it had clearly fallen into decline.
The entire Prince’s Mansion, aside from Shi A and Master Wang, there was no one else.
Of course.
Now there were two more, Ding Ling and Zhao Yun.
On the road, Ding Ling couldn’t help but ask:
"May I ask if your respected master is named Wang Yue?"
"Indeed."
Shi A nodded, frowning as he looked at Ding Ling:
"It’s best not to mention my master’s name recklessly. You should call him Master Wang, like everyone else."
He really was called Wang Yue.
Ding Ling was delighted.
But it was indeed strange.
In the mansion of a generation’s Sword God, no player had found their way here.
How strange!
Players are supposed to be a species that gets into everything!
’Perhaps it has something to do with Wang Yue’s refusal to teach outsiders?’
Ding Ling pondered.
Games usually directly assign newcomers an initial ’Martial Arts Learning’ place.
Ding Ling was in the Jizhou military camp.
The vast majority of newcomers were mingling in various military camps, or in places like Penglai Mountain, or racing horses outside the passes, etc.
Wang Yue was deeply hidden in the complex environment of Luoyang, alone, during such a sensitive period, and not gathering crowds to teach newcomers seemed understandable.
If he gathered crowds and was misunderstood by Dong Zhuo, he could end up in prison. If he were to be directly killed, there would be nowhere to appeal.
Of course, most likely Wang Yue could not be killed.
But now that he was older, he probably didn’t want to run around anymore.
Otherwise, such a large Prince’s Mansion wouldn’t only have two people.
To decline this far, Wang Yue no longer inviting anyone, his attitude was quite apparent.
Click, click!
Although Shi A was taciturn, he could speak right to the point, and his actions were neat and tidy.
He clearly explained some precautions.
All the way, leading Ding Ling and Zhao Yun, they stepped into the inner courtyard, passed through a long corridor, turned several corners, and arrived outside the study.
The door of the study was open.
Standing outside.
You could clearly see the decor inside.
Covering about fifty square meters, with several bookshelves inside, all filled with bamboo slips or books.
In the center against the wall, there was also a weapon rack.
On it lay an ancient sword.
Clearly a study room.
But the decorations and furnishings were a bit different.
Somewhat eclectic.
At this moment, Wang Yue was standing in front of a bookshelf reading, seemingly unaware of their arrival.
"Master."
Shi A stepped into the study, reverently:
"The people have been brought."
"Hmm."
Wang Yue nodded, placing a bamboo slip back on the bookshelf.
He turned, facing them, looking Ding Ling and Zhao Yun up and down:
"I already know your intentions."
Ding Ling was pleased.
Zhao Yun breathed a sigh of relief.
"But let me say this first."
Wang Yue said sternly:

"Though I can give face to Tong Yuan, that doesn’t mean I’ll give face to you. If your qualifications and comprehension greatly differ from what Tong Yuan described, or if your performance disappoints me, I will directly send you away."
Zhao Yun appeared relaxed.
Ding Ling’s full-level acting kicked in, listening with a straight face, though a hint of tension flashed in his eyes.
Wang Yue saw all this, thinking Ding Ling was scared, and couldn’t help but added:

"Of course, I don’t demand you compare to the likes of the era’s sons Chiyou, the Yellow Emperor, etc. As long as you can match or stand shoulder to shoulder with Shi A, I will keep you and teach you all my Martial Arts."
Zhao Yun nodded, unconcerned.
His Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique had not yet achieved Great Success. Biting off more than one can chew, he came more to accompany Ding Ling and gain experience.
Ding Ling’s full-level acting was constantly in play, appearing particularly earnest and solemn.
If he didn’t use acting, Ding Ling feared he wouldn’t hold up.
Only by gaining Wang Yue’s approval could Ding Ling learn Martial Arts.
He naturally should present himself seriously, not too casually.
If he angered Wang Yue, that would be a significant loss.
Didn’t you hear Wang Yue say, ’if your qualifications, comprehension differ too far from Tong Yuan’s description, I will send you away’?
How did Tong Yuan describe Ding Ling?
It was full of praise!
What Ding Ling needed to do now was to lower Wang Yue’s expectations, not let them be too high, otherwise, a poor performance might directly backfire, making Ding Ling leave.
Ding Ling understood this well, naturally knowing how to behave.
Fortunately, the full-level acting skill again revealed its ’mighty power.’
Wang Yue, indeed, lowered his requirements each time:
"I don’t require you to be like Shi A in every aspect, as long as one aspect like bone structure or comprehension is similar, that’s enough."
He paused, gestured for Ding Ling and Zhao Yun to come over:
"Let’s test your bone structure first."
Ding Ling was speechless but still stepped forward to let Wang Yue examine his bones.
After examining Ding Ling, Wang Yue frowned without speaking, then turned to examine Zhao Yun.
After examining Zhao Yun.
Wang Yue’s tense face looked much better, and the look in his eyes towards Zhao Yun carried admiration and praise.

sentences.text: The Sword God’s disciple, Wang Yue, had one named Shi A!
Moreover, Shi A had a sword hanging from his waist, calloused hands, and moved with a certain finesse.
It was obvious he was skilled in swordsmanship.
Also, to be an old friend of Tong Yuan, he must definitely be a master.
Then linking to Luoyang, Master Wang...
Ding Ling guessed that the old man earlier was most likely the Sword God Wang Yue!
He was a bit thrilled.
This was Wang Yue!
At eighteen, he rode alone into Helan Mountain, taking the head of the Qiang Race chieftain and returning, with no one daring to meet his blade!
At thirty, he was nearly undefeated across the world, a peerless figure!
In history, as a ranger, he was listed among the heroes in the historical records of the Three Kingdoms!
Such a person, how formidable he must be, needs no more elaboration!
’I never imagined Tong Yuan would be so considerate.
He actually introduced Wang Yue to me.’
Ding Ling’s heart rippled.
’If I can learn Wang Yue’s Martial Arts, I can certainly advance even further!
Not to say invincible, but probably not far off!’
Thinking this.
Ding Ling’s heart pounded for a while before slowly calming down.
The world’s number one war general.
It’s the dream of so many people!
Before Ding Ling got the ’Library,’ it was something he didn’t even dare to imagine, but now he had hope of achieving it.
How could he not be happy?
Although through taking Great Medicine, he would one day achieve this goal.
But not to mention that Great Medicine is hard to find, even if found, how much could he consume?
And apprenticing to learn skills.
It could undoubtedly accelerate this process infinitely.
This is much more reliable than taking Great Medicine, at least it seems so at present.
Especially learning skills from a wonder like Wang Yue, it’s even more reliable!
Shi A was taciturn and didn’t talk much.
On the road, his exchanges with Ding Ling and Zhao Yun were few and far between.
Only when arranging the bedrooms did he speak a few more words.
Once everything was settled.
Shi A took Ding Ling and Zhao Yun towards the study.
The Prince’s Mansion looked rundown from the outside.
But actually, inside there was Heaven and Earth, covering quite a large area.
You could see.
It was once glorious.
But now it had clearly fallen into decline.
The entire Prince’s Mansion, aside from Shi A and Master Wang, there was no one else.
Of course.
Now there were two more, Ding Ling and Zhao Yun.
On the road, Ding Ling couldn’t help but ask:
"May I ask if your respected master is named Wang Yue?"
"Indeed."
Shi A nodded, frowning as he looked at Ding Ling:
"It’s best not to mention my master’s name recklessly.
You should call him Master Wang, like everyone else."
He really was called Wang Yue.
Ding Ling was delighted.
But it was indeed strange.
In the mansion of a generation’s Sword God, no player had found their way here.
How strange!
Players are supposed to be a species that gets into everything!
’Perhaps it has something to do with Wang Yue’s refusal to teach outsiders?’
Ding Ling pondered.
Games usually directly assign newcomers an initial ’Martial Arts Learning’ place.
Ding Ling was in the Jizhou military camp.
The vast majority of newcomers were mingling in various military camps, or in places like Penglai Mountain, or racing horses outside the passes, etc.
Wang Yue was deeply hidden in the complex environment of Luoyang, alone, during such a sensitive period, and not gathering crowds to teach newcomers seemed understandable.
If he gathered crowds and was misunderstood by Dong Zhuo, he could end up in prison.
If he were to be directly killed, there would be nowhere to appeal.
Of course, most likely Wang Yue could not be killed.
But now that he was older, he probably didn’t want to run around anymore.
Otherwise, such a large Prince’s Mansion wouldn’t only have two people.
To decline this far, Wang Yue no longer inviting anyone, his attitude was quite apparent.
Click, click!
Although Shi A was taciturn, he could speak right to the point, and his actions were neat and tidy.
He clearly explained some precautions.
All the way, leading Ding Ling and Zhao Yun, they stepped into the inner courtyard, passed through a long corridor, turned several corners, and arrived outside the study.
The door of the study was open.
Standing outside.
You could clearly see the decor inside.
Covering about fifty square meters, with several bookshelves inside, all filled with bamboo slips or books.
In the center against the wall, there was also a weapon rack.
On it lay an ancient sword.
Clearly a study room.
But the decorations and furnishings were a bit different.
Somewhat eclectic.
At this moment, Wang Yue was standing in front of a bookshelf reading, seemingly unaware of their arrival.
"Master."
Shi A stepped into the study, reverently:
"The people have been brought."
"Hmm."
Wang Yue nodded, placing a bamboo slip back on the bookshelf.
He turned, facing them, looking Ding Ling and Zhao Yun up and down:
"I already know your intentions."
Ding Ling was pleased.
Zhao Yun breathed a sigh of relief.
"But let me say this first."
Wang Yue said sternly:
"Though I can give face to Tong Yuan, that doesn’t mean I’ll give face to you.
If your qualifications and comprehension greatly differ from what Tong Yuan described, or if your performance disappoints me, I will directly send you away."
Zhao Yun appeared relaxed.
Ding Ling’s full-level acting kicked in, listening with a straight face, though a hint of tension flashed in his eyes.
Wang Yue saw all this, thinking Ding Ling was scared, and couldn’t help but added:
"Of course, I don’t demand you compare to the likes of the era’s sons Chiyou, the Yellow Emperor, etc.
As long as you can match or stand shoulder to shoulder with Shi A, I will keep you and teach you all my Martial Arts."
Zhao Yun nodded, unconcerned.
His Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique had not yet achieved Great Success.
Biting off more than one can chew, he came more to accompany Ding Ling and gain experience.
Ding Ling’s full-level acting was constantly in play, appearing particularly earnest and solemn.
If he didn’t use acting, Ding Ling feared he wouldn’t hold up.
Only by gaining Wang Yue’s approval could Ding Ling learn Martial Arts.
He naturally should present himself seriously, not too casually.
If he angered Wang Yue, that would be a significant loss.
Didn’t you hear Wang Yue say, ’if your qualifications, comprehension differ too far from Tong Yuan’s description, I will send you away’?
How did Tong Yuan describe Ding Ling?
It was full of praise!
What Ding Ling needed to do now was to lower Wang Yue’s expectations, not let them be too high, otherwise, a poor performance might directly backfire, making Ding Ling leave.
Ding Ling understood this well, naturally knowing how to behave.
Fortunately, the full-level acting skill again revealed its ’mighty power.’
Wang Yue, indeed, lowered his requirements each time:
"I don’t require you to be like Shi A in every aspect, as long as one aspect like bone structure or comprehension is similar, that’s enough."
He paused, gestured for Ding Ling and Zhao Yun to come over:
"Let’s test your bone structure first."
Ding Ling was speechless but still stepped forward to let Wang Yue examine his bones.
After examining Ding Ling, Wang Yue frowned without speaking, then turned to examine Zhao Yun.
After examining Zhao Yun.
Wang Yue’s tense face looked much better, and the look in his eyes towards Zhao Yun carried admiration and praise.

chapters.title: Chapter 74: Sword God Wang Yue
paragraphs: "Zhao Yun’s innate abilities can truly dominate a region, one in ten thousand! He is a genuine martial arts prodigy!"
Wang Yue was satisfied:

"No wonder Tong Yuan said your talent and foundation are extraordinary. You are the perfect material for martial arts. Rest assured, under my guidance, I will teach you sword technique well, striving to make you a formidable general skilled in both spear and sword!"
Zhao Yun expressed his gratitude.
Wang Yue waved his hand, indicating Zhao Yun need not be overly formal, showing that Wang Yue had already recognized Zhao Yun’s potential.
He then turned to Ding Ling, incredulously stating:

"As for you, Ding Ling... I don’t understand why Tong Yuan praised you as not inferior to the progeny of this era, but I truly find it hard to comprehend how someone with such an ordinary foundation can be compared to Chiyou and the Yellow Emperor!"
Ding Ling activated his full-level acting skill, his expression changing just in time to appear somewhat embarrassed.
Zhao Yun observed with some confusion, instinctively speaking up to defend Ding Ling:
"Master Wang, Ding Ling’s talent definitely surpasses mine. Rest assured."
"I understand you two share a strong bond. But you don’t have to cover for him against your conscience."
Wang Yue looked deeply at Zhao Yun and raised his hand to stop Zhao Yun, who was taken aback:
"You needn’t explain further. Everything lies in the outcome. And the current result shows you, Zhao Yun, are the real prodigy. While Ding Ling is merely mediocre."
Shi A glanced at Ding Ling with a peculiar look in his eyes, evidently pondering what Wang Yue had just said.
He likely couldn’t understand how someone as ordinary as Ding Ling could be praised so highly by a renowned Spear God!
The thought seemed almost like a dream!
"If it wasn’t confirmed that the letter came from Tong Yuan, I would suspect it was a forgery."
It was evident Wang Yue was not satisfied with Ding Ling.
This sharply contrasted with Tong Yuan’s portrayal.
Like heaven and earth!
Fortunately, he had adjusted his expectations, so at this moment, he wasn’t furious, outright scolding Ding Ling to leave, but decided to give Ding Ling another chance.
He stated directly:
"Next is the stage for testing comprehension!"
His voice rang clear, echoing in the study:
"The most important aspects of martial arts are just a few."
He paused, then continued:
"First is the cultivation technique. A good cultivation technique allows one to progress further.
Second is the master. Proper guidance can prevent detours.

Third is innate ability. Those with strong abilities are geniuses who progress rapidly in martial arts without hindrance. In contrast, the ordinary might not exceed common folk even after a lifetime of training."
At this point.
Wang Yue glanced at Ding Ling and others, saying:
"Fourth is comprehension.
Strong comprehension allows one to understand various obstacles, quickly grasping the essence of a cultivation technique, making practice more efficient!
Fifth is herbal medicine and prescriptions.
Having herbs and prescriptions that complement the Breathing Technique can accelerate physical fitness, making one increasingly robust and fierce."
He took a deep breath:
"As long as these five are achieved, it’s challenging not to become a first-class fierce general. However..."
He glanced at Ding Ling:
"You fall short in the most crucial aspect of innate ability. I don’t know if you still have a chance to grow."
Ding Ling was solemn.
Zhao Yun was at a loss for words, instinctively defending again:
"Master Wang, actually Ding Ling he..."
"Enough."
Wang Yue raised his hand again to stop Zhao Yun:
"I know you care for your friend. For the sake of Tong Yuan, I will let him learn sword with you. How far you both progress depends on your own fortunes."
He walked to a weapon rack, took out an ancient sword, gently caressing it, sighed, and said:
"The ancient divine weapon Shadow Sword has gathered dust here for years. What a pity."
Shi A said with respect beside him:
"Master is a Sword God. I believe the Shadow Sword possesses a spirit and must be delighted to follow you."
Ding Ling glanced sideways, thinking Shi A, usually quiet and reserved, spoke quite eloquently with his master.
But the Shadow Sword?
Ding Ling looked at the ancient sword.
This is a renowned ancient sword!
Its fame echoed through the ages! It once was the sword of Emperor Shang!
Unexpectedly, it had come into Wang Yue’s possession.
"Enough talk."
Wang Yue carried the sword out of the study, with a few leaps, arrived at a martial training ground in the inner courtyard.
The training ground wasn’t far from the study.
It wasn’t large either.
Covering around a hundred square meters.
Clearly, it was Wang Yue’s special training area. Or perhaps for teaching inner courtyard disciples.
As the outer courtyard had a larger martial training ground!
Undoubtedly, it was for the outer courtyard disciples.
"I will first teach you high-tier swordsmanship."
He did not teach initial or middle-tier swordsmanship.
Evidently, he knew Tong Yuan had already taught them.
Undoubtedly, Tong Yuan mentioned this in the letter. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have asked about Ding Ling and Zhao Yun’s martial arts progress.
In fact, both Zhao Yun and Ding Ling had indeed learned initial and middle-tier swordsmanship.
Especially Ding Ling, under the coverage of the library, directly reaching full level.
"Pay attention!"
Clang!
Wang Yue drew the sword, the ancient divine weapon Shadow Sword unsheathed!
Amidst the clang, a sword light flickered across the void, layers of sword shadows continuously overlapped and flashed in midair!
Clearly, it was just ordinary high-tier swordsmanship, yet Wang Yue performed it splendidly, like a full moon in the sky, or a glowing sun, pleasing to the eye, uplifting the spirit involuntarily!
As Wang Yue wielded the sword, he explained the mantra, esoteric truth, and true essence of high-tier swordsmanship!
After one round.
He performed it once more.
Then he stopped.
He looked at Zhao Yun and Ding Ling:
"How do you feel?"
Zhao Yun nodded, indicating he remembered.
Ding Ling also nodded, and briefly closed his eyes.
On one of the library’s bookshelves had already formed a book:
"High-tier Swordsmanship"!
In an instant.
[High-tier Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Defense +0.3]
Due to agility, strength, and physique reaching their limits, only truly high-level martial arts would enhance these three attributes.
This foundational martial art evidently couldn’t bring about enhancement of the three attributes.
The energy originally belonging to the three was transformed, turning entirely into defense attribute points.
Naturally, a lot of energy was consumed.
But increasing defense by 0.3 was quite decent.
Ding Ling could distinctly feel his skin, muscles, and bones once again enhanced and strengthened!
This was no slower than taking the Great Medicine!
And with deeper potential! Mastering high-tier swordsmanship also significantly advanced his skills in this area.
"Your memory is not bad."
Wang Yue glanced at Ding Ling, having lowered his expectations almost to a minimum after testing his innate ability.
Ding Ling’s expressions further reduced his expectations.
Now, Ding Ling’s memorization was quite outstanding.
He couldn’t hold back from offering a word of praise.
Zhao Yun wanted to say: ’You underestimate Ding Ling’s talent. He’s the kind who learns a martial art by watching it once, a super genius beyond human comprehension or definition!’

chapters.title: Chapter 75: Zhao Yun’s Art of Persuasion
paragraphs: "It’s merely about remembering techniques, names, mantras, and esoteric truths. For Ding Ling, this is completely effortless!"
Zhao Yun couldn’t help but speak up in defense of Ding Ling.
"Hmm."
Wang Yue did not argue with Zhao Yun and merely nodded calmly, saying:
"I’ll give you three days to comprehend the high-tier swordsmanship. Come to my study in three days."
"I don’t think we need three days."
Zhao Yun spoke.
"Oh?"
Wang Yue glanced sideways.
Shi A was moved.
To understand, he took a full three days to comprehend the high-tier swordsmanship thoroughly, let alone mastering it, which naturally took even longer.
Could it be that Zhao Yun could comprehend it thoroughly in less than three days?
Truly worthy as the closed-door disciple of Spear God Tong Yuan!
Undoubtedly a rare genius praised as one in ten thousand by his master, indeed remarkable!
"How long do you think it will take?"
Wang Yue actively asked.
"I think one day is more than enough."
Zhao Yun cast a glance at Ding Ling, seeing Ding Ling calm and composed, evidently confident, which set his heart at ease, and he said assuredly:
"Half a day, no, two, maybe even one hour is enough."
Wang Yue chuckled wryly:
"Zhao Yun, do you find this amusing, or do you think it’s humorous, trying to make me laugh?"
He looked serious:
"Learning martial arts, especially learning swordsmanship! I won’t allow such formalism! I want something practical and effective, with mutual respect! Do you understand?"
"Of course."
Zhao Yun straightened his back, full of confidence:
"I’m not lying to you. I truly feel that even one hour is more than enough."

He recalled how Ding Ling mastered various fist techniques, body techniques, and palm techniques in an instant, and seeing Ding Ling’s current relaxed demeanor, his expression grew increasingly confident!
Shi A was shocked, shaken:
"One hour?!"
"Are you sure you’re not joking with me?"
Wang Yue was astonished and seriously said.
"Surely not!"
"Have you learned high-tier swordsmanship before?"
"No!"
"Good."
Wang Yue took a deep breath, didn’t leave, and simply stood aside. He glanced at the sky and fixed his gaze on Zhao Yun:

"I’ll wait here for you for one hour! If you really can learn high-tier swordsmanship within an hour, I will teach you everything I’ve learned in my life, even my breathing technique, with no reservations!"
"If someone can learn high-tier swordsmanship in one hour, you’d teach them unreservedly?"
Zhao Yun was pleased.
He knew that Ding Ling’s real intention for coming all the way to Luoyang this time was to help him out.
"Of course."
Wang Yue nodded firmly:
"Such a genius in swordsmanship, wouldn’t it be a pity not to let them inherit my legacy?"
"Good."
Zhao Yun looked at Ding Ling, his eyes bright and full of vigor:
"Ding Ling, did you hear that? This is an opportunity!"
"Naturally."
Ding Ling nodded, feeling gratified inside as well.
Zhao Yun was indeed a divine teammate! This divine assist could let Ding Ling smoothly learn Wang Yue’s lifetime knowledge!
Although Wang Yue previously said that as long as someone could measure up to Shi A, he would teach them everything he knew.
But that is different from being completely unreserved!
"What do you mean by this?"
Wang Yue looked puzzledly at Zhao Yun.
Shi A was also confused.
Seeing Zhao Yun acting like he was vying for Ding Ling, a mediocrity, it was baffling.
"My meaning is clear."
Zhao Yun pointed at Ding Ling:
"The real genius is Ding Ling! When I say learning high-tier swordsmanship within an hour, I wasn’t referring to myself, but Ding Ling."
"What!"
Shi A was stunned.
Wang Yue was shocked, astonished, then furious:
"Zhao Yun, are you playing a trick on me?!"
"I wouldn’t dare."
Zhao Yun solemnly, clasping his fists, said:
"I’ve always held a great respect for the senior from the beginning. How could I dare to disrespect or trick you?!"
"But you..."
"I’m stating the truth."
Before Wang Yue could finish, Zhao Yun interrupted decisively:
"My master said Ding Ling is a peerless genius, and this is absolutely well-founded! If the senior doesn’t believe me, let Ding Ling demonstrate the high-tier swordsmanship for you."
With that, Zhao Yun looked at Ding Ling, inquiring with his eyes if there was any problem?
Ding Ling reassured him.
Zhao Yun grew firmer, and his eyes beamed with dazzling brilliance!
Wang Yue was moved, looking towards Ding Ling inquisitively:
"You can learn high-tier swordsmanship within an hour?!"
His tone was filled with doubt and disbelief!
Shi A’s expression and gaze clearly indicated that he also thought Ding Ling couldn’t possibly do it.
Saying Zhao Yun might be possible.
For Zhao Yun is a rare genius in a million!
What does Ding Ling have?!
Even with extraordinary aptitude, it’s absolutely unachievable!
"I can."
Ding Ling said frankly, looking straight at Wang Yue:
"I can demonstrate it for you now, senior."
"Are you sure you’re serious?"
Wang Yue couldn’t hold back, his face slightly darkened:
"If you’re just fooling me, I’ll throw you out immediately. Even if Tong Yuan came, it wouldn’t work!"
"I wouldn’t dare."
"Good."
Wang Yue nodded, expressionless, saying:

"Go ahead and show me. If it’s nonsensical, you’ll pay the due price for your boastfulness. Being humble, practical, especially in martial arts, one must avoid being overambitious and unrealistic. Do you understand?"
"I understand."
Ding Ling replied casually.
He wasted no time, directly entered the martial arts area, glanced around, picked up a piece of broken wood from the ground, and began to practice high-tier swordsmanship with the wood as a sword!
Wang Yue’s high-tier swordsmanship is an advanced version of middle-tier swordsmanship.
More profound, mysterious, and remarkable.
Yet it still retains the core of basic swordsmanship!
Such swordsmanship is far inferior to the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear and Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques.
Moreover, Ding Ling’s agility now has reached a super-elite level!
He wielded the broken wood as a sword with ease and grace, like a breeze in the heavens and earth, stirring waves in everyone’s hearts as he passed.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
The sound of cutting through the air rose with the movement of the wood.
Clearly, it was just a piece of wood.
Yet Ding Ling wielded it like a peerless divine weapon.
When Ding Ling finished performing a set of high-tier swordsmanship.
The entire scene fell into silence.
Shi A was dumbfounded.
Wang Yue was in a daze.

Zhao Yun was overjoyed, instinctively wanting to applaud and cheer for Ding Ling, but seeing Wang Yue and Shi A’s expressions, he knew it was not the time to be overly enthusiastic, lest it embarrass Wang Yue.
He could only restrain himself, but his gaze on Ding Ling was filled with inward admiration, feeling that Ding Ling had really made him proud!
Having such a friend is truly an honor!
After a while.
Wang Yue was the first to recover, he coughed lightly, couldn’t help scrutinizing Ding Ling up and down thoroughly.
Ding Ling accepted it calmly.
This made Wang Yue feel slightly uncomfortable.
He looked at Ding Ling, pondered for a while, and said:

"How long do you think it will take?"
Wang Yue actively asked.
"I think one day is more than enough."
Zhao Yun cast a glance at Ding Ling, seeing Ding Ling calm and composed, evidently confident, which set his heart at ease, and he said assuredly:
"Half a day, no, two, maybe even one hour is enough."
Wang Yue chuckled wryly:
"Zhao Yun, do you find this amusing, or do you think it’s humorous, trying to make me laugh?"
He looked serious:
"Learning martial arts, especially learning swordsmanship!
I won’t allow such formalism!
I want something practical and effective, with mutual respect!
Do you understand?"
"Of course."
Zhao Yun straightened his back, full of confidence:
"I’m not lying to you.
I truly feel that even one hour is more than enough."

He recalled how Ding Ling mastered various fist techniques, body techniques, and palm techniques in an instant, and seeing Ding Ling’s current relaxed demeanor, his expression grew increasingly confident!
Shi A was shocked, shaken:
"One hour?!"
"Are you sure you’re not joking with me?"
Wang Yue was astonished and seriously said.
"Surely not!"
"Have you learned high-tier swordsmanship before?"
"No!"
"Good."
Wang Yue took a deep breath, didn’t leave, and simply stood aside.
He glanced at the sky and fixed his gaze on Zhao Yun:
"I’ll wait here for you for one hour!
If you really can learn high-tier swordsmanship within an hour, I will teach you everything I’ve learned in my life, even my breathing technique, with no reservations!"
"If someone can learn high-tier swordsmanship in one hour, you’d teach them unreservedly?"
Zhao Yun was pleased.
He knew that Ding Ling’s real intention for coming all the way to Luoyang this time was to help him out.
"Of course."
Wang Yue nodded firmly:
"Such a genius in swordsmanship, wouldn’t it be a pity not to let them inherit my legacy?"
"Good."
Zhao Yun looked at Ding Ling, his eyes bright and full of vigor:
"Ding Ling, did you hear that?
This is an opportunity!"
"Naturally."
Ding Ling nodded, feeling gratified inside as well.
Zhao Yun was indeed a divine teammate!
This divine assist could let Ding Ling smoothly learn Wang Yue’s lifetime knowledge!
Although Wang Yue previously said that as long as someone could measure up to Shi A, he would teach them everything he knew.
But that is different from being completely unreserved!
"What do you mean by this?"
Wang Yue looked puzzledly at Zhao Yun.
Shi A was also confused.
Seeing Zhao Yun acting like he was vying for Ding Ling, a mediocrity, it was baffling.
"My meaning is clear."
Zhao Yun pointed at Ding Ling:
"The real genius is Ding Ling!
When I say learning high-tier swordsmanship within an hour, I wasn’t referring to myself, but Ding Ling."
"What!"
Shi A was stunned.
Wang Yue was shocked, astonished, then furious:
"Zhao Yun, are you playing a trick on me?!"
"I wouldn’t dare."
Zhao Yun solemnly, clasping his fists, said:
"I’ve always held a great respect for the senior from the beginning.
How could I dare to disrespect or trick you?!"
"But you..."
"I’m stating the truth."
Before Wang Yue could finish, Zhao Yun interrupted decisively:
"My master said Ding Ling is a peerless genius, and this is absolutely well-founded!
If the senior doesn’t believe me, let Ding Ling demonstrate the high-tier swordsmanship for you."
With that, Zhao Yun looked at Ding Ling, inquiring with his eyes if there was any problem?
Ding Ling reassured him.
Zhao Yun grew firmer, and his eyes beamed with dazzling brilliance!
Wang Yue was moved, looking towards Ding Ling inquisitively:
"You can learn high-tier swordsmanship within an hour?!"
His tone was filled with doubt and disbelief!
Shi A’s expression and gaze clearly indicated that he also thought Ding Ling couldn’t possibly do it.
Saying Zhao Yun might be possible.
For Zhao Yun is a rare genius in a million!
What does Ding Ling have?!
Even with extraordinary aptitude, it’s absolutely unachievable!
"I can."
Ding Ling said frankly, looking straight at Wang Yue:
"I can demonstrate it for you now, senior."
"Are you sure you’re serious?"
Wang Yue couldn’t hold back, his face slightly darkened:
"If you’re just fooling me, I’ll throw you out immediately.
Even if Tong Yuan came, it wouldn’t work!"
"I wouldn’t dare."
"Good."
Wang Yue nodded, expressionless, saying:
"Go ahead and show me.
If it’s nonsensical, you’ll pay the due price for your boastfulness.
Being humble, practical, especially in martial arts, one must avoid being overambitious and unrealistic.
Do you understand?"
"I understand."
Ding Ling replied casually.
He wasted no time, directly entered the martial arts area, glanced around, picked up a piece of broken wood from the ground, and began to practice high-tier swordsmanship with the wood as a sword!
Wang Yue’s high-tier swordsmanship is an advanced version of middle-tier swordsmanship.
More profound, mysterious, and remarkable.
Yet it still retains the core of basic swordsmanship!
Such swordsmanship is far inferior to the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear and Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques.
Moreover, Ding Ling’s agility now has reached a super-elite level!
He wielded the broken wood as a sword with ease and grace, like a breeze in the heavens and earth, stirring waves in everyone’s hearts as he passed.
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
The sound of cutting through the air rose with the movement of the wood.
Clearly, it was just a piece of wood.
Yet Ding Ling wielded it like a peerless divine weapon.
When Ding Ling finished performing a set of high-tier swordsmanship.
The entire scene fell into silence.
Shi A was dumbfounded.
Wang Yue was in a daze.

Zhao Yun was overjoyed, instinctively wanting to applaud and cheer for Ding Ling, but seeing Wang Yue and Shi A’s expressions, he knew it was not the time to be overly enthusiastic, lest it embarrass Wang Yue.
He could only restrain himself, but his gaze on Ding Ling was filled with inward admiration, feeling that Ding Ling had really made him proud!
Having such a friend is truly an honor!
After a while.
Wang Yue was the first to recover, he coughed lightly, couldn’t help scrutinizing Ding Ling up and down thoroughly.
Ding Ling accepted it calmly.
This made Wang Yue feel slightly uncomfortable.
He looked at Ding Ling, pondered for a while, and said:

chapters.title: Chapter 76: Shuoyue Sword
paragraphs: "Are you sure you haven’t learned high-tier swordsmanship before?"
"Of course."
Ding Ling affirmed.
"If that’s truly the case, it’s somewhat unbelievable."
Wang Yue spoke frankly:
"I’ve traveled far and wide and seen all sorts of geniuses, yet I’ve never seen or even heard of someone like you."
He paused and continued:
"I cannot comprehend how you managed to grasp and cultivate this sword technique to the level of innate ability in just a moment! This is beyond my understanding.
Logically speaking.
Your aptitude seems ordinary, making it impossible to cultivate this sword technique to the realm of Great Perfection so quickly.
Yet you have achieved it regardless. It’s unfathomable!"
He sighed:
"I now somewhat understand Tong Yuan’s feelings."
However, thinking back to what he previously said to Ding Ling, he couldn’t help but blush with embarrassment.
Meanwhile, Shi A remained silent, his gaze at Ding Ling filled with curiosity and confusion.
"Just mastering a mere high-tier sword technique is not enough for me to declare you an unparalleled genius."
Wang Yue decided not to leave. He drew the Shadow Sword again and looked at Ding Ling with piercing eyes:
"Next, I will impart a true sword technique to you. If you can quickly comprehend and learn it, I’ll acknowledge you as the chosen of our era."
Ding Ling had no desire to be any era’s chosen one but was instinctively inclined to say something.
Wang Yue raised his hand to stop Ding Ling from speaking and said:
"Don’t take too much to heart about what I said earlier. Watch closely. This is the first sword technique of my unique supreme skill: Double Flower Swordsmanship!"
Clang!
With a swing of the sword, the air seemed to be filled with blooming flowers!
Though it appeared to be two flowers, with each swing of the sword, it seemed as if thousands of flowers materialized in the void, embellishing the surroundings.
Each flower was dazzling and blinding, dangerous and fierce!
One stab could certainly take a person’s life.
This is true murderous swordsmanship!
Wang Yue continued to wield the sword and explain its esoteric truths.
After going through it once.
Ding Ling slightly closed his eyes.
A book quickly materialized on the library shelf:
"Double Flower Swordsmanship!"
A moment later.
[Double Flower Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Defense +0.5]
Various esoteric truths of swordsmanship flashed continuously in his mind!
At this moment, Ding Ling had thoroughly mastered this sword technique.
His defense also increased by 0.5.
The skin, meridians, and organs were nourished by mysterious energy, becoming stronger!
Compared to high-tier swordsmanship as a foundational technique.
Double Flower Swordsmanship was indeed stronger.
Yet it still belonged to the category of Low-tier Martial Arts.
It was quite a distance from high-tier.
Evidently, Wang Yue’s method of imparting sword techniques was similar to Tong Yuan’s, progressing from simple to complex, step by step upwards, in accordance with the martial arts path!
"Hmm?!"
Wang Yue also noticed the change in Ding Ling’s expression and eyes.
Especially after going through it once, Ding Ling even closed his eyes.
He felt uncertain and paused the demonstration and explanation, fixed his gaze on Ding Ling.
When Ding Ling opened his eyes again, swoosh!
A sharp force burst forth from his body.
"This aura..."
Wang Yue was astonished, eyes wide, full of incredulity as he looked at Ding Ling:
"I explained it once and you understood and learned it?"
"Yes."
Ding Ling didn’t hesitate, sincerely saying:
"I have learned it."

Wang Yue’s eye twitched twice, instinctively disbelieving, even wanting to reproach Ding Ling for boasting, but the aura just now, along with Ding Ling’s previous performance, made him swallow his words.
He was just about to let Ding Ling practice a bit, seeing that Ding Ling was without a sword, so he asked Ding Ling to wait a little, instructing Shi A to fetch a sword from the armory.

In Wang Yue’s words: "As a swordsman, one should have a sword! You have now grasped the esoteric truths of high-tier swordsmanship, have understood the essence of Double Flower, and a sword aura has emerged from you. You can now be considered a swordsman. I will give you one of my treasured swords."
He did not mention giving it to Zhao Yun.
Clearly, in his heart, he believed Zhao Yun was not yet a swordsman.
Zhao Yun didn’t mind, he was very pleased with Ding Ling’s achievement.
He felt pride in Ding Ling’s dazzling performance.
Even inherently felt a sense of accomplishment and thrill.
After all, Wang Yue and Shi A were previously doubting him, yet now the facts proved that Zhao Yun was right!
Soon after.
Shi A arrived carrying a sword.
He handed the sword to Wang Yue.
Wang Yue received it and solemnly gave it to Ding Ling:

"This is the Shuoyue Sword! A great sword that cuts through iron like mud! I have treasured it for years, now I’m giving it to you. I hope you won’t let this sword down and let its fame spread along with yours, across the world!"
"I will."
Ding Ling received the Shuoyue Sword.
He felt a slight weight in his hand.
This sword weighed at least forty to fifty pounds!
Such a heavy sword is rare.
He drew out the sword, clang!
A rather hefty but brilliantly sharp sword with dual edges like the moon and snow was drawn.
The top of the sword was engraved with two characters:
"Shuoyue!"
A light flick of his finger, clang clang! The sword hummed!
"Great sword!"
Ding Ling was delighted, demonstrating the Wall-Climbing Technique, he leaped onto the martial practice field, unleashing the Double Flower Swordsmanship.
Clang!
Clang clang clang!

The sword followed his movements, appearing as an extension of Ding Ling’s arm, a slight shake would conjure blooming sword flowers in the air, Ding Ling’s agility was extremely high! Making the entire sword technique flow smoothly, without any hindrance!
It was as lively and swift as an eagle hunting!
Graceful and superb like a fairy scattering flowers!
Moments later.
Clang!
The Shuoyue Sword returned to its sheath, Ding Ling walked back to his original position, looked at Wang Yue and said:
"Senior, please advise."
Wang Yue was astonished.
Although he had a sense from the aura on Ding Ling’s body earlier that Ding Ling might have truly learned the Double Flower Swordsmanship,
he absolutely did not expect Ding Ling would directly cultivate Double Flower Swordsmanship to the mastery level!
This couldn’t be achieved without years of hard work and diligent practice!
Yet Ding Ling?
Just watched him demonstrate and explain the Double Flower Swordmanship once, and then mastered it?!
How could this be?!
As stunned as Wang Yue was,
Shi A was even more shocked, his scalp tingling, his worldview starting to crumble:
"This, this, this... impossible?!"
For this normally taciturn person to be so shocked as to speak out, shows the tumultuous waves in his heart must have surged to tremendous heights!
"Indeed, unbelievable."
Wang Yue exhaled deeply, circled Ding Ling once, couldn’t help but touch Ding Ling’s bones.
Still a mediocre talent indeed!
How did he become such a prodigy?!
"You haven’t learned Double Flower Swordsmanship before?"
Wang Yue couldn’t help but ask a question similar to before.
"No."
Ding Ling still answered decisively.
"Good."
Wang Yue nodded and said:
"My supreme skill progresses step by step. Some earlier sword techniques might have been leaked by some outer disciples. But the further you go, the fewer people have contact with it..."
