chapters.title: Chapter 77: Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship
paragraphs: "...Even Shi A has not yet fully mastered my true inheritance and supreme skill. As for the other disciples, there’s no need to mention them."
Wang Yue glanced at Ding Ling, his face showing a marvelous light:
"If you can master the supreme skills that I have not taught to others, then I will truly believe that you are an unparalleled true genius!"
His words now are not the same as before.
It is evident that he has begun to acknowledge Ding Ling.
He did not say that Ding Ling is the child of an era!
Clearly, he still cannot come to terms with how Ding Ling managed to master his supreme skill, the Double Flower Swordsmanship, to the point of innate mastery so swiftly!
This has somewhat shattered his worldview.
If he accepted this point,
His worldview would crumble to dust.
Thus, Wang Yue did not overly praise Ding Ling.
It was obvious that he was guessing whether his sword technique had somehow been passed around outside and by chance learned by Ding Ling.
Once a doubt enters the mind,
It will grow rapidly like weeds, take root deep inside the heart, and it becomes very difficult to quickly comprehend and accept everything!
Perhaps Wang Yue himself also perceived this point.
Facing Zhao Yun’s curiosity,
Ding Ling’s gaze,
Even the Sword God, Wang Yue, felt somewhat embarrassed and apologetic. He gave a dry cough, quickly composed himself, and said earnestly:
"Next is the advanced version of Double Flower Swordsmanship, the Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship!"
He stepped into the center of the field and began to demonstrate and explain the Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship.
In comparison to the Double Flower Swordsmanship,
The Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship is faster and sharper!
The sword flowers that unfurled were as splendid and magnificent as blooming flowers!
They even ’weaved’ peculiar patterns in the void.
The patterns flashed by, hard to see clearly, faintly resembling roses.
After a round of practice.
Ding Ling closed his eyes slightly.
A book condensed in the library:
"Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship."
In an instant,
[Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Defense +0.7]
In just a blink, Ding Ling completely grasped the essence and esoteric truths of the Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship, incorporating everything about this swordsmanship into his instincts.
At this moment, Ding Ling was evidently a Sword Master!
The sharp aura unique to a swordsman on his body grew increasingly intense!
’Defense has increased.’
Ding Ling opened his eyes, carefully sensing himself.
His muscles, bones, and internal organs were once again refined, improving significantly.
Yet this Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship was still not high-level Kung Fu!
Although it was far superior to Double Flower Swordsmanship, it still could not be deemed as high-level martial arts.
However, for Ding Ling, this was irrelevant.
As long as there is real Kung Fu to learn, he can swiftly enhance himself.

Mastering the Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship led to a frenzy in the improvement of his sword skill level, to say the least, advancing his defense further, making him increasingly resilient to strikes!
"You learned it?!"
Wang Yue, seeing Ding Ling closing his eyes again after just one demonstration, could not help but be astonished and bewildered. As Ding Ling opened his eyes, he instinctively asked.
"Learned it!"
"...Try it."
Wang Yue moved to the side, gesturing for Ding Ling to practice.
This time, his attitude was worlds apart from before, evidently showing how rapidly Ding Ling’s pace of improvement was impacting him!
"Alright."
Ding Ling entered the martial arts field, drew the Shuoyue Sword with a clang!
He began to swing the sword!
His swordplay was almost like a replica of Wang Yue’s.
And even slightly more graceful and fluid.
When he finished his performance,
The place fell into silence once again.
After a long pause.
Wang Yue clapped, praising:

"Amazing! Regardless of whether you learned this swordsmanship from someone outside, being able to practice the Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship to the realm of Great Success already qualifies you as a Great Swordsman!"
Shi A was silent, only his eyes grew increasingly doubtful and uncertain.
Clearly, Ding Ling’s speed in improvement and learning swords had completely overwhelmed him!
Zhao Yun became increasingly pleased.
Every exclamation from Wang Yue and Shi A made him proud.
After all, this was his friend! Comrade!
Having such a comrade and friend is truly something to be proud of.
"Next is the Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship."
Wang Yue once more drew his sword to demonstrate:

"This is the advanced version of the Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship, a true superior martial art! It can only be learned by Inner Sect disciples. If you can do this martial art, it indicates that the person who secretly taught you Kung Fu must be an Inner Sect disciple."
Ding Ling was speechless.
Wang Yue clearly could not accept him comprehending and learning his supreme skill so quickly, now becoming more and more suspicious that someone privately taught him the swordsmanship.
Ding Ling couldn’t say much about it either and could only express himself through actions.
After a while.
After one demonstration.
Wang Yue instinctively stopped, wanting to see, with such superior martial arts, whether Ding Ling could learn it after only one demonstration.
If he could really learn it,
Wang Yue would be more convinced someone privately passed it on!
Because when he was young, learning this set of martial arts to the realm of Great Success took him a full two to three years!
He was supposed to be all Sword Bone! A natural prodigy for practicing swordsmanship!
He didn’t believe that someone as ordinary as Ding Ling could be even more suited to sword practice than him!
Ding Ling closed his eyes.
A new book condensed on the bookshelf:
"Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship"!
Then...
[Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.3]
[Constitution +0.2]
His bones crackled and exploded.
His skin and membranes swelled!
As the essence and esoteric truths of the Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship were incorporated into his instincts.
Ding Ling’s strength, agility, and constitution were thus increased.
Ding Ling was delighted.
At this moment, he witnessed the greatness of superior martial arts.
This was a supreme skill far superior to the Cloud Strike Saber Technique!
Don’t look at agility just being 0.1 more than the Cloud Strike Saber Technique.
But it’s exactly this 0.1.
That demonstrates the Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship’s superiority in speed and lethality over the Cloud Strike Saber Technique!
The strength of the Cloud Strike Saber Technique had allowed Ding Ling to achieve repeated victories on the battlefield.
And the Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship was even stronger than the Cloud Strike Saber Technique, showing just how terrifying it was!
"How is it?"
Wang Yue, seeing the sword qi soaring from Ding Ling as if piercing through the clouds, couldn’t help but be shocked. As Ding Ling opened his eyes, he immediately asked eagerly.
"No problem."
This time, Ding Ling didn’t wait for Wang Yue’s signal and directly entered the field, resolutely practicing.
Clang!
Clang clang clang!

The Shuoyue Sword seemed like a crescent moon flickering in the void, and with every flash, there would always be countless flowers blooming and spinning, creating a ’Flowers in Bloom’ scene out of thin air in the void!
This was the ’scene’ that could only be created when mastering the Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship!
Much like the ’Hundred Birds Paying Homage to the Phoenix’ scene when mastering the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear!
Even though the Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship was slightly less than the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear, it was still undoubtedly extraordinary.
If not for Ding Ling’s constitution having reached a certain limit. By relying on this Kung Fu, it would definitely increase his strength by 2 points or more, agility by 2 points or more, and so on.
Shi A was shocked, his eyes widened as big as bells, stammering:
"This, this, this, is the Great Success into Innate Ability, the perfect ’Flowers in Bloom’! How, how is it possible?!"
He had been learning this Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship for years, yet he had not reached this step!
As for Ding Ling?
How long has he been learning it?!

As for the other disciples, there’s no need to mention them."
Wang Yue glanced at Ding Ling, his face showing a marvelous light:
"If you can master the supreme skills that I have not taught to others, then I will truly believe that you are an unparalleled true genius!"
His words now are not the same as before.
It is evident that he has begun to acknowledge Ding Ling.
He did not say that Ding Ling is the child of an era!
Clearly, he still cannot come to terms with how Ding Ling managed to master his supreme skill, the Double Flower Swordsmanship, to the point of innate mastery so swiftly!
This has somewhat shattered his worldview.
If he accepted this point,
His worldview would crumble to dust.
Thus, Wang Yue did not overly praise Ding Ling.
It was obvious that he was guessing whether his sword technique had somehow been passed around outside and by chance learned by Ding Ling.
Once a doubt enters the mind,
It will grow rapidly like weeds, take root deep inside the heart, and it becomes very difficult to quickly comprehend and accept everything!
Perhaps Wang Yue himself also perceived this point.
Facing Zhao Yun’s curiosity,
Ding Ling’s gaze,
Even the Sword God, Wang Yue, felt somewhat embarrassed and apologetic.
He gave a dry cough, quickly composed himself, and said earnestly:
"Next is the advanced version of Double Flower Swordsmanship, the Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship!"
He stepped into the center of the field and began to demonstrate and explain the Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship.
In comparison to the Double Flower Swordsmanship,
The Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship is faster and sharper!
The sword flowers that unfurled were as splendid and magnificent as blooming flowers!
They even ’weaved’ peculiar patterns in the void.
The patterns flashed by, hard to see clearly, faintly resembling roses.
After a round of practice.
Ding Ling closed his eyes slightly.
A book condensed in the library:
"Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship."
In an instant,
[Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Defense +0.7]
In just a blink, Ding Ling completely grasped the essence and esoteric truths of the Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship, incorporating everything about this swordsmanship into his instincts.
At this moment, Ding Ling was evidently a Sword Master!
The sharp aura unique to a swordsman on his body grew increasingly intense!
’Defense has increased.’
Ding Ling opened his eyes, carefully sensing himself.
His muscles, bones, and internal organs were once again refined, improving significantly.
Yet this Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship was still not high-level Kung Fu!
Although it was far superior to Double Flower Swordsmanship, it still could not be deemed as high-level martial arts.
However, for Ding Ling, this was irrelevant.
As long as there is real Kung Fu to learn, he can swiftly enhance himself.

Mastering the Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship led to a frenzy in the improvement of his sword skill level, to say the least, advancing his defense further, making him increasingly resilient to strikes!
"You learned it?!"
Wang Yue, seeing Ding Ling closing his eyes again after just one demonstration, could not help but be astonished and bewildered.
As Ding Ling opened his eyes, he instinctively asked.
"Learned it!"
"...Try it."
Wang Yue moved to the side, gesturing for Ding Ling to practice.
This time, his attitude was worlds apart from before, evidently showing how rapidly Ding Ling’s pace of improvement was impacting him!
"Alright."
Ding Ling entered the martial arts field, drew the Shuoyue Sword with a clang!
He began to swing the sword!
His swordplay was almost like a replica of Wang Yue’s.
And even slightly more graceful and fluid.
When he finished his performance,
The place fell into silence once again.
After a long pause.
Wang Yue clapped, praising:
"Amazing!

Regardless of whether you learned this swordsmanship from someone outside, being able to practice the Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship to the realm of Great Success already qualifies you as a Great Swordsman!"
Shi A was silent, only his eyes grew increasingly doubtful and uncertain.
Clearly, Ding Ling’s speed in improvement and learning swords had completely overwhelmed him!
Zhao Yun became increasingly pleased.
Every exclamation from Wang Yue and Shi A made him proud.
After all, this was his friend!
Comrade!
Having such a comrade and friend is truly something to be proud of.
"Next is the Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship."
Wang Yue once more drew his sword to demonstrate:
"This is the advanced version of the Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship, a true superior martial art!
It can only be learned by Inner Sect disciples.
If you can do this martial art, it indicates that the person who secretly taught you Kung Fu must be an Inner Sect disciple."
Ding Ling was speechless.
Wang Yue clearly could not accept him comprehending and learning his supreme skill so quickly, now becoming more and more suspicious that someone privately taught him the swordsmanship.
Ding Ling couldn’t say much about it either and could only express himself through actions.
After a while.
After one demonstration.
Wang Yue instinctively stopped, wanting to see, with such superior martial arts, whether Ding Ling could learn it after only one demonstration.
If he could really learn it,
Wang Yue would be more convinced someone privately passed it on!
Because when he was young, learning this set of martial arts to the realm of Great Success took him a full two to three years!
He was supposed to be all Sword Bone!
A natural prodigy for practicing swordsmanship!
He didn’t believe that someone as ordinary as Ding Ling could be even more suited to sword practice than him!
Ding Ling closed his eyes.
A new book condensed on the bookshelf:
"Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship"!
Then...
[Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.3]
[Constitution +0.2]
His bones crackled and exploded.
His skin and membranes swelled!
As the essence and esoteric truths of the Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship were incorporated into his instincts.
Ding Ling’s strength, agility, and constitution were thus increased.
Ding Ling was delighted.
At this moment, he witnessed the greatness of superior martial arts.
This was a supreme skill far superior to the Cloud Strike Saber Technique!
Don’t look at agility just being 0.1 more than the Cloud Strike Saber Technique.
But it’s exactly this 0.1.
That demonstrates the Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship’s superiority in speed and lethality over the Cloud Strike Saber Technique!
The strength of the Cloud Strike Saber Technique had allowed Ding Ling to achieve repeated victories on the battlefield.
And the Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship was even stronger than the Cloud Strike Saber Technique, showing just how terrifying it was!
"How is it?"
Wang Yue, seeing the sword qi soaring from Ding Ling as if piercing through the clouds, couldn’t help but be shocked.
As Ding Ling opened his eyes, he immediately asked eagerly.
"No problem."
This time, Ding Ling didn’t wait for Wang Yue’s signal and directly entered the field, resolutely practicing.
Clang!
Clang clang clang!

The Shuoyue Sword seemed like a crescent moon flickering in the void, and with every flash, there would always be countless flowers blooming and spinning, creating a ’Flowers in Bloom’ scene out of thin air in the void!
This was the ’scene’ that could only be created when mastering the Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship!
Much like the ’Hundred Birds Paying Homage to the Phoenix’ scene when mastering the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear!
Even though the Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship was slightly less than the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear, it was still undoubtedly extraordinary.
If not for Ding Ling’s constitution having reached a certain limit.
By relying on this Kung Fu, it would definitely increase his strength by 2 points or more, agility by 2 points or more, and so on.
Shi A was shocked, his eyes widened as big as bells, stammering:
"This, this, this, is the Great Success into Innate Ability, the perfect ’Flowers in Bloom’!
How, how is it possible?!"
He had been learning this Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship for years, yet he had not reached this step!
As for Ding Ling?
How long has he been learning it?!

chapters.title: Chapter 78: Sword Sect Tracing Back to the Era of the Ancient Yellow Emperor
paragraphs: Terrifying!
Shi A was amazed and looked at Ding Ling with admiration.
Regardless of whether an Inner Sect disciple passed the sword technique to Ding Ling privately.
To have mastered the Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship to such a level, it is clear Ding Ling is definitely a Swordsmanship Grandmaster!
Someone who can absolutely suppress Shi A with his unparalleled skill as a swordsman!
He is no match for him!
"Could it really be done?!"
Wang Yue was also astounded, no longer calm.
To be precise, he was already unsettled, but this time, he was even slightly trembling.
This is the reaction of being utterly amazed.
[Achievement Medal Obtained: You have gained Shi A’s deep admiration!]
[Note: When you successively mastered the Double Flower Swordsmanship and Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship, Shi A was already internally overwhelmed!
When you mastered the Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship to Great Success.
He could no longer contain his astonishment!
His respect for you escalated to the ultimate level at this moment!
Undoubtedly, if you were truly to apprentice under Wang Yue, he would willingly let you take the position of the top disciple.
Because in his eyes.
At this moment, you are glowing all over!]
[Obtained E-level Achievement Medal: You have earned high recognition from Sword God Wang Yue!]
[Note: Although Wang Yue expressed little admiration or fondness for you in words, he secretly holds the highest regard for you!
To him.
Every disciple who can master the Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship to the Great Success Realm is worth all his effort to teach!
He waited for many years, waiting for Shi A, hoping Shi A could master the Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship to the Realm of Perfection.
But you achieved it first!
You can say, in this instant, you became an almost irreplaceable candidate for Sword Sect’s heir in his heart!
To him!
You are a truly exceptional talent!
Consecutively obtained two medals.
Ding Ling listened to the prompting sound passing by his ear.
And felt a slight joy in his heart.

From the situation of obtaining the E-level medal this time, it is almost certain that if you only consider this person, considering this Three Kingdoms Plane, perhaps only super-elites would possess an E-level Medal!
To obtain another one.
Is naturally something worth celebrating.
However...
Ding Ling thought of the prompting sound and couldn’t help glancing at Wang Yue.
Seeing him indeed looking at himself with appreciation, Ding Ling couldn’t help but feel assured. Thus it seems that intending to learn all of Wang Yue’s martial arts is promising.
"You are very good."
This time Wang Yue’s praise was very sincere:
"If you had learned this sword technique in an instant, I could only say it was incomprehensible and utterly unbelievable! But even if you received transmission from an Inner Sect disciple.
To have cultivated to this point, you could be considered an extraordinary genius!"
His face showed obvious delight and sighed:
"I used to think many of the supreme skills of the Sword Sect would be taken to the grave. Now, it seems possible to find an heir to pass them on."
"Sword Sect?"
Zhao Yun was taken aback.
"Yes."
A trace of pain flashed across Wang Yue’s face:

"Sword Sect can be traced back to the ancient era and shone brightly during the Yellow Emperor’s time. The Yellow Emperor once held the position of Sect Leader for Sword Sect for a period. Therefore, the Yellow Emperor’s sword skill is extremely impressive!"
Ding Ling was startled to hear this.
This Sword Sect can be traced back to the Yellow Emperor’s time?
This is too exaggerated, isn’t it?!
But thinking this is a game world, and in the Three Kingdoms, as long as they are a first-class general, almost everyone has martial arts and a breathing technique.
He came to terms with it.
How could a normal Three Kingdoms world resemble a martial world?
"What’s unfortunate is..."
Wang Yue let out a long sigh:
"The supreme skills of my Sword Sect have always been orally transmitted, so whenever a sect leader goes missing or dies, a small portion of the legacy inevitably disappears!
Year after year.
And to this day, countless supreme skills of Sword Sect have vanished in the long river of time, never to be found again."
"Truly unfortunate."
Zhao Yun lamented:
"If they could be recorded and passed down to the present, how wonderful that would be."
"You are unaware."
Wang Yue then said:

"Some mysterious sword skills and breathing techniques must be performed and explained by someone; relying solely on a secret manual makes it impossible to learn. If one were to forcibly learn, mild cases could lead to a berserk state, severe cases to disability or violent death! It’s precisely because such precedents have occurred.
Therefore, Sword Sect has set a rule that it must be orally transmitted, with a master guiding the teaching!

And from ancient times to now, in peaceful times it’s fine, but once war or chaos strikes, the inheritors of my Sword Sect must enter the world! And once in the world, the chances of dying increase greatly.
If one dies, chances are high their legacy is lost."
He sighed:

"I can now say I am possibly the last Sword God of Sword Sect! If I cannot pass on my supreme skills before I die, if I cannot find a successor for Sword Sect, I will be unwilling. Fortunately, Heaven has shown mercy to me."
His eyes shone brightly as he glanced at Shi A, Ding Ling, and Zhao Yun:
"He has sent me three geniuses. Especially you, Ding Ling..."
He appeared perplexed and puzzled, but mostly joyful:

"Although I don’t know how you could master the Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship to the Realm of Perfection with such an ordinary talent! But you did. So you are qualified to learn the true Sword God Skill!"
"Sword God Skill?!"
Shi A’s heart accelerated, full of longing:
"Master, are you planning to teach Ding Ling your master skill, the Sword God Skill?"
"Yes."
Wang Yue nodded, stroking his beard and smiling:

"Ding Ling’s mastery of the Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship has met the minimum condition for learning the Sword God Skill! He can indeed step into this domain. I can naturally teach him. And I am willing to teach him!"
Shi A felt ashamed:
"Master, I’ve let you down!"
"You are already very good."
Wang Yue patted Shi A on the shoulder:

"I searched across the Jiuzhou Land before I found such a sword dao genius like you! You must not belittle yourself! Your future holds limitless prospects, do not discard your martial skills! You need to continue working hard, diligent cultivation!"
"Yes. Master!"
Shi A was solemn.
"Ding Ling."
Wang Yue turned to Ding Ling:

"To meet you when I am old, it seems my luck is good. One day when Shi A’s sword dao is fulfilled, I will go to Penglai Mountain to thank Tong Yuan! Thanks to him for sending me a Sword Sect successor."
"Predecessor is too kind."
Ding Ling was humble.
"Hehe."
Wang Yue chuckled slightly, and said:
"I won’t casually praise others; those who do not earn my approval can never learn the Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship, let alone the Sword God Skill.
Although I still cannot believe you learned Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship in an instant. I suspect you may have encountered an Inner Sect disciple of mine earlier on.
But regarding the Sword God Skill, I am certain I have never passed it on to anyone else!
Including my teacher.
He only passed it on to me!
So, about the Sword God Skill, currently only I know it in the whole world."
He spoke with great assurance:
"If I were to die, the Sword God Skill would surely be lost. But now, with you Ding Ling, there might be hope."
He didn’t shy away from Zhao Yun or Shi A.

chapters.title: Chapter 79: A Sword Breaks the Dawn, Blossoms Unfurl
paragraphs: Wang Yue said directly:
"Today I’ll simply teach you three the Sword God Skill. How much you can understand depends on your own fate."
Shi A was excited.
Zhao Yun was solemn.
Ding Ling was delighted.
At last, they had reached the crucial stage of swordsmanship!
The Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship is just slightly inferior to the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear!
And the Sword God Skill, which is much stronger than the Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship!
How terrifying must that be?
Ding Ling had every reason to be joyful.
For him,
he had a library, which meant there was almost nothing he couldn’t learn!
Regardless of whether it was the Breathing Technique, martial arts, or various skills in the real world, he could learn them very quickly!
To put it accurately,
as long as the library condenses these skills and martial arts into books,
he could learn them instantly and achieve perfection!
The more powerful the Sword God Skill, the happier he was!
"Watch closely!"
Wang Yue walked to the center of the training ground, drew his sword, and started dancing, swoosh, swoosh!
He exhaled a breath of turbid air, his entire aura changed drastically, and his dancing speed became faster and faster, until in the end, only beams of light could be seen flashing!
Wherever the sword light passed, brilliance and colorfulness coexisted!
It was like a ray of spring light breaking through the darkness, bringing dawn!
"This is the first part of the Sword God Skill: ’Dawn Swordsmanship!’"
"It signifies breaking shackles and illuminating the Qiankun Realm! Breaking into the supreme realm of the Sword Sect!"

"Only by truly understanding and cultivating the Dawn Swordsmanship to Great Perfection can one be considered a true disciple of the Sword Sect. It also paves the way for stepping into the legendary realm of the Sword Sect!"
Clang!
Clang clang clang!
Wang Yue, wielding the sword, danced as if he were a Celestial God manipulating Heaven and Earth, his demeanor so composed and free, resembling an Upper Immortal traversing the mortal world!
At this moment, Wang Yue exuded the true demeanor of a Sword God, radiant and dazzling, beyond gaze!
Seeing this,
Ding Ling couldn’t help but feel admiration.
At this moment, he also confirmed some rumors about Wang Yue!
A Swordsmanship Grandmaster like this, if he couldn’t accomplish taking the head of a general among thousands of troops, then who could?
This was truly a War God-like figure.
Ding Ling thought of the Path of Glory and mused:
"For ordinary players, this task is almost impossible to complete. It’s too difficult!"
The Path of the War God has over a dozen rules.
Although mainly the first three.
But any one of them is extremely challenging for ordinary players!

It’s important to know that a player’s aptitude is not necessarily better than that of the natives! So much that some native martial artists need to train for many years, a player might need just as long!
Thinking about it, it’s enough to make many players collapse!
However, no one can refuse a game world that allows self-improvement, and progress, however slow, is better than no progress at all!
’The Path of the War God requires defeating the strongest in the plane. But whether it’s Tong Yuan or Wang Yue, I can’t beat them! It seems I still need to work harder!’
As for the Path of the Emperor?
It must be equally challenging as the Path of the War God, with many stringent conditions to trigger and complete!
’Luckily, there are cheats, otherwise this Path of the War God would be too time-consuming, mentally, and physically exhausting!’
Thinking this, Ding Ling glanced at the library.
A ’book’ on the library was slowly forming as Wang Yue continued to demonstrate and explain the swordsmanship.
And as Wang Yue finished explaining and stood with the sword sheathed,
whoosh!
This library book instantly took shape, inscribed with four large characters:
"Dawn Swordsmanship!"
In an instant afterward,
[Dawn Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Strength +0.4]
[Agility +0.6]
[Constitution +0.4]
Various incredible sword skills surged and boiled in his mind!
At the same time, Ding Ling’s strength, agility, and constitution increased, making his physique lighter.
His endurance, cold resistance, and more were greatly enhanced.
He slightly clenched his fist.
Even his bones seemed to resonate in vibration.
This was a sign of a significant increase in strength.
"Very good."
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
It’s important to know, after reaching full level in Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship, strength +0.2, agility +0.3, constitution +0.2.
But now the attribute points increased by the Dawn Swordsmanship are completely twice that of Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship!
This shows that the Dawn Swordsmanship can entirely crush the Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship.
And indeed it was.
If the difficulty of the Double Flower Swordsmanship is 1, then the Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship would be 10. The Dawn Swordsmanship would be 100!
An entire tenfold increase!
Although the attribute points only improved by twofold,
Ding Ling’s understanding of the Sword Skill had already reached a state of Transformation Realm.

It could be said that now Ding Ling, relying entirely on Dawn Swordsmanship, could completely overwhelm the Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship! Of course, provided that he doesn’t use other techniques, only the sword.
"This aura?!"
Wang Yue seemed to sense something and couldn’t help but turn to look, after careful observation, noticed the sharp yet robust and warm aura on Ding Ling, he was shocked:
"You, you, you..."
Even the esteemed Sword God at this moment was somewhat speechless!
One could see how turbulent his inner emotions were!
Only after quite some time,
Wang Yue finally sorted out his tongue, promptly and swiftly said:
"Ding Ling, have you mastered the Dawn Swordsmanship?!"
"Hmm?!"
Zhao Yun and Shi A were still immersed in the grandeur and magnificence of the Dawn Swordsmanship!
Upon hearing this,
they snapped back to clarity.
Shi A looked at Ding Ling, hardly daring to believe.

Zhao Yun was both shocked and pleased; shocked at the difficulty of the Dawn Swordsmanship, even harder to learn than the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear, yet Ding Ling could learn it in moments? Moreover, he had just heard it once!
Delighted because he was Ding Ling’s friend, and if he had truly learned it, he naturally felt joy for him!
"Indeed."
Ding Ling bowed to Wang Yue:
"Thank you, senior, for imparting the technique!"
"You, you, you..."
Wang Yue, being too astonished, stumbled over his words again, and after quite some time, he quickly said:
"You couldn’t have possibly encountered Dawn Swordsmanship before, how did you learn it?! And just by hearing it once!!"
"I heard it, grasped it, understood it, and naturally knew it!"
Ding Ling’s full-level acting engaged, his demeanor was completely calm.
Wang Yue was shaken, his worldview somewhat shattered:
"How can it be this simple! This is the Dawn Swordsmanship!"
He was skeptical:
"Try it and demonstrate to me."
"Okay."
Ding Ling walked to the center of the training ground and drew his sword.
Clang!

The Shuoyue Sword unsheathed, like an extension of his arm, followed Ding Ling’s movement, rapidly transforming, sometimes resembling Tian Mountain snow, each sword dispersed yet perfectly forming sword curtains, with the curtains congealing into a state of snowflakes covering the sky, rotating like a wind wheel, falling in all directions, causing the void to tremble;
Sometimes resembling a blooming season, each sword converging into a complete bouquet, with the sky filled with sword light forming a sea of flowers, incredibly beautiful and wondrous!
But within this sea of flowers, killing intent spread, leaving the ground as if churning, trembling!
Clang clang clang!
The sword light continuously flashed, like a Sword God dancing, an Upper Immortal soaring from the heavens!
Zhao Yun and Shi A watched in fascination, utterly amazed!
Wang Yue was astounded to the extreme, overwhelmed with horror, confusion, gratitude, exhilaration...
Emotions mixed to the utmost!
In a few words, it was hard to express his current feelings!

sentences.text: Wang Yue said directly:
"Today I’ll simply teach you three the Sword God Skill.
How much you can understand depends on your own fate."
Shi A was excited.
Zhao Yun was solemn.
Ding Ling was delighted.
At last, they had reached the crucial stage of swordsmanship!
The Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship is just slightly inferior to the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear!
And the Sword God Skill, which is much stronger than the Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship!
How terrifying must that be?
Ding Ling had every reason to be joyful.
For him,
he had a library, which meant there was almost nothing he couldn’t learn!
Regardless of whether it was the Breathing Technique, martial arts, or various skills in the real world, he could learn them very quickly!
To put it accurately,
as long as the library condenses these skills and martial arts into books,
he could learn them instantly and achieve perfection!
The more powerful the Sword God Skill, the happier he was!
"Watch closely!"
Wang Yue walked to the center of the training ground, drew his sword, and started dancing, swoosh, swoosh!
He exhaled a breath of turbid air, his entire aura changed drastically, and his dancing speed became faster and faster, until in the end, only beams of light could be seen flashing!
Wherever the sword light passed, brilliance and colorfulness coexisted!
It was like a ray of spring light breaking through the darkness, bringing dawn!
"This is the first part of the Sword God Skill: ’Dawn Swordsmanship!’"
"It signifies breaking shackles and illuminating the Qiankun Realm!
Breaking into the supreme realm of the Sword Sect!"
"Only by truly understanding and cultivating the Dawn Swordsmanship to Great Perfection can one be considered a true disciple of the Sword Sect.
It also paves the way for stepping into the legendary realm of the Sword Sect!"
Clang!
Clang clang clang!
Wang Yue, wielding the sword, danced as if he were a Celestial God manipulating Heaven and Earth, his demeanor so composed and free, resembling an Upper Immortal traversing the mortal world!
At this moment, Wang Yue exuded the true demeanor of a Sword God, radiant and dazzling, beyond gaze!
Seeing this,
Ding Ling couldn’t help but feel admiration.
At this moment, he also confirmed some rumors about Wang Yue!
A Swordsmanship Grandmaster like this, if he couldn’t accomplish taking the head of a general among thousands of troops, then who could?
This was truly a War God-like figure.
Ding Ling thought of the Path of Glory and mused:
"For ordinary players, this task is almost impossible to complete.
It’s too difficult!"
The Path of the War God has over a dozen rules.
Although mainly the first three.
But any one of them is extremely challenging for ordinary players!
It’s important to know that a player’s aptitude is not necessarily better than that of the natives!
So much that some native martial artists need to train for many years, a player might need just as long!
Thinking about it, it’s enough to make many players collapse!
However, no one can refuse a game world that allows self-improvement, and progress, however slow, is better than no progress at all!
’The Path of the War God requires defeating the strongest in the plane.
But whether it’s Tong Yuan or Wang Yue, I can’t beat them!
It seems I still need to work harder!’
As for the Path of the Emperor?
It must be equally challenging as the Path of the War God, with many stringent conditions to trigger and complete!
’Luckily, there are cheats, otherwise this Path of the War God would be too time-consuming, mentally, and physically exhausting!’
Thinking this, Ding Ling glanced at the library.
A ’book’ on the library was slowly forming as Wang Yue continued to demonstrate and explain the swordsmanship.
And as Wang Yue finished explaining and stood with the sword sheathed,
whoosh!
This library book instantly took shape, inscribed with four large characters:
"Dawn Swordsmanship!"
In an instant afterward,
[Dawn Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Strength +0.4]
[Agility +0.6]
[Constitution +0.4]
Various incredible sword skills surged and boiled in his mind!
At the same time, Ding Ling’s strength, agility, and constitution increased, making his physique lighter.
His endurance, cold resistance, and more were greatly enhanced.
He slightly clenched his fist.
Even his bones seemed to resonate in vibration.
This was a sign of a significant increase in strength.
"Very good."
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
It’s important to know, after reaching full level in Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship, strength +0.2, agility +0.3, constitution +0.2.
But now the attribute points increased by the Dawn Swordsmanship are completely twice that of Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship!
This shows that the Dawn Swordsmanship can entirely crush the Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship.
And indeed it was.
If the difficulty of the Double Flower Swordsmanship is 1, then the Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship would be 10.
The Dawn Swordsmanship would be 100!
An entire tenfold increase!
Although the attribute points only improved by twofold,
Ding Ling’s understanding of the Sword Skill had already reached a state of Transformation Realm.
It could be said that now Ding Ling, relying entirely on Dawn Swordsmanship, could completely overwhelm the Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship!
Of course, provided that he doesn’t use other techniques, only the sword.
"This aura?!"
Wang Yue seemed to sense something and couldn’t help but turn to look, after careful observation, noticed the sharp yet robust and warm aura on Ding Ling, he was shocked:
"You, you, you..."
Even the esteemed Sword God at this moment was somewhat speechless!
One could see how turbulent his inner emotions were!
Only after quite some time,
Wang Yue finally sorted out his tongue, promptly and swiftly said:
"Ding Ling, have you mastered the Dawn Swordsmanship?!"
"Hmm?!"
Zhao Yun and Shi A were still immersed in the grandeur and magnificence of the Dawn Swordsmanship!
Upon hearing this,
they snapped back to clarity.
Shi A looked at Ding Ling, hardly daring to believe.
Zhao Yun was both shocked and pleased; shocked at the difficulty of the Dawn Swordsmanship, even harder to learn than the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear, yet Ding Ling could learn it in moments?
Moreover, he had just heard it once!
Delighted because he was Ding Ling’s friend, and if he had truly learned it, he naturally felt joy for him!
"Indeed."
Ding Ling bowed to Wang Yue:
"Thank you, senior, for imparting the technique!"
"You, you, you..."
Wang Yue, being too astonished, stumbled over his words again, and after quite some time, he quickly said:
"You couldn’t have possibly encountered Dawn Swordsmanship before, how did you learn it?!
And just by hearing it once!!"
"I heard it, grasped it, understood it, and naturally knew it!"
Ding Ling’s full-level acting engaged, his demeanor was completely calm.
Wang Yue was shaken, his worldview somewhat shattered:
"How can it be this simple!
This is the Dawn Swordsmanship!"
He was skeptical:
"Try it and demonstrate to me."
"Okay."
Ding Ling walked to the center of the training ground and drew his sword.
Clang!

The Shuoyue Sword unsheathed, like an extension of his arm, followed Ding Ling’s movement, rapidly transforming, sometimes resembling Tian Mountain snow, each sword dispersed yet perfectly forming sword curtains, with the curtains congealing into a state of snowflakes covering the sky, rotating like a wind wheel, falling in all directions, causing the void to tremble;
Sometimes resembling a blooming season, each sword converging into a complete bouquet, with the sky filled with sword light forming a sea of flowers, incredibly beautiful and wondrous!
But within this sea of flowers, killing intent spread, leaving the ground as if churning, trembling!
Clang clang clang!
The sword light continuously flashed, like a Sword God dancing, an Upper Immortal soaring from the heavens!
Zhao Yun and Shi A watched in fascination, utterly amazed!
Wang Yue was astounded to the extreme, overwhelmed with horror, confusion, gratitude, exhilaration...
Emotions mixed to the utmost!
In a few words, it was hard to express his current feelings!

chapters.title: Chapter 80: The Sword God’s Shame and Shock
paragraphs: Wang Yue was astonished that Ding Ling had cultivated the Dawn Swordsmanship to the point of mastery!
Baffled by how there could be such a swordsmanship genius in this world!
He himself took over a decade to master Dawn Swordsmanship, but Ding Ling?!
How could the gap be this vast?!
Wang Yue, with his innate sword bone, born as Sword Dao Venerable, a genius for the sword! How could he lose to a junior with ordinary talent?!
Touched by the fact that the Sword Sect has successors!
Excited by the possibility that the Sword Sect might shine brightly because of Ding Ling! Once again spreading the brilliance of the Sword Sect to the world!
To show the world the power, glory, and fearfulness of the Sword Sect!
Therefore.
At this moment, Wang Yue’s emotions were extraordinarily complex!
Various feelings intertwined, an utter chaos!
Growing up, it was his first time experiencing such emotions.
This was truly inconceivable.
And all of this was because of Ding Ling in front of him!
"It’s truly a miracle!"
Wang Yue was ashamed and sighed:

"To think I considered you, Ding Ling, a mediocre talent, and thought if you couldn’t learn high-tier swordsmanship quickly, I’d send you away. Now it seems, how am I different from those in the Imperial Palace with their dogs’ eyes looking down on people?"
His face was hot, as he apologized to Zhao Yun:
"Though I am a veteran, it’s a fundamental moral quality to correct one’s mistakes.
I misunderstood you earlier, thinking you were mocking me. I hope you don’t mind."
Zhao Yun quickly assured that he wouldn’t mind.
Wang Yue nodded, then looked towards Ding Ling, his eyes revealing astonishment, guilt, heat... very complex:
"I owe more apologies to you, Ding Ling. For the misunderstandings I had towards you were deeper and more numerous."
"Senior’s willingness to earnestly pass down the teachings to me, I am already immensely grateful."
Ding Ling said solemnly:
"Senior mustn’t be like this, I cannot bear it!"
"Alright."
Wang Yue’s old face was flushed like burning clouds, he awkwardly coughed a few times.
Especially recalling the times he doubted, even almost reprimanded, he couldn’t help but feel fortunate; if he had truly reprimanded, where would he put his face now?!
He truly hadn’t expected that such a terrifying, monstrous person would appear in this world!
Although Tong Yuan mentioned in his letter that Ding Ling was comparable to the Child of the Era, an undeniable super genius of boundless potential!
He also mentioned Ding Ling and Zhao Yun had learned Initial Tier and Middle-tier Swordsmanship.
Yet Tong Yuan didn’t describe the specifics of Ding Ling’s martial arts learning process.
He merely used a lot of ink to praise Ding Ling greatly!
Wang Yue was curious about what kind of genius would make Tong Yuan praise him so highly.
But after meeting and bone touching, he was disappointed!
Thinking Tong Yuan was fooling or amusing him!
He even contemplated sending a mediocre talent to amuse Tong Yuan!
But until now.
Only now did Wang Yue truly understand Tong Yuan’s letter!
It could be said.
Each statement made by Tong Yuan, every praise, was extremely accurate! Even without perfectly illustrating Ding Ling’s terribleness.
Tong Yuan’s letter only outlined half of Ding Ling’s monstrous talent!
No.
Perhaps not even half.
Because Ding Ling’s terrifying talent had exceeded Wang Yue’s understanding!
Such a genius.
He previously thought Ding Ling ’pre-learned’ Double Flower Swordsmanship and others, hence mastered various sword techniques so swiftly.
Now it seems...
"I underestimated Ding Ling too much!"
Wang Yue felt ashamed!
He, a Sword God!
Born with sword bones!
Being entirely crushed by Ding Ling in the study of sword techniques!
No room for comparison!
It was too preposterous.
Had he not witnessed it himself, he wouldn’t believe it! Because it was too absurd!!
"But still..."
Wang Yue thought of something, slightly puzzled:
"Ding Ling, with your talent, defying the heavens. Why did you appear so embarrassed before, causing misunderstandings, and even infinitely lowering my expectations of you?"
"Senior looked down on my lack of talent. Isn’t it normal for me to be embarrassed?"
Ding Ling’s full-level acting activated again, his speech and behavior extremely natural, without any anomaly.
Wang Yue, hearing Ding Ling’s response, was even more embarrassed, hastily changing the topic and no longer mentioning it, instead saying:
"You learned Dawn Swordsmanship so quickly. Next, I’ll teach you the second part of Sword God Skill: Sunset Swordsmanship!"
"Sunset Swordsmanship?"
"Indeed."
Wang Yue sighed:
"Initially after Dawn Swordsmanship, should have come Dawn Swordsmanship, then Middle Heaven Swordsmanship and others. But these are missing."
"Is it due to war and other factors as senior mentioned?"
Zhao Yun asked.
"Indeed."
Wang Yue felt deep regret:
"The war and others caused the deaths of Sword Sect seniors, naturally leading to repeated breaks in inheritance."
"What a pity no Sword Manual Secret Manual was left."
Zhao Yun lamented:
"If it had been preserved for Ding Ling to see, he definitely could learn it!"
"How could that be?!"
Wang Yue instinctively refuted:

"Sword Sect’s inheritance till now, many ancient geniuses died because they tried to learn our secret manuals! Without a master’s guidance and teaching, even a genius is useless! It is precisely recognizing this that our Sword Sect doesn’t leave Sword Manual Secret Manuals in the world!"
"If you don’t believe, you can try."
Zhao Yun spoke bluntly:
"Just try it with that Sunset Swordsmanship!"
"Hmm?!"
Wang Yue stared, glanced at Zhao Yun, then couldn’t help but look at Ding Ling:
"Are you... serious?!"
"Of course."
Zhao Yun was confident:
"I trust Ding Ling!"
Ding Ling nodded calmly.
Shi A was speechless, moved.
Wang Yue was shaken, unable to believe this was real.
But recalling Zhao Yun’s earlier words, and Ding Ling’s various incredible performances before.
He swallowed hard, for the second time in his life began doubting reality!
The first time was when Ding Ling learned Dawn Swordsmanship in a moment!
"Alright!"
Wang Yue leapt onto the martial arts field, drew his sword, and said loudly:
"I have to see if there truly is such a transcending, peerless monster in this world!"
"Watch closely! This is Sunset Swordsmanship!"
This time Wang Yue didn’t explain further.
Directly executing the sword moves, reciting the mantra!
Aside from this, simply following what the manuals ’contained’!
Wang Yue naturally didn’t have a manual.
But he knew manuals merely engrave sword moves, mantras, etc.
They definitely couldn’t profoundly demonstrate all esoteric truths, essences.
Thus Wang Yue’s demonstration of sword moves was quite standard, not showing his understanding of these moves.
Even so.
This set of Sunset Swordsmanship was still beautifully executed by Wang Yue, with a sense of fierceness and murderous intent amidst the beauty.
After some time.
Wang Yue sheathed his sword and stood.
Looked at Ding Ling:
"Are you sure there isn’t any problem?"
"I can give it a try."
Ding Ling slightly closed his eyes, recalling all the sword moves, mantras just now.
On the bookshelf in the library quickly condensed a book:
"Sunset Swordsmanship!"
In an instant...

chapters.title: Chapter 81: Sword Light Condenses into the Setting Sun Diagram
paragraphs: [Sunset Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Strength +0.4]
[Agility +0.6]
[Physique +0.4]
The increase in strength, agility, and physique is no different from the Dawn Swordsmanship.
But in terms of sword moves and sword principles, they are two completely different sword techniques!
Their esoteric truth and essence are even said to be completely opposite.
One seems capable of breaking through the darkness, welcoming the dawn! Embracing warmth!
The other seems capable of falling into the abyss, entering deathly silence! Stepping into darkness!
The sense of artistic conception they give people is completely different!
Clang!
Ding Ling leaped to one side, drew his sword, the Shuoyue Sword unsheathed, his wrist shook, and the sword body immediately began to weave through the void like a roaming dragon.
Clang clang clang!
Each mysterious sword move in Ding Ling’s hands flashed like dazzling fireworks, leaving people dazed and dazzled!

Like looking at flowers in the mist, only finding it extremely beautiful, yet unable to see it clearly, only catching a glimpse of the hazy sword moves, and in the next moment, more mysterious and fierce sword moves surged in like billowing waves!
One move after another.
The surging artistic conception was akin to the sun setting, darkness descending, with a touch of loneliness amidst the tragic beauty, and a hint of desolation in the despair!
Like a final desperate strike!
Like a struggle with all one’s strength before death!
Boom!
The sword moves suddenly bloomed, and beams of sword light finally condensed into a ’Setting Sun Diagram’!

The pattern blossomed in the void for a moment, then suddenly exploded and dissipated, the fierce murderous intent radiating in all directions, even Shi A and the others, standing quite far away, felt a chilling breath coming towards them!
They shivered involuntarily, their gaze at Ding Ling completely changed.
Shi A’s pupils dilated to the extreme, making his expression seem entirely consumed by bewilderment and shock.
His emotions at this moment were at their peak!
He initially thought Ding Ling was a mediocre talent, far inferior to himself, and couldn’t help but look down on Ding Ling slightly.
Most of his attention was focused on Zhao Yun, this disciple of the Spear God.
And the result?
It was exactly the opposite of what he thought!
Zhao Yun didn’t even perform at all; his brilliance was entirely overshadowed by Ding Ling!
Standing next to Ding Ling.
A distinguished disciple of the Spear God, a rare and unparalleled genius, seemed just like a foil!
And what about Shi A himself?
Did he resemble a joker or a servant beside Ding Ling?
Shi A smiled bitterly.
Ding Ling’s performance was more astonishing each time!
By now.
He was already so shocked that his scalp tingled!
It was simply unimaginable that such a person as Ding Ling could exist in this world! It was so subversive!
"Too strong!"
Wang Yue was stunned:
"Could it really be?!"
"Of course."
Zhao Yun was also quite moved, but mostly felt a sense of pride and honor for Ding Ling:
"He’s truly an unparalleled genius!"
As he said this.
The expression of pride and honor on his face grew even stronger.
Obviously, he completely considered himself on Ding Ling’s side!
"I need to take a break."
Wang Yue walked aside, taking a few deep breaths, closing his eyes slightly to gather his spirit.
His worldview, his outlook on life, was shattered to pieces.
What he considered the supreme in swordsmanship!
The number one genius in sword dao, respected by countless masters!
Yet when facing Ding Ling now?
Completely crushed!
Utterly unable to withstand a single blow!
Wang Yue was extremely shaken, questioning life and feeling an emotional turmoil to the point of dizziness and shortness of breath!
Afraid of losing face in front of Ding Ling and the others, he had to step aside to calm his mind, regulate his breath, and settle his heart!
After a while.
The Breathing Technique continued to operate unabated.
Suppressing the surging complex emotions back down.
Only then did Wang Yue recover.
He looked at Ding Ling, exclaiming:
"In my life, the experiences I’ve had, the people I’ve met, are far too many. Hence, I was already capable of looking down upon all great talents under heaven.
But it seems I’ve met my match with you."
Ding Ling hurriedly and modestly expressed he dared not.
"I now consider you one of my own."
Wang Yue smiled slightly, as if already accepting the harsh reality that he was inferior to Ding Ling, hence, his tone became much calmer, his expression more composed:
"So, what I say to you comes from the bottom of my heart."
He looked at Ding Ling admiringly:
"I thought other than those few old fellows, I’d never see an evenly matched opponent again. But now, I see hope in you."
He got straight to the point without wasting words:
"Let’s continue imparting the skill.
He said:
"After the Sunset Swordsmanship. The Sword God Skill has only some fragmentary moves left. I’ll impart them all to you now."

The fragmentary moves involve various sword skills, truly fragmentary, though not as formidable as the Dawn Swordsmanship, they are considerably more powerful than the Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship. Quite impressive.
Ding Ling reached full level instantly again.
The power he demonstrated.
Was not much weaker than Wang Yue.
Wang Yue was gratified:

"If someday, you come across the full secret manual containing these fragmentary moves, maybe you’ll be able to learn other Sword God Skills. If you master the complete Sword God Skill, perhaps you can truly become the Land Sword God, reviving the glory of the Ancient Sword Sect!"
Ding Ling was speechless.
Wang Yue realized this too, and laughed:
"Indeed. Right now, the Sword Sect only has a few of us. Where would we find other secret manuals?"
He didn’t mention this anymore, just looked at Ding Ling and said:
"I have already imparted all my sword techniques to you. The only thing I haven’t taught you is the ’Sword God Breathing Technique’. Do you want to learn it?"
"Of course!"
Ding Ling answered with certainty.
"But I heard that learning multiple breathing techniques can easily cause respiratory dissonance, unstable regulation! The aftereffects could be severe."
Zhao Yun couldn’t help but remind.
"Oh?"
Wang Yue turned to Ding Ling and asked:
"So, you’ve mastered Tong Yuan’s Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique?"
"Yes."
"That’s quite unfortunate."
Wang Yue sighed:
"I initially wanted to impart the Sword Sect’s supreme skill, the Sword God Breathing Technique, to you as well, but it seems now it’s not possible."
"I think it’s no problem."
Ding Ling still wanted to try.
After all, he was cheating the system.
"This..."
Wang Yue frowned, puzzled:

"Breathing techniques are almost impossible to coexist. Unless one is internal and the other external. But as far as I know, the Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique is like the Sword God Breathing Technique, an external refining breathing technique. It’s utterly impossible for them to coexist."
"There’s no harm in trying."
Ding Ling persisted.
"Alright then."
Wang Yue had seen too many miracles in Ding Ling, after thinking, finally agreed:

"Many geniuses have tried to practice two external refining breathing techniques simultaneously, but the result was either rupture of internal organs, suffocation, cerebral hemorrhage, or qi collision leading to shattered meridians..."
He looked deeply at Ding Ling:
"So once you sense anything off, you must immediately stop practicing."
"Understood."
Ding Ling said solemnly.
Listening to Wang Yue’s serious words.
Ding Ling was also a bit apprehensive.
Feeling that he must be cautious later.
"Listen carefully now."
Wang Yue did not avoid Zhao Yun either.
As for Shi A?
It seemed he had already mastered the Sword God Breathing Technique.

sentences.text: [Sunset Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Strength +0.4]
[Agility +0.6]
[Physique +0.4]
The increase in strength, agility, and physique is no different from the Dawn Swordsmanship.
But in terms of sword moves and sword principles, they are two completely different sword techniques!
Their esoteric truth and essence are even said to be completely opposite.
One seems capable of breaking through the darkness, welcoming the dawn!
Embracing warmth!
The other seems capable of falling into the abyss, entering deathly silence!
Stepping into darkness!
The sense of artistic conception they give people is completely different!
Clang!
Ding Ling leaped to one side, drew his sword, the Shuoyue Sword unsheathed, his wrist shook, and the sword body immediately began to weave through the void like a roaming dragon.
Clang clang clang!
Each mysterious sword move in Ding Ling’s hands flashed like dazzling fireworks, leaving people dazed and dazzled!

Like looking at flowers in the mist, only finding it extremely beautiful, yet unable to see it clearly, only catching a glimpse of the hazy sword moves, and in the next moment, more mysterious and fierce sword moves surged in like billowing waves!
One move after another.
The surging artistic conception was akin to the sun setting, darkness descending, with a touch of loneliness amidst the tragic beauty, and a hint of desolation in the despair!
Like a final desperate strike!
Like a struggle with all one’s strength before death!
Boom!
The sword moves suddenly bloomed, and beams of sword light finally condensed into a ’Setting Sun Diagram’!

The pattern blossomed in the void for a moment, then suddenly exploded and dissipated, the fierce murderous intent radiating in all directions, even Shi A and the others, standing quite far away, felt a chilling breath coming towards them!
They shivered involuntarily, their gaze at Ding Ling completely changed.
Shi A’s pupils dilated to the extreme, making his expression seem entirely consumed by bewilderment and shock.
His emotions at this moment were at their peak!
He initially thought Ding Ling was a mediocre talent, far inferior to himself, and couldn’t help but look down on Ding Ling slightly.
Most of his attention was focused on Zhao Yun, this disciple of the Spear God.
And the result?
It was exactly the opposite of what he thought!
Zhao Yun didn’t even perform at all; his brilliance was entirely overshadowed by Ding Ling!
Standing next to Ding Ling.
A distinguished disciple of the Spear God, a rare and unparalleled genius, seemed just like a foil!
And what about Shi A himself?
Did he resemble a joker or a servant beside Ding Ling?
Shi A smiled bitterly.
Ding Ling’s performance was more astonishing each time!
By now.
He was already so shocked that his scalp tingled!
It was simply unimaginable that such a person as Ding Ling could exist in this world!
It was so subversive!
"Too strong!"
Wang Yue was stunned:
"Could it really be?!"
"Of course."
Zhao Yun was also quite moved, but mostly felt a sense of pride and honor for Ding Ling:
"He’s truly an unparalleled genius!"
As he said this.
The expression of pride and honor on his face grew even stronger.
Obviously, he completely considered himself on Ding Ling’s side!
"I need to take a break."
Wang Yue walked aside, taking a few deep breaths, closing his eyes slightly to gather his spirit.
His worldview, his outlook on life, was shattered to pieces.
What he considered the supreme in swordsmanship!
The number one genius in sword dao, respected by countless masters!
Yet when facing Ding Ling now?
Completely crushed!
Utterly unable to withstand a single blow!
Wang Yue was extremely shaken, questioning life and feeling an emotional turmoil to the point of dizziness and shortness of breath!
Afraid of losing face in front of Ding Ling and the others, he had to step aside to calm his mind, regulate his breath, and settle his heart!
After a while.
The Breathing Technique continued to operate unabated.
Suppressing the surging complex emotions back down.
Only then did Wang Yue recover.
He looked at Ding Ling, exclaiming:
"In my life, the experiences I’ve had, the people I’ve met, are far too many.
Hence, I was already capable of looking down upon all great talents under heaven.
But it seems I’ve met my match with you."
Ding Ling hurriedly and modestly expressed he dared not.
"I now consider you one of my own."
Wang Yue smiled slightly, as if already accepting the harsh reality that he was inferior to Ding Ling, hence, his tone became much calmer, his expression more composed:
"So, what I say to you comes from the bottom of my heart."
He looked at Ding Ling admiringly:
"I thought other than those few old fellows, I’d never see an evenly matched opponent again.
But now, I see hope in you."
He got straight to the point without wasting words:
"Let’s continue imparting the skill.
He said:
"After the Sunset Swordsmanship.
The Sword God Skill has only some fragmentary moves left.
I’ll impart them all to you now."
The fragmentary moves involve various sword skills, truly fragmentary, though not as formidable as the Dawn Swordsmanship, they are considerably more powerful than the Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship.
Quite impressive.
Ding Ling reached full level instantly again.
The power he demonstrated.
Was not much weaker than Wang Yue.
Wang Yue was gratified:
"If someday, you come across the full secret manual containing these fragmentary moves, maybe you’ll be able to learn other Sword God Skills.
If you master the complete Sword God Skill, perhaps you can truly become the Land Sword God, reviving the glory of the Ancient Sword Sect!"
Ding Ling was speechless.
Wang Yue realized this too, and laughed:
"Indeed.
Right now, the Sword Sect only has a few of us.
Where would we find other secret manuals?"
He didn’t mention this anymore, just looked at Ding Ling and said:
"I have already imparted all my sword techniques to you.
The only thing I haven’t taught you is the ’Sword God Breathing Technique’.
Do you want to learn it?"
"Of course!"
Ding Ling answered with certainty.
"But I heard that learning multiple breathing techniques can easily cause respiratory dissonance, unstable regulation!
The aftereffects could be severe."
Zhao Yun couldn’t help but remind.
"Oh?"
Wang Yue turned to Ding Ling and asked:
"So, you’ve mastered Tong Yuan’s Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique?"
"Yes."
"That’s quite unfortunate."
Wang Yue sighed:
"I initially wanted to impart the Sword Sect’s supreme skill, the Sword God Breathing Technique, to you as well, but it seems now it’s not possible."
"I think it’s no problem."
Ding Ling still wanted to try.
After all, he was cheating the system.
"This..."
Wang Yue frowned, puzzled:
"Breathing techniques are almost impossible to coexist.
Unless one is internal and the other external.
But as far as I know, the Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique is like the Sword God Breathing Technique, an external refining breathing technique.
It’s utterly impossible for them to coexist."
"There’s no harm in trying."
Ding Ling persisted.
"Alright then."
Wang Yue had seen too many miracles in Ding Ling, after thinking, finally agreed:

"Many geniuses have tried to practice two external refining breathing techniques simultaneously, but the result was either rupture of internal organs, suffocation, cerebral hemorrhage, or qi collision leading to shattered meridians..."
He looked deeply at Ding Ling:
"So once you sense anything off, you must immediately stop practicing."
"Understood."
Ding Ling said solemnly.
Listening to Wang Yue’s serious words.
Ding Ling was also a bit apprehensive.
Feeling that he must be cautious later.
"Listen carefully now."
Wang Yue did not avoid Zhao Yun either.
As for Shi A?
It seemed he had already mastered the Sword God Breathing Technique.

chapters.title: Chapter 82: Sword God Breathing Technique and the Illusory Warrior’s Breathing Method Secret Manual
paragraphs: "The mantra of the Sword God Breathing Technique is..."
Wang Yue recited carefully.
Ding Ling listened once and gently closed his eyes.
On one of the library’s shelves, a book suddenly materialized:
"Sword God Breathing Technique!"
In an instant.
[Sword God Breathing Technique Full Level]
[Charm +1]
Various related esoteric truths, essences, and principles surged like waves in his mind, roiling and crashing.
Then quickly transformed into a mastery and rushed into every part of Ding Ling’s body.
Ding Ling’s breathing started to change.
Between each inhalation and exhalation.
It was as if a Sword God was accumulating and exhaling endless sword principles and sword qi!
A supreme sharpness rushed straight to the sky!
Just standing there, Ding Ling gave an impression of an intense sharpness that was hard to gaze upon directly.
He seemed like an unsheathed Divine Sword, exposing its edge, making people afraid to get close.
"Is this the outward manifestation of achieving great success in the Sword God Breathing Technique?!"
Shi A was shocked, a face full of disbelief.
Even though he had already been stunned by Ding Ling, making his scalp tingle, unable to control himself.
At this moment, he still couldn’t remain calm and composed!
To think that the Sword God Breathing Technique is extremely difficult!
He has been cultivating for over ten years, still lingering at the middle tier level, not to mention great success, he hasn’t even touched upon the high tier level!
And Ding Ling?!
How long has it been?!
If not counting the time for the master’s teaching, it was just a few blinks of an eye?
Wang Yue was also dumbfounded.
He was of course surprised that Ding Ling learned the Sword God Breathing Technique so quickly!
But he was shocked that Ding Ling could actually make two External Refining Breathing Techniques coexist?!
How is this possible?!
"Ding Ling you!"
Zhao Yun was also unsettled!
Staring at Ding Ling, afraid that something unexpected might happen.
After all, cultivating two External Refining Breathing Techniques is a huge taboo!
Many ancient geniuses died prematurely!
This is a profound lesson learned through blood!
"I’m fine."
Ding Ling smiled slightly, feeling unprecedentedly good.
"Are you really sure you’re fine?"
Zhao Yun, who prides himself on Ding Ling and trusts him greatly, was still extremely anxious and surprised.
It’s imaginable what Shi A and Wang Yue’s attitudes were at this moment, you could say they were completely disoriented!
Once again falling into a state of a collapsed worldview!
"Really."
Ding Ling nodded, comforting Zhao Yun with a few words.
Seeing Zhao Yun relax.
He gently closed his eyes and began to scrutinize himself.
He discovered that in his limbs, bones, organs, and internal cavities, two kinds of vigorous qi were interweaving, thoroughly permeating everywhere.
The feeling of emptiness that was previously somewhat present now completely disappeared.
The whole person became particularly fulfilled.
He pondered:

"Perhaps it’s because the breathing technique has been integrated into my mastery, or maybe my physical quality is exceptionally high? Or maybe it’s due to the library’s cheat-like reason? Making these two breathing techniques almost spread all over the skin membranes and meridians, constantly refining the meridians, etc."
"However, it seems like two External Refining Breathing Techniques are the limit."
"At least that’s what it looks like currently."
Ding Ling glanced at the library, thinking:
’If I forcefully cultivate a third External Refining Breathing Technique, what results will appear?’
He pondered that the library’s bookshelf might not display a third book of the External Refining Breathing Technique then?
If otherwise.
Instantly reaching full level.
Wouldn’t he have learned it again?
’Find an opportunity to try it sometime.’
Ding Ling thought of Tong Yuan as a mobile martial arts library, and couldn’t help but look at Wang Yue, asking him whether he had any other secret manuals of External Refining Breathing Techniques.
Wang Yue was speechless and sighed:

"You’ve broken people’s understanding. You’ve broken the curse that two External Refining Breathing Techniques absolutely cannot be cultivated simultaneously! Do you still want to cultivate a third one?!"
"I think two is the limit."
Ding Ling replied truthfully:
"I just want to see the result. Trying it shouldn’t matter."
"Okay."
Wang Yue nodded and said:
"I indeed know another External Refining Breathing Technique. It is the family heritage technique. Before meeting my master, I had always been cultivating this breathing technique."
His spirits slightly rise, as if caught in some memories:

"However, the family heritage breathing technique didn’t suit me, it was incompatible with me and hard to harmonize. Even with long-term cultivation, I lingered at the initial tier. Later, I met my master who taught me the Sword God Breathing Technique, and I felt this breathing technique far surpassed the family heritage one and was more suitable for me, so I abandoned the family heritage breathing technique.
Dedicated myself to cultivating the Sword God Breathing Technique.
And as expected.
With the Sword God Breathing Technique, I improved rapidly."
He paused for a moment:
"The one suitable for oneself is the best. Even I, when encountering unsuitable techniques, find it very hard to improve."
He looked at Shi A, Zhao Yun, and Ding Ling:
"Don’t bite off more than you can chew, remember, remember."
Though he thought of Ding Ling’s talent.
Wang Yue was slightly at a loss for words; he didn’t waste words and directly began speaking about the points and the mantra of his family heritage breathing technique.
After speaking, he looked at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling gently closed his eyes.
As expected.
On the shelf, a book began slowly to coagulate.
Engraved on it were five large words:
"Warrior’s Breathing Method!"
This is Wang Yue’s family heritage breathing technique.
Cultivate it to the extreme, you will inevitably become a valiant war general! An imposing aura will be common.
But at this moment.
The "Warrior’s Breathing Method" on the bookshelf in the library, though successfully coagulated in the end, was illusory, not substantialized.
Entirely different from other substantialized books.
"Is it really not possible?"
Ding Ling was relieved.
Thinking:
’It seems when reaching the limits of bodily tolerance, the library will pause at ’enlightenment’ full-level!’
’Maybe once my body qualities improve, fully adapt to the third breathing technique, the library will make the Warrior’s Breathing Method full-level?’
Specifically how.
Ding Ling did not know.
Nevertheless, he knew one thing.
The library’s automatic full-level and mastery integration, the ability to ’neutralize’ and ’regulate,’ is unrivaled!
The ancient world lost many geniuses to failure.
But only Ding Ling succeeded.
This proves the absolute magic of the library!
Unfortunately, though Ding Ling’s body qualities have enhanced, two seem to be the limit.
’If the body quality indeed gets improved again and can accommodate the third breathing technique, wouldn’t that be even more powerful?’
Ding Ling can clearly feel the power of the two breathing techniques.
Previously, when absorbing medicinal power, there would be slight losses.
Now the losses are almost negligible.
Not only that.
The efficiency and speed of digestion, refinement, and absorption of medicinal power will soar!
Moreover, the two breathing techniques can simultaneously exert force, providing various amplifications for Ding Ling!
Ding Ling silently nodded, very satisfied.
"How is it?"
Wang Yue couldn’t help asking.
"Not possible."
Ding Ling lamented.
Wang Yue seemed to breathe a sigh of relief, thinking:

"Ding Ling, this fellow has already broken the curse of not being able to cultivate two External Refining Breathing Techniques simultaneously, becoming, since time immemorial, the first great talent in breathing technique cultivation! If he could cultivate a third, how would I describe him?! Deity? Immortal?!"
