chapters.title: Chapter 83: Wang Family Supreme Skill Inheritance
paragraphs: Ding Ling’s matter of not being able to cultivate the third Breathing Technique was left aside.
Even so.
Zhao Yun, Shi A, and Wang Yue were no longer calm or serene; each of them looked at Ding Ling as if they were seeing a prodigy or a freak.
"Two Breathing Techniques achieved Great Success simultaneously!"
"The aura he exudes combines the advantages of the Spiritual Phoenix and the Sword God, appearing extraordinarily charming!"
"The aura combines grandeur, nobility, sharpness, bravery, and supreme energy; such energy is precious and enviable!"
Shi A and the others’ Heart Lake was stirred.
They all watched Ding Ling with burning eyes.
At this moment, they discovered that Ding Ling seemed to be automatically gathering and harmonizing the two Breathing Techniques.
Causing Ding Ling’s aura to continually transform.
His charm grew increasingly high!
Originally, Ding Ling’s repeated growth in stature and appearance had already made him seem like a handsome gentleman.
Now with his charm enhanced.
He appeared exceedingly impressive, remarkably eye-catching.
"Incredible. Cultivating two Breathing Techniques simultaneously actually enhances charm?"
Wang Yue praised, stroked his beard, and said contentedly:
"Now that our Sword Sect has encountered such a perfect disciple in you, Ding Ling, I have no regrets in this life."
But Ding Ling replied:
"I wonder if the senior has any other skills?"
"Hmm?!"
Wang Yue was taken aback, "What do you mean? Could it be you want to learn more?"
"Yes."
"Is being a Sword Sect disciple and an unparalleled swordsman not good enough?"
"The senior might not know."
Zhao Yun couldn’t help but interject:
"Ding Ling learns everything quickly. It’s fine."
"Is that so?"
At this moment, Wang Yue completely believed Zhao Yun’s words.
After all, he had lost face several times before for not believing.
One or two mistakes were enough; how could he repeat them five, six, seven, eight times?
Wang Yue considered himself shrewd, so upon hearing Zhao Yun, he instinctively nodded, saying:
"Since even Zhao Yun says so. Fine. I’ll teach you all the skills I know."
"Thank you, senior."
Ding Ling’s face lit up with joy.
Shi A smiled bitterly.
Wang Yue sighed:
"Indeed, geniuses are different. Although I know some other skills, most are family-inherited. Moreover, I have abandoned them for decades, let alone cultivating them.
If it weren’t for your reminder today.
I would have almost forgotten my family-inherited skills."
He paused and said:

"My family skills include not only the Warrior’s Breathing Method but also the Gale Spear Technique, Howling Moon Posture, and the Wang Family Fist Skill. I haven’t cultivated these to the Great Success Realm, only approaching Great Perfection. I’ll teach you all now."
"Let’s start with the Gale Spear Technique. There’s no spear here, so I’ll use a long sword as a spear to show you..."
Wang Yue detailed the mantra and moves one by one.
Ding Ling remembered them.
A book emerged in the library thereafter:
"Gale Spear Technique"!
In an instant later.
[Gale Spear Technique Full Level]
[Defense +0.5]
The essences and esoteric truths of the spear techniques flashed through his mind!
In the span of a breath, Ding Ling fully mastered the spear technique while also increasing defense by 0.5.
The defense points were identical to those enhanced by Double Flower Swordsmanship.
In terms of difficulty.
The Gale Spear Technique was similar to Double Flower Swordsmanship.
But compared to Double Flower Swordsmanship, the Gale Spear Technique was clearly more suited for battlefield killing!
From the Warrior’s Breathing Method to the Gale Spear Technique, it was evident that Wang Yue’s ancestors must have been a valiant general traversing the battlefield!
"How is it?"
"Accomplished."
Ding Ling nodded, drew his sword, and thrust out!
Clang!
Though it was clearly a sword, at that moment, it demonstrated the spear technique’s heavy, majestic, and grand presence, showing a killing aura in every move.
"It’s indeed Great Perfection."
Wang Yue praised:
"Truly an unparalleled genius, a gifted child against the heavens!"
Shi A felt inferior, gazing at Ding Ling with admiration as though looking at a Celestial God.
He was thoroughly convinced.
[Obtained Achievement Medal: You earned profound admiration from the Sword God Wang Yue!]

[Annotation: You have impressed Wang Yue repeatedly. Now he is in awe of you, admitting in terms of comprehension, compared to you, he feels inferior, having a sense of the Yangtze River’s waves pushing forward, leaving the ones before to die on the sands!]
Another achievement medal.
It seems that after brushing E-level, it can indeed be brushed again for an ordinary one.
Ding Ling nodded silently, looking toward Wang Yue with anticipation.
Wang Yue was momentarily stunned, then he came to his senses and began to teach the Wang Family Fist Skill.
When instructing, he was methodical, similarly without explaining the esoteric truths and essence within.
Knowing Ding Ling needed no explanation to comprehend and cultivate to Great Success.
He naturally wouldn’t waste time doing so.
Moreover, he himself hadn’t achieved Great Success in fist techniques; his explanations would definitely be flawed, so he wouldn’t mislead anyone.
With these thoughts in mind.
Wang Yue’s fist techniques seemed increasingly mechanical.
The mantra he used was word by word, just like rote teaching.
After one round.
Ding Ling remembered, closed his eyes.
The books on the library shelf took shape.
[Wang Family Fist Skill Full Level]
[Defense +0.3]
The fist technique was very intricate.
Though not as sharp as spear techniques, it held its own subtleties.
When paired with other fist techniques, it showcased more of its versatility.
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
This fist skill was basically a free gain, let alone it added 0.3 defense attribute points.
0.3 wasn’t much.
But Ding Ling felt his whole body heating up, a mysterious energy pounding his organs, the sensation on his skin lasted a little while before dissipating.
He could clearly feel his muscles and bones becoming stronger.
Silently praising in his heart, he couldn’t help but look at Wang Yue again.
Wang Yue gestured for Ding Ling to demonstrate the fist skill before proceeding.
So Ding Ling entered the training ground, swung his fists, and performed the Wang Family Fist Skill.
The performance was full of spirit, impressively authoritative.
After completing one set of Wang Family Fist Skill.
Wang Yue clapped and exclaimed:
"So remarkable! If my father knew that the family-inherited supreme skill was practiced to the level of mastery, he would be greatly satisfied, and could rest in peace."
He sighed, as if recalling something unpleasant, his expression slightly wistful.
But soon he brushed it aside, revitalized, and said:

"Next is the Howling Moon Posture. This Pile Skill was bestowed upon my ancestors who were renowned for their battle achievements by His Majesty the Emperor at the time, making it arguably the most supreme Pile Skill in the world! It is a Royal Secret Skill!"
Ding Ling’s expression subtly invigorated.
A Royal Secret Skill!
He couldn’t help but gaze in the direction of Luoyang Imperial Palace.
He wondered if there were any undiscovered Royal Secret Skills in the Luoyang Treasury?
If there were.
Could he find a way to take a look inside?
"Don’t get any ideas about the Royal Armory."
Wang Yue seemed to see through Ding Ling’s thoughts:
"When Dong Zhuo entered the capital, the Royal Armory was already divided up. Now the Imperial Palace Armory and Armory are in ruins. There’s nothing of value left. It would be a fruitless visit."
"How do you know so much, senior?"
Ding Ling was surprised.
"I used to hold an official position. It was only later that I retired."
Wang Yue sighed:
"Besides, as the Land Sword God, I come and go without a trace. If I really wanted to visit the Palace, who could stop me?"

sentences.text: Ding Ling’s matter of not being able to cultivate the third Breathing Technique was left aside.
Even so.
Zhao Yun, Shi A, and Wang Yue were no longer calm or serene; each of them looked at Ding Ling as if they were seeing a prodigy or a freak.
"Two Breathing Techniques achieved Great Success simultaneously!"
"The aura he exudes combines the advantages of the Spiritual Phoenix and the Sword God, appearing extraordinarily charming!"
"The aura combines grandeur, nobility, sharpness, bravery, and supreme energy; such energy is precious and enviable!"
Shi A and the others’ Heart Lake was stirred.
They all watched Ding Ling with burning eyes.
At this moment, they discovered that Ding Ling seemed to be automatically gathering and harmonizing the two Breathing Techniques.
Causing Ding Ling’s aura to continually transform.
His charm grew increasingly high!
Originally, Ding Ling’s repeated growth in stature and appearance had already made him seem like a handsome gentleman.
Now with his charm enhanced.
He appeared exceedingly impressive, remarkably eye-catching.
"Incredible.
Cultivating two Breathing Techniques simultaneously actually enhances charm?"
Wang Yue praised, stroked his beard, and said contentedly:
"Now that our Sword Sect has encountered such a perfect disciple in you, Ding Ling, I have no regrets in this life."
But Ding Ling replied:
"I wonder if the senior has any other skills?"
"Hmm?!"
Wang Yue was taken aback, "What do you mean?
Could it be you want to learn more?"
"Yes."
"Is being a Sword Sect disciple and an unparalleled swordsman not good enough?"
"The senior might not know."
Zhao Yun couldn’t help but interject:
"Ding Ling learns everything quickly.
It’s fine."
"Is that so?"
At this moment, Wang Yue completely believed Zhao Yun’s words.
After all, he had lost face several times before for not believing.
One or two mistakes were enough; how could he repeat them five, six, seven, eight times?
Wang Yue considered himself shrewd, so upon hearing Zhao Yun, he instinctively nodded, saying:
"Since even Zhao Yun says so.
Fine.
I’ll teach you all the skills I know."
"Thank you, senior."
Ding Ling’s face lit up with joy.
Shi A smiled bitterly.
Wang Yue sighed:
"Indeed, geniuses are different.
Although I know some other skills, most are family-inherited.
Moreover, I have abandoned them for decades, let alone cultivating them.
If it weren’t for your reminder today.
I would have almost forgotten my family-inherited skills."
He paused and said:
"My family skills include not only the Warrior’s Breathing Method but also the Gale Spear Technique, Howling Moon Posture, and the Wang Family Fist Skill.
I haven’t cultivated these to the Great Success Realm, only approaching Great Perfection.
I’ll teach you all now."
"Let’s start with the Gale Spear Technique.
There’s no spear here, so I’ll use a long sword as a spear to show you..."
Wang Yue detailed the mantra and moves one by one.
Ding Ling remembered them.
A book emerged in the library thereafter:
"Gale Spear Technique"!
In an instant later.
[Gale Spear Technique Full Level]
[Defense +0.5]
The essences and esoteric truths of the spear techniques flashed through his mind!
In the span of a breath, Ding Ling fully mastered the spear technique while also increasing defense by 0.5.
The defense points were identical to those enhanced by Double Flower Swordsmanship.
In terms of difficulty.
The Gale Spear Technique was similar to Double Flower Swordsmanship.
But compared to Double Flower Swordsmanship, the Gale Spear Technique was clearly more suited for battlefield killing!
From the Warrior’s Breathing Method to the Gale Spear Technique, it was evident that Wang Yue’s ancestors must have been a valiant general traversing the battlefield!
"How is it?"
"Accomplished."
Ding Ling nodded, drew his sword, and thrust out!
Clang!
Though it was clearly a sword, at that moment, it demonstrated the spear technique’s heavy, majestic, and grand presence, showing a killing aura in every move.
"It’s indeed Great Perfection."
Wang Yue praised:
"Truly an unparalleled genius, a gifted child against the heavens!"
Shi A felt inferior, gazing at Ding Ling with admiration as though looking at a Celestial God.
He was thoroughly convinced.
[Obtained Achievement Medal: You earned profound admiration from the Sword God Wang Yue!]
[Annotation: You have impressed Wang Yue repeatedly.

Now he is in awe of you, admitting in terms of comprehension, compared to you, he feels inferior, having a sense of the Yangtze River’s waves pushing forward, leaving the ones before to die on the sands!]
Another achievement medal.
It seems that after brushing E-level, it can indeed be brushed again for an ordinary one.
Ding Ling nodded silently, looking toward Wang Yue with anticipation.
Wang Yue was momentarily stunned, then he came to his senses and began to teach the Wang Family Fist Skill.
When instructing, he was methodical, similarly without explaining the esoteric truths and essence within.
Knowing Ding Ling needed no explanation to comprehend and cultivate to Great Success.
He naturally wouldn’t waste time doing so.
Moreover, he himself hadn’t achieved Great Success in fist techniques; his explanations would definitely be flawed, so he wouldn’t mislead anyone.
With these thoughts in mind.
Wang Yue’s fist techniques seemed increasingly mechanical.
The mantra he used was word by word, just like rote teaching.
After one round.
Ding Ling remembered, closed his eyes.
The books on the library shelf took shape.
[Wang Family Fist Skill Full Level]
[Defense +0.3]
The fist technique was very intricate.
Though not as sharp as spear techniques, it held its own subtleties.
When paired with other fist techniques, it showcased more of its versatility.
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
This fist skill was basically a free gain, let alone it added 0.3 defense attribute points.
0.3 wasn’t much.
But Ding Ling felt his whole body heating up, a mysterious energy pounding his organs, the sensation on his skin lasted a little while before dissipating.
He could clearly feel his muscles and bones becoming stronger.
Silently praising in his heart, he couldn’t help but look at Wang Yue again.
Wang Yue gestured for Ding Ling to demonstrate the fist skill before proceeding.
So Ding Ling entered the training ground, swung his fists, and performed the Wang Family Fist Skill.
The performance was full of spirit, impressively authoritative.
After completing one set of Wang Family Fist Skill.
Wang Yue clapped and exclaimed:
"So remarkable!
If my father knew that the family-inherited supreme skill was practiced to the level of mastery, he would be greatly satisfied, and could rest in peace."
He sighed, as if recalling something unpleasant, his expression slightly wistful.
But soon he brushed it aside, revitalized, and said:
"Next is the Howling Moon Posture.
This Pile Skill was bestowed upon my ancestors who were renowned for their battle achievements by His Majesty the Emperor at the time, making it arguably the most supreme Pile Skill in the world!
It is a Royal Secret Skill!"

Now the Imperial Palace Armory and Armory are in ruins.
There’s nothing of value left.
It would be a fruitless visit."
"How do you know so much, senior?"
Ding Ling was surprised.
"I used to hold an official position.
It was only later that I retired."
Wang Yue sighed:
"Besides, as the Land Sword God, I come and go without a trace.
If I really wanted to visit the Palace, who could stop me?"

chapters.title: Chapter 84: Power Progress
paragraphs: As he spoke, an unmistakable overbearing aura emerged.
It was evident that Wang Yue was extremely confident in his martial arts!
Ding Ling nodded silently.
To be invincible across the world at a young age.
Now that he’s older, the Sword God Breathing Technique has long reached the Transformation Realm, and his strength has obviously reached an unfathomable level!
It could be said this way.
At the levels of Tong Yuan and Wang Yue, martial arts techniques are merely auxiliary; the truly powerful aspect is the Breathing Technique.
Because they cannot cheat like Ding Ling.
They can only use the Breathing Technique to rapidly enhance their physical qualities and strengthen themselves.
This was true for Tong Yuan and Wang Yue alike.
It’s just that the way they practice the Breathing Technique is different.
Tong Yuan collected herbs in the mountainous and remote areas, often secluding himself in high mountains and dangerous places.
Wang Yue relied on being an official, the higher the rank, the more points of knowledge and information he was exposed to, and naturally, the more merchants and medicinal materials he could access.
Ding Ling knew this through conversations with Wang Yue.
Rumor had it that Wang Yue was obsessed with officialdom.
Rather than saying he was obsessed with officialdom, it would be better to say he was a martial fanatic!
He simply felt that practicing like Tong Yuan was too slow, so he chose a shortcut in the bureaucracy, attempting to use a large amount of official resources to gather herbs.

Unfortunately, it did not go as he wished, and instead, due to being tainted by impure qi, his mind was disturbed, making his Breathing Technique practice inferior to that of Tong Yuan, who had completely calmed his mind.
If it weren’t for his superiority in skill with the Sword God Skill over the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear.
The outcome of their confrontation would truly be uncertain.
It seems he realized this point.
Additionally, having become thoroughly disillusioned with the bureaucracy of the Han Dynasty.
Wang Yue had already resigned from office, dismissed many disciples, and was staying at the Prince’s Mansion, nurturing his mind and at the same time teaching Shi A:

"I initially thought that once Shi A mastered swordsmanship, I could enter the treacherous terrains of Tian Mountain to gather herbs, looking to see if I could break through the Celestial Being barrier. But now..."
Wang Yue looked brightly at Ding Ling:
"I’ve seen hope in you!"
"Celestial Being?"
Ding Ling’s eyes widened slightly.
"Exactly."
Wang Yue stroked his beard and said:

"For clarity to the world. The general division of military generals and experts is simple and clear. There are soldiers, unranked generals, third-class generals, second-class generals, first-class generals, super-elite generals!"
He glanced at Shi A and the others:
"Shi A can be comparable to the weakest first-class general. Zhao Yun can rival the strongest first-class general. As for you, Ding Ling, you have already stepped into the super-elite."
He sighed:
"So young and already at super-elite, with some of the old masters hidden from the world, if you were to campaign across Jiuzhou, you might even defeat all enemies!"
Ding Ling hurriedly modestly said that he dared not.
After all, before a senior, how dare he claim to be the world’s number one? To have no worthy opponents?
"You need not be modest."
Wang Yue stroked his beard and smiled:
"Not long ago, I faced a super-elite expert in a certain area of the Imperial Palace. You are no worse than him."
"Super-elite expert?"
Zhao Yun glanced sideways, surprised:
"In the Imperial Palace?!"
"Yes. He seems to be named Lü Bu."
Wang Yue thought and said,
"He is said to be Jiuyuan Lü Bu, who fought so fiercely on the frontier that the barbarians dared not move their herds south; alas, alas, such an expert has now become the Thief Dong’s henchman!"
Upon hearing Jiuyuan Lü Bu.
Ding Ling was relieved.
This was truly the world’s number one Flying General in the absence of people like Tong Yuan!
Does he himself now not fall short of Lü Bu?
Ding Ling’s heart was slightly joyful.
It seems he has indeed reached an extraordinary level.
Not inferior to Lü Bu.
Then, engaged in a solo battle with the Three Heroes, wouldn’t that mean he could fight back and forth?
"Your strength is not inferior to his, but your potential is higher."
Wang Yue was very pleased with Ding Ling:
"Surpassing Lü Bu in the future is just a matter of time!"
"All right."
He began to recite the mantra of the Howling Moon Posture and posed:
"Watch carefully. This is the foundation of the Royal Secret Skill: Howling Moon Posture!"
Ding Ling looked carefully.
After one round.
He closed his eyes.
A book condensed in the library.
In an instant.
[Howling Moon Posture Full Level]
[Defense+0.4]
A mere posture skill.
Yet more mysterious and profound than the Wang Family Fist Skill.
Only slightly inferior to Gale Spear Technique.
This is a foundational posture skill!
To achieve this step.
It’s truly worthy of being a Royal Secret Skill.

One can almost imagine that if he could obtain other secret manuals and cultivation techniques from the Royal Armory, Ding Ling would surely progress by leaps and bounds, becoming the world’s number one might not be impossible.
Swoosh!
After learning this posture skill, in terms of foundation, Ding Ling was already indestructible and extremely solid!
He raised his head to look at the sky, bent slightly, posing like the Wolf King howling at the moon.
With each breath, an awe-inspiring Evil Qi emerged.
This was the external manifestation of the Howling Moon Posture entering the Transformation Realm.
Shi A and the others clearly understood.
They couldn’t help but look at each other, then felt relieved.
After all, it was Ding Ling!
He could learn any martial skill in an instant, so the foundational posture skill of the Royal Secret Skill was naturally not a challenge.
Swoosh!
Ding Ling finished and stood up.
He glanced at the character panel:
Strength changes:

[Bone structure 1 (ordinary human is 1 point), Wisdom 2, Strength 21.5+0.2+0.4+0.4=(22.5), Agility 20.2+0.3+0.6+0.6 (21.7), Constitution 20.2+0.2+0.4+0.4 (21.2), Defense 13.3+0.3+0.5+0.7+0.5+0.3+0.4 (16), Charisma 3+1 (4)]
Weapon changes:
[A set of General Armor, an eighty-pound Heaven-piercing Halberd, a forty-six-pound Shuoyue Sword, a Five-Stone Bow...]
Skill changes:

[High-tier Swordsmanship (Level 10), Double Flower Swordsmanship (Level 10), Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship (Level 10), Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship (Level 10), Dawn Swordsmanship (Level 10), Sunset Swordsmanship (Level 10), Sword God Breathing Technique (Level 10), Gale Spear Technique (Level 10), Howling Moon Posture (Level 10), Wang Family Fist Skill (Level 10)...]
This was the transformation from spending half a day learning at the Prince’s Mansion.
It must be said.
Cheating was definitely more enjoyable and faster.
Much faster than consuming Great Medicine.
At least it seems to be the case for now.
"You’ve learned all my martial arts."
Wang Yue looked at Ding Ling with a very subtle gaze, one filled with surprise, praise, admiration, and even a little shame... extremely complex!
"Now I have nothing more to teach you. Stay as you wish or leave. But I must advise you all a few words."
He paused and said:
"Luoyang City has been extremely chaotic recently. Various forces have disturbed this pond to such murkiness, an ordinary person falling in wouldn’t make even a splash. In my own sight.
The Thief Dong staying in the Imperial Palace and desecrating countless concubines is an undeniable fact."
Ding Ling turned sideways.
Wang Yue actually went spying!!
"Don’t look at me like that."
Wang Yue’s old face slightly blushed:
"It was because the Thief Dong’s voice was too loud, I heard it by chance while exploring the Imperial Palace."
"And what about Lü Bu?"
"We ran into each other accidentally."
Wang Yue gave a dry cough, seemingly unwilling to elaborate on this matter, quickly turned the topic, and said:

chapters.title: Chapter 85: The Legend of Zuo Ci
paragraphs: "The great army of Thief Dong slaughters the common people, decapitating them to make military merit, causing public outrage to boil over. Yet this individual, Thief Dong, still cares only for his own carefree enjoyment."
Wang Yue shook his head and sighed:
"I don’t even know how long this Royal City can hold out? Whether my Prince’s Mansion can sustain, I reckon, is also questionable."
Ding Ling initially wanted to say it was not unexpected; it was probably only a matter of time before Dong Zhuo set Luoyang ablaze.
By then, not to mention the Prince’s Mansion, even the Imperial Palace would be destroyed in an instant.
"Although I despise Thief Dong, his power is indeed extremely large, deeply rooted in Luoyang, with many followers; ordinary people simply cannot bring him down!"
Hearing this, Zhao Yun seemed to think of something and couldn’t help but ask:
"Then who in the world will be the hero to ease the hardship and relieve the plight of the people?"
"I don’t know either."
Wang Yue felt ashamed but soon looked at the three people including Ding Ling:

"However, you all might be the hope. Especially you, Ding Ling. If you really become the world’s number one war general, galloping across battlefields, unmatched, perhaps it would have a positive and proactive effect on the entire world. The premise is that you don’t aid the tyranny! Don’t help Thief Dong!"
Ding Ling nodded.
Dong Zhuo’s days are numbered, known for his violent and bloodthirsty nature.
How could Ding Ling possibly assist him at this time?
He wouldn’t even align with Yuan Shao, and he would align with Dong Zhuo?!
Especially after Wang Yue mentioned Thief Dong actually eats people.
Ding Ling couldn’t help but feel his scalp tingle!
This is simply a beast! Actually eating people!
But then he thought about how Cao Mengde had once committed massacres and used human flesh as military rations.
Ding Ling couldn’t help but feel a bit uncomfortable in his heart.
He was pondering whether leading Zhao Yun and the others to join Cao Mengde was right or wrong.
But thinking about it now, Cao Mengde seemingly hadn’t done those things, Ding Ling felt somewhat relieved.
A person must have a bottom line.
Otherwise, what right do they have to still be called human?
Dong Zhuo already has no bottom line to speak of.
One horrifying, unfathomable act after another flowed from Wang Yue’s mouth.
Ding Ling listened, tongue-tied.
This Dong Zhuo really committed every evil deed, confusing deed, outrageous deed. Yet as a man, he indeed enjoyed the ’happiness’ that no one could imagine.
However, Zhao Yun listened and was filled with rage, gritting his teeth.
"...That’s how things are."
Wang Yue narrated everything he knew about the secret affairs of Luoyang.
It was apparent.
Wang Yue hadn’t been idle during this time.
His occasional stealth trips into the Imperial Palace were evidence!
Ding Ling thus seized the opportunity to ask:
"Is there a chance I can reclaim the Supreme Skills that were divided up from the Imperial Palace? Or take them back?"
"Difficult, difficult, difficult!"
Wang Yue said the word ’difficult’ three times:

"Although there are many secret manuals in the Imperial Palace, most of Thief Dong’s generals are crude. After dividing them, they find it difficult to learn, and some might have directly discarded or burned them. You know, human nature is selfish; what they can’t obtain, they also don’t want others to get.
Moreover.
Most of the secret manuals in the Imperial Palace are passed on orally.
The recorded parts are mostly basic martial arts; even if the true Supreme Skills are documented, most are surely fragmented pieces. Who can learn them?
So I estimate these Supreme Skills are probably all destroyed now.
Unless you find the person who knows these martial arts, otherwise, I fear the Han Dynasty’s Royal Secret Skills are to be lost forever."
Ding Ling felt greatly regretful but pondered whether he should go looking at the residences of Thief Dong’s generals.
This Royal Secret Manual might contain the complete top-notch martial arts?
Even if they were fragmentary pieces, it wouldn’t matter!
His library cheat could instantly max out martial arts routines from reality.
Even fragmentary moves could be instantly maxed out.
How could fragmentary pieces not be maxed out?
As long as he could obtain them, it would result in significant advancement!
The more Ding Ling thought, the more eager he became.
He forgot to employ his full-level acting skill.
So Wang Yue immediately saw through his thoughts and urgently advised:
"Stay calm, Ding Ling! The opponent has strength in numbers; even if you are a super-elite fierce general, you can’t withstand a pack of wolves. Here’s the thing."
Wang Yue thought for a moment:
"I know a place suitable for you to learn martial arts."
"Oh?"
Ding Ling was delighted, looking askance.
Wang Yue was silent, but he could see Ding Ling’s fanatic enthusiasm for martial arts, and stroked his beard, saying:
"I know a Daoist priest skilled in Inner Breathing Techniques and crafting talismans. If you find and persuade him to teach you Inner Breathing Techniques. Unity of inner and outer.
Your skill progress would surely advance by leaps and bounds."
Ding Ling asked:
"I wonder who this Daoist priest is."
"His name is Yhiuu Ji."
"Yhiuu Ji?"
Ding Ling remembered.
Yhiuu Ji, one of the representative figures of Huang-Lao Dao in the late Eastern Han Dynasty, later killed by Sunx Ce.
Now Yhiuu Ji should still be alive.
After all, Dong Zhuo is still around.
"Indeed."
Wang Yue said:

"He is currently in Yangzhou. During my middle age, I challenged masters around the world, and I met him once. Back then, he had already entered the Dao. This person is indifferent by nature, his sole hobby is cultivating Dao and crafting talismans, and he has a rather thin skin.
If someone goes to him for help.
He would use talisman water to treat them.
Over time, countless people sought him for healing.
Finding his whereabouts isn’t difficult.
Once in the earth realm of Yangzhou, just ask a local elder, and you’ll know."
"What if he ignores me?"
Ding Ling hesitated.
"That’s why you need to persuade him."
Wang Yue felt helpless:
"In my youth and middle age, I was full of vigor, looked down on everyone, so my relationship with Yhiuu Ji isn’t good. If you mention my name, he might ignore you even more."
Ding Ling was speechless.
It seems futile to think of learning martial arts through recommendations again.
If there were acquaintances to introduce.
That would be too convenient.
Ding Ling had witnessed the power of this method.
From Gao Lan and Zhang Hex, to Pan Feng, Tong Yuan, and then Wang Yue.
Without someone pulling strings, Ding Ling would never have succeeded so smoothly.

"If you manage to persuade Yhiuu Ji to teach you the Inner Refining Breathing Technique and all his skills, talisman techniques. Perhaps you might even meet the elusive Daoist Zuo Ci, the see-the-head-but-not-the-tail Divine Dragon."
"Zuo Ci?"
Zuo Ci, styled Yuanfang, self-titled Mr. Wujiao, a famous alchemist of the late Eastern Han Dynasty!
Skilled in Alchemy Skill, fluent in the Five Classics, understanding of star astrology, proficient in the Six Jia...
Ding Ling’s mind quickly flashed with information about Zuo Ci.
Compared to Yhiuu Ji.
Zuo Ci’s mythical tales were even more abundant!
It wouldn’t be an exaggeration to call him an Earth Immortal!
To think there indeed is such a divine being in this world.
"Correct."
Wang Yue said with some admiration:

"Compared to the External Refining Breathing Technique of martial arts, the Inner Refining Breathing Technique of Divine Dao is also extremely marvelous! And Zuo Ci is rumored to have reached a god-like understanding with his Inner Refining Breathing Technique, truly unfathomable.
Although in martial arts competition.
I consider myself superior to Zuo Ci.
But in the mysterious, unpredictable Daoist Technique, he surpasses me greatly.
Only to say Inner Refining Breathing Technique, External Refining Breathing Technique, each has its miraculous aspects.
If you could truly master Zuo Ci’s Inner Refining Breathing Technique.
Unity of inner and outer.
Invincible under heaven is definitely not an illusion!"

sentences.text: "The great army of Thief Dong slaughters the common people, decapitating them to make military merit, causing public outrage to boil over.
Yet this individual, Thief Dong, still cares only for his own carefree enjoyment."
Wang Yue shook his head and sighed:
"I don’t even know how long this Royal City can hold out?
Whether my Prince’s Mansion can sustain, I reckon, is also questionable."
Ding Ling initially wanted to say it was not unexpected; it was probably only a matter of time before Dong Zhuo set Luoyang ablaze.
By then, not to mention the Prince’s Mansion, even the Imperial Palace would be destroyed in an instant.
"Although I despise Thief Dong, his power is indeed extremely large, deeply rooted in Luoyang, with many followers; ordinary people simply cannot bring him down!"
Hearing this, Zhao Yun seemed to think of something and couldn’t help but ask:
"Then who in the world will be the hero to ease the hardship and relieve the plight of the people?"
"I don’t know either."
Wang Yue felt ashamed but soon looked at the three people including Ding Ling:
"However, you all might be the hope.
Especially you, Ding Ling.
If you really become the world’s number one war general, galloping across battlefields, unmatched, perhaps it would have a positive and proactive effect on the entire world.
The premise is that you don’t aid the tyranny!
Don’t help Thief Dong!"
Ding Ling nodded.
Dong Zhuo’s days are numbered, known for his violent and bloodthirsty nature.
How could Ding Ling possibly assist him at this time?
He wouldn’t even align with Yuan Shao, and he would align with Dong Zhuo?!
Especially after Wang Yue mentioned Thief Dong actually eats people.
Ding Ling couldn’t help but feel his scalp tingle!
This is simply a beast!
Actually eating people!
But then he thought about how Cao Mengde had once committed massacres and used human flesh as military rations.
Ding Ling couldn’t help but feel a bit uncomfortable in his heart.
He was pondering whether leading Zhao Yun and the others to join Cao Mengde was right or wrong.
But thinking about it now, Cao Mengde seemingly hadn’t done those things, Ding Ling felt somewhat relieved.
A person must have a bottom line.
Otherwise, what right do they have to still be called human?
Dong Zhuo already has no bottom line to speak of.
One horrifying, unfathomable act after another flowed from Wang Yue’s mouth.
Ding Ling listened, tongue-tied.
This Dong Zhuo really committed every evil deed, confusing deed, outrageous deed.
Yet as a man, he indeed enjoyed the ’happiness’ that no one could imagine.
However, Zhao Yun listened and was filled with rage, gritting his teeth.
"...That’s how things are."
Wang Yue narrated everything he knew about the secret affairs of Luoyang.
It was apparent.
Wang Yue hadn’t been idle during this time.
His occasional stealth trips into the Imperial Palace were evidence!
Ding Ling thus seized the opportunity to ask:
"Is there a chance I can reclaim the Supreme Skills that were divided up from the Imperial Palace?
Or take them back?"
"Difficult, difficult, difficult!"
Wang Yue said the word ’difficult’ three times:
"Although there are many secret manuals in the Imperial Palace, most of Thief Dong’s generals are crude.
After dividing them, they find it difficult to learn, and some might have directly discarded or burned them.
You know, human nature is selfish; what they can’t obtain, they also don’t want others to get.
Moreover.
Most of the secret manuals in the Imperial Palace are passed on orally.
The recorded parts are mostly basic martial arts; even if the true Supreme Skills are documented, most are surely fragmented pieces.
Who can learn them?
So I estimate these Supreme Skills are probably all destroyed now.
Unless you find the person who knows these martial arts, otherwise, I fear the Han Dynasty’s Royal Secret Skills are to be lost forever."
Ding Ling felt greatly regretful but pondered whether he should go looking at the residences of Thief Dong’s generals.
This Royal Secret Manual might contain the complete top-notch martial arts?
Even if they were fragmentary pieces, it wouldn’t matter!
His library cheat could instantly max out martial arts routines from reality.
Even fragmentary moves could be instantly maxed out.
How could fragmentary pieces not be maxed out?
As long as he could obtain them, it would result in significant advancement!
The more Ding Ling thought, the more eager he became.
He forgot to employ his full-level acting skill.

"Stay calm, Ding Ling!
The opponent has strength in numbers; even if you are a super-elite fierce general, you can’t withstand a pack of wolves.
Here’s the thing."

"I know a place suitable for you to learn martial arts."
"Oh?"

chapters.title: Chapter 86: Chaos Within a Chaotic World
paragraphs: Ding Ling was completely captivated.
Zhao Yun and Shi A were no exception.
But Wang Yue’s subsequent words seemed like a cold shower to Zhao Yun and Shi A:
"Although the Inner and Outer Refining Breathing Method might have the possibility of successful integration,
it only increases the probability of success a little more compared to practicing two External Refining Breathing Techniques simultaneously.
No one has ever succeeded in practicing two External Refining Breathing Techniques simultaneously.
However, some have succeeded with one internal and one external.
But the successful ones are extremely rare.
Therefore, unless absolutely necessary, or unless someone has truly extraordinary talent, never attempt to practice two Breathing Techniques, because it is too dangerous!"
Zhao Yun and Shi A were disheartened.
Ding Ling activated his full-level acting skill, displaying a confident demeanor.
Wang Yue fell silent, but considering Ding Ling’s talent, he didn’t say much more:
"Perhaps after mastering one internal and one external technique, Ding Ling, you might break through the Celestial Human threshold."
Upon hearing this, Ding Ling realized.
Previously, Wang Yue’s words had veered off course. Now, they finally returned to the main topic.
He quickly inquired about the matter of Celestial Humans.
Wang Yue said:

"After Super-Elite Fierce General comes the Celestial Human Realm. Breaking through to the Celestial Human Realm will grant you extraordinary powers and skills! At that point, jumping dozens to hundreds of feet in the air, leaping tens of feet high, will likely be commonplace."
Ding Ling pondered.
Is this not the legendary Martial Arts expert?
Can someone in the Three Kingdoms World cultivate to be comparable to a Martial Arts expert?
That’s truly extraordinary.
You must understand that the External Refining Breathing Technique of the Three Kingdoms World tempers the skin, membranes, meridians, etc., while internal organs are merely incidental.
In terms of combat power and defense.
Super-Elite Fierce Generals are absolutely powerful!
It’s just unknown whether they can defeat First-class Experts or Innate Experts from the Martial World?
Ding Ling was uncertain.
After all, the Three Kingdoms World is ’mutated.’
Who knows what changes might occur in the Martial World.
Currently, his primary goal:
Is to become the world’s number one expert in the Three Kingdoms World!
Other matters can wait for later.
"I will set off for Yangzhou tomorrow."
Ding Ling was decisive.
Not wanting to waste time.
He turned to Zhao Yun:
"Zhao Yun, you can stay here to learn Sword Technique."
"No."
Zhao Yun was even more decisive than Ding Ling:
"I’ll follow you. After all, you’ve mastered all the Sword Techniques. You can teach me on the road."
Ding Ling nodded, no longer persuading.
Zhao Yun’s personality is steadfast, once he decides, he is usually difficult to persuade otherwise.
Shi A looked at Zhao Yun and Ding Ling with envy.
He also wished to venture ’into the world’ alone!
Unfortunately, his skills were inadequate.
Not to mention Ding Ling, even compared to Zhao Yun, he was utterly outmatched in almost every aspect.
This made Shi A somewhat dispirited.
Wang Yue noticed the mood of the three and first comforted Shi A, advising him not to belittle himself, then suggested Ding Ling and Zhao Yun stay here for two more days, explaining the reason:

"In the next two days, the winds of change will blow through Luoyang City, and major events will occur. The city gates permit entry but not exit. If you try to leave now, you’ll only be extorted or scammed, unable to get out, unless you’re willing to cause a scene. But in that case, it will be challenging to escape the Si Li Territory."
"Hmm?!"
Ding Ling was surprised.
"How could such a thing happen? Isn’t this chaos?"
"Thief Dong has always been causing trouble. When the upper beam is not straight, the lower beam is crooked. The lower parts are also highly chaotic!"
"But I clearly remember, without bribery, the guards at the city gate won’t let you in. Moreover, there aren’t crowds gathered at the city gate wanting to leave."
Zhao Yun was puzzled.
"That’s just appearances."
Wang Yue seemed to remember something, saying sadly:

"Anyone entering Luoyang City, if they haven’t found a place to stay by nightfall, will very likely be caught, oppressed, or directly beheaded for credit by those rogue soldiers! As far as Thief Dong’s army is concerned.
These people entering Luoyang City are all walking silver and merit!
Once in, don’t even think about getting out!"
Zhao Yun heard this, furious.
Ding Ling was astonished, realizing it’s even more chaotic than imagined.
It seems that with the addition of player groups, this chaos has further escalated.
I wonder if Cao Mengde is also in the city?
If players snitch, trying to curry favor with Dong Zhuo.
Wouldn’t Cao Mengde be finished instantly?
Ding Ling was thoughtful, feeling a bad premonition, but also thinking it might not be that bad.
After all, compared to the experts of the Three Kingdoms World, the players are far too weak.
It’s fair to say.
If a Super-Elite Expert were to kill players, it would truly be one person easily slaughtering one army after another.
Provided these armies haven’t formed.
However, although the players are weak and mostly not united, they know the Three Kingdoms plot, and Ding Ling doesn’t doubt their ability to cause trouble.
"You all stay properly in the Prince’s Mansion. Here, you are absolutely safe in the short term. Those rogue soldiers wouldn’t dare to come here to stir up trouble."
Wang Yue said this.
Ding Ling could only agree.
"And you mustn’t entertain any ideas about the Royal Armory anymore; it’s too dangerous."
Wang Yue warned repeatedly.
Ding Ling reluctantly nodded, abandoning that emerging thought in his mind.
Wang Yue’s advice was reasonable.
In these troubled times, one careless mistake might lead to ruin, even though Ding Ling is a Super-Elite Expert, facing attacks from Lü Bu and others, his probability of dying is quite high.
Moreover, if he dies, the losses would be substantial.
Losing levels and items would be secondary.
The main concern is Ding Ling fearing other repercussions, because this Game World is too magical, NPCs are hardly different from True Persons.
Ding Ling has every reason to suspect this Game World might be a real world.
Therefore, unless absolutely necessary.
Ding Ling definitely won’t do anything suicidal.
Unless facing an absolute crisis, then he can only resolve to fight back desperately.
A day passed.
Whether it’s Wang Yue or Shi A.
They treated Ding Ling with great enthusiasm and attentiveness.
The usually reticent Shi A, in Ding Ling’s presence, rarely spoke a few more words, showing a difference in attitude from before.
The facts prove.
Only the strong are respected!
As for Zhao Yun?
He’s been diligently practicing Sword Technique.
It’s undeniable, Zhao Yun’s talent is extremely strong! His talent in Sword Technique is in no way inferior to Spear Technique! In some respects, it exceeds it!
Wang Yue has praised him numerous times.
If it weren’t for Ding Ling, the prodigy ahead, Zhao Yun would certainly shine with unrivaled brilliance!
Unfortunately, even such a peerless genius as Zhao Yun gets utterly outmatched by Ding Ling.
He can only grit his teeth and arduously practice Sword Technique, his diligence unquestionable.
In Zhao Yun’s words:
"If I can’t match Ding Ling in talent, then I’ll surpass him in diligence!"
This statement motivated Shi A as if he were injected with adrenaline, starting to train Sword Skills as well.
Ding Ling was bored.
Reading in Wang Yue’s study.
Unexpectedly, he came across some ancient chess manuals and music scores.
Then...
The chess manuals and music scores instantly reached full level.
Enhancing Ding Ling’s chess and musical skills further.

chapters.title: Chapter 87: Identity Exposed
paragraphs: Aside from chess and music manuals, there were other ancient books as well.
But most of them described the general overview of the world.
There were even many history books that Ding Ling found here.
These were not very helpful for Ding Ling’s skill improvement.
He wasn’t interested in reading them.
After flipping through, and going through all the books in the study,
Ding Ling took the gold and wanted to go out to buy some great medicine.
Wang Yue stopped him, saying:
"If Luoyang had great medicine, it would have been taken by Dong Zhuo, Lü Bu, Guo Si, Li Jue and others long ago. How could it be our turn?"
Thinking about the great medicine snatched from the slain Hu Zhen, Ding Ling immediately gave up the idea of buying it.
Rather than buying.
Why not rob?
Robbing the Thief Dong army’s great medicine would be acting for the people and removing a public calamity!
Wang Yue said the same, he certainly agreed to rob but absolutely did not agree to do it in Luoyang, because once you rob in Luoyang, you become a turtle in a jar, with no place to escape.

"I am not a stubborn traditionalist decaying with age. In such tumultuous times, speaking of the Three Principles and Five Constants and etiquette with some great thieves who steal from the heavens is futile. Only with fists and weapons can they be awakened!"
Wang Yue patted Ding Ling’s shoulder, saying:
"Wait a few days. I know someone. By then, we can bribe him to send you out at night. Once you are out of Luoyang City, you will be safe."
He smiled slightly:

"If you take the opportunity to go straight to Yangzhou and find Yhiuu Ji or Zuo Ci, learn their Inner Refining Breathing Technique and achieve Unity of Inner and Outer, there will be an earth-shaking transformation.
I am eagerly anticipating your metamorphosis!
After defeating all challengers under the heavens, I once met some truly reclusive masters in the mountains. Unfortunately,
I was not their match at that time.
Just like Pan Feng, the first in Jizhou at the moment. He is also not a match for Tong Yuan and me.
And he certainly couldn’t kill such reclusive masters like Zuo Ci!
Most true masters reside deep in the remote mountains, cultivating in seclusion!"
He paused for a moment:
"But if you achieve Unity of Inner and Outer, perhaps one day, even those reclusive masters won’t be your match."
"What about those reclusive masters you’ve encountered, senior?"
"Most of them are probably dead of old age."
Wang Yue sighed:
"No matter how formidable a person is, they are difficult to withstand the erosion of time’s torrent!"
He touched his graying temples:
"I am old too."
After lamenting, he laughed:
"Alright, let’s not speak of this. I’ll go seek out that general for you and make preparations for your early departure from the city."
"Thank you, senior."
Ding Ling expressed his gratitude and saluted.
"Let’s skip the formalities."
Wang Yue waved it off, laughed heartily, and strode away.
Ding Ling thus extinguished the idea of going out.
He prepared to quietly wait for good news.
Then leave Luoyang City and head straight to Yangzhou to seek his opportunities, learning the Inner Refining Breathing Technique.
He is on the Path of the War God.
So striving to improve himself is definitely right.
However, Ding Ling’s plans were good.
But many times, some things often don’t shift according to one’s will.
As he was holding the Shuoyue Sword, ready to practice his Sword Technique in the martial arts arena, thud, thud, thud!
The sound of knocking suddenly echoed.
He glanced at Shi A and Zhao Yun nearby.
These two, besides eating, were practicing swordplay.
Zhao Yun was naturally gifted, and with Ding Ling’s provocation, plus occasional guidance from Ding Ling and Wang Yue, his progress in High-tier Swordsmanship was astonishing.
High-tier Swordsmanship is just foundational, not difficult. For a genius like Zhao Yun, making rapid progress surpassing ordinary people is understandable.
But this also greatly stimulated Shi A, causing Shi A to also practice swordplay frantically.
At this moment, seeing Ding Ling looking over, Shi A, though puzzled, still sheathed his sword, saying:
"I’ll open the door."
"No."
Ding Ling gestured:
"You continue practicing swordplay. I’ll open it."
Coming to Luoyang City.
Having learned all the Kung Fu from Wang Yue,
Ding Ling, out of boredom, initially thought of seeing Diao Chan and Cai Wenji, these two beauties.
After all, these two are renowned throughout history, any man would want to see what kind of charm and elegance they have to captivate countless men.
But Wang Yue’s words dispelled his thoughts.
He now only wanted to discreetly leave the city, then discreetly unite Inner and Outer Breathing Techniques!
To become a true peerless master.
And then, upon reemerging, sweep across the lands and achieve the name of War God!
This is the cautious strategy preferred by those who choose a safe battle method!
Though Ding Ling is a passionate young man, his essence is very steady!
If a risk is too great, exceeding tolerable levels, he generally chooses to temporarily retreat, waiting until he becomes stronger in the future.
Once stronger, no demons or monsters will stand a chance.
Might makes right (Power generates truth).
This is reality!
Of course, if taking a risk can yield unparalleled benefits, he would also choose to take the risk.
But undoubtedly, what benefit could come from looking at beauties? It’s not worth it.
Ding Ling even gave up going to the residences of generals under Dong Zhuo to ’seek secret manuals’, giving up looking at beauties, naturally is understandable.
At this moment, hearing the knock on the door.
Ding Ling really had nothing else to do, and having been looked after by Shi A for the past couple of days, felt a bit guilty, so he let Shi A continue practicing swordplay.
He then strode towards the front door.
At this moment, all three of them were in the outer sect’s practice yard, not far from the front door.
Soon, Ding Ling reached the front door, creak!
The arm exerted force, pulling open the heavy door.
After opening the door.
Ding Ling saw a man over eight feet tall, full of whiskers, with eyes filled with violent greed.
He looked Ding Ling up and down for a few moments, then suddenly asked:
"Are you Ding Ling?"
Ding Ling was puzzled,
"May I ask who you are?"
"So, your friend Zhao Yun is here as well?"
Ding Ling instinctively sensed trouble.
"So it is you two."
The man shouted loudly, taking a step back.
In the next instant.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
Hundreds of elite archers appeared before the door, each drawing bows and aiming at Ding Ling.
The man stood behind the archers, a slight smirk on his lips, laughing:

"There is a road to heaven yet you do not take it; there is no entrance to hell yet you rush in! Very well. Ding Ling, I now give you two choices: be shot dead by me here, or obediently come with me."
"Who exactly are you?"
Ding Ling’s face turned somber, tightly gripping the Shuoyue Sword in his hand, he shouted:
"I bear no grudge against you, nor do I even know you. You intrude into private property out of the blue and mean to kill me—aren’t you going too far! This is Luoyang City! The Emperor’s realm!"
The voice thundered.
Awakening Zhao Yun and Shi A from the training ground.
Both drew their swords, rushing over, seeing Ding Ling’s back towards them, using his right hand to make several gestures behind him.
Zhao Yun comprehended, immediately turning to grab weapons.
Shi A quickly rushed towards Ding Ling, sword in hand.
"Hahaha..."
The man laughed, seemingly disdainful, mocking, and dismissive:

sentences.text: Aside from chess and music manuals, there were other ancient books as well.
But most of them described the general overview of the world.
There were even many history books that Ding Ling found here.
These were not very helpful for Ding Ling’s skill improvement.
He wasn’t interested in reading them.
After flipping through, and going through all the books in the study,
Ding Ling took the gold and wanted to go out to buy some great medicine.
Wang Yue stopped him, saying:
"If Luoyang had great medicine, it would have been taken by Dong Zhuo, Lü Bu, Guo Si, Li Jue and others long ago.
How could it be our turn?"
Thinking about the great medicine snatched from the slain Hu Zhen, Ding Ling immediately gave up the idea of buying it.
Rather than buying.
Why not rob?
Robbing the Thief Dong army’s great medicine would be acting for the people and removing a public calamity!
Wang Yue said the same, he certainly agreed to rob but absolutely did not agree to do it in Luoyang, because once you rob in Luoyang, you become a turtle in a jar, with no place to escape.
"I am not a stubborn traditionalist decaying with age.
In such tumultuous times, speaking of the Three Principles and Five Constants and etiquette with some great thieves who steal from the heavens is futile.
Only with fists and weapons can they be awakened!"
Wang Yue patted Ding Ling’s shoulder, saying:
"Wait a few days.
I know someone.
By then, we can bribe him to send you out at night.
Once you are out of Luoyang City, you will be safe."
He smiled slightly:

"If you take the opportunity to go straight to Yangzhou and find Yhiuu Ji or Zuo Ci, learn their Inner Refining Breathing Technique and achieve Unity of Inner and Outer, there will be an earth-shaking transformation.
I am eagerly anticipating your metamorphosis!
After defeating all challengers under the heavens, I once met some truly reclusive masters in the mountains.
Unfortunately,
I was not their match at that time.
Just like Pan Feng, the first in Jizhou at the moment.
He is also not a match for Tong Yuan and me.
And he certainly couldn’t kill such reclusive masters like Zuo Ci!
Most true masters reside deep in the remote mountains, cultivating in seclusion!"
He paused for a moment:
"But if you achieve Unity of Inner and Outer, perhaps one day, even those reclusive masters won’t be your match."
"What about those reclusive masters you’ve encountered, senior?"
"Most of them are probably dead of old age."
Wang Yue sighed:
"No matter how formidable a person is, they are difficult to withstand the erosion of time’s torrent!"
He touched his graying temples:
"I am old too."
After lamenting, he laughed:
"Alright, let’s not speak of this.
I’ll go seek out that general for you and make preparations for your early departure from the city."
"Thank you, senior."
Ding Ling expressed his gratitude and saluted.
"Let’s skip the formalities."
Wang Yue waved it off, laughed heartily, and strode away.
Ding Ling thus extinguished the idea of going out.
He prepared to quietly wait for good news.
Then leave Luoyang City and head straight to Yangzhou to seek his opportunities, learning the Inner Refining Breathing Technique.
He is on the Path of the War God.
So striving to improve himself is definitely right.
However, Ding Ling’s plans were good.
But many times, some things often don’t shift according to one’s will.
As he was holding the Shuoyue Sword, ready to practice his Sword Technique in the martial arts arena, thud, thud, thud!
The sound of knocking suddenly echoed.
He glanced at Shi A and Zhao Yun nearby.

chapters.title: Chapter 88: Sword God Skill Slays Three Hundred
paragraphs: "Precisely because this is Luoyang City. That’s why I dare to enforce the law like this. Because here, I am the law."
The man’s face dropped, and he said sinisterly:
"Since you refuse the toast and want the penalty drink instead, I have no choice but to send you to meet King Yama."
He waved his hand, pointed at Ding Ling, and ordered:
"Shoot him dead!"
Whoosh whoosh!
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!

A full three hundred elite archers had already drawn their bows and arrows. Hearing the command, they immediately released their strings, and amid the crisp sound of bowstrings snapping, arrows whistled through the air.
Arrows flew through the sky!
Weaving a curtain.
Like a torrent, they poured down towards Ding Ling’s position.
"Ah!"
Shi A, standing not far away, saw this and shouted:
"Watch out!"
"Hmph!"
Ding Ling snorted angrily, raised his eyebrows, and instantly activated the Sword God Breathing Technique, Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique, Wall-Climbing Technique, and Sunset Swordsmanship!
Clang!
The Shuoyue Sword unsheathed.
With the sword in hand, Ding Ling advanced, charging towards the man’s position instead of retreating.
Clang clang clang!
The Shuoyue Sword in his hand was like a swimming dragon in the sky, and like countless leaves blown by a wild wind, the air was filled with sword light and killing qi!
The Setting Sun Diagram occasionally flashed across the air, forming a dense sword curtain!
Like an impeccable sword net!
Enveloping Ding Ling so tightly that not even wind or water could penetrate!
Moving forward, it was clear to see arrows being deflected by the Shuoyue Sword.
Ding Ling was like a swift boat against the current;
More like a war god charging bravely on the battlefield!
One man and one sword, like a beam of light, he crossed dozens of meters of obstacles, landing in front of the archers, and then swung the Shuoyue Sword!
Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship!
Dawn Swordsmanship!
In an instant, the sword danced with countless blossoms!
The ground and sky were filled with brilliant sword flowers, everywhere were petals falling like rain!
Clang!
Clang clang clang!
After the rain of flowers, accompanied by rhythmic clanging sounds, thud thud!
Heads flew into the sky.
Accompanied by columns of blood shooting into the air!
Headless bodies fell to the ground powerlessly!
Ding Ling was like a death god, moving with the sword!
Wherever he went.
The ground was littered with remains.
A scene of devastation!
Clang clang clang!
Amidst the desperate screams, the sword light reverberated, suddenly retracting, and fell onto the man’s neck.
Ding Ling stared at him coldly:
"Who are you?"
The man trembled, fear-stricken, in disbelief, as if seeing the death god, eyes wide open.
Ding Ling’s figure reflected in his eyes.
Hearing Ding Ling’s words.
Cold sweat rolled down his forehead.
Never in his life had he seen such fierce and sharp prowess!
Not even Lü Bu’s efficiency in killing could compare!
Who is this man exactly?!
Is he really Ding Ling, a seventh-rank official from Jizhou?
How can a mere seventh-rank military officer be this absurdly strong?!
"Hmm?!"
Ding Ling slightly exerted force with his sword.
Puff!
A blood trace appeared, blood flowing out.
The man cried out in pain:
"Spare me. Don’t kill me! I’ll confess everything, everything!"
’Then speak.’
Ding Ling said coldly.
He sighed inwardly.
What a mess?
He intended to leave, yet this happened.
It seems waiting for Wang Yue is no longer possible.
He could only fight his way out.
He felt sorry, seemingly dragging Wang Yue and Shi A into this?
Shi A arrived at this moment, looking at Ding Ling as if seeing a monster.
The relentless sword light shooting into the sky just showed the terrifying power of the Sword God Skill for the first time, it was truly invincible, too strong!
Unfortunately...
He couldn’t do it!
How great it would be if he could!
One man killing three hundred archers, like cutting through vegetables, too fierce!
Shi A was excited, not afraid, instead feeling thrilled, stimulated!
He gripped his sword hilt, stepped to Ding Ling’s side, glanced at Ding Ling, then looked around, the battle’s commotion had already alerted the neighbors.
The scent of blood was strong.
Filling the surroundings.
They couldn’t stay long, otherwise more of Thief Dong’s men would surely come.
Shi A quickly whispered to remind Ding Ling.
Ding Ling, clear-headed, nodded to Shi A, indicating he understood.
He turned back to the man and said:
"Who are you?"
"Hu Feng."
"Hu Feng?"
Ding Ling frowned: "An unknown nobody. Never heard of!"
"I’m the nephew of General of Cavalry Li Jue!"
Hu Feng hastily said:
"Today’s Third-Grade Official Imperial Guard is me."
Upon hearing this from Hu Feng.
Ding Ling remembered.
Hu Feng, Li Jue’s nephew, was instructed by Li Jue to kill Right General Fan Chou of Dong Zhuo’s subordinates.
This is documented in books.
But now, because of player intervention, the Three Kingdoms plot collapsed, and Hu Feng’s situation was obviously different from before.
Ding Ling couldn’t care less about this, he cared about how Hu Feng knew he was here and why he wanted to kill him.
Hu Feng replied truthfully:
"It was Li Meng who told me."
Li Meng?
Ding Ling remembered this person.
He was a subordinate of Dong Zhuo in the late Eastern Han Dynasty. Later, he joined with Li Jue, Guo Si, and others to besiege Chang’an City.
A notable military general too.
"I don’t know Li Meng. How did he know I was here?"
"I don’t know."
Hu Feng froze, seeing Ding Ling’s murderous intent emerging, his heart trembled, and he hurriedly answered:
"I only heard from Li Meng that the two people fitting the image of defeating Hu Zhen’s great army’s top experts were likely Ding Ling and Zhao Yun!"
He didn’t dare look at Ding Ling, lowered his head slightly, and spoke quickly:

"I wasn’t sure if it was related to Zhao Yun. I just knew to capture first, speak later. If they didn’t comply, kill them, cut off the head and present it to my uncle, it would surely be a great merit."
He spoke weakly, nervously, uneasily:
"I was just looking for scapegoats. But accidentally offended a hero like you. Please do not be angry, as long as you let me go, this will have never happened."
"Scapegoats?"
Ding Ling sighed.
Feeling like saying: What a mistake you’ve stumbled into the ’culprit’! Truly fortunate!
Ding Ling guessed that his situation was definitely leaked by players to Li Meng’s men.
As for why players named the two of them.
It’s open to personal interpretation.

Perhaps out of jealousy towards Ding Ling, hoping for his death, regression. After all, Ding Ling was ahead of the players, they would feel unfair, being this far ahead, jealous to the point of madness, surely there are many hoping for Ding Ling’s fall!
It’s not Ding Ling judging others harshly.
But in the Great Thousand Worlds, there’s nothing too strange.
There are good people, bad people, naturally no shortage of extremely jealous sorts.
Indeed.
This is only one possibility.

It’s also possible players saw Ding Ling, Zhao Yun enter Luoyang City, thinking of currying favor with Dong Zhuo’s men, involved in what they believed was false news, to gain rank and title. Betting right, achieving great success, betting wrong, they’d simply disappear, who could find them?

chapters.title: Chapter 89: Farewell and Take Care
paragraphs: Or it’s just that players instinctively felt it was Ding Ling and Zhao Yun’s doing.
After all, considering the time, location, and Ding Ling and Zhao Yun’s route, the probability is quite high.
As Ding Ling and Zhao Yun went along, aside from perfectly covering up the killing of Hu Zhen’s Legion,
they generally didn’t conceal much in other areas.
It’s no wonder that players recognized them and deduced this information.
After all, players have forums and Player Plaza, where they can exchange and complement information.
It’s not surprising that most of the things Ding Ling did in the Three Kingdoms World could be gathered together.
There may be other reasons.
But regardless of which point,
Ding Ling felt a sense of frustration as if struck by lightning.
Whoever it is, being targeted like this is unbearable.
But Ding Ling wasn’t afraid.
If he truly found out who secretly leaked and schemed, he would kill them on sight every time!
Even if it kills him down to level 0, he would still continue to kill!
"Hero. Can you let me go?"
Hu Feng asked tremblingly, his voice shaking.
"Puff!"
What responded to Hu Feng was a swift sword from Ding Ling, puff!
One sword cut the throat, and blood spurted out!
"You, you, you..."
Hu Feng clutched his throat, his face full of disbelief and fear.
His eyes were filled with regret, remorse, and shock as well as a longing for life.
If he had known that this would be the result of coming here,
he wouldn’t have come even if he were beaten to death!
’Li Meng, I curse you to die early!’
Hu Feng fell with overwhelming hatred and regret.
He died without closing his eyes.
"You killed him?!"
Shi A was astounded.
"If not kill him, keep him for the New Year?"
Ding Ling retorted:
"You’ve offended him to death, do you really believe he would’ve let us go?"
"That’s true."
Shi A thought of something and quickly understood:

"These people burn, kill, loot, and do all evil; cutting off the people’s heads and counting them as military achievements is frequent! If he had been truly provoked, the consequences would be disastrous without exception."
He looked at Ding Ling with great admiration:

"Ding Ling, you truly act decisively and ruthlessly. I should learn from you. Such villains should be killed swiftly and neatly! I remember a master who entered the city recently also clashed with Thief Dong’s forces; in the end, the master subdued their general and, not wanting to cause trouble, let the general go.
Soon after, he was surrounded and killed by the general with a large crowd in tow. His head is rumored to still hang at the general’s mansion as a banner."
Ding Ling was about to say a few words upon hearing this.
At that moment.
"Ding Ling."
Zhao Yun came over with the horse.
Ding Ling’s horse was carrying weapons like the Heaven-piercing Halberd and Five-Stone Bow.
Ding Ling nodded towards Zhao Yun, jumped onto the horse, picked up the Heaven-piercing Halberd, and hung the scabbard of the Shuoyue Sword on his back.
The scabbard had straps that were convenient to carry once tied up.
One hand holding a sword, the other, the Heaven-piercing Halberd.
Under the impetus of Ding Ling’s two great Breathing Techniques, he looked extremely charismatic, resembling a noble Sword God!
The sharp aura around him was intimidating!
"Shi A, we have to leave. The mountains and rivers do not change, the green waters flow forever, we will meet again."
Ding Ling bowed towards Shi A:

"Convey my apologies to the seniors. If by chance I put you in danger because of this, you can go to Jizhou to find Pan Feng, mention my name, and they will provide you with a place to settle. In Jizhou Ye City, I also have a mansion."
Wang Yue is known as the Land Sword God.
He comes and goes freely in the Imperial Palace.
Ding Ling believed that if he wanted to take Shi A away, no one could stop him!
But taking one person is one thing.
Taking three at the same time is clearly impossible.
Ding Ling has now offended Dong Zhuo and Li Jue’s factions; he must immediately ride out of the city, seizing an advantage in time.
Otherwise, if surrounded in Luoyang City, it would be dangerous.
Killing hundreds of people is different from killing tens of thousands.
Moreover, those he killed before were mostly skilled at long-range, archers!
The real close-combat elites will definitely be more troublesome!
"No need for apologies."
Shi A said sternly:

"We are both disciples of the Sword Sect; we do not speak separately as a family. My master and I had long wanted to leave Luoyang. Just taking this opportunity to leave. You need not worry about us, but you must be cautious this time as you leave the city."
He paused and said:
"If necessary, I will come to support you."
"No need."
Ding Ling smiled slightly, his Full-level Acting activated, and with resolute spirit, he said:
"How can a mere Thief Dong possibly do anything to me? Farewell then."
Drive!
Both sides exchanged wishes of safety.
Ding Ling then spurred his horse wildly towards the southern gate.
His conversation with Shi A did not take much time.
Just as Zhao Yun finished bringing the horse, Ding Ling immediately mounted and left.
The few words exchanged took almost no time at all.
Clip-clop!
In the urgent sound of hoofbeats.
Ding Ling and Zhao Yun gradually faded into the distance.
Shi A watched their figures disappear around the distant corner, feeling a sense of loss.
Suddenly having two companions to practice swordsmanship with, just when it was getting exciting and thrilling, the two companions left.
Shi A’s feelings at this moment were extremely complex.
He glanced at the ground littered with corpses, thinking of the scenes he had just witnessed, his heart stirred with waves:
"Is this the Sword God Skill? I must learn it!"
Clip-clop!
The sound of more hoofbeats rang out.
Faintly, he could hear shouting and angry roars.

Shi A’s heart tightened, without hesitation he leapt into the Prince’s Mansion, shut the door tightly, swiftly packed up some things, and left through the back door, heading for the emergency contact location agreed upon with his master.
[Achievement Medal obtained: You intimidated the elite cavalry team of Guo Si’s camp]

[Note: Shortly after you left, Guo Si’s patrol team followed the scent of blood to the scene and witnessed the state of the three hundred archers. After investigating the cause and questioning the neighbors, they learned that you were the one who did it alone.
They were extremely shocked!
Both frightened and furious, they harbored a strong desire to kill you.
They are very likely to choose to surround and kill you rather than engage in a duel!]
A prompt sounded in his ears.
Spurring his horse, Ding Ling, who had activated the ’Geography’ Full-level Skill, dashed swiftly towards the southern gate of Luoyang following the map in his mind.
At this moment.
Ding Ling began to feel grateful for those times he absentmindedly glanced through some geography atlases.
He had previously looked through many chess manuals, music scores, etc., in Wang Yue’s study.
Along with a few geography atlases, books on cultural overviews, etc.
Most books he only skimmed through.
Luckily, he noticed that geography might be useful at that time and remembered it.
At this moment, it indeed proved to be extremely useful.
Wang Yue’s geography atlases, especially those concerning Luoyang, were recorded in great detail.
As Ding Ling had a full-level in Geography skills, Following the Map was not difficult.
Of course, without such skills, the old him would have been utterly lost.
The old him would’ve absolutely needed navigation whenever arriving in an unfamiliar city!
"Has Guo Si’s elite group already taken notice of me?"

they generally didn’t conceal much in other areas.
It’s no wonder that players recognized them and deduced this information.

It’s not surprising that most of the things Ding Ling did in the Three Kingdoms World could be gathered together.

he wouldn’t have come even if he were beaten to death!

chapters.title: Chapter 90: Prime Minister Dong’s Nephew
paragraphs: Ding Ling recalled the content of the notification, raised his eyebrows, and pressed the horse’s belly to advance.
Now he could only accelerate, hoping to clear the road to the South Gate and ride off before being surrounded and killed.
Once out of Luoyang City,
It would be like the sky being high for birds to fly, the sea vast for fish to leap!
Clop, clop!
The sound of hooves echoed on the street.
Ding Ling and Zhao Yun arrived at the bustling market crowded with people.
Seeing the crowded long street,
Ding Ling decisively chose to detour.
Clop, clop!
Zhao Yun silently followed behind Ding Ling with his spear.
"Weren’t those two just now Ding Ling and Zhao Yun?"
Some players at the market noticed the two men galloping swiftly, watched them rein in their horses at the market entrance, rear the horses, and quickly turn to leave.
The players exchanged glances and whispered:

"I saw on the forum that someone said Ding Ling and Zhao Yun came to Luoyang City, and I didn’t believe it. I didn’t expect to actually see them here. Judging by their hurried demeanor, could something major have happened?"

"Zhao Yun has distinct features, and Ding Ling is a recent influential figure, a frequent climber on the rankings! These two together are bound to cause a sensation and heated discussions. But we haven’t seen them these past two days. It’s likely they were stationed somewhere and didn’t come out."
Players speculated on where Ding Ling and Zhao Yun had been these days and what they had done. Could it really be, as the forums suggested, that they probably killed Hu Zhen’s troops?
Has something happened now?
Did they have a conflict with Dong Zhuo’s Legion?
Is that why they are in a hurry to escape?
No one knows the truth.
But some players, eager to know the truth, logged in and out quickly several times, finally figuring out what happened, which soon spread widely, causing everyone to be shocked and astonished.
For a while, discussions were rampant, with all sorts of opinions.
But it cannot be denied that Ding Ling’s powerful swordsmanship and combat ability still made many players skeptical, thinking it simply impossible!
After all, it’s too outrageous!
And because of the players’ heated discussions,
more and more natives in Luoyang City began to hear about this, and for a while, Ding Ling’s fame soared, his name spreading widely!
Regarding this matter,
Ding Ling was unaware.
Even if he knew, he wouldn’t care too much.
As he galloped, the sound of war drums gradually began to echo all around.
Zhao Yun understood, his face changed drastically, and he shouted:
"Ding Ling, this is Thief Dong’s legion gathering, intending to surround and kill us."
Ding Ling nodded, heading south all the way.
Detoured several times along the way.
Finally, on a wide street, Ding Ling inevitably encountered a ceremonial procession.
On the ceremonial procession was a large, bright character:
’Dong!’
"Who comes there!"
The ceremonial procession consisted of over two hundred people, each tall and strong, clad in armor, wielding swords and spears.
The leading Cavalry General was particularly arrogant, wielding a long spear, squinting at the incoming Ding Ling and Zhao Yun, and shouted:
"Dismount immediately, or be killed without mercy!"
Ding Ling and Zhao Yun ignored him.
Ding Ling was fine, with Wall-Climbing Technique and Sword God Skill protecting him, both on horseback and on foot, his combat power was astonishing.
However, Zhao Yun was a War General on horseback, and his combat power would greatly diminish if he dismounted.
Ding Ling naturally wouldn’t dismount to be captured; he tightly gripped the Heaven-piercing Halberd in his right hand and held the Shuoyue Sword in his left.
Because the saddle had been modified to a modern saddle, Ding Ling could stand upright on horseback.
Plus, with his ’Riding Skill’ at Full Level,
it meant wielding a halberd in one hand and a sharp sword in the other did not affect his riding but rather significantly increased his combat power.
Clop, clop!
Ding Ling quickly rushed to the Cavalry General’s proximity.
The Cavalry General was shocked and furious:
"It’s the first time I’ve encountered someone so arrogant in the presence of Prime Minister Dong’s nephew, Lord Imperial Attendant!"
His face was full of disbelief, then he flew into a rage:
"Shoot arrows! Kill them!"
Prime Minister Dong was certainly Dong Zhuo.
The nephew of Prime Minister Dong, also a person of the Imperial Attendant.
That could only be Dong Huang!
Various data on Dong Huang flashed quickly through Ding Ling’s mind; this was a figure with real power commanding the Imperial Guard.
Unexpectedly encountered here, truly unlucky.
Ding Ling frowned slightly, but having encountered them, there was no reason to retreat.
He subtly wielded the large halberd, perfectly demonstrating the spear technique of Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear with the halberd.

Although it was a halberd, under Ding Ling’s great strength, high sensitivity, and Perfect Level Mastery of Spear Technique, the Hundred Birds Paying Homage to the Phoenix pattern occasionally flashed in the void.
Clang, clang, clang!
The arrows were all blocked by the ’Hundred Birds Paying Homage to the Phoenix’ pattern.
Because the spear was at its fastest!
Condensed in the void into a pattern, not only could it block arrows like a shield, but it could also pierce the enemy’s viscera and head like a sharp blade.
In the Cavalry General’s incredulous eyes,
Ding Ling and Zhao Yun blocked the first wave of arrows completely unscathed,
quickly rushing to within less than thirty meters of Dong Huang’s ceremonial procession.
This close.
The Cavalry General and his men could even clearly sense the noble and sharp aura on Ding Ling, so lofty and unviewable, just approaching made them feel a chilling and hair-raising sensation.
"This is the aura of Breathing Technique Entering the Transformation Realm!"
The Cavalry General’s eyes widened, tongue-tied, and couldn’t help but shout:
"Who exactly are you? Is there some misunderstanding between us?"
He apparently also realized the prowess of Ding Ling and Zhao Yun, his voice quivering slightly.
But Ding Ling and Zhao Yun paid him no heed; instead, they accelerated their charge.
He was terrified and couldn’t help but shout desperately:
"Shield bearers, move forward immediately!"
"Quick knife hands, ready!"
"Long spears, ready!"
Thud, thud!
The hundreds of men were evidently a group with very high combat power.
They quickly formed several small squads.
The shield bearers were at the forefront, boom, boom, boom! The heavy shields were placed on the ground, quickly forming a ’Copper Wall and Iron Wall!’
Long spears were thrust out from the gaps between the shields, the spear tips hooked, flashing cold light!
The quick knife hands stood at the back, ready to assist at any moment.
Such a formation.
Could be said to be the nemesis of a small cavalry unit!
The long spears could trip the horse’s legs, kill the cavalry.
The shields could block the cavalry’s impact.
The lightly armored quick knife hands could spring up at any moment, swiftly cut through entanglements, and kill the fallen cavalry opponents!
It was evident.
The Cavalry General was an extremely experienced veteran, able to form a group quickly on the spur of the moment and confront Ding Ling and Zhao Yun, which was very rare.
But Ding Ling wasn’t frightened in the slightest by this.
Soon.
The two sides approached, Ding Ling thrust the halberd, hitting the long spears directly, and shouted explosively.
’Ha!’

The Breathing Technique operated with full force, more than two thousand pounds of massive strength poured into the halberd, as the halberd struck upwards with force, boom! Like a torrent impacting a dam, a surging, violent force burst forth instantly, astonishingly flipping several long spears away, and that was not all.
