chapters.title: Chapter 91: A Sword’s Radiance Shines Upon Jiuzhou
paragraphs: Ding Ling seized the moment and struck the shield with his halberd.
This blow gathered the final few ultimate techniques from the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques, reaching the pinnacle of force and magnitude,
resembling a mighty axe splitting mountains;
even more like a heavy hammer smashing the earth!
With a resounding crash, several shields were flung away.
The individuals behind the shields screamed in agony, knocked back by a tremendous force, flying helplessly, colliding with several spearmen before halting.
"Ha!"

Ding Ling broke through a gap in the shield formation, immediately charged in on horseback, wielding the Sword God Skill with his left hand, Dawn Swordsmanship, Sunset Swordsmanship unleashed their might, sword light dazzling, akin to the Sword God’s descent upon the world, one sword light shining coldly across Jiuzhou!

In his right hand, Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear, Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques occasionally flashed, all sorts of incredible ultimate skills executed with the grace of an antelope’s horns, utterly unmatched.
One sword, one halberd!
Resembling two meat grinders!
A bloody rain and fierce wind everywhere they passed!
No one could withstand a single clash against Ding Ling!
In just a few blinks, he had killed or wounded no less than dozens, storming like lightning to the Cavalry General’s front, slashing as the enemy stared in terror, liver torn.
Clang!
Setting Sun Diagram flashed through the void, with a puff!
The Cavalry General’s head was easily severed by the Shuoyue Sword, cutting through iron as if it were mud!
Crack!
The sword’s edge not only severed the head but continued on to cleave the proud ’Dong’ banner, cracking as the flag broke and fell to the ground.
Perhaps the sounds of killing outside startled the person inside the sedan.
He poked his head out to check, just in time to see the Cavalry General’s head being hacked off, the banner breaking.
He was shocked, shouting:
"I am Dong Huang, leader of the Imperial Guard! Prime Minister Dong’s nephew! Who are you?! How dare you kill my Imperial Guard General Wang Fang!"
Wang Fang was also a historically renowned figure.
Ding Ling didn’t expect the Cavalry General he casually killed to be Wang Fang, no wonder he possessed some courage and skill.
But since Wang Fang was already slain.
There was no need to spare Dong Huang.
Thinking of this, he raised his halberd and thrust it at Dong Huang.
Dong Huang had long been wary of Ding Ling, hurriedly shrinking his head back into the sedan, shouting:
"Men, men! There’s an assassin! Save me!"
"Protect the leader!"
The remaining fast knife and spear handlers were panicked, though very fearful of Ding Ling and Zhao Yun’s combat prowess, they still charged forward resolutely.
Ding Ling’s brow slightly furrowed, these warriors’ battlefield strength far exceeding ordinary elites, each nearly at the level of a Third-class General!
Even though still slightly away from Fully Third-class General level!
But without a doubt.
A group nearing Third-class General status, this force would certainly be terrifying. And Ding Ling could assert, such elite soldiers were definitely few.
If he slew these hundreds, it would definitely cause a major disruption.
Yet, having killed so many already.
Ding Ling decided to go on a rampage, shouting, one hand wielding Sword God Skill, the other Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear, charging the enemy force like a God of Death.
This time, these brave warriors lacked the guidance of a Cavalry General, fighting staggered, their effectiveness greatly reduced, no longer a solid unit.
Faced with Ding Ling’s mounted assault, they couldn’t withstand even a single clash!
Ding Ling’s Sword God Skill, Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear Technique reached Full Level standard, in terms of skill already at the world’s peak level!
Regarding power, agility, physique, all three reached Super-Elite standard!
His endurance was incredibly astonishing, not to mention, high agility, tremendous strength, moreover his defense was not low, ordinary minor injuries barely affecting his combat.
It was precisely the combination of various factors.
Enabling Ding Ling to slay enemies, like an autumn breeze sweeping fallen leaves.
Swinging the halberd, Shuoyue Sword, as if wielded by Ghost Gods, his ultimate skills killing enemies from unimaginable angles, speeds to their necks, foreheads, vital points.
Puff!
Puff!
One after another, warriors’ heads pierced through, collapsing in screams, growls.
Zhao Yun behind Ding Ling occasionally ’finishing moves’.
His spear was fast!
As Ding Ling’s rear guard, perfectly protecting Ding Ling’s rear, allowing him to charge undistracted in front.
The two charging side by side.
Within the squad of over two hundred, going back and forth through several times, piercing through their formation over and over.
In just a moment.
Killed all these fierce warriors, either stabbing, slashing, beaten to death.
Boom!
Ding Ling charged towards the sedan’s position, leapt from horseback, deploying Wall-Climbing Technique, Light Body Ascension, bounding to the coach’s front.
This coach was enormous!
Drawn by a full ten fine horses!
The carriage body was immense, like a finely adorned wooden house!
Ding Ling raised the coach’s curtain.
Whoosh!
An arrow suddenly shot forth, aiming straight at Ding Ling’s face.

Ding Ling’s Sword God Skill danced, clang! A Flowers in Bloom pattern briefly flashing before his eyes, slicing the arrow to pieces like a cutter, carrying a rush of Vigorous Qi directly surging into the cabin.
Accompanied by a cry of agony.
A corpse fell dead before Ding Ling.
Ding Ling gazed down slightly, revealing a coachman full of whiskers, clad in armor.
The coachman’s face etched with sword scars, glaring at Ding Ling in death agony.
Ding Ling glanced inside the cabin.
Dong Huang was cowering in a corner of the cabin.
On an exceptionally luxurious bed, several trembling young women lay.
Ding Ling frowned slightly, saying to them:
"You may go home."
The girls cast a fearful glance at Ding Ling, hurriedly donned their clothes, stumbled out of the cabin.
Dong Huang witnessing this, tremblingly attempted to flee as well.
Ding Ling promptly stabbed at him with his halberd, puff!
Right in Dong Huang’s thigh.
Nailed him to the bed.
He screamed:
"Hero! Spare me!"
Kneeling on the bed, snot and tears:
"I am willing to offer all beauties, gold to you, only begging you spare my life."
"Do you have Great Medicine on you?"
"Hm?"
Dong Huang froze, quickly nodding frantically, enduring the acute pain, pointing to a small cabinet:
"It’s in that cabinet."
Ding Ling withdrew his halberd.
Amid Dong Huang’s shrill cries, he thrust his halberd at the cabinet.
The cabinet door opened.
Inside were indeed various precious items.
There were gold pearls, gold forks, a small golden house, two exquisite boxes, a thin Secret Manual.
Ding Ling’s eyes gleamed slightly.
Waving his left hand sword, directly cutting down the car curtain, one sword lift, laying the curtain level before the cabinet.

Ding Ling’s halberd repeatedly prodded, gold pearls, boxes, Secret Manual fell upon the curtain. Ding Ling then inserted the halberd into the carriage, extending his right hand to wrap the items, tying a knot, slinging onto his back, securing.
Picking up the halberd again, he glanced at Dong Huang.
Dong Huang clutching his bleeding left leg wound, though clearly grimacing, upon meeting Ding Ling’s gaze, couldn’t help but forced a flattering smile:
"H-Hero, see, you’ve taken all my treasures already. Could you, could you spare me this time?"

This blow gathered the final few ultimate techniques from the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques, reaching the pinnacle of force and magnitude,
resembling a mighty axe splitting mountains;
even more like a heavy hammer smashing the earth!
With a resounding crash, several shields were flung away.
The individuals behind the shields screamed in agony, knocked back by a tremendous force, flying helplessly, colliding with several spearmen before halting.
"Ha!"

chapters.title: Chapter 93: Reishi Refined
paragraphs: Hu Zhen grew more fearful the more he thought about it, and dared not ponder further, so he obediently followed alongside.
On the way, a patrolling soldier saw Hu Zhen and was about to salute, but was intimidated by a glare from Hu Zhen and recoiled.
Zhao Yun warned:
"Don’t play tricks."
Hu Zhen grinned obsequiously:
"Absolutely not. Please rest assured, hero!"
He called Ding Ling a hero.
He called Zhao Yun a warrior.
Such different treatments.
This shows Hu Zhen’s shrewdness, and also his deep fear of Ding Ling.
Ding Ling obtained two exquisite boxes and a thin secret manual from the cabinet.
The secret manual contained the Howling Moon Spear Technique.
The boxes contained precisely the Great Medicine reishi.
Ding Ling didn’t know how many years the reishi had aged.
But he took a bite.
After circulating the Breathing Technique.
Whoosh!
A surge of heat flowed through his limbs, his whole body feeling warm and comfortable!
The warmth lasted for a good while.
Ding Ling glanced at the Character Panel:
[Strength +0.2]
[Defense +0.2]
Almost the same efficacy as the Great Medicine he previously obtained from Hu Zhen.
No doubt, it was an extremely precious Treasure Medicine.
Such a Treasure Medicine.
Hu Zhen carried it on him, showing his regard for it.
But unfortunately for him, it ended up benefiting Ding Ling.
Ding Ling finished it in a few bites.
[Strength +0.8]
[Defense +0.8]
He gained another 0.8 points in both strength and defense.
It’s just that the reishi was a bit small, otherwise the points would definitely have increased more than the ginseng.
Yet even so, the difference wasn’t much.
In terms of the surging potency, it was certainly not inferior to the previous ginseng Great Medicine!
Whoosh!
Ding Ling exhaled, and even his nose emitted two faint white mist streams.
This was the external manifestation of the Breathing Technique at its peak.
The two Breathing Techniques displayed their power simultaneously.
This greatly accelerated Ding Ling’s absorption and refinement of the reishi’s medicinal power! It took very little time!
For Ding Ling, this was nothing short of good news.
No need to specially stop and wait for the reishi to digest before moving on.
After consuming this reishi.
He opened the other box, revealing another reishi inside.
Snap snap!
Finished in a few bites.
Rolling medicinal power surged through his organs! The two major Breathing Techniques swiftly operated, quickly absorbing and refining the medicinal power.
Turning the medicinal power into a ’great hammer’, pounding on his skin, tendons, and bones.
Widening Ding Ling’s meridians.
Making his skin increasingly tough.
His bones more and more solid!
Defense power increased, strength surged.
[Strength +0.9]
[Defense +0.9]
This reishi directly increased strength and defense by 0.9 attribute points.
Ding Ling glanced at the Character Panel:
Power:

[Base Stats - Bone Structure1 (ordinary person 1 point), Intelligence 2, Strength 22.5+0.2+0.2+0.8+0.9= (24.6), Agility 21.7+0.2 (21.9), Constitution 21.2+0.1 (21.3), Defense 16+0.2+0.8+0.9 (17.9), Charm 4]
Strength and defense grew the fastest!
Strength had now surged to over two thousand four hundred pounds, his every movement carrying a terrifying force, and second-rate generals couldn’t withstand a strike from Ding Ling.
Even first-rate ones couldn’t withstand a few moves!
Only true super-elite were worthy opponents for Ding Ling!
Defense reaching 17.9.
Ding Ling was now equivalent to carrying several layers of defensive armor, ordinary soldiers simply couldn’t break his defense!
Only sharp arrows piercing vital points or blades striking the neck and head could possibly severely injure him. Otherwise, he might just take it and get through.
’This feeling really is intoxicating.’
Ding Ling’s spirit greatly revived.
The skyrocketing power brought a great sense of security!
His slightly empty heart was suddenly full and much more confident.
Hu Zhen watched as Ding Ling gnawed the reishi, his aura soaring, leaving him terrified to the core.
He couldn’t imagine how Ding Ling managed to refine the reishi for his own use.
But then he remembered Ding Ling’s Transformation Realm Breathing Technique and felt slightly relieved, yet mostly filled with dread.
’How unlucky for me to have bumped into such a heaven-defying person.’
"Da da!"
Ding Ling tossed away the empty box.
Repackaged his bundle and tied it to the side of the horse.
Revitalized his energy.
With a halberd in one hand and the Shuoyue Sword in the other, he sped up his horse.
With Hu Zhen alongside.
Typical patrols wouldn’t dare touch Ding Ling, being scolded away by Hu Zhen.
One must admit.
Bringing Hu Zhen along was indeed a wise decision.
Otherwise.
An entire journey fighting patrols.
Would surely waste a lot of time!
[Achievement Medal obtained: You have intimidated Lü Bu’s Army.]

[Note: Some patrols from Lü Bu’s Army spread the news of you killing Flying Bear Army and kidnapping Hu Zhen. This led certain Lü Bu generals to personally lead teams to investigate the truth and interrogate neighbors and passersby.
After uncovering the truth.
Your actions shocked and astonished them!
For the first time, they truly realized, Flying General Lü Bu might not be invincible, and perhaps a rival for Lü Bu has emerged.
You should be careful.
As they will most likely gang up on you instead of a one-on-one duel, understanding that a mighty force like Lü Bu cannot be defeated by one man alone!]
While on the road.
A notification suddenly slipped past his ear.
Ding Ling paused for a moment, then understood.
Throughout the journey, he had Hu Zhen alongside.
Racing through major streets.
He was almost at the south gate.
A good half an hour had probably passed.
At this time.
Some patrols reporting back, and their superiors checking and discovering the truth, made sense.
But...
’Did I kill the Flying Bear Army earlier?’
Flying Bear Army: Dong Zhuo’s elite private forces during the Late Eastern Han Dynasty, consisting of elite Xiliang troops led by Dong Zhuo’s trusted general, Li Jue, and others.
This was what Ding Ling knew.
But now it seemed that the commander of the Flying Bear Army was most likely Hu Zhen.
They were indeed his own people.
Dong Zhuo favored nepotism without merit.
’No wonder their combat power is so astonishing.’
As Ding Ling rode along, he casually asked Hu Zhen some questions.
He learned that the Flying Bear Army had a total of only three thousand.
Typically, over two thousand were stationed in the Imperial Palace to ensure Dong Zhuo’s safety.
The remainder of a few hundred were usually led by Hu Zhen.
This time, Hu Zhen brought over two hundred, nearly three hundred, and a Flying Bear Army commander-level cavalry general, Wang Fang, and they were all killed.
Considering this, Hu Zhen couldn’t help but feel panicked; he answered whatever Ding Ling asked, showing great sincerity and honesty.
Of course, Ding Ling knew this was just a façade, and he was not courteous to Hu Zhen. Once they arrived at the south gate, he asked him to call for the gate to be opened.
Hu Zhen very much wanted to refuse.
But he knew.
If he refused, he would be the first to die.
His good days were just beginning, and he didn’t want to die.
So, even though Hu Zhen hated Ding Ling to death, he had no choice but to suppress his fear and step forward to loudly command the Defender General at the south gate:

chapters.title: Chapter 94: Hao Meng of the Eight Brave Generals
paragraphs: "Blind fools! Haven’t you seen who I am? Hurry up and open the city gate for me!"
"Lord Imperial Attendant. What is this?"
The South Gate Guardian General was a man of eight feet tall, with a commanding appearance.
In terms of looks, quite impressive.
But at this moment, faced with Dong Huang’s reprimand, he instantly seemed dwarfed.
He timidly replied:
"I am stationed here by order of Marquis Wenn, without his command, I cannot open the gate."
"How dare you!"
Dong Huang was furious:

"I am the commander of the Imperial Guard, the nephew of Prime Minister Dong! Who does Lü Fengxian think he is? A sycophant and flatterer! My uncle adopted him as a godson, it is a courtesy view of him! It doesn’t mean his status is higher than my biological nephew’s!
You now dare to refuse my order. Do you believe I won’t have someone chop off your head right now to play ball?"
Dong Huang was always tyrannical!
He was aggressive even without reason, and with reason, even less likely to let it go!
He was already trembling and shivering with intimidation from Ding Ling.

Now provoked by the general’s words, rage surged from his heart, and malice grew with bravery. If his foot was not injured, and not without a weapon, he would definitely take action against the general now, to vent his inner frustration!
"I dare not."
The general still appeared subservient, but he stubbornly refused to open the gate.
Dong Huang was so angry he was beside himself with fury!
Ding Ling saw Dong Huang had tried his best, so he could only let him step aside.
He came rushing southward.
Galloping through countless long streets and paths.
The sound of war drums grew louder and more intense.
It’s evident.
The matter between him and Zhao Yun must have spread throughout all of Luoyang.
Now it’s causing entire forces to be deployed to encircle him.
If they don’t open the South Gate swiftly and decisively, once blocked here with an attack from front and back, even with extraordinary powers, he could only die here.
This was not what he wanted.
Dong Huang led the way all along, saving Ding Ling a lot of time.
Now he barely has some time to break through this South Gate.
Clippity-clop!
Ding Ling rode to a spot not far from the general and flicked the halberd in his hand, clearly saying:
"Are you opening the gate or not?"
"Who are you?"
The general, servile before Dong Huang, but seeing Ding Ling, a surge of heroic spirit broke forth, he looked at Ding Ling disdainfully, shook his long spear, and coldly said:
"With Hao Meng here, no one can pass. Unless there’s an order from Marquis Wenn or Prime Minister Dong."
Hao Meng, one of the Eight Brave Generals under Lü Bu.
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow, sighed:
"I’m warning you for the last time, you better listen to the Lord Imperial Attendant and open the gate, otherwise you’ll be responsible for the consequences."
"How?"
Hao Meng’s heart tightened, stepped back.
Swish, swish!
The soldiers around him immediately swarmed forward, holding long spears and confronting Ding Ling, shielding Hao Meng behind.
In such a situation, only then did Hao Meng seem to breathe a sigh of relief, loudly saying:

"I’ll say it one last time. Go back and get an order from Marquis Wenn or Prime Minister, then I’ll open the gate, otherwise, if you force your way through, don’t blame me, Hao Meng, for showing no mercy!"
"Alas."
Ding Ling sighed.
Gave Zhao Yun a look.
Zhao Yun understood, gripped his long spear, ready to respond at any time.
"Since it’s like this. Only the killer move remains."
Ding Ling’s halberd suddenly lifted, slashing and stabbing toward the soldiers in front.
A single halberd.
Forged with the essence of axe technique, staff technique, saber technique, spear technique, halberd technique, and many other weapons.
Once executed, it seemed as if Heaven and Earth reversed, the Illusion Realm descended upon the mortal world.

But amid the sky full of spear flowers flashing across the void, fierce and piercing clashing sounds cut through the air, and upon closer look, a dozen soldiers clutching their throats, looked at Ding Ling with a face of astonishment and horror, murmuring as if trying to say something, but what came out was all blood.
"What kind of spear technique is this?!"
Hao Meng, a master at the peak of second-class, although still quite a distance from first-class in terms of strength.
But in the use of long spear technique, he had reached a very profound level.
Thus, when Ding Ling wielded the halberd to execute the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear to kill the enemy, he immediately saw that what was just exhibited was not halberd technique, but spear technique!
Clang! Clang, clang, clang!
Responding to him was even quicker, more numerous flowers of the spear.
Even occasionally various hooking, slashing, as if unparalleled axe technique were being summoned, drawn out by Ding Ling.
It was clearly a halberd.
At this moment, it exhibited the flavor of eighteen different weapons.
Slaughtering the soldiers was such that they were overwhelmed, unable to resist.
Many couldn’t withstand even a single round, genuinely upon just attacking past, were speared to death, slashed to death by the halberd!
Instantly killing over ten!
Ding Ling’s artistry in enemy slaying was increasingly exquisite, increasingly possessed a poignant beauty.
One hand Sword God Skill.
One hand alternating spear technique, axe technique, etc.
While occasionally swinging through the Setting Sun Diagram, Flowers in Full Bloom.
While occasionally passing through the Hundred Birds Paying Homage to the Phoenix pattern, Celestial Spirit Giant Axe picture!
Various patterns, impossible to distinguish or see with the naked eye.
Only faint phantoms were seen.
Yet often before clearly seeing, the next instant, soldiers lay in a pool of blood.
A single person, wielding a halberd, a sword, yet killing until the entrance of the South City Gate ran with rivers of blood.
No less than hundreds of people virtually slaughtered by him alone.
By the end.
Even Hao Meng couldn’t help but tremble with fear, wanting to flee.
He wanted to climb the city walls.
Seen by Ding Ling, with a twist of the halberd, a slash, killing the last obstructing soldier, he used his throwing skill, directly throwing the halberd towards Hao Meng’s position.
Hao Meng heard the sound of something piercing the air, instinctively dodged to the side!
Crack!
The halberd stuck straight into the city wall over three inches deep!
Hao Meng broke out in a cold sweat, kicked the ground, and like a swift bird, quickly climbed the steps to the city wall.

Seeing this, Ding Ling directly leaped up from the horseback, performed the Wall-Climbing Technique, kicked the horse’s back, soared through the void like a gust of wind over ten meters, landed on the steps, quickly climbed up to the city wall, charging towards Hao Meng.
Hao Meng fled in a mess, but his speed was not nearly as quick as Ding Ling.
Seeing close to being caught up, he immediately shouted:
"I can open the city gate for you."
"No need for you to open it."
Already offended to the core.
How could there be reason for forgiveness?
If the other side merely employs delaying tactics, lulling Ding Ling, wouldn’t that be even more troublesome?
Thinking upon this, Ding Ling swiftly caught up with Hao Meng, wielding the Shuoyue Sword towards Hao Meng.
Dawn Swordsmanship!
Thousands of sword flowers bloomed in mid-air, weaving into a picture of floral scenic beauty!
Descending upon Hao Meng’s head.
Hao Meng roared:
"Spear Skill!"
Boom!

Vigorous Qi exploded, a sharp and fierce force burst from his body, tightly gripping the long spear, he shook out a plethora of spear flowers, trying to leverage the spear’s advantage, to swiftly stab Ding Ling to death.
Clang, clang, clang!
The sword and spear clashed for merely a single round.
Thud!
A sword flower sliced past Hao Meng’s arm, thud!
A crisp sound.
Hao Meng’s hand gripping the spear was cut off.

Haven’t you seen who I am?
Hurry up and open the city gate for me!"
"Lord Imperial Attendant.
What is this?"
The South Gate Guardian General was a man of eight feet tall, with a commanding appearance.
In terms of looks, quite impressive.
But at this moment, faced with Dong Huang’s reprimand, he instantly seemed dwarfed.
He timidly replied:
"I am stationed here by order of Marquis Wenn, without his command, I cannot open the gate."
"How dare you!"
Dong Huang was furious:
"I am the commander of the Imperial Guard, the nephew of Prime Minister Dong!
Who does Lü Fengxian think he is?
A sycophant and flatterer!
My uncle adopted him as a godson, it is a courtesy view of him!
It doesn’t mean his status is higher than my biological nephew’s!
You now dare to refuse my order.
Do you believe I won’t have someone chop off your head right now to play ball?"
Dong Huang was always tyrannical!
He was aggressive even without reason, and with reason, even less likely to let it go!
He was already trembling and shivering with intimidation from Ding Ling.
Now provoked by the general’s words, rage surged from his heart, and malice grew with bravery.
If his foot was not injured, and not without a weapon, he would definitely take action against the general now, to vent his inner frustration!

The general still appeared subservient, but he stubbornly refused to open the gate.
Dong Huang was so angry he was beside himself with fury!

He came rushing southward.
Galloping through countless long streets and paths.
The sound of war drums grew louder and more intense.
It’s evident.

Dong Huang led the way all along, saving Ding Ling a lot of time.

Clippity-clop!

chapters.title: Chapter 95: Frightening the Royal Capital
paragraphs: Blood flowed like a torrent.
Crimson patches covered the earth!
"Ah!"
Hao Meng screamed miserably, his face pale and defeated, staggering backward, in great panic:
"Don’t kill me! If you kill me, Marquis Wenn won’t spare you."
"As if sparing you would mean Marquis Wenn wouldn’t try to kill me anyway."
Ding Ling sneered coldly, swinging the Shuoyue Sword forward in his hand.
Sunset Swordsmanship!
The Setting Sun Diagram flickered across the void.
It traced along Hao Meng’s neck.
Thud!
A large head was severed, fell with a thump to the ground, rolled a bit, and stopped by Ding Ling’s feet, staring straight at Ding Ling with wide eyes, seemingly unwilling even in death.
Fear, annoyance, regret, reluctance still lingered on the face!
Ding Ling glanced and then leapt off the city wall.
"Ding Ling!"
Zhao Yun was calling him.
Ding Ling followed the sound.
It turned out Zhao Yun had seized the opportunity to open the city gate:
"Hurry up. I saw a large troop coming from the north."
"Hmm."
Ding Ling nodded, pulled the Heaven-piercing Halberd from the city wall, and with a few leaps, mounted his horse, glancing at Dong Huang:
"What are you stunned for? Move it!"
Dong Huang was completely at a loss.
This time he finally witnessed clearly how Ding Ling killed the enemy!
Even cutting vegetables isn’t done with such ease!
It’s terrifying!
Is this still human?!
"Go!"
Ding Ling glared at Dong Huang, slightly raised the Shuoyue Sword in his hand.
Dong Huang was greatly shaken, instinctively spurred his horse out of the south gate.
Ding Ling followed closely behind out of the south gate.
Once the horses were out of the city.
Ding Ling looked back behind him.
The ancient, thick, and weathered royal capital remained there!
The majestic, grand, and imposing city wall still stood there.
But at this moment, Ding Ling felt it completely differently.
It seemed to be surrounded by an aura of decay, bloodiness, ruin, shame, and depravity.
This was brought by Dong Zhuo’s great army.
"Luoyang..."
Ding Ling looked deeply at the royal capital, and then rode away without looking back.
If possible.
He hoped this royal capital wouldn’t be destroyed.
After all, its grandeur and history were etched in its very essence, destroying it would be a great pity.
Once away from the royal capital.
The three of them sought rest in a patch of forest.
Ding Ling’s stomach was long hungry!
The previous upgrades left him urgently needing an energy replenishment.
He rode around the forest, killed a few wild boars, and returned to make barbecue.
Smoke wafted out of the forest, spreading to all directions.
"Will this attract enemies?"
Zhao Yun scrutinized carefully, a bit worried.
"It’s impossible not to eat, right? Eat your fill, then hit the road."
Ding Ling said:
"Besides, there are beacon towers everywhere, plus there are soldiers ready to report situations to all corners in eight hundred miles’ haste, in Luoyang, we caught them off guard.
That Hao Meng seemed not to know what specifically happened.
Otherwise, we certainly couldn’t have escaped the city so smoothly."
This time, escaping the city smoothly.
Besides Dong Huang’s assistance.
It was also because Ding Ling and his party were fast, strong, and brave enough.
If they hesitated at all, they’d probably be trapped inside Luoyang City, unable to come out.
"Indeed."
Zhao Yun was relieved, sat down to start grilling meat.
A while later.
The two ate and drank their fill.
Dong Huang, however, was so hungry his stomach rumbled like a drum.
Ding Ling handed him a pig’s hind leg.
He scorned it and didn’t eat.
But feeling painfully hungry, he had no choice but to eat with his mouth shut, unexpectedly finding it delicious.
Ding Ling glanced at Dong Huang, contemplating whether to just kill him here, taking along such a burden was clearly unwise.
Dong Huang seemed to understand, struggled swallowing the meat, quickly said:

"Hero, rest assured, I’m certainly useful in the Si Li Territory, with me here, ordinary generals wouldn’t dare act, I’ll do my utmost to protect you until you leave the Si Li Realm, just hope afterward you spare my life."
"If it’s truly as you say, sparing your life isn’t impossible."
Ding Ling seldomly relented.
Dong Huang rejoiced, hurriedly said:
"Hero, watch my methods. I guarantee you’ll have a smooth journey, no one will dare act rashly!"
’Hopefully so.’
Ding Ling nodded.
Almost simultaneously.
[Achievement Medal Acquired: Frightening the Royal Capital!]
[Note: Your deeds have spread across Luoyang, even reached Dong Zhuo’s ears! Your martial arts and skills have shocked all the officials! Undoubtedly.
Your War God’s reputation begins to rise at this moment!]
Upon hearing this.
Ding Ling couldn’t help but glance at the character panel.
[3: You must make your War God name resonate through the entire Plane World. 3%/100%.]
Previously it was 2%.
Now it moved forward one small increment.
Ding Ling pondered, contemplating:
’It seems that many recognized my abilities, martial arts, and skills in the battle at Luoyang, thus my War God reputation soared?’
There is only this possibility.
Only when acknowledged to have unparalleled martial arts skills does the reputation rise.
It was the same when defeating the Black Mountain Army.
And now too.
The reason it moved only 1%.
It probably relates to most of those defeated being second-class generals.
If he managed to defeat seven or eight tenths of Luoyang’s war generals like he did with most leaders of the Black Mountain Army, his War God reputation would definitely skyrocket.
Upon thinking this.
Ding Ling’s spirit brightened.
He thought of a plan.
If there were truly a coalition against Dong Zhuo.
’I’d challenge all fierce generals of Dong Zhuo’s side or alliance front in front of the coalition, then my War God’s name would soar up, and this mission might be completed ahead of time.’
Yet actually implementing this definitely carries certain difficulties.
At present, Ding Ling doesn’t wish to rashly join Cao Mengde and others.
He needs to choose a suitable opportunity.
If Cao Mengde and others don’t suit his taste, then naturally there’s no need to join them.
As for the task progress bar?
As long as the battle opportunity is seized correctly, with strong enough powers, it can naturally be completed effortlessly.
"In conclusion, enhancing oneself remains the most crucial."
Ding Ling made a decision.
Go south to Yangzhou to seek Yhiuu Ji and Zuo Ci for Inner Refining Breathing Technique practice.
Aim for Unity of Inner and Outer!
After all, when two External Refining Breathing Techniques are combined.
Their power multiplied many times over! The effectiveness in boosting oneself is quite evident!
If Unity of Inner and Outer is achieved?
Ding Ling doesn’t know the effect but since Wang Yue asserted it would surely lead to invincibility.
Then it should be accurate.
Thinking of this, Ding Ling was stirred with enthusiasm.
World’s Number One!
Who wouldn’t want such a title?
Reputation is inconsequential.
Ding Ling cares foremost about the genuine formidable strength of World’s Number One!
"I wonder where the hero plans on going?"
"Naturally heading south."
"There are a few routes you can take southward."
Dong Huang also guessed that Ding Ling was headed south, why else would he have gone out the south gate?
He had considered before, now under Ding Ling and Zhao Yun’s gaze, he quickly said:

chapters.title: Chapter 96: Southern March Route (1/50)
paragraphs: "We can head east to Yanshi City and Gong County, pass Hulao Pass, take a detour through Xingyang City, then head south."
Dong Huang kept gesturing with his fingers:
"The second route is through Yique City, heading southward through Xin City and Luhun City, reaching Songh County, crossing two rivers and a mountain range, and then entering Jingzhou."
"The third route goes through Yiyang City, Luoning City, Lushi City, and detours through Wu Pass to reach Jingzhou."

"The fourth option is to head west, pass through Xin’an City and Hongnong City, reach Chang’an, and then detour to enter Jingzhou. Alternatively, we can continue into Liangzhou, detour through Yizhou, and then enter Jingzhou or Jiaozhou..."
Dong Huang spoke eloquently.
He was evidently very familiar with the geographical situation.

Ding Ling couldn’t help but take notice, thinking: It seems that although Dong Huang is a bit of a fool, he has his own strengths. If he were truly useless, how could a formidable figure like Dong Zhuo entrust his Imperial Guard to a worthless commander? After all, it concerns his personal safety!
Now it seems, Dong Huang indeed has his merits.
Come to think of it, how many useless people have left their names in history?
Especially one like Dong Huang, who grew up under the watchful eyes of fierce generals, how could he be useless?
After all, those who are close to vermilion become red; those close to ink become black. People cultivated in the harsh environment of Xiliang’s borders are absolutely more formidable than bandits!
"...Which route does the hero plan to take?"
After speaking, Dong Huang looked at Ding Ling somewhat anxiously.
Ding Ling pondered.
He ultimately decided on the second route.
Although this path was more challenging, it was the shortest and had rivers and mountains as barriers.
As long as they moved quickly enough,
Dong Zhuo’s troops would be unable to encircle or capture them!
In those vast mountains, even if Dong Zhuo were extraordinarily skilled, it would be impossible to find just two people!
If they went east, Hulao Pass was heavily guarded. If Dong Huang’s words held no weight, they would find themselves in the same predicament as at the south gate earlier, and it would be over!
At least at the south gate, they could catch their opponents off guard.
But Hulao Pass was definitely not like that.
Because players might report Ding Ling’s information for the sake of achievement, it’s very likely that the Defender General of Hulao Pass already has Ding Ling’s details on his desk.
Ding Ling always considered the worst-case scenario regarding players’ attitudes towards him.
Because people have both good and evil in them, and indeed some players are wicked beyond forgiveness, which is undeniable.
Of course, most players are normal, with the correct values and moral bottom lines.
Ding Ling didn’t need to overly guard against players because he was one himself, and he knew that most are ordinary people.
But because he was a player, he also knew that some players could be terribly malicious!
He needed to guard against those, the wicked ones, the vile ones.
Some players’ evil is unreasonable, much like Dong Zhuo and Dong Huang, who unfairly oppress and suppress the common folk!
Towards such players, Ding Ling’s approach is not to provoke them, but if they provoke him, he would absolutely kill one at a time.
In the past, Ding Ling was an ordinary person who had to endure bullying, but now he doesn’t have to anymore! Why endure when you have cheats?!
"We’ll take the second route."

Ding Ling decisively mounted his horse, Shuoyue Sword strapped to his back, his right hand gripping a halberd, his left hand tightening the reins, prompting the sturdy horse to turn south. From the saddle, he looked at Zhao Yun and Dong Huang:
"It’s time to go. I hear movement."
His keen senses indeed caught the approaching sound of a large force.
He knew it might have been the meal delay causing this.
But skipping meals was not an option.

Because he had experienced several enhancements, consumption was high, and without food, prolonged hunger would lead to weakness when they needed to hurry, making it likely they’d be caught by enemies due to exhaustion.
But having a full meal, fully energized with immense strength and endurance, he naturally wouldn’t worry about these issues.
"Alright."
Zhao Yun nodded, signaling Dong Huang to lead the way.
Dong Huang wore a troubled expression but had no choice but to rush ahead.
Ding Ling stayed at the rear.
He didn’t choose the other two routes because one was too far, and the other had too many enemies.
Traveling through Chang’an was definitely inadvisable.
Liangzhou was Dong Zhuo’s main base. Going there was like walking into a trap, wasn’t it?
And going through Wu Pass?
The same logic, heavily guarded, inadvisable!
Da-da!
The three had changed horses.
The pace was not slow at all.
The horses they had seized in Luoyang were coming in handy, allowing them to switch horses when the current ones grew weary to continue speeding up.
Their speed was undoubtedly fast.
But it seemed the enemy’s horses weren’t slow either.
The booming roar of iron hooves reverberated and thrummed incessantly in their ears.
Ding Ling glanced back.
He could clearly see the skyward clouds of dust and smoke stirring!
They were all cavalry.
The numbers were likely over a thousand.
How many exactly was uncertain.
"It cannot continue like this."
Dong Huang spoke up:
"If we reach Yique City and the city guard doesn’t open the gate, we’re very likely to be trapped outside. That would be perilous."
He was considering Ding Ling’s situation. Or rather, considering his own little life.
Ding Ling understood this very well, nodded, and said:
"Is there a slope ahead suitable for cavalry charges?"
"Yes,"
Dong Huang quickly replied:
"Another six or seven miles ahead, there’s a hill."
"Then head there."
"Ding Ling, are you planning to fight them?"
Zhao Yun turned his gaze.
"It’s us,"
Ding Ling arched an eyebrow.
"Exactly right."
Zhao Yun nodded approvingly, showing no fear:
"No matter how many men and horses they have, as long as we work together with sincerity, there’s no need to be afraid."
Clip-clop!
Seven horses galloped forward for six or seven miles when Ding Ling indeed spotted a hill.
He rode up the hill and stood at its highest point.
A downhill charge, if the sturdy horse donned armor, would definitely have tremendous impact.
Thus, Ding Ling gathered the armor from the other horses and concentrated them on two.
Some of the armor pieces didn’t fit.
Ding Ling simply used ropes to secure and bind them.
He had the ropes for a long time, and now they found their use.
After doing all this.
The group of Iron Cavalry from afar was already barreling towards them.
Ding Ling vaulted onto the horse, took out the Five-Stone Bow, drew an arrow, and aimed at the vanguard strongman in the distance.
As the strongman led his team, charging to over a hundred meters from Ding Ling, Ding Ling released the string!
Twang!
A light sound.
The arrow tore through the sky like lightning, shooting towards the strongman’s head.
Clang!
The strongman held a long spear, his eyes blazing. Seeing Ding Ling daring to shoot from so far away, he smirked in disdain, flicking his spear.
The Breathing Technique circulated, the Spear Technique was triggered, and a vigorous qi surged forth with an aura seemingly capable of Soul Destruction, stabbing towards the arrow.
A sound, bang!
The spearhead of the strongman’s long spear skewed, almost slipping from his grip.
"How is this possible?!"
He was stunned!
"What tremendous strength!!"
His hand trembled slightly.
If he were a bit more careless and hadn’t triggered the Spear Technique, wouldn’t he have been gravely injured just now?

Dong Huang kept gesturing with his fingers:
"The second route is through Yique City, heading southward through Xin City and Luhun City, reaching Songh County, crossing two rivers and a mountain range, and then entering Jingzhou."
"The third route goes through Yiyang City, Luoning City, Lushi City, and detours through Wu Pass to reach Jingzhou."
"The fourth option is to head west, pass through Xin’an City and Hongnong City, reach Chang’an, and then detour to enter Jingzhou.

People cultivated in the harsh environment of Xiliang’s borders are absolutely more formidable than bandits!

chapters.title: Chapter 97: The Fierce Generals Wei Xu and Song Xian (2/50)
paragraphs: Think about it.
Hu Feng couldn’t help but break out in a cold sweat.
"Wei Xu, are you okay?"
Another cavalry general, dressed in general armor and looking handsome and broad-shouldered, came rushing over.
He held a long saber in his hand and, seeing Hu Feng’s grim expression, felt a twinge in his heart and quickly asked:
"Is there something wrong?"
"Nothing."
Wei Xu’s face was slightly pale as he forced a smile and said:
"I just feel like the two people we’re pursuing might be stronger than we imagined. Perhaps those aliens weren’t exaggerating. We must be cautious."
"Heh heh."
The cavalry general with the long saber smiled slightly and said confidently:
"No matter how formidable they are, they’re only two people. How can they withstand over a thousand Wolf Riders like us!"
He shouted loudly:

"You must know that our Wolf Riders have dominated the border regions of Bingzhou, killing barbarians so that they dared not drive their herds south. Our mighty reputation shakes the world; there’s no way we can’t kill two people on the opposing side!"

"Yet, Hao Meng, who commanded hundreds of elites guarding the south gate of Luoyang, is dead; Wang Fang, a cavalry general at the commander level leading nearly three hundred Flying Bear Army soldiers, is also dead! Even Hu Feng and others are all dead. The fierce reputations of Ding Ling and Zhao Yun are known to all, and we must not underestimate them."
Wei Xu’s face was serious as he quickly said:

"Song Xian, to be honest, at first, I also thought we would definitely win this battle and thus underestimated Ding Ling and Zhao Yun a bit. But just now, that arrow from the other side had an extraordinary force. Ding Ling’s strength is obviously far superior to ours. We shouldn’t duel with him!"
"I wouldn’t be foolish enough to duel him."
Song Xian nodded and said:

"He was able to kill generals like Wang Fang and Hao Meng, so naturally, he can kill us too. How could I be so foolish to charge out? The best method is, of course, to unleash a long-range arrow rain from the Wolf Cavalry to shoot him!"
"But Dong Huang is there. If we accidentally kill him, it would be hard to explain."
At this moment, Wei Xu and Song Xian had already led their cavalry to a spot about seventy to eighty meters away from the hill.
They were confronting Ding Ling and Zhao Yun.
Standing at this position, being experts at the peak of second-class, they could naturally see the rough features of Dong Huang, and they exchanged glances, feeling very troubled:
"I originally thought Dong Huang had already been killed by them, given the ruthlessness of their actions! But now he’s been spared a life?!"
"It seems Dong Huang is of great help to them. The other side probably intends to use old tricks, leveraging Dong Huang’s influence to flee all the way out of the Si Li Territory!"

"Heh, what a beautiful thought. The big deeds these two have done have already alarmed Marquis Wenn and the Prime Minister. Both of them are furious and have sworn to kill Ding Ling and Zhao Yun. They can’t escape."
Wei Xu looked at Ding Ling and Zhao Yun, gripping his spear tightly while speaking rapidly:
"Currently, Marquis Wenn is also deploying his troops and will soon charge here. If we surround them and temporarily prevent their escape until Marquis Wenn arrives, they will be doomed!"
"Indeed."
Song Xian agreed:
"What we need to do is trap them. Delay as long as possible."

"It’s not just Marquis Wenn. When we set out, I also saw Hua Xiong leading the Flying Bear Army. The Flying Bear Army is the Prime Minister’s top elite force. Hua Xiong is an unparalleled warrior from the Prime Minister’s Xiliang faction! The Prime Minister sent out Hua Xiong and the Flying Bear Army, which shows how furious he is; he is enraged beyond measure!"
Wei Xu’s eyes flickered with sharpness:

"If we can kill these two before Marquis Wenn and the Prime Minister, do you think we would receive immense merit? After all, the crimes these two committed are just too immense. Killing them would be the greatest accomplishment!"
"It’s not impossible."
Song Xian hesitated but still insisted:
"But it’s best to delay time. If by mistake, Dong Huang is killed, our achievements would be in vain!"
’That’s not what you said before.’
"I didn’t know Dong Huang wasn’t dead back then."
The two discussed it for a while.
Then formulated a plan.
They decided that surrounding was the best strategy. However, if there was an opportunity to kill Ding Ling and Zhao Yun, they would definitely act without hesitation.
The above seems long to say, but it happened in just a moment.
Ding Ling sat steadily on horseback, and after shooting an arrow, he saw surprise on the other side’s face, but they would occasionally glance towards Dong Huang behind him to the left.
Moreover, they were communicating with another person in general armor, who also looked cautiously at Dong Huang.
Ding Ling understood after a slight thought.
Undoubtedly, these two were apprehensive of Dong Huang, so they hadn’t attacked him immediately.
Given this...
Ding Ling bent his bow and nocked an arrow again, this time aiming not at the generals but at subordinate officials like the Village Chief and Military Marquis.
Whoosh!
Boom!
The bowstring quivered like a thunderbolt!
The arrow flew like a meteor falling to the ground!
Amid the sound of it tearing through the sky, thunk! The arrow hit the forehead of a deputy commander!

The deputy commander, full of shock and disbelief, fell backward from his horse, and the battle horse sensed something, neighed loudly, and the deputy commander uncontrollably tumbled off the horse, crashing heavily onto the ground.
"What?!"
Wei Xu and Song Xian glanced over, shocked, and then furious.
Wei Xu yelled:
"Be on guard!"
They hadn’t expected Ding Ling to directly choose to attack the deputy commanders!
If all the Wolf Cavalry’s deputy commanders were killed, the combat capability of these Wolf Riders would be more than halved.
The commander-in-chief is the soul.
The deputy commanders are the spirit.

Only with both the soul and spirit can the Wolf Riders be agile and orderly, like a solid piece of iron. If the spirit is missing, they become a sieve that leaks rain, full of holes, easily exploited by others.
Wei Xu and Song Xian understood this concept, so they immediately became vigilant.
Increased precautions were advised.
Whoosh!
Whoosh whoosh!
Ding Ling fired one arrow after another.
His Basic Archery was at full level, with a very high hit rate.
In addition, his strength, agility, and constitution were at super-elite levels, giving him incredible endurance!
Moreover, he had two full-level Breathing Techniques augmenting him.
Making his arrows astonishingly sharp, with power as vast as the sea, especially now with the distance reduced to about seventy to eighty meters.
At this point.
The lethality of Ding Ling’s arrows was extremely evident!
Average deputy commanders couldn’t withstand the sharpness of his arrows!
Those who chose to face him directly would be shot off their horses, either killed or severely or lightly injured.
Whoosh whoosh!
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!

The sound of arrows tearing through the air filled the void, like the Scythe of Death harvesting mortal lives. Though it was just one person, the shooting caused the Wolf Riders to shiver, retreating repeatedly.
Ding Ling saw this, his eyes brightened, instantly understanding Song Xian’s plan, and immediately ordered Dong Huang to follow them.

chapters.title: Chapter 98: Shooting Wolf Cavalry Officers (3/50)
paragraphs: Ding Ling temporarily abandoned his plan to charge and kill the enemy atop the dirt hill.
He had his strong armored horse stay on the dirt hill.

Switching to a lightly-armored good horse, he galloped down the dirt hill, approached the cavalry formation, and continued to bend his bow and draw arrows, shooting to kill the enemy’s secondary officers.
The secondary officers’ general armor was too obvious.
Ding Ling, with his keen hearing and exceptional vision, could easily distinguish them at a glance.
Swish, swish, swish!
The sound of arrows piercing the air echoed continuously, akin to a Death God summoning souls!
Every secondary officer was deeply frightened.
They were shocked, angry, and fearful, understanding Ding Ling’s intentions. Some secondary officers immediately stepped forward, shouting:
"Both generals, if we don’t attack now, our morale will scatter, and we’ll have no choice but to retreat."
"Just two insignificant bandits. Why do generals keep retreating instead of daring to attack and kill?"
Even the Military Marquis questioned angrily.
Normally, they wouldn’t be so bold, but with the Death God watching over them, they couldn’t take it anymore. In their panic and apprehension, they erupted:
"We could completely finish them off in a single blow! Why gamble with our brothers’ lives so recklessly?"
"Enough!"
Wei Xu let out an angry snort:
"With Lord Imperial Attendant here, who dares act recklessly?"
"Lord Imperial Attendant?"
The Military Marquis was bewildered:
"Is the person beside Ding Ling the Lord Imperial Attendant?!"
"What do you think?"
Song Xian glared coldly at the Military Marquis: "Or did you think we’d be that foolish?"
The Military Marquis, feeling dejected, was about to say more when whoosh!
An arrow, as if penetrating the void, shot with irresistible force and struck the Military Marquis squarely on the head, directly shattering his helmet!
The arrowhead collided violently with the helmet, instantly shattering and breaking.

Yet, the arrow shaft, driven by immense force, struck the split opening of the helmet, crackling! In an instant, the arrow shaft was torn into tiny splinters by the sharp edge of the crack, scattering some debris, but most were driven by inertia to impact the Military Marquis’s skull.
It was as if needles were piercing vital points like the temples!

The Military Marquis let out a miserable yell, tumbling from his horse to the ground, his face and head covered in blood. His eyes were filled with a longing for life and intense unwillingness and indignation. He stretched out his hand toward Wei Xu and Song Xian, struggling to say:
"Gen- General..."
His words were unfinished.
He had already died, his eyes gradually losing their luster.

In shock and horror, Wei Xu and Song Xian were furious, their anger reaching its peak. For a moment, they truly wanted to abandon all restraint and directly order the execution of Ding Ling and his people!
But reason pulled them back from the brink of madness.
They believed it was not worth risking their future on this incident.
Swish, swish!
The sound of arrows piercing the air continued.
Secondary officers fell from horses repeatedly.
Especially as Ding Ling, Zhao Yun, and Dong Huang pursued the Wolf Cavalry, drawing nearer and nearer, the power of the arrows increased.
In the end.
Often, an arrow would shoot out with a bang! Directly sending a person flying off their horse!
The strength was astonishingly remarkable!
Average secondary officers couldn’t withstand it, attempting to block with weapons would only result in severe injury or death!
"We should have sent heavy cavalry earlier."
Wei Xu regretted.
The Wolf Cavalry were light cavalry.
High attack, high agility, fast speed.
But their drawback was their insufficient defense!
To catch up with Ding Ling and Zhao Yun, dispatching fast-moving, high-attack Wolf Cavalry was the most appropriate!
This was an order personally given by Lü Bu.

Wei Xu and Song Xian also agreed, believing that with the unrivaled Wolf Cavalry, charging and killing the enemy would be unstoppable, eliminating merely two fierce generals was not a problem; they had slain exceptional generals before on the frontier!
But upon actual contact, they realized how troublesome Ding Ling was!
Compared to Zhao Yun, Ding Ling’s archery skill was astonishingly great! Moreover, his strength was simply terrifying!
One arrow’s force would be no less than a thousand pounds!
Apart from peak second-class or first-class fierce generals, ordinary second-class military generals wouldn’t dare claim they could withstand such an arrow!
Whoever tried to withstand it would likely face death!
Adding to that, the Wolf Cavalry wore leather armor, lacking high defense, facing such an arrow, they could only wait passively for death.
"Don’t push us around too much!"
Wei Xu watched as the Village Chief, Military Marquis, and others were nearly all dead.
Finally unable to bear it any longer, he charged out of formation, pointing his spear at Ding Ling, loudly shouting:
"Ding Ling, I am Wei Xu, the prominent general under Marquis Wenn! I now warn you! Do not provoke me! Or suffer the consequences!"
Wei Xu?
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow, lowered the Five-Stone Bow, pondering:
It turns out one of the Eight Brave Generals was Wei Xu.
Then who was the other one?
Seeing Ding Ling look at him, Song Xian stepped out to introduce himself.
Ding Ling understood.
Another from the Eight Brave Generals.
So this means.
The ones behind them were Lü Bu’s elite cavalry, the Wolf Cavalry?

"Our Wolf Cavalry are battle-hardened elite from the frontier, and Marquis Wenn is famed as the Flying General, intimidating all sides! If you don’t want to be deemed an enemy by Marquis Wenn, you’d better stop!"
Song Xian shouted loudly:

"We Bingzhou Army have galloped across the battlefield for years, undefeated and unbroken! Although you and Zhao Yun are strong, mere two men, how dare you face the edge of our tens of thousands of Bingzhou troops?
If you are wise, obediently return with us to Luoyang, strive for leniency, and we will certainly speak on your behalf."
Hearing Song Xian speak so.
Ding Ling sneered coldly, daring to threaten him?
He immediately raised the lowered Five-Stone Bow, tightened the big bow, nocked an arrow, and released the string!
Thud!
An arrow shot towards Song Xian.

Song Xian was shocked, attempting to dodge, but the arrow’s speed was too fast, and the distance between the two was only fifty or sixty meters, impossible to fully evade! Even if he dodged the vital head!
He would likely get shot in the arm!
Song Xian, naturally not wanting to get injured, instinctively activated the Breathing Technique, employed the Sword Technique, and slashed heavily at the arrow.
’Mountain Opening Saber Technique!’
Boom!
As he sliced, it seemed able to tear through heaven and earth, a peerless blaze burst forth, clashing with the swift arrow! Amidst the booming, a violent explosion erupted.
The arrow shattered, fragments scattering in all directions.
Song Xian’s body swayed slightly, unstable, almost falling off his horse!
His heart was tremendously shocked, barely containing the fear, pretended calmness while gazing at Ding Ling:
"Do you really want a mutually destructive battle?"
His hand was trembling slightly.
During the clash just now.
He exerted all his strength.
Yet could only barely fend off the power of that single arrow!
The opponent’s force was too great, the arrow’s attack power was too high!
Song Xian’s heart was tumultuous, unable to stay calm.
He truly realized Ding Ling’s sharpness and fierceness for the first time!
Previously, he merely watched from the scene, feeling Ding Ling was extraordinary, but hadn’t personally experienced it. Now, upon trying.
Song Xian understood the opponent’s might, fear rising within him, not daring to advance further, reining his horse, he gradually withdrew into the Wolf Cavalry formation.
He never intended to duel with Ding Ling.

sentences.text: Ding Ling temporarily abandoned his plan to charge and kill the enemy atop the dirt hill.
He had his strong armored horse stay on the dirt hill.

Switching to a lightly-armored good horse, he galloped down the dirt hill, approached the cavalry formation, and continued to bend his bow and draw arrows, shooting to kill the enemy’s secondary officers.
The secondary officers’ general armor was too obvious.
Ding Ling, with his keen hearing and exceptional vision, could easily distinguish them at a glance.
Swish, swish, swish!
The sound of arrows piercing the air echoed continuously, akin to a Death God summoning souls!
Every secondary officer was deeply frightened.
They were shocked, angry, and fearful, understanding Ding Ling’s intentions.
Some secondary officers immediately stepped forward, shouting:
"Both generals, if we don’t attack now, our morale will scatter, and we’ll have no choice but to retreat."
"Just two insignificant bandits.
Why do generals keep retreating instead of daring to attack and kill?"
Even the Military Marquis questioned angrily.
Normally, they wouldn’t be so bold, but with the Death God watching over them, they couldn’t take it anymore.
In their panic and apprehension, they erupted:
"We could completely finish them off in a single blow!
Why gamble with our brothers’ lives so recklessly?"
"Enough!"
Wei Xu let out an angry snort:
"With Lord Imperial Attendant here, who dares act recklessly?"
"Lord Imperial Attendant?"
The Military Marquis was bewildered:
"Is the person beside Ding Ling the Lord Imperial Attendant?!"
"What do you think?"
Song Xian glared coldly at the Military Marquis: "Or did you think we’d be that foolish?"
The Military Marquis, feeling dejected, was about to say more when whoosh!
An arrow, as if penetrating the void, shot with irresistible force and struck the Military Marquis squarely on the head, directly shattering his helmet!
The arrowhead collided violently with the helmet, instantly shattering and breaking.
Yet, the arrow shaft, driven by immense force, struck the split opening of the helmet, crackling!
In an instant, the arrow shaft was torn into tiny splinters by the sharp edge of the crack, scattering some debris, but most were driven by inertia to impact the Military Marquis’s skull.
It was as if needles were piercing vital points like the temples!
The Military Marquis let out a miserable yell, tumbling from his horse to the ground, his face and head covered in blood.
His eyes were filled with a longing for life and intense unwillingness and indignation.
He stretched out his hand toward Wei Xu and Song Xian, struggling to say:
"Gen- General..."
His words were unfinished.
He had already died, his eyes gradually losing their luster.
In shock and horror, Wei Xu and Song Xian were furious, their anger reaching its peak.
For a moment, they truly wanted to abandon all restraint and directly order the execution of Ding Ling and his people!
But reason pulled them back from the brink of madness.
They believed it was not worth risking their future on this incident.
Swish, swish!
The sound of arrows piercing the air continued.
Secondary officers fell from horses repeatedly.

In the end.
Often, an arrow would shoot out with a bang!
Directly sending a person flying off their horse!
The strength was astonishingly remarkable!

This was an order personally given by Lü Bu.

chapters.title: Chapter 99: Defender General Yang Ding
paragraphs: So, from the start, Song Xian kept a distance from Ding Ling.
But even from such a distance, Ding Ling still had the ability to threaten his life.
This left him shocked, stifled, and fearful, causing him to involuntarily retreat.
Wei Xu understood, swallowed hard, and quickly said:

"Wait. Ding Ling, you must know that we refrain from attacking you purely out of concern for Lord Imperial Attendant’s safety. If pushed to the brink, we will not care about these things, so you better think it through."
Dong Huang’s heart tightened, his face tensed up, and he couldn’t help but look at Ding Ling, afraid that Ding Ling might choose to abandon him.
Ding Ling slightly raised an eyebrow and put away the big bow once again.
Dong Huang sighed in relief.
What he didn’t realize was this.
Ding Ling, after weighing the pros and cons, felt that sparing Dong Huang’s life for the time being would better aid his escape from the Si Li Territory.
If Dong Huang were to die, not only would the difficulty of heading south increase exponentially, but he would also face a rain of arrows from Lü Bu and Dong Zhuo’s cavalry.
Of course.
With Ding Ling’s Sword God Skill, Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear, and Howling Moon Spear Technique all at the level of mastery, he wasn’t afraid of ordinary arrow showers.

He was only concerned about being relentlessly pursued, leaving him no time to eat, eventually exhausting his strength. At that point, if surrounded and attacked, he could only go offline. But if he went offline, Zhao Yun would be doomed.
Even if he came back online, the players aiding Dong Zhuo and Lü Bu’s army would still accurately execute kill missions against him.
So, it’s not an option.
Ding Ling thought it through and immediately said:
"If you want me to hold my arrows, you must stay at least ten li away from the three of us!"
A ten-li distance.
It was enough for Ding Ling to make some preparations.
He hoped the Wolf Cavalry would return to Luoyang and not besiege him.
But he knew this was unrealistic, so he didn’t bother mentioning it.
"Alright."
Wei Xu agreed without hesitation:
"We will withdraw now."
They couldn’t kill Dong Huang.
Nor could they match Ding Ling in archery.
And they didn’t dare challenge him one-on-one!
Moreover, they always had to face Ding Ling’s surprise arrows.
Wei Xu and Song Xian were extremely frustrated and could only choose to retreat temporarily.
They needed to await Lü Bu’s order; as soon as Lü Bu commanded them not to mind Dong Huang’s life, they certainly wouldn’t care!
"Clip-clop!"
Song Xian, Wei Xu, and their group came in full fury but scrambled away in a sorry state.
As the swirling dust rose into the sky, they gradually disappeared into the distance.
The tight tension in Ding Ling’s heartstrings eased a bit.
He was actually prepared to fight desperately alongside Zhao Yun, but now since there was no need to fight, it was all the better. It allowed him to save energy and stamina.
[Achievement Medal Acquired: You intimidated the Wolf Cavalry Legion!]
[Note: Since the Wolf Cavalry was formed, they have never feared anyone or any team. You are the only person who made them suffer a major setback and had to retreat in frustration.
This made them extremely furious and resentful!
So, although you subdued them, they are likely to seek revenge!]
The notification sound brushed past his ears.
Ding Ling was slightly taken aback, then relieved.
Seeking revenge is normal!
However, the Wolf Cavalry bears an Achievement Medal too, seems like no player has brushed off such a medal from them yet.
As for Wei Xu and Song Xian?
They did not.
It seems, like Hao Meng and the others, they were also brushed off by other players?
Ding Ling pondered, thinking:
’I originally planned to intentionally seek out some celebrities to brush Achievement Medals. It seems now there’s no need for that.’
No need to think about it; it’s clear.
Most likely, the Achievement Medals of these famous figures would have been brushed away by other players.
Though players don’t have cheats like Ding Ling, they have various means, and Ding Ling never has nor will ever underestimate them.
The only thing he can do is crazily activate cheats to leave the players far, far behind so they can’t even see his back!
In this way.
He doesn’t need to fear players’ conspiracies and tricks!
Because all conspiracies are mere paper tigers in the face of absolute power!!
’Therefore, improving strength is the top priority!’
Ding Ling’s route remains going south to Yangzhou to learn the Inner Refining Breathing Technique.
He’s also curious to see if mastering the Inner Refining Breathing Technique would indeed make one invincible in the world.
’Besides Yhiuu Ji and Zuo Ci, who else in the Three Kingdoms World might know the Inner Refining Breathing Technique?’
Naturally, Ding Ling asked Wang Yue about this matter, but Wang Yue was also unclear.
Even Wang Yue, a Sword God traversing Jiuzhou and a top existence on par with Tong Yuan, didn’t know, then it must be that he truly didn’t know.
However, Ding Ling knows some things from the book "Romance of the Three Kingdoms."
For example:
Apart from Yhiuu Ji and Zuo Ci, there are actually records of three other extraordinary masters: Li Yi, Master Zixu, and Nanhua Old Immortal.
Nanhua Old Immortal is the ’Immortal’ who gave the Taiping Sutra to Zhang Jiao.
Of course, the specifics remain to be verified by Ding Ling, but he recalls that the book records that Master Zixu and Li Yi seem to be in Yizhou!
It’s uncertain whether these two are still in Yizhou amid the massive influx of players now?
Ding Ling feels that if going to Yangzhou yields no results, he might consider a trip to Yizhou.
Clip-clop!
The three of them rode swiftly to the first ancient city.
Which was their destination: Yique City!
Ding Ling is a very decisive person, after seeing Wei Xu and his group leave, he also did not chase after them to see if they would truly stay ten li away from him!

Because he knew it was unrealistic, since Wei Xu and Song Xian had already set their hearts on killing him, how could they be so obedient? They would definitely follow from afar and look for a good opportunity to surround him.
Ding Ling was fully aware but still rode swiftly.
As long as he was fast enough.
If he could escape into the vast mountains, no matter how tough the Wolf Cavalry was, it would be pointless.
"Open the gate!"
Dong Huang had long since been ’tamed’ by Ding Ling and obediently stepped forward to shout:
"I’m the nephew of Prime Minister Dong, the leader of today’s court’s Imperial Guard, and a dignified Lord Imperial Attendant! Are you blind? Can’t you recognize me?"
The General defending the city seemed to recognize Dong Huang, upon hearing the voice, and scrutinized Dong Huang’s face closely, then gasped in shock:
"Lord Imperial Attendant, how come you’re here from Luoyang?!"
"None of your business! Quickly open the city gate, we need to hurry."
Dong Huang glared, staring angrily at the Defender General.
"Yes, yes, yes."
The Defender General seemed unaware of what had happened in Luoyang.
However, when a soldier approached and whispered something to him, his expression changed drastically, and he looked at the small soldier uncertainly:
"Are you sure?"
"This is a Court Officer’s letter, you can take a look."
The soldier handed over a letter.
The Defender General opened it.
Seeing that it indeed bore the large seal of a Court Officer, he hesitated slightly.
Dong Huang was getting anxious:
"Yang Ding, are you looking to die? Daring to make me, a dignified leader of the Imperial Guard, wait for you?! Are you tired of living?!"
Frightened all the way by Ding Ling’s intimidation.
Terrified by the Wolf Riders from the Bingzhou Army he looked down upon.
Now, having arrived at a city defended by his own people, he was unexpectedly treated with such disrespect!

chapters.title: Chapter 100: Sword Shield Soldiers Sent Flying
paragraphs: Is this looking down on him as the commander of the Imperial Guard?!
Does his role as the Lord Imperial Attendant truly have no deterrent power at all?!
A mere Defender General!!
Dong Huang was so furious as if one Buddha came out and two Buddhas ascended to heaven!
His nostrils were smoking, angrily pointing at Yang Ding:
"Yang Ding, if you don’t personally come out of the city and apologize to me properly today, I will make sure to deal with you in the future!"
"Lord Imperial Attendant."
Yang Ding leaned forward from the city wall to give a salute to Dong Huang, then pointed at Ding Ling and Zhao Yun, saying:
"Are they Ding Ling and Zhao Yun?"
"Hmm?!"
Dong Huang was stunned.
Yang Ding understood, especially when he saw Ding Ling holding a large bow, he immediately retracted his head.
Bang bang bang!
A group of sword shield soldiers swiftly moved forward, forming a ’Copper Wall and Iron Wall’ to protect Yang Ding.
Then Yang Ding spoke loudly from behind the ’Iron Wall’:
"Lord Imperial Attendant, I’m sorry. I cannot defy Prime Minister Dong’s orders. I cannot open the gate for you."
Dong Huang opened his mouth, both angry and shocked, embarrassed, anxious, uneasy, fearful... A mixed array of emotions was evident.
He looked at Ding Ling in awe, fearing that if Ding Ling became furious, he would stab him to death with a lance.
He had witnessed Ding Ling’s ferocity, absolutely terrifying!
"Alas."
Ding Ling sighed:
"Such a great Lord Imperial Attendant, yet so useless."
Dong Huang’s legs weakened with fear; if his leg hadn’t been injured, he would undoubtedly have jumped off his horse to kneel and apologize to Ding Ling.
It was so frightening:
"This, this, this... Hero..."
He stammered:
"I, I’ll try again. I definitely can."
He now hated Yang Ding.
Not only did he lose face, but he was also so embarrassed and startled!
He remembered this grudge.
"Hmm."
Ding Ling nodded slightly, indifferent.
So Dong Huang tried again, resorting to all kinds of insults, threats, and intimidation towards Yang Ding!
But it seemed to have no effect.
Ding Ling couldn’t help but take a closer look at Yang Ding.
Yang Ding stood tall at eight feet, broad and imposing, with a dignified appearance, three strands of long beard fluttering underneath his chin, extremely authoritative!
Standing behind the sword shield soldiers holding a spear, naturally commanding respect without anger.
Regarding this person.
Ding Ling had some impression.
The Romance of the Three Kingdoms recorded that Yang Ding was a fierce general under Dong Zhuo. After Dong Zhuo’s death, Yang Ding was promoted to General Anxi and General among other positions.
Such a person, now guarding the city gate at Yique City?
Isn’t this using a talented person for a mundane role?
However, considering that Yique City could be regarded as the first gateway near Luoyang, Ding Ling understood, seeing how much Dong Zhuo valued and trusted him.
"Enough."
Dong Huang shouted loudly, to the point that his throat was smoking, yet Yang Ding remained indifferent.
Ding Ling frowned slightly and called Dong Huang back.

Had it not been for considering that Dong Huang was still somewhat useful, Ding Ling might have cut down Dong Huang already. With just Yique City being like this, how would he handle other cities later?
Ding Ling was deeply skeptical.
Dong Huang, with his face pale, rode back to Ding Ling’s side, slightly bowed, appearing a bit timid, not daring to speak.
The boastful, arrogant demeanor he showed before Yang Ding was now completely different!
Yang Ding’s troops were taken aback, discussing:
"Who is that person? Why does the Lord Imperial Attendant seem so afraid of him?"
"Incredible. It’s rumored that Prime Minister Dong trusts and pampers his nephew immensely. Could it be he’s so cowardly now?!"
Players who knew the truth were frantically revealing the facts beside them.
They spoke of the various big things Ding Ling did in Luoyang!
Capturing Yang Ding’s troops’ minds and spirits, shocking them immensely. Each one was filled with disbelief, as if they heard a fairy tale, doubting reality!
Ding Ling naturally didn’t know he had already been added to the Court Officer’s blacklist, his information leaked by them, and he had been secretly targeted and plotted against several times.
Yang Ding refused to open the gate in time was also due to the Court Officer’s interference.
Ding Ling was completely unaware.
But he knew one thing, that many things wouldn’t be attained through peace.
Instead, they are won through force and truth!
He directly bent his bow and readied an arrow, aiming at Yang Ding, causing Yang Ding to duck more securely, his arrow point then turned toward the archers atop the city gate tower.
Whew!
Accompanied by the sound of tearing through the air, the arrow flew like a meteor through the sky, bang!
Directly hitting the archer’s forehead, piercing through his skull, a mighty force carrying him knocked over several archers along the way.
Ding Ling took the opportunity to shoot arrows one after another explosively.
Whew whew whew!
Zhao Yun immediately dismounted, handing arrows beside him.

Ding Ling bent the bow and shot arrows, like fierce electricity, like wild wind, with the screeching sound of whew whew whew, directly hitting the foreheads, chest, heart, and other vital spots of the archers;
Some died instantly;
Some were spared by the Heart-Protecting Mirror but were also blown backward due to the massive impact, some fainted, others were severely injured unable to get up.
There were hardly any entirely unharmed, most sustained injuries to varying degrees.
"Dodge!"
Yang Ding reacted, roaring:
"Archers, fire back!"
At this moment, Ding Ling was no more than sixty meters away from the city gate.
Very close.
At this proximity, he could perfectly unleash the power of the Five-Stone Bow!
But regular soldiers could barely pull a One-Stone Bow.
From sixty meters away, how could you reveal a stunning power?
Even if there were real experts, Zhao Yun was beside him, holding a Dragon Gall Silver Spear, always alert, every approaching arrow would be swiftly deflected by him.
Ding Ling didn’t need to care about these, focused solely on shooting down archers!
Once the archers were dealt with.
Ding Ling could directly use the Wall-Climbing Technique, ascend the city tower, and kill Yang Ding!
Ding Ling could also choose to walk around the city.
But it’d be too time-consuming.
This city, at least seven to eight miles in length or width, if he really went around it, Wei Xu’s Wolf Cavalry would likely catch up, not to mention more large troops might pursue him!
If Yang Ding also joined the chase.
Would he not be encircled from all sides?
Ding Ling could not afford to take such risks.
So killing Yang Ding was an inevitable move!
Whew whew!
Ding Ling’s arrows were not only swift but also powerful!
Often one arrow would severely injure or kill a person, with few just suffering minor injuries.
In just a moment.
Most of the three hundred-plus archers atop the city gate tower were either dead or injured.
More than a hundred archers had already been frightened into hiding, not daring to show themselves at all.
Ding Ling turned the arrowhead, aimed at other sword shield soldiers, spear shield soldiers.
This time he rode forward for quite a distance, getting closer to the sword shield soldiers.
At such close range shooting, boom!
Often one arrow seemed to have the force of a thousand pounds, regular sword shield soldiers couldn’t withstand it, even the shield along with the person was blasted away.
The city gate tower was in chaos.
Yang Ding was dumbfounded, trembling with fear:
"How can this person be so formidable?!"
He looked at the previous message soldier:
"How do you expect me to stop him?"

sentences.text: Is this looking down on him as the commander of the Imperial Guard?!
Does his role as the Lord Imperial Attendant truly have no deterrent power at all?!
A mere Defender General!!
Dong Huang was so furious as if one Buddha came out and two Buddhas ascended to heaven!
His nostrils were smoking, angrily pointing at Yang Ding:
"Yang Ding, if you don’t personally come out of the city and apologize to me properly today, I will make sure to deal with you in the future!"
"Lord Imperial Attendant."
Yang Ding leaned forward from the city wall to give a salute to Dong Huang, then pointed at Ding Ling and Zhao Yun, saying:
"Are they Ding Ling and Zhao Yun?"
"Hmm?!"
Dong Huang was stunned.
Yang Ding understood, especially when he saw Ding Ling holding a large bow, he immediately retracted his head.
Bang bang bang!
A group of sword shield soldiers swiftly moved forward, forming a ’Copper Wall and Iron Wall’ to protect Yang Ding.
Then Yang Ding spoke loudly from behind the ’Iron Wall’:
"Lord Imperial Attendant, I’m sorry.
I cannot defy Prime Minister Dong’s orders.
I cannot open the gate for you."
Dong Huang opened his mouth, both angry and shocked, embarrassed, anxious, uneasy, fearful...
A mixed array of emotions was evident.
He looked at Ding Ling in awe, fearing that if Ding Ling became furious, he would stab him to death with a lance.
He had witnessed Ding Ling’s ferocity, absolutely terrifying!
"Alas."
Ding Ling sighed:
"Such a great Lord Imperial Attendant, yet so useless."
Dong Huang’s legs weakened with fear; if his leg hadn’t been injured, he would undoubtedly have jumped off his horse to kneel and apologize to Ding Ling.
It was so frightening:
"This, this, this...
Hero..."
He stammered:
"I, I’ll try again.
I definitely can."
He now hated Yang Ding.
Not only did he lose face, but he was also so embarrassed and startled!
He remembered this grudge.
"Hmm."
Ding Ling nodded slightly, indifferent.
So Dong Huang tried again, resorting to all kinds of insults, threats, and intimidation towards Yang Ding!
But it seemed to have no effect.
Ding Ling couldn’t help but take a closer look at Yang Ding.
Yang Ding stood tall at eight feet, broad and imposing, with a dignified appearance, three strands of long beard fluttering underneath his chin, extremely authoritative!
Standing behind the sword shield soldiers holding a spear, naturally commanding respect without anger.
Regarding this person.
Ding Ling had some impression.
The Romance of the Three Kingdoms recorded that Yang Ding was a fierce general under Dong Zhuo.
After Dong Zhuo’s death, Yang Ding was promoted to General Anxi and General among other positions.
Such a person, now guarding the city gate at Yique City?
Isn’t this using a talented person for a mundane role?
However, considering that Yique City could be regarded as the first gateway near Luoyang, Ding Ling understood, seeing how much Dong Zhuo valued and trusted him.
"Enough."
Dong Huang shouted loudly, to the point that his throat was smoking, yet Yang Ding remained indifferent.
Ding Ling frowned slightly and called Dong Huang back.
Had it not been for considering that Dong Huang was still somewhat useful, Ding Ling might have cut down Dong Huang already.
With just Yique City being like this, how would he handle other cities later?
Ding Ling was deeply skeptical.
Dong Huang, with his face pale, rode back to Ding Ling’s side, slightly bowed, appearing a bit timid, not daring to speak.
The boastful, arrogant demeanor he showed before Yang Ding was now completely different!
Yang Ding’s troops were taken aback, discussing:
"Who is that person?
Why does the Lord Imperial Attendant seem so afraid of him?"
"Incredible.
It’s rumored that Prime Minister Dong trusts and pampers his nephew immensely.
Could it be he’s so cowardly now?!"
